title: Kierownik / Kierowniczka Warsztatu pojazdów ciężarowych i naczep
description:
Dlaczego TIP?

TIP Trailer Services to jedna z największych firm w Europie specjalizujących się w wynajmie, serwisowaniu i naprawach pojazdów ciężarowych oraz naczep. Obsługujemy klientów z branży transportowej i logistycznej, dysponując flotą liczącą ponad 90 000 jednostek.

Pracując w TIP, dołączysz do międzynarodowej organizacji oferującej stabilne zatrudnienie, ciekawe wyzwania oraz realne możliwości rozwoju zawodowego. Więcej informacji znajdziesz na stronie: .

Rozwiń swoją karierę razem z nami

W związku z rozwojem sieci warsztatów w Polsce poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Kierownika / Kierowniczki Warsztatu w Błoniu.

To doskonała okazja dla osób, które znają realia pracy serwisowej i są gotowe na kolejny krok w swojej karierze. Jeśli obecnie pracujesz jako Doradca/Doradczyni Serwisowy/-a, Starszy/-a Doradca / Doardczyni Serwisowy/-a, Mistrz/Mistrzyni Warsztatu, Lider / Liderka Zmiany lub Koordynator /Koordynatorka Serwisu i chcesz rozwijać się w kierunku zarządzania, ta rola może być właśnie dla Ciebie.

Nie oczekujemy wieloletniego doświadczenia na stanowisku kierowniczym. Najważniejsza jest dla nas praktyczna znajomość funkcjonowania warsztatu, umiejętność organizowania pracy zespołu oraz budowania dobrych relacji z klientami.

Warsztat TIP w Błoniu to około 10-osobowy zespół mechaników. Szukamy osoby, która chce aktywnie uczestniczyć w codziennym życiu serwisu, wspierać zespół w realizacji zadań i jednocześnie odpowiadać za sprawne funkcjonowanie warsztatu oraz osiągane wyniki.

Kogo szukamy?

Zapraszamy do aplikowania osoby, które:

  • posiadają doświadczenie w pracy serwisowej lub warsztatowej,

  • potrafią skutecznie organizować pracę zespołu i ustalać priorytety,

  • dobrze odnajdują się w kontakcie z klientami,

  • cieszą się autorytetem wśród współpracowników,

  • chcą rozwijać kompetencje menedżerskie i są gotowe przejąć większą odpowiedzialność.

Doświadczenie na stanowisku kierowniczym będzie dodatkowym atutem, ale nie jest warunkiem koniecznym. Jeśli czujesz, że nadszedł moment, aby przejść od koordynowania napraw do prowadzenia własnego zespołu, chętnie Cię poznamy.

Twój zakres obowiązków

  • odpowiedzialność za codzienne funkcjonowanie warsztatu. To stanowisko operacyjne, blisko ludzi i klientów

  • planowanie i koordynowanie pracy zespołu 10 mechaników

  • ustalanie priorytetów oraz pilnowanie terminowej realizacji napraw

  • pozostawanie w bezpośrednim kontakcie z klientami

  • wspieranie zespołu w rozwiązywaniu bieżących problemów

  • dbanie o jakość i bezpieczeństwo wykonywanych prac

  • rozwijanie zespołu i tworzenie środowiska sprzyjającego efektywnej współpracy

  • odpowiedzialność za sprawne funkcjonowanie oraz wyniki warsztatu

Nasze wymagania

  • doświadczenie na stanowisku Kierownika, Doradcy Serwisowego, Starszego Doradcy Serwisowego, Mistrza Warsztatu, Lidera Zmiany lub Koordynatora Serwisu

  • doświadczenie w branży samochodowej, transportowej lub serwisowej

  • dobra znajomość procesów obsługi i napraw pojazdów

  • umiejętność organizowania pracy i ustalania priorytetów,

  • umiejętności interpersonalne oraz gotowość do przejmowania odpowiedzialności,

  • umiejętność efektywnej współpracy zarówno z zespołem mechaników, jak i klientami,

  • motywacja do rozwoju w obszarze zarządzania zespołem i działalnością serwisową,

  • sprawna obsługa komputera oraz systemów wspierających pracę serwisu,

  • znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie umożliwiającym podstawową komunikację,

  • prawo jazdy kat. B

To oferujemy

  • zatrudnienie na podstawie umowy o pracę

  • atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie i pakiet benefitów (w tym: prywatną opiekę medyczną, kartę lunchową, kartę sportowo-kulturalną, Pracownicze Plany Kapitałowe)

  • dużą samodzielność w prowadzeniu warsztatu

  • możliwość zdobycia realnego doświadczenia w zarządzaniu zespołem i wynikiem serwisu

  • pracę w międzynarodowej organizacji i możliwości dalszego rozwoju wraz z rozwijającą się siecią TIP w Polsce

Prześlij swoje CV i wykonaj kolejny krok w karierze razem z TIP.

👉 Zobacz, dlaczego ludzie lubią pracować w TIP i poznaj nasze benefity – dowiedz się więcej tutaj!

title: Bygningskonstruktør til Matas Group
description:
Har du et skarpt blik for byggetekniske detaljer, og motiveres du af at finde gode, holdbare løsninger i praksis? Trives du med en hverdag, hvor du både arbejder med tekniske vurderinger, koordinering, ombygninger og dialog med butikker, udlejere og leverandører?

Hos Matas Group søger vi en bygningskonstruktør med stærk teknisk forståelse til vores nordiske team, der arbejder med etablering, ombygning og løbende udvikling af vores butikker. Du får en alsidig rolle med base på vores kontor i Allerød, hvor du bliver en vigtig byggefaglig sparringspartner i alt fra mindre ombygninger og tekniske problemstillinger til skader og større ændringer i butikkerne.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan kombinere byggeteknisk faglighed, struktur og sans for detaljen — og som samtidig har lyst til at tage ud i butikkerne, når en opgave kræver, at du ser forholdene med egne øjne.

En hverdag med byggeteknik, koordinering og praktiske løsninger
Som bygningskonstruktør får du en varieret hverdag, hvor du har flere forskellige opgaver og byggesager i gang samtidig. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om at sikre gode løsninger, høj kvalitet og velfungerende butikker.

Du vil blandt andet arbejde med:

  • planlægning og koordinering af mindre og mellemstore ombygninger

  • besigtigelse af butikker og vurdering af byggetekniske forhold

  • udarbejdelse og kvalificering af tekniske løsninger

  • koordinering af håndværkere, entreprenører og leverandører

  • indhentning og gennemgang af tilbud samt opfølgning på økonomi og udførelse

  • håndtering af bygningsskader, herunder vand, fugt, skimmel, ventilation og indeklima

  • kvalitetssikring og opfølgning, så opgaver bliver afsluttet ordentligt

Fælles for opgaverne er, at du er med til at sikre, at vores butikker fungerer byggeteknisk, og at ombygninger, reparationer og udbedringer bliver udført professionelt — helt ned i detaljen.

Du bliver bindeled mellem butikker, udlejere og leverandører
En vigtig del af rollen er dialogen med udlejere og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Du deltager i møder, tekniske gennemgange og afklaringer, hvor der skal findes gode løsninger på konkrete byggesager eller tekniske problemstillinger.

Det betyder, at du blandt andet skal:

  • repræsentere Matas i den byggetekniske dialog

  • deltage i møder og gennemgange af konkrete byggesager

  • afklare ansvar ved skader og bygningsmæssige forhold

  • følge op på arbejder og udbedringer, der håndteres af udlejer

  • vurdere og konstruktivt udfordre foreslåede tekniske løsninger

  • sikre dokumentation og opfølgning på aftaler

Du skal derfor være komfortabel med både den tekniske og den kommunikative del af rollen. Du behøver ikke kende svaret på alt, men du skal være nysgerrig, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og sikre, at vi ender med den rigtige og holdbare løsning.

Du har stærk byggeteknisk forståelse og følger tingene til dørs
Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet bygningskonstruktør eller har en tilsvarende byggeteknisk baggrund. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med byggeri, renovering, drift eller ombygninger — og gerne kendskab til AutoCAD.

Som person er du struktureret, detaljeorienteret og kvalitetsbevidst. Du kan bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver kører sideløbende, og du tager ansvar for at skabe fremdrift og følge dine opgaver helt til dørs. Du kommunikerer klart og professionelt og trives med samarbejde på tværs af butikker, udlejere, leverandører og interne afdelinger.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • har stærk byggeteknisk forståelse og sans for kvalitet

  • har erfaring med byggeri, renovering, drift eller ombygninger

  • kan læse og forstå tegninger og teknisk dokumentation

  • har erfaring med vand-, fugt- og skimmelproblematikker

  • kan vurdere håndværksmæssige løsninger og stille fagligt relevante spørgsmål

  • arbejder struktureret og kan koordinere flere faggrupper og opgaver

  • taler og skriver dansk og engelsk flydende

Din base er i Allerød — men du kommer også ud i butikkerne
Din base bliver på vores kontor i Allerød, hvor omkring 80 % af arbejdstiden vil være kontorbaseret. Her arbejder du blandt andet med tekniske vurderinger, koordinering, tilbud, tegninger, dokumentation og dialog med håndværkere og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

De resterende ca. 20 % vil du være ude af huset. Det kan fx være for at besigtige en butik før en ombygning, gennemgå en teknisk problemstilling, vurdere en skade, mødes med en udlejer eller følge op på kvaliteten af en færdig løsning. Arbejde om aftenen eller i weekender kan forekomme — også med kort varsel.

Da rollen indebærer besøg i butikker og på øvrige lokationer, er det et krav, at du har gyldigt kørekort kategori B, har egen bil, som kan anvendes i jobbet, og er indstillet på løbende kørsel til butikker, byggesager og møder rundt i landet.

En rolle med ansvar, variation og stærkt fællesskab
Hos os får du ikke to ens dage. Den ene dag arbejder du fra Allerød med tilbud og planlægning af en ombygning. Den næste vurderer du en vandskade. Og den tredje følger du op på, om en teknisk løsning i en butik er blevet udført korrekt.

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med højt engagement, stærkt fællesskab og en uformel tone, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og arbejder målrettet for at skabe gode resultater. Hos Matas Group får du gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling — og naturligvis også adgang til attraktive medarbejderfordele.

Klar til at søge?
Trives du med ansvar, variation og en kombination af byggefaglig fordybelse, koordinering og praktisk problemløsning? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Om Matas Group
Matas Group er nordisk leder inden for skønhed og velvære med en omsætning på +8 mia. kr., +500 butikker, +4.000 medarbejdere, +5 mio. loyalitetsmedlemmer og webshops i Danmark, Sverige, Norge og Finland. Matas Group opererer med to detailbannere på tværs af markederne: Matas i Danmark og KICKS i Sverige, Norge og Finland og tilbyder en bred portefølje af eksterne brands, egne brands og fokus på høj service, personlig- og ekspertrådgivning. Matas Group er noteret på Nasdaq OMX Copenhagen.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
N.B. This role is open to remote candidates within the UK only.

About Flash Pack:

When was the last time you made a new friend? The quality of your relationships is the single most important factor for your mental health. Travel has a unique ability to fast-forward the friendship-making process, which is why we’re on a mission to create one million meaningful friendships using the power of travel and technology as a platform for human connection.

We create curated social adventures for solo travellers in their 30s, 40s and 50s. Since launching in 2014, we’ve seen impressive year-on-year growth and become the category leader in a thriving, rapidly expanding market with the majority of our business now in the US.

We’re well-funded, we’ve shaken up an outdated industry, and we see ourselves as a friendship company far more than a travel company. Our culture is down-to-earth, hard-working and compassionate, built by exceptional people who care deeply about doing work we’re proud of.

You can find out more about our culture and life at Flash Pack here.

The Role:

At Flash Pack, design isn't just about UX. It's about giving Flashpackers the feeling that they've just walked into a hotel lobby, that the adventure starts the second they hit the website, not just when they step off the plane.

You'll work closely with our Co-founder, Head of Product and Engineering team to take ideas from early thinking through to launch and iteration.

You'll own the end to end design process, helping us solve meaningful customer problems while raising the quality bar across everything we ship. You'll work within our established brand rather than own it, collaborating closely with colleagues who own imagery and visual craft to create product experiences that feel beautifully executed, premium in every detail, and unmistakably Flash Pack.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role and a rare opportunity to be the only Product Designer in the business. That means you'll have genuine influence over the product experience without needing to manage people or build a design function.

We're looking for someone who loves doing the work, simplifying flows like checkout, refining interactions, moving with purposeful momentum and bringing conviction to design decisions. You'll use research, customer insight and data to inform your decisions, but never at the expense of judgement.

We want someone with exceptional UX, strong instincts for flows, interaction and structure, and a sharp visual eye. Someone who has shipped consumer products people call beautiful and can explain why they work, who knows when a screen feels like Flash Pack and when it feels like a booking engine, and who believes great design is often what customers remember long after they've forgotten the feature itself.

In line with our salary framework, the salary for this role is £83,000–£89,500 depending on experience. This is a remote-flexible role. In practice, we come together as a team in London every 6–8 weeks, with the rest of the time spent working remotely from within the UK.

Where you will spend your time:

  • Owning end to end design for key initiatives, starting with checkout, trip pages, and presenting new premium stays well

  • Making checkout simpler and faster, and raising the bar on interaction quality and conversion

  • Partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data and Marketing to shape solutions

  • Using quantitative data and qualitative insight to inform design decisions

  • Rapidly iterating in ambiguous, fast moving environments

  • Challenging product direction constructively and proposing better alternatives

  • Taking initiative to identify problems worth solving, not just responding to briefs

What we’d love to see from you:

You'll bring a portfolio that demonstrates outstanding craft, not just well documented processes. We'd love to see examples of work you're most proud of, including at least one product you'd call beautiful. We want to understand what you changed, why you made those decisions, and how your design improved the feel of the experience as well as the outcome.

  • You'll be a collaborative team member and know that design doesn't happen in a bubble

  • You will have strong hands on product design experience in a startup or scale up environment

  • Exceptional UX, with real depth in flows, interaction and structure

  • A strong visual eye. You've shipped consumer products people describe as beautiful and can explain why they work, though art direction or a classic brand design background isn't required here

  • An instinct for emotional flair, so you know when a screen feels like Flash Pack and when it feels like a booking engine

  • A clear point of view and the confidence to advocate for better experiences, even when they're harder to achieve

  • Significant hands on experience shipping consumer digital products in fast moving, high growth environments, comfortable owning problems from discovery through to delivery

  • Some experience with app design is a plus. We're likely to build an app in 2027, though this isn't a pure app role as checkout and web work stay central

  • A strong bias toward action and momentum over perfection. You are happy to fail and learn, and happy operating in ambiguity

  • Naturally curious about AI and already using it thoughtfully to improve your design practice, speed up exploration and increase your impact

We're after the right person and if you don't quite hit all the criteria, we'd still encourage you to apply. We'd love to chat and see if you could be a great fit for Flash Pack

Interview Process 🛠️:

Our interviews take place on Google Meet and usually consist of the following stages:

  • Introductory chat with our talent team to see if there is a match (30-45 mins)

  • A competency-based interview with the hiring manager to hear more about your background and experience and to give you a deep dive into the role (~60 mins)

  • A case study and presentation with the hiring manager and key stakeholders. Take our checkout or a trip page, make it simpler, make it feel like Flash Pack, and tell us what you cut (60 mins)

  • Meet with one of our founders for any final questions you or we have (~60 mins)

Diversity and Inclusion

We’re led by a BAME, female CEO and building a diverse and inclusive team is incredibly important to us which is why we are building diversity and inclusion into the company hiring, performance and progression framework.

We see our diversity as a key competitive advantage which is why we are committed to hiring top talent regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age or status as an individual with a disability.

title: End-to-End Test and Integration Engineer – 4G/5G Mobile Core
description:
About us

Join us at Orange Business!

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.

Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

About the role

As part of our CNaaS (Core Network As A Service) program, we are looking for an End-to-End Test and Integration Engineer to support the integration, testing, and validation of 4G/5G Core network solutions. The role covers the end-to-end validation of network functions and services, as well as L2/L3 investigation and support.

The Core network platform includes cloud-native network functions deployed in a Kubernetes environment. You will work with engineering, operations, and component expert teams to ensure that the platform and its services meet functional, interoperability, performance, and stability requirements.

About you

Main Responsibilities

  • Set up and maintain the test environments required to validate 4G/5G Core platforms, including remote access to lab environments.
  • Define and execute end-to-end integration and service validation tests for 4G/5G Core network functions.
  • Validate key 4G/5G services and procedures, including registration, authentication, PDU session establishment, mobility, and roaming, as applicable.
  • Perform integration testing following upgrades or configuration changes to 4G/5G Core components, in coordination with relevant technical teams.
  • Investigate complex issues across the 5G Core, using functional and protocol testing, traces, logs, and performance indicators.
  • Coordinate root-cause analysis and resolution with component, infrastructure, and operations teams.
  • Support the automation of recurring test activities using scripting and DevOps tools.
  • Contribute to the configuration and improvement of observability capabilities, including monitoring, logging, and alerting.
  • Monitor the performance, availability, and stability of qualification, pre-production, and production environments.
  • Maintain test plans, procedures, results, and technical documentation.
  • This job position requires on-call and 24/7 support on rotational basis.

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of 4G/5G SACore architecture, network functions, and end-to-end procedures.
  • Experience with4G/5G SA Core integration, testing, or validation in a telecom environment.
  • Good understanding of 3GPP specifications and interfaces.
  • Experience troubleshooting control-plane and user-plane issues using traces and protocol analysis tools.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native or virtualized environments.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, including CI/CD, deployment automation, and configuration management.
  • Scripting skills for test automation, preferably in Python, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of security principles and incident management.

Profile

  • Engineering degree or equivalent in telecommunications, computer science, or a related field.
  • Significant experience in testing and integrating mobile core network solutions, with a focus on 4G/5G Core.
  • Practical experience working with containerized or virtualized telecom platforms.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary technical teams.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to document technical processes and findings clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

What we offer

  • Global Opportunities: Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).
  • Professional Development: Training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.
  • Career Growth: Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.
  • Caring and Daring Culture: Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity & inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.
  • Reward Programs: Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

Only your skills matter

Regardless of your age, gender identity, race, ethnic origin, religion/belief, sexual orientation, marital status, neuroatypia, disability, veteran status or appearance, we encourage diversity within our teams because it is a strength for the collective and a vector of innovation. Orange Group is a disabled-friendly company and equal opportunity employer: don't hesitate to tell us about your specific needs.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
### About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

### **About the role**

As a Salesforce Administrator at Forto, you will be a central point of contact for multiple departments, including our Commercial, Legal, and Product teams. Your primary focus will be to ensure our Sales Cloud platform runs efficiently and scales reliably alongside our business needs.

In this position, you will work closely with colleagues to understand their daily processes and help gather requirements for our platform roadmap. We are looking for someone who can review our current setup objectively and identify practical, sustainable improvements.

Because you will collaborate across the business, clear communication is essential. You should feel comfortable discussing system changes with non-technical stakeholders, explaining the reasoning behind different design options, and outlining how those changes will practically affect their daily work

### **Key Responsibilities**

  • Collaborate across teams: Work closely with a multi-disciplinary team (Engineering, Administration, and Product) to align the Salesforce platform with our business goals.
  • Bridge business and technical needs: Participate in discovery sessions to gather and validate requirements, translating them into scalable solutions that prioritize a clean user experience.
  • Configure and build: Perform declarative Salesforce configuration using best practices, including Flow, permission sets, dynamic layouts, approval processes, and custom reporting.
  • Manage the day-to-day: Handle core system administration, including user management, resolving support tickets, and facilitating user training.
  • Ensure data integrity: Monitor and improve data quality using validation rules and automation, and perform mass data updates using ETL tools (e.g., Salesforce Data Loader, G-Connector).
  • Oversee deployments and environments: Manage our sandbox environments and support the wider team with release deployments.
  • Support third-party tools: Maintain and troubleshoot business application integrations, such as Slack, Outreach, and Clay.
  • Document our systems: Create and maintain clear technical documentation to ensure our platform architecture remains transparent and accessible to the team.

### **Required Skills and Experience**

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Administrator, ideally within a complex stakeholder environment.
  • Core Certifications: You hold the baseline Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.
  • Solution Design: Experience of creating best-practice declarative solutions, particularly Flows, Lightning Apps, Validation Rules, and Approval Processes.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Experience working directly with diverse stakeholder groups. You know how to build trust, ask the right questions, and manage expectations.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. You are comfortable translating technical requirements clearly for non-technical colleagues.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

  • Advanced Certifications: Additional certifications, such as Certified Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder are a strong plus.
  • Code Familiarity: Any experience with Apex and/or related languages would be a positive.
  • Integrations: Experience of using/managing integrations with third party apps such as Hubspot, Outreach, Clay, and Demodesk would be highly desirable.

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit!

### **Why work with us?**

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

title: MANAGER IST - Clinical Systems - (Clin Doc/CPOM)
description:
Overview

About the Role

The Manager of IST serves as a key administrative partner to the deparrtment. This position is responsible for planning and maintaining work systems, procedures, and policies that enable and encourage the optimum performance of its people and other resources within a business unit.

University Hospital is a dynamic, mission driven, at the heart of one of the region’s leading academic medical centers. We are passionate about building an inclusive, supportive, and innovative workplace where employees thrive and make a real impact. If you're energized by collaboration, purpose-driven work, and the opportunity to contribute to meaningful changes in healthcare, you'll find a rewarding environment in our department.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Oversees and manages the evaluation, implementation, analysis, and coordination of IT systems employed by University Hospital
  • Identifies opportunities for operating efficiency, cost containment and reduction, outcomes, improved communications, patientcare, patient safety and fiscal management that are supported through automated systems.
  • Partners with senior leadership to ensure that all technology-related policies and guidelines are current
  • Leads employees to meet the organization’s expectations for productivity, quality, and goal accomplishment
  • Maintains transparent communication; appropriately communicates organizational information through department
  • Understands and adheres to University Hospital’s compliance standards as they appear in University Hospital's Corporate Compliance Policy, Code of Conduct and Conflict of Interest Policy

Qualifications

What You’ll Bring

Required:

title: Case Manager I - Workforce Development
description:
Job Summary

The Case Manager I - Workforce Development provides integrated, healing-centered case management services to participants across all three cohort tracks of the Digital Technology Workforce Development Program: a women’s healing-centered cohort, a co-ed cohort including justice-experienced adults and individuals with histories of homelessness, and a transitional age youth cohort (ages 18–30).

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Key Areas of Responsibility:

  • Conduct comprehensive, trauma-informed intake assessments and develop individualized, goal-oriented service plans for each participant across all three cohort tracks, identifying both barriers and strengths.
  • Provide ongoing, individualized case management through regular one-on-one meetings, check-ins, and responsive outreach, maintaining meaningful contact with every participant across all three cohorts.
  • Provide advocacy and linkage to needed or supportive services and resources including mental health services, rental assistance, food access, benefits enrollment, re-entry legal aid, childcare, immigration legal services, and transportation.
  • Respond to urgent requests for assistance from participants and manage crisis response across multiple population types with appropriate clinical judgment, safety planning, and coordination with licensed mental health and crisis staff.

Essential Duties:

  • Participate in and help facilitate regular multi-disciplinary case conferences with the Program Manager, Career Coach, and an expanded network of specialists including: youth development counselors, licensed mental health clinicians, gang intervention and street outreach counselors, re-entry case managers, probation liaisons, TAY housing specialists, and other SJC program staff.
  • Work closely with re-entry case managers, probation officers, and legal service providers to ensure justice involved participants receive coordinated support that addresses both reintegration needs and workforce development goals.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and comprehensive case notes and participant records across all three cohort tracks in SJC’s data management systems.
  • Ensure compliance with program, agency, and funder requirements related to client data, confidentiality, and documentation standards.

Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed are designed to provide typical examples of the work performed; not all duties and responsibilities assigned are included here, nor is it expected that all similar positions will be assigned every duty and responsibility.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Ability to work effectively in multi-disciplinary team environments, engaging clinical staff, youth counselors, gang intervention specialists, and instructional staff as collaborative partners.
  • Skilled in conflict resolution, de-escalation, and safety planning across diverse and sometimes high-risk participant circumstances.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and documentation skills; able to balance a high volume of participant contacts while maintaining professional case records.

Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience with highly vulnerable populations in a non-profit, social services, or workforce development setting.

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

title: Associate Director of Site Operations - Care Campus
description:
About the Role

The Skid Row Care Campus is a comprehensive, low-barrier service center providing individuals experiencing homelessness with access to hygiene facilities, case management, health and behavioral health services, and connections to housing and other essential resources. The Campus offers a safe, welcoming, and trauma-informed environment that promotes dignity, stability, and pathways to long-term housing.

The Associate Director of Site Operations is a senior operational leader responsible for the day-to-day readiness and coordination of the Care Campus. The position oversees Safety, Hygiene Services, and other assigned operational functions and directly leads the managers responsible for those areas.

This role ensures that Campus operations are appropriately staffed, coordinated, supplied, and prepared to support safe, reliable, participant-centered services. Key areas of accountability include staffing and coverage, participant flow, Safety and Hygiene operations, emergency preparedness, incident response, facilities coordination, third-party security coordination, and continuity of operations.

Key Responsibilities

Campus Operations & Readiness

  • Lead the day-to-day coordination of assigned Campus operations and maintain visibility into staffing, participant volume, service demand, site conditions, safety concerns, and other operational factors.
  • Ensure effective opening, operating, shift-transition, and closing procedures across operational areas.
  • Resolve significant cross-functional operational issues and maintain continuity of essential services during staffing shortages, facility disruptions, emergencies, and other unexpected situations.
  • Identify operational barriers that affect participant access, safety, service delivery, or employee effectiveness and drive timely solutions.

People Leadership & Workforce Management

  • Provide direct supervision, coaching, development, and performance management to operational managers.
  • Establish clear expectations and accountability for staffing, scheduling, attendance, call-offs, timekeeping, training, performance, and routine employee relations.
  • Monitor vacancies, overtime, turnover, attendance trends, and other workforce indicators that may affect service delivery.
  • Establish staffing and contingency systems that support reliable operations seven days per week, including periods of high call-offs, vacancies, emergencies, and increased participant volume.
  • Ensure shift leaders understand their authority and escalation responsibilities when senior leadership is not on site.

Safety & Emergency Operations

  • Provide leadership oversight of the Care Campus Safety function and Safety management.
  • Ensure appropriate Safety staffing, deployment, de-escalation practices, incident response, documentation, communication, and leadership coverage.
  • Promote a trauma-informed approach to safety that protects participants, employees, visitors, and property while maintaining participant dignity.
  • Serve as a key operational leader during medical emergencies, overdoses, behavioral health crises, fire, earthquake, utility outages, workplace violence, security incidents, and major service disruptions.
  • Review significant incidents and trends and ensure appropriate corrective action, operational follow-up, and preparedness.

Hygiene Services & Participant Flow

  • Provide leadership oversight of Hygiene Services and ensure shower, restroom, and laundry services are appropriately staffed, supplied, safe, sanitary, accessible, and effectively managed.
  • Monitor service capacity, wait times, participant flow, sanitation, and operational barriers affecting access.
  • Coordinate operational strategies across waiting areas, common spaces, hygiene areas, entrances, exits, and other high-volume locations.
  • Ensure operational practices support respectful, trauma-informed, participant-centered engagement and effective connections to program services when needs are identified.

Facilities, Security & Infrastructure

  • Serve as the primary site-level liaison with organizational Operations and Facilities leadership regarding building and infrastructure needs.
  • Coordinate operational planning around repairs, inspections, utilities, equipment, maintenance, vendors, and facility disruptions.
  • Develop temporary operating plans when physical spaces, building systems, equipment, or utilities are unavailable.
  • Coordinate with organizational Operations regarding third-party security, including site protocols, emergency procedures, handoffs, performance concerns, and emerging coverage needs.

Performance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor operational indicators related to staffing, service availability, incidents, safety, hygiene utilization, and other assigned areas.
  • Maintain accurate operational documentation and support funder monitoring, audits, site reviews, corrective-action plans, and compliance activities.
  • Use staffing information, incident trends, participant feedback, manager input, and operational observations to identify recurring risks and improve systems.
  • Partner across Programs, Facilities, Human Resources, Compliance, Finance, Contracts, IT, Data, Safety, and other functions to resolve complex operational issues.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, public administration, human services, nonprofit management, operations management, or a related field preferred.
  • At least five years of progressively responsible experience in operations, homeless services, social services, healthcare, residential services, facilities-based programs, or a related environment.
  • At least three years of supervisory or management experience, including responsibility for managers, supervisors, or large frontline teams.
  • Experience overseeing complex operations in a high-volume, extended-hours, 24/7, residential, shelter, healthcare, hospitality, or comparable environment strongly preferred.

title: Staff Engineer, Deployment Architecture onPrem
description:
About Qevlar AI

Qevlar is a B2B SaaS scale-up on a mission to boost the productivity of cybersecurity teams with Artificial Intelligence. We build an AI platform that transitions Security Operations Centers from reactive to proactive units through autonomous security alert investigations.

In just three years, we have:

  • Raised a total of $44m in series-A & seed rounds from EQT Ventures, Forgepoint Capital and Partech

  • Deployed our solution with major Enterprises such as Sodexo and GlobalConnect, and leading MSSPs like Orange Cyberdefense

  • Expanded to the US market with a growing North American presence

  • Ended 2025 with a strong multi-million dollar ARR and ambitious goals for 2026

We are launching Qevlar on-premise for customers who cannot let their security data leave their perimeter. Your job is to turn a signed bundle into a running production platform inside their datacentre, and to make each deployment faster than the last.

On these accounts the critical path is rarely the software. It is the security review board, the firewall change request, the PKI team, the change advisory board. Someone has to own that path, with enough technical credibility to be taken seriously by the customer's infrastructure architects: this is your role.

What You Will do

  • Run our on-prem deployments end to end, several in parallel, each on its own customer timeline, from technical kickoff to production sign-off. The first one lands within your first few months.

  • Own the pre-flight. Build and run the prerequisites assessment: Kubernetes distribution, GPU capacity, storage, identity provider, network egress, certificate authority. Every gap surfaces before install week, not during it.

  • Navigate the customer's organisation. Security reviews, firewall change requests, PKI, CAB cycles. You hold the schedule even though you control neither the resources nor the decisions.

  • Treat documentation as the product. We cannot log into our customers' environments. The install guide, the prerequisites matrix and the troubleshooting runbook are what these users actually consume. The acceptance test is a customer engineer completing an install without calling us.

  • Own the release train to customers. Version announcements, upgrade campaigns, migration planning across a fleet where every customer sits on a different release.

  • Run L3 triage. Qualify the issue, reproduce it from a support bundle, and escalate with everything engineering needs. You are the reason our engineers can debug an environment they will never see.

  • Close the loop. Every friction point you hit in the field becomes a documented requirement, a product ticket or a change to the bundle. The playbook gets shorter every quarter.

  • Cut the cycle time. Signature to production should shrink measurably across your first four deployments. That number is yours.

Who you are

You have:

  • Deployed complex software into large enterprise datacentres, as a deployment architect, delivery lead, professional services engineer or technical program manager. You know what a six-week PKI ticket feels like.

  • A real technical floor. You read a values.yaml , debug a TLS handshake, explain what a proxy with a custom CA does to a container, and know what an OpenShift SCC is. You will not write the feature, but you will understand exactly why it broke.

  • Run several technical projects in parallel, each with its own stakeholders, timeline and definition of done, without losing any of them.

  • Serious writing skills. Documentation a stranger can execute without calling you is the bar we hold you to.

  • Composure in front of infrastructure architects, security officers and CISOs. These conversations are technical, adversarial by design, and decisive for the account.

  • Fluent English and French.

Why join us

  • Work on meaningful problems with real-world impact in cybersecurity

  • A high-impact role in a small, international, fast-moving team where your contributions directly shape the company and its success

  • Shape the future of a product already making noise in AI + security circles

  • A company culture that values autonomy and creativity

  • Opportunity for equity and early ownership

  • We’re flexible on location - you can either work from home or join your colleagues in our beautiful office in Paris’ 9th arrondissement.

If you’re excited about helping security teams adopt cutting-edge AI, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s build the future of cybersecurity together!

Hiring process

  1. Intro Call

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Technical interview

  4. References and Offer

title: IT Security Specialist

title: SPA, Türkiye Diplomacy and Global Analysis, Global Clean Power Diplomacy (London preferred / Brussels & Berlin possible)
description:
SPA, Türkiye Diplomacy and Global Analysis, Global Clean Power Diplomacy, London (Brussels & Berlin possible) - Internal Opportunity


The Global Clean Power Diplomacy team is seeking a Senior Policy Advisor to steer E3G’s engagement on Türkiye’s energy transition and climate diplomacy and to lead its data analysis and visualisation work on the global energy transition. The successful applicant will lead the team’s work on and with Türkiye which will continue to be essential following COP31. The role will communicate energy transition analysis into clear, policy-relevant insight, and will work closely with team members, partners and external stakeholders to ensure that evidence and strategic narrative underpin the team’s advice and diplomatic engagement.


Background

E3G is looking for an experienced candidate to lead the Global Clean Power Diplomacy team’s data and evidence work on power system transitions across national, regional and global contexts. The role will have responsibility for leading E3G’s country strategy on Türkiye, maintaining relationships across government, regulators, business and civil society and building out a post-COP31 strategy, as well as work on the energy transition in Türkiye. The role holder will translate complex quantitative and qualitative material into accessible outputs that inform policy engagement, identifying the opportunities and risks that shape the pace of the energy transition. They will set standards for data quality and governance, and act as the team’s point of reference on analytical tools and methods.


Key Responsibilities

  • Türkiye strategy and leadership: Lead E3G’s engagement on Türkiye’s energy transition and climate diplomacy. Shape and deliver the country strategy, advise on engagement opportunities, and maintain trusted relationships with ministries, regulators, business associations and civil society. Liaise with civil society and policy actors in Türkiye to support E3G’s regional influence on the energy transition. Design and deliver convening that connects Turkish actors to international climate networks, including roundtables, delegation visits and events at moments such as London Climate Action Week.
  • COP31 Presidency and multilateral engagement: Track and analyse Türkiye’s COP31 Presidency and its wider multilateral climate positions. Produce briefings, blogs, talking points and meeting notes for Presidency and delegation engagements, and represent E3G at relevant international moments at COP31 and beyond.
  • Türkiye coal-to-clean analysis: Maintain E3G’s evidence base on Türkiye’s power sector, covering the coal fleet and project pipeline, renewables deployment, grid investment and system flexibility. Analyse the political economy the energy transition, including employment, regional and financial dimensions, and develop credible policy options and sequencing for a just transition.
  • Data analysis and visualisation: Lead the team’s data analysis and visualisation work across coal, gas and renewable energy portfolios, translating large energy transition datasets into clear and accessible charts, graphs and dashboards that inform the coal-to-clean strategy. Act as the go-to expert on analytical tools such as Excel and Tableau, and advise colleagues on best practice in evidence-led storytelling.
  • Insight development & strategic storytelling: Develop structured, policy-relevant insights from global energy transition data. Provide analysis that turns complex trends into actionable intelligence for decision-makers, ensuring that evidence underpins E3G’s clean transition work. Ensure that visualisations, reports and briefing materials align with E3G’s narratives and are tailored to target audiences for maximum impact. Supervise the team’s major analysis outputs, from scoping through to publication.
  • Internal collaboration: Take an active part in E3G-wide discussions and initiatives on data use and storytelling, sharing expertise across teams to strengthen the organisation’s capability in data-driven communication.


Person Description

  • You are intellectually curious and motivated to contribute to the clean energy transition.
  • You are committed to high-quality outputs and use collaboration to achieve better outcomes.
  • You are confident in setting strategic priorities and comfortable working in a team of diverse personalities.
  • You enjoy complex analytical work, take ownership of the systems and processes behind it, and care as much about how findings are communicated as about the findings themselves.
  • You are able to identify and engage a wide range of external stakeholders, understand their perspectives and communicate your ideas persuasively.
  • You take pride in supporting the development of colleagues.


Experience and Skills

  • An undergraduate degree in a relevant discipline, such as climate change, international relations, energy, economics, politics, development, and geography. A post-graduate qualification in an appropriate discipline is desirable but not essential.
  • Relevant professional experience in a related field, such as policy or research work within governmental or international organisations, civil society, think tanks, or research institutes.
  • Working knowledge of Türkiye’s energy and climate policy landscape and of the actors that shape it, together with an established network, or the ability to build one quickly, among relevant government, business and civil society contacts. Familiarity with the UNFCCC process and COP dynamics is desirable.
  • Strong research, analytical and thinking skills, with creativity and confidence in working with complex information. Skilled in numerical analysis and adept at handling, structuring and presenting data. Proven ability to communicate data and political trends effectively through written and visual outputs.
  • Demonstrable experience working with relevant tools including Excel, Tableau and Flourish. Familiarity with data management and governance practice, including maintaining datasets and analytical processes to a consistent standard.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. Fluency in Turkish is desirable given the country focus of the role.


What we offer

  • Permanent contract, full-time position.
  • Flexible working arrangements and a hybrid working approach.
  • 25 vacation days + additional leave between Christmas and New Year.
  • E3G offers a reward and benefits package which compares well with other organisations within our sector.


E3G is unable to provide any relocation assistance to candidates who would need to move in order to take up this position. Occasional international travel may be required from time to time. E3G will require candidates to demonstrate that they have the right to live and work in the jurisdiction in which E3G employs them.


London

  • The indicative salary range in the UK for this position is from £52,862 to £57,000 per annum, dependant on experience.
  • Cycle scheme.


Brussels

  • The indicative salary range in Brussels for this position is from €4,144.10 to €4,407.30 per month, dependant on experience - with holiday pay and a 13th month.
  • Mobile phone and contract, lunch and eco vouchers, hospitalisation and travel insurance, travel expense reimbursement (bicycle or public transport).


Berlin

  • The indicative salary range in Berlin for this position is from €56,876 to €60,500 per annum, dependant on experience.
  • BahnCard50 travel cover.


How to apply

Please submit your application in English. Please include:

  • Your CV.
  • A cover letter of no more than one page outlining why you are interested in applying for this role.


The deadline for applications is at 23:59 on Tuesday the 3rd of November.


E3G values diversity and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or ethnic background. We aim to build an inclusive workforce that is reflective of the populations we support, and actively seek applications from those who are marginalized and underrepresented. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities.

title: Service Coordinator
description:
Overview

Premier Equipment is the largest full-service John Deere dealership in Ontario serving agriculture, lawn care, golf, commercial grounds, and compact construction customers across Ontario. With 20 locations and over 190 skilled technicians, we deliver innovative equipment, expert service, and unmatched support. Since the 1950s, we’ve grown with a clear purpose: To be the best part of our customer’s day by improving their business and lifestyle. Whether it’s solving equipment issues or offering new technology, we’re here to make their day better—and yours too.

It’s an exciting time to join Premier. Come grow with us.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Service Coordinator, you’ll be at the heart of the service operation—making sure every work order, invoice, and technician hour is tracked and processed accurately. You'll play a key administrative role, ensuring smooth communication between departments, organizing service records, and monitoring performance metrics like payroll and WIP. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction, you'll also handle incoming calls, support service scheduling, and assist with event planning or special projects. Whether it’s billing, coordinating trucking, or improving workflow, your attention to detail and dedication to excellent service will help the team deliver a top-tier customer experience every day.

Responsibilities

  • Provide Premier Equipment’s customers with an above-average level of support, encouraging loyalty and professionalism while enhancing the customer experience.

  • Support customer service and corporate initiatives on a daily basis.

  • Promote teamwork and a “Customer First” mindset across Service, Parts, and Sales departments within and between branches.

  • Perform all administrative tasks for the Service Department, including opening, maintaining, commenting on, invoicing, and filing internal, external, and warranty work orders.

  • Ensure all accounts payable invoices use the purchase order system and are posted to the appropriate work order; apply proper G/L account numbers to all invoices before forwarding to Accounts Payable.

  • Monitor the Service Department’s payroll daily to ensure accuracy in technician hours and labor performance.

  • Monitor WIP (Work In Process) daily to maintain a minimum 100% WIP ratio, aiming toward the benchmark of 75%.

  • Ensure all miscellaneous charges (e.g., service accessories, trucking, service calls, dyno charges) are applied appropriately to each work order.

  • Assist the Service Manager in reducing lost time.

  • Identify and support opportunities to reduce departmental expenses through process improvements or cost-saving measures.

  • Schedule all service department trucking as needed.

  • Promote a safe, clean, and healthy work environment in the Service Department.

  • Assist with incoming store phone calls.

  • Support the Service Manager with special events and projects as required.

Qualifications

  • Basic understanding of accounting practices.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and standard internet applications.

  • Customer service experience or skills.

  • Knowledge of general office procedures.

  • Strong organizational and communication abilities.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

  • Availability for rotating Saturdays.

  • Valid driver’s license.

Preferred

  • General understanding of mechanical or technical terms.

  • Prior experience in a dealership or service department.

Education

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

At Premier Equipment, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, accessible work environment, where all employees feel valued, respected and supported. We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities as part of its recruitment process. If you are contacted to arrange for an interview, please advise us if you require an accommodation.

#HP02

What's in It for You

At Premier Equipment, we invest in our people and reward their contributions with a competitive and supportive compensation package, including:

  • Comprehensive Health & Dental Coverage (includes vision and paramedical services)
  • Company-Matched RRSP
  • Annual Profit Sharing
  • Boot & Tool Allowance
  • Apprenticeship Scholarships
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Company Vehicle (for qualifying positions)

Compensation

Placement within the wage range is based on skills, experience and qualifications.

Applicants with more or less experience and qualifications may be placed outside the salary range.

Sales positions will have a commission component as well.

Salary Range

CAD $53,000.00 - CAD $65,000.00 /Yr.

title: Brigádník/brigádnice (DPP), Praha Westfield Černý Most
description:
Jako Brigádník/brigádnice v H&M budete součástí týmu a pomůžete zákazníkům najít to, co hledají. Přivítáte je v prodejně, poradíte jim s výběrem a zajistíte, aby měli skvělý zákaznický zážitek. Svou energií a přístupem přispějete nejen k vlastnímu úspěchu, ale i k úspěchu celého týmu.

  • Pomáhat zákazníkům s výběrem a sdílet své znalosti o módě
  • Spolupracovat s kolegy a zajistit, aby byl obchod vždy přehledný a dobře zásobený
  • Podílet se na otevírání a zavírání prodejny
  • Reprezentovat značku H&M s pozitivním přístupem

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAT

Naše prodejny jsou srdcem společnosti – místem, kde zákazníci zažívají naši značku na vlastní kůži. Jako součást dynamického týmu, který tvoří Prodejní poradci, Store Manageři, Visual Merchandiseři a další kolegové, budete přispívat k příjemné atmosféře a skvělému zákaznickému servisu. Spolupracovat budete nejen se svým týmem, a společně se budete podílet na úspěchu. Pomůžete zákazníkům cítit se sebevědomě a vyjádřit svůj styl – a tím přispějete k tomu, aby byla móda dostupná a udržitelná pro všechny.

KOHO HLEDÁME

Hledáme nadšené lidi, kteří:

  • Mají zkušenosti se zákaznickým servisem v oblasti módy, retailu nebo podobném oboru (není podmínkou, ale výhodou).
  • Baví je móda a chtějí zákazníkům zajistit skvělý zákaznický zážitek.
  • Rádi pracují v dynamickém a týmovém prostředí.
  • Jsou komunikativní, kreativní a otevření novým technologiím.
  • Jsou flexibilní, proaktivní a ochotní učit se nové věci.
  • Mají češtinu na minimální úrovni B2
  • Mají možnost pracovat na odpoledních směnách (max do 21:30) a o víkendu.
  • Maji 18 let a více.

PROČ SE K NÁM PŘIDAT
V H&M Group jsme hrdí na to, že jsme živou a přátelskou společností. Našim zaměstnancům nabízíme benefity a rozsáhlé rozvojové příležitosti po celém světě.

  • Rozsáhlý školící program – vše tě naučíme.
  • Možnost kombinace práce a osobního života (flexibilita směn).
  • Občerstvení na pracovišti.
  • Šance být součástí unikátní H&M společnosti a její kultury.

PŘIDEJTE SE K NÁM
Naše jedinečnost vychází z mnoha faktorů – inkluzivní a spolupracující kultury, silných hodnot i možností růstu. Především jsou to, ale naši zaměstnanci, kteří dělají H&M tím, čím je.

Jedná se o pozici na DPP (300 hodin ročně), se sídlem v Praze. Přihlaste se zasláním životopisu co nejdříve, nejpozději však do 03.11.2026.

Vzhledem k zásadám ochrany osobních údajů přijímáme žádosti pouze prostřednictvím kariérní stránky.

Udělejte další krok ve své kariéře společně s námi. Vaše cesta začíná právě tady.

*Zavazujeme se k náborovému procesu, který je spravedlivý, rovný a založený na kompetencích. Proto vás laskavě žádáme, abyste k vaší žádosti nepřikládali motivační dopis.

title: Events and Charters Executive - Expressions of Interest (Internal)
description:
About us


Fullers360 has been connecting Aucklanders and visitors to the Hauraki Gulf for over 40 years. With a team of 350+ and a fleet of high-speed ferries and modern buses, we proudly serve nearly 6 million passengers a year - getting commuters to work and visitors to explore.
Our Waiheke Bus Company introduced Auckland’s first electric bus fleet, and we’re proud to be operating Auckland’s first hybrid-electric fast ferries. Sustainability, community, and a down-to-earth culture are at the heart of everything we do.


About the role


The Events & Charters Executive will become a key point of contact for Waiheke charter and group clients, taking bookings from initial enquiry or handover through planning, confirmation, service delivery and follow-up.
This role will see you working closely with our Operations team to turn customer requirements into transport plans that are practical, safe and achievable.
Reporting to the Head of Waiheke Bus Company. This role will involve coordinating corporate groups visiting the island, planning transport for a weddings or events, organising private transfers, building itineraries for a tour groups or arranging ferry connections
You’ll be responsible for developing external relationships with venues, accommodation providers, tourism operators, wedding and event planners and other local businesses, helping position Waiheke Bus Company as the preferred transport provider for events, tours and group movements on the island.


About you


We’re looking for someone who enjoys dealing with people, is highly organised and is comfortable taking ownership.
You’ll need to be able to build a strong relationship with a client or local business while also having the attention to detail required to make sure the operational plan works.
You’ll be a good communicator, practical problem solver and someone who can remain calm and responsive when plans change.
Commercial awareness is important too. This isn’t simply about administering existing bookings – we want someone who is prepared to get out, build relationships, identify opportunities and help grow the business.
You’ll ideally bring


• Proven experience in tourism, events, hospitality, transport, customer service, sales or operations
• Good knowledge of Waiheke and the businesses and venues that make the island unique.
• Excellent organization, planning and attention to detail.
• Commercial awareness and confidence identifying new business opportunities.
• Confidence working directly with clients and external stakeholders.


Why join us?


• Be part of an organisation connecting people, places and communities across the Hauraki Gulf
• Play a key role in a connecting visitors and families to the beautiful Waiheke Island
• Work with passionate, professional teams who value safety, ownership and continuous improvement
• Make a real difference to how thousands of customers experience ferry travel every day

• Access to discounted gym memberships (Auckland Council) and discounted healthcare (Southern Cross)
• Discount at SpecSavers for employees and their family

title: Technologue en emballage / Packaging Technologist
description:
FR | EN

La description du poste est présentée en français en premier, suivie de la version anglaise.

The job description is provided in French first, followed by the English version.

______________________________________________________________________________

Qui nous sommes

Chez Nature's Touch, vous ne faites pas que bâtir une carrière : vous rejoignez une équipe dynamique qui croit à la collaboration, à la diversité et à l'apprentissage continu.

Depuis 2004, nous avons grandi rapidement, passant d'une petite entreprise au Québec à un leader mondial dans la fabrication d'aliments surgelés de marque privée. Aujourd'hui, nous avons des usines modernes en Amérique du Nord et une présence en Australie, à Taïwan et au Japon. Nous sommes fiers de fournir nos produits à des millions de foyers dans le monde.

Ce qui nous motive : la qualité, l'innovation et le respect de l'environnement.

Nous construisons l'avenir des fruits surgelés - et nous aimerions que vous en fassiez partie !


L'opportunité

Relevant du technologue principal en emballage, le ou la technologue en emballage est le moteur technique, sur le terrain, de nos projets d'amélioration continue et de maintenance en emballage : refonte de sacs et de boîtes, intégration de fournisseurs, transferts d'usine et mise à jour des spécifications.

Vous interviendrez sur les trois niveaux d'emballage, soit primaire (film souple), secondaire (carton ondulé) et tertiaire (palettisation), en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'usine ainsi qu'avec les équipes Affaires réglementaires, Développement durable, Approvisionnement, Opérations et Chaîne d'approvisionnement.


Montréal (Québec), Canada | Mode hybride : 3 jours par semaine au bureau


Ce que vous ferez

Projets d'amélioration continue et de maintenance

  • Réaliser des refontes et des optimisations d'emballage (réduction de l'épaisseur des films, changements de matériaux, refonte de boîtes, formats)
  • Soutenir les essais en usine, analyser les résultats et résoudre les problèmes d'emballage sur le plancher de production
  • Effectuer des tests de performance (résistance des scellés, chute, ISTA, compression verticale, résistance à l'écrasement sur chant [ECT], OTR/MVTR)

Film souple et emballage secondaire

  • Développer et optimiser les structures de films souples (laminés, coextrudés, monomatériaux) et valider leur machinabilité et leurs propriétés barrières
  • Élaborer et tenir à jour les spécifications de carton ondulé (grade, cannelure, ECT, dimensions) et repérer les occasions d'optimisation

Palettisation et logistique

  • Modéliser et optimiser les configurations de palettes et le chargement des conteneurs dans TOPS afin de maximiser le taux de remplissage

Spécifications et fournisseurs

  • Créer et tenir à jour les spécifications d'emballage dans TraceGains et TOPS, avec contrôle des versions
  • Soutenir l'intégration et la qualification des fournisseurs, et tenir à jour leur documentation (certificats d'analyse, certifications, spécifications)
  • Soutenir les transferts d'usine, la qualification des co-emballeurs, les enquêtes sur les non-conformités et les projets de développement de nouveaux produits, au besoin

Ce que vous apportez

  • De 2 à 3 ans d'expérience en emballage en milieu manufacturier, ou diplôme récent accompagné de stages pertinents (requis)
  • Expérience pratique des films souples et de l'emballage primaire (requis)
  • Expérience en usine dans le secteur alimentaire, des boissons ou des produits de consommation courante (requis)
  • Expérience en résolution de problèmes sur le plancher : changements de format, problèmes de film souple (requis)
  • Expérience avec TOPS et TraceGains (requis)
  • Excellente maîtrise d'Excel et utilisation concrète d'outils d'IA pour la documentation, l'analyse et la production de rapports (requis)

title: Cable Technician
description:
• We are looking for a mid-level Cable Technician II to join our layer-one structured cabling team. This role builds on the copper foundation of Tech I and adds full proficiency in fiber optic installation, termination, and testing. The Tech II is expected to work independently across both media types, guide Tech I personnel on day-to-day installation tasks, and take ownership of moderately complex scopes from plan to acceptance.

    This is an onsite role in a cleanroom semiconductor manufacturing environment. The successful candidate will spend extended periods in a smock with required PPE, working from floor plans or ticket-driven scopes to deliver layer-one infrastructure that meets company and industry standards. Tech II has strong expectations towards hands-on execution, solid fiber skills, and the judgment to catch and escalate design or field issues before they become rework.

    Responsibilities:

  • Lead the installation, adjustment, and change of copper and fiber layer-one network connections for technical systems.
  • Install, terminate, test, and troubleshoot Category 5e/6/6a copper cabling and single-mode and multi-mode fiber optic cabling for data infrastructure in a large enterprise environment.
  • Terminate fiber across a range of interfaces and form factors (LC, SC, ST, APC) using both field-termination and pre-terminated methods; perform fusion and mechanical splicing as required.
  • Test and certify fiber using industry-standard equipment (OTDR, OLTS, fiber inspection scopes) and interpret results to acceptance criteria.
  • Properly comb, dress, and label copper and fiber cables in accordance with site and industry standards; enforce bend-radius and pull-tension discipline.
  • Implement structured pathways per approved designs; identify physical constraints and propose field-practical corrections to the senior technician.
  • Interpret floor plan designs and as-builts; redline field deviations and submit for incorporation into final documentation.
  • Provide day-to-day direction and on-the-job training to Tech I personnel on copper and basic fiber work.
  • Work from a request / ticket system, owning assigned scopes end-to-end including pre-job material checks, execution, and closeout documentation.
  • Author and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for install, test, and acceptance workflows.
  • Support the network team on hardware replacements, rack / de-rack activity, hotfix participation to resolve connectivity issues and scheduled change points.
  • Support 24x7 data center and fab operation per on-call scheduling.
  • Follow all on-site security protocols, Standard Operating Procedures, and company policies.

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of experience in the structured cabling industry, including hands-on copper and fiber work.
  • 2+ years of experience in a construction environment with working knowledge of standard safety practices.
  • Demonstrated cabling experience with knowledge of low-voltage specifications, standards, and safety practices.
  • Proficient with copper termination (Cat 5e/6/6a) and cable certification using industry-standard testers (Fluke DSX or equivalent).
  • Proficient with fiber termination across multiple interfaces (LC, SC, APC, MPO/MTP) and with fiber testing (OTDR, OLTS, inspection scopes).
  • Able to speak, read, and write clearly in English.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Must live within a one-hour drive of assigned campus.
  • Moderate computer literacy: Microsoft Office, standard file systems, typing, and proper email etiquette.
  • Ability to read and follow floor plan designs and as-built documentation.
  • OSHA 10 certification.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate's degree in a related technical field.
  • Prior experience in a semiconductor, cleanroom, data center, or other mission-critical environment.
  • BICSI Installer 1 or Installer 2 certification.
  • Fusion splicing certification or manufacturer-specific fiber termination certification (Corning, CommScope, Panduit, etc.).
  • Experience mentoring junior technicians or leading small crews on scoped work.
  • OSHA 30 certification.

Physical Requirement

• Must be able to lift 50 pounds.

• Must be able to work in elevated areas on ladders upward of 40 feet.

• Must be able to work in confined spaces and tight areas for extended periods.

• Must be able to wear a cleanroom smock and required PPE for extended periods.

• Must be able to work a standard Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM schedule.

• Must be willing to work a flexible schedule when needed (past 5:00 PM, weekends, on-call).

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

*** NO C2C ***

title: Senior Graphic Designer - Parental Leave Cover (12 Months)
description:
Since our founding in 2010, Grace Loves Lace has revolutionised the bridal industry, redefining what it means to be a modern bride. Launching as a visionary e-commerce-only brand, we embraced bold innovation – and it transformed the industry! Today, we’ve expanded our reach across four continents, with 24 stunning global boutiques, shipping to over 80 countries, and establishing a strong global wholesale presence.



The Role:

The Senior Graphic Designer is responsible for leading the execution, quality and delivery of creative assets across all digital, print, retail and wholesale channels. Working closely with our Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) and Creative Director, you’ll translate brand strategy into exceptional creative execution while ensuring consistency across every customer touchpoint.

This is a hands-on role that combines creative design, campaign development, content creation and day-to-day workflow management. You’ll also guide and mentor our Graphic Designer, helping to prioritise workloads, maintain creative standards and deliver high-quality work on time.

Our ideal candidate is a creative thinker with a strong eye for detail, a passion for design and the ability to balance multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. You’ll be confident working independently, collaborating across teams and bringing innovative ideas to life while ensuring all creative output reflects the Grace Loves Lace brand and values.

This is a 12-month parental leave contract, with an ideal start date in early January 2027. The role is full-time, based at our head office, however, we also welcome applications from candidates seeking a part-time arrangement of four days per week. Work-from-home flexibility is available one day per week.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead creative execution from approved brief through to final production, ensuring high-quality, on-brand deliverables across all channels.
  • Collaborate with the CMO and Creative Director to develop creative assets for campaigns, events, product launches and promotions across digital, print, retail and wholesale.
  • Manage the day-to-day design workflow, prioritising tasks and mentoring the Graphic Designer to maintain quality and meet deadlines.
  • Design digital advertising, EDMs, social media content, press releases, sales collateral, packaging and internal communications.
  • Support website and e-commerce design, including banners, landing pages and content updates, using Shopify and other relevant platforms.
  • Edit, retouch and optimise photography and video content for digital, social media and marketing campaigns.
  • Maintain brand guidelines and creative templates, collaborating with Marketing on trend research and regular creative reviews.
  • Manage print requests and production, and support photoshoots, events and wider marketing initiatives as required.

Essential Knowledge/Behaviours:

  • Relevant qualification in Graphic Design, Website Development, E-commerce or a related discipline, with demonstrated industry experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro and Acrobat.
  • Experience with CMS and e-commerce platforms, ideally Shopify, with HTML coding skills.
  • Experience with CRM and email marketing platforms, ideally Klaviyo.
  • Strong creative vision, attention to detail and understanding of digital, print and brand design best practices.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise workloads and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organisational, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously, collaborate across teams and mentor junior designers.
  • A proactive, innovative approach and alignment with the Grace Loves Lace mission and GRACE values.

Perks & Benefits:

  • Substantial product discounts of 30% to 50% for yourself, your direct family and friends.
  • Access to an Employee Discount Platform, offering exclusive discounts at major Australian retailers.
  • Car novated leasing and salary packaging options through Flare.

title: Driftstekniker

  • Oppfølging av energiforbruk EOS-system

  • Oppfølging av serviceleverandører og vedlikeholdsarbeid

  • Bidra med innspill i budsjetter og leietakermøter ved behov

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Utdanning og erfaring innen byggfag, elektrofag eller automasjon

  • Erfaring fra drift og vedlikehold av større eiendommer

  • Erfaring om internkontroll og HMS, energioppfølging og SD-anlegg

  • Forståelse for risikovurderinger og korrigerende tiltak

  • Gode ferdigheter på bruk av PC som arbeidsverktøy

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Må kunne sikkerhetsklareres

Egenskaper

  • Gode mellommenneskelige egenskaper

  • Serviceinnstilt og kvalitetsbevisst

  • Løsningsorientert, systematisk og fleksibel

  • God muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne på norsk

  • Selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst

Er du teknisk interessert og har erfaring, men mangler formell kompetanse? Søk likevel!
Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion og etnisk bakgrunn.

Søknadsfrist: 31. oktober. Aktuelle kandidater kontaktes fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren

Newsec tilbyr eiendomsbesittere, investorer og leietakere et bredt spekter av tjenester innen eiendomsforvaltning.

Hos Newsec Property Asset Management i Norge finner du Norges største team av spesialister innen drift, rådgivning og forvaltning av næringseiendom. Våre 300 ansatte forvalter ca. 4 millioner kvadratmeter med næringseiendom til en verdi på ca. 68 milliarder NOK. Hovedkontoret i Norge er i Trondheim.

Newsec ble grunnlagt i 1994 og er i dag et partnereid selskap med over 2 800 medarbeidere i Norden og Baltikum. Vi er i dag Nord-Europas største forvalter av næringseiendom, og takket være store volumer, lokal tilstedeværelse og inngående forståelse av bransjen, har vi en unik kunnskap om eiendomsmarkedet i Norge og Nord-Europa.
