title: Community Engagement & Outreach Senior Manager
description:
Job Title: Community Engagement & Outreach Senior Manager

Department: External Relations

Reports to: External Relations Senior Director

Position Status: Full-time (32 hour workweek); Exempt

Location: Cambridge, Boston Area (hybrid: minimum two days in office)

Work Schedule: 32 hours per week

Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000; commensurate with experience

Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled.


BARCC Overview

Founded in 1973, the Boston Area Rape Crisis Center (BARCC) is the oldest and largest rape crisis center in New England, serving as the only comprehensive center for survivors of sexual violence in the Greater Boston Area. BARCC’s mission is to end sexual violence through healing, empowerment, and social change. BARCC empowers survivors of sexual violence to help find healing and seek justice in ways that are meaningful to them and works to provide education and advocacy needed to create social change and prevent sexual violence. We rely on our dedicated staff to do this important work, and our team is growing!


The External Relations team plays a critical role in advancing BARCC's mission by building the resources, relationships, and visibility necessary to sustain and grow our work. We are a collaborative, mission-driven team that values initiative, accountability, creativity, and shared ownership of outcomes.


Position Overview

BARCC is seeking a highly motivated, hands-on Community Engagement & Outreach Senior Manager to play a central role in strengthening the organization’s relationships across the communities BARCC serves. Reporting to the Senior Director of External Relations, this role is a key member of the External Relations team responsible for leading community outreach, partnership development, prevention education and training, and public engagement efforts.


This is a highly engaged, roll-up-your-sleeves role for someone who thrives in a relationship-driven, mission-focused environment and takes pride in building meaningful connections that advance impact. The Community Engagement & Outreach Senior Manager works across departments, manages complex collaborative projects, and brings initiative, adaptability, and strong follow-through to all aspects of the work.


The role ensures that BARCC’s community presence, training efforts, and outreach strategies are aligned, inclusive, and responsive to evolving community needs: directly supporting BARCC’s mission of ending sexual violence through healing and social change.


Work Environment

BARCC's staff, operations, hours, and location vary by function, type of work, and work style. This is a 32-hour per week full-time position. This position will work in a hybrid schedule with a minimum of two days on-site. Attendance at occasional evening or weekend events at BARCC offices and off-site may be required for this position. BARCC will engage in an interactive process regarding reasonable accommodations.


Key Responsibilities


Community engagement and partnership development

  • Develop and implement strategies to deepen community engagement and expand BARCC’s visibility and relationships across diverse communities.
  • Cultivate and manage partnerships with community organizations, institutions, and stakeholders to advance BARCC’s mission.
  • Plan and oversee designated community collaboration projects, including managing workflows, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Diplomatically manage relationships with partner agencies, ensuring shared goals are upheld and decisions are made collaboratively.
  • Represent BARCC at community events, coalitions, and public forums.

Prevention education and training

  • Coordinate and support delivery of prevention education initiatives and community-based training programs.
  • Plan and facilitate collaboration meetings that are accessible, inclusive, and grounded in BARCC’s values.
  • Develop and deliver trainings to raise awareness about sexual violence and prevention, including curricula, resource manuals, and other materials.
  • Serve as a liaison between community partners and program staff to align outreach, education, and service needs.
  • Identify opportunities to expand training reach and strengthen community-based prevention efforts.
  • Coordinate training requests for our Survivor Speakers Bureau (SSB).
  • Collaborate with staff to provide orientation and training for survivors to join our SSB.

Product and resource development

  • Write, design, and develop a wide range of products for internal and external use, such as curricula, resource guides, fact sheets, and toolkits, in collaboration with BARCC staff and partner organizations.
  • Support planning and execution of community-facing events, awareness campaigns, and engagement activities.
  • Collaborate with External Relations and program teams to ensure all products and events reflect survivor-centered, inclusive practices.

Data tracking and systems management

  • Track community partnerships, outreach efforts, training data, and project budgets to ensure accurate reporting and impact measurement.
  • Utilize data platforms to document engagement activities and support cross-department coordination.
  • Manage grant reporting requirements and communicate with funders as applicable.
  • Contribute to development of systems and workflows that strengthen community engagement infrastructure.

Event and communications support

  • Partner with the Senior Director of External Relations and Development Manager to support integrated supporter communications strategies.
  • Provide support to events and initiatives
  • Surface program stories, community insights, and engagement data that support survivor narratives.

Internal collaboration and organizational citizenship

  • Serve as a bridge between programs, External Relations, and leadership to ensure alignment across outreach, training, and community priorities.
  • Model accountability, initiative, and collaborative leadership.
  • Act as an ambassador of BARCC’s mission and values in all community-facing work.
  • Participate in departmental, organization-wide, and external meetings and events as needed.
  • Supervise interns and volunteers as assigned.
  • Perform other duties in support of organizational priorities.


Physical Requirements & Essential Functions

  • The role may involve remaining in a stationary position for periods of time during calls, meetings, and general role responsibilities.
  • This role requires the ability to work comfortably with databases, spreadsheets and cloud-based tools.
  • This role requires the ability to communicate with community partners and colleagues through multiple formats, as well as use a computer, phone and other office equipment.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.


Required Qualifications

  • At least three years of experience in community engagement, outreach, partnership development, nonprofit program management, or related roles.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating training programs, facilitation, or community-based education initiatives.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, budgets, and deadlines.
  • Comfort working in a hands-on role that includes both strategic thinking and day-to-day execution.
  • Experience working with CRM or supporter databases.
  • Strong written, verbal, and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to work independently while thriving in a highly collaborative team environment.
  • Commitment to equity, inclusion, and survivor-centered values.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Experience in sexual violence prevention, social justice, disability justice, or human services organizations.
  • Experience supervising or mentoring staff, interns, or volunteers.
  • Experience developing curricula, training materials, or community resources.


Benefits and incentives

At BARCC, we understand the hard work and dedication necessary to support our mission-driven organization, which is why we are committed to ensuring our employees are healthy, happy, and secure. We offer the following benefits:

  • 32-hour work week designed to promote healthy work-life balance
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans offered at 85% employer paid
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO): 12 vacation days, 15 paid sick days, minimum 14 paid holidays, two personal days, and two religious holidays per year
  • Parental Leave and Massachusetts Paid Family Medical Leave Act (PFMLA) benefits
  • Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 403(b) retirement plan
  • Commuter benefits
  • Professional Development Allowance and other perks
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness eligible employer
  • The opportunity to make meaningful change and improve the lives of others through mission-driven work, at all levels of the organization.


Hiring process and timeline

Please submit your resume and cover letter via our online application system. We want to get to know you as the incredible professional you are and ask that your cover letter not be written by AI. No phone calls, please. The full hiring process will include a phone-screen, first-round virtual interview and a final team interview with skills assessment. Reasonable accommodation is provided upon request.


Employment is contingent upon satisfactory completion of any background checks required by applicable law, regulation, contract, or funding requirement. Information obtained through a background check will be considered in accordance with applicable law and BARCC policy, including an individualized assessment where required.


BARCC is an equal opportunity employer committed to workforce diversity and hiring people with diverse life experiences. Survivors, people who are bilingual/bicultural, persons of color, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people are encouraged to apply

title: Deal Desk Manager
description:
About Stoïk

Stoïk is a European scale-up that protects businesses against cyber risk by combining insurance with cybersecurity tools.

The role

Your job is to build the Deal Desk from the ground up.

You will own everything that happens to a contract along the customer journey, outside commercial negotiation. The scope is cross-product: you will work on both our insurance contracts and our cyber contracts (licences and security services), in every country where we operate.

What you’ll do

Cash collection

  • Drive the collection of amounts owed by clients and partners

  • Track overdue payments, run follow-ups and escalate when needed

  • Build and monitor collection KPIs such as DSO, outstanding balance and bad-debt rate

KYB: Know Your Broker

  • Ensure our broker distribution network meets compliance requirements

  • Collect, verify and keep partners’ regulatory documentation up to date

  • Design compliance processes for broker onboarding and ongoing monitoring, working with Legal and Compliance

Licence overage billing

  • Identify and bill cyber licence overages every month, whether direct or through our MSP partners

  • Work with Sales to review significant cases

  • Make sure billing is accurate, traceable and clearly explained to the client

Non-commercial contract amendments

  • Handle administrative changes such as payment methods, contract dates, company registration number (SIREN), address and similar updates

  • Set clear processing times and meet them

Special contracts for CrowdStrike and SentinelOne

  • Track actual licence consumption and bill it accurately

  • Reconcile vendor invoices with client billing

  • Spot discrepancies early and raise them with the right teams

Beyond that

  • Document and automate Deal Desk processes so they hold up as we grow

  • Be the go-to person on these topics for Sales, Success, Finance and Legal

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst (QMS)
description:
About the job

About Dash Technologies

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, USA, Dash Technologies Inc. is a healthcare-focused technology company with a global delivery center in Ahmedabad, India. For more than 15 years, Dash has partnered with healthcare and MedTech organizations to design and engineer digital health solutions spanning Medical IoT, device and system integration, connected applications, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data analytics. An ISO 9001-certified company, Dash combines strong engineering capabilities with practical execution to advance healthcare’s digital transformation and improve care delivery.

The Opportunity

Dash Technologies is seeking an experienced Software Quality Engineer to lead software quality assurance, testing, validation, and regulatory documentation for a Medical Device Software product being built from scratch.

You will be responsible for developing test strategies, executing software verification and validation activities, maintaining quality documentation, and ensuring compliance with applicable medical device standards and FDA quality system requirements.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for a quality professional who combines deep medical device software expertise with strong documentation discipline and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

What You’ll Do

Software Quality Assurance

  • Develop, review, and maintain software quality plans, procedures, work instructions, test documentation, and quality records.
  • Ensure software quality processes and documentation align with ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 62304, and other applicable medical device standards.
  • Maintain accurate, controlled, and audit-ready quality documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing timely access to quality documentation, test evidence, and project records.

Software Testing and Validation

  • Develop and execute comprehensive test cases, test scripts, test plans, and test procedures for Medical Device Software.
  • Design and execute validation protocols, including IQ, OQ, and PQ where applicable.
  • Perform software verification and validation activities in alignment with IEC 62304 software lifecycle requirements.
  • Conduct functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing across development sprints.
  • Identify, document, and track defects through resolution using bug-tracking tools.
  • Review test results, prepare quality reports, and ensure issues are appropriately addressed before release.

Risk Management and Compliance

  • Apply ISO 14971 risk management principles to software testing and validation activities.
  • Contribute to software risk analysis, hazard identification, and mitigation verification.
  • Ensure traceability between user needs, requirements, design outputs, code, test cases, test results, and risk controls.
  • Support design controls, design reviews, verification activities, and design transfer in accordance with ISO 13485 and FDA requirements.
  • Identify quality and compliance risks and communicate them to relevant stakeholders.

Agile Quality Integration

  • Work within agile development teams to integrate quality practices into sprint planning, execution, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Define acceptance criteria and participate in backlog refinement.
  • Ensure quality gates are met before software releases.
  • Collaborate with developers on test automation strategies and CI/CD pipeline integration.
  • Balance agile development velocity with medical device regulatory rigor and documentation requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with product managers to ensure requirements are testable, measurable, and aligned with intended use and regulatory expectations.
  • Work with engineering teams to resolve defects, improve testability, and enhance software quality.
  • Liaise with regulatory affairs and clinical teams to ensure software verification and validation activities support regulatory submissions and clinical evidence requirements.
  • Communicate quality status, project risks, testing progress, and quality metrics to leadership and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 5 years of experience in software quality engineering, software testing, or software verification and validation roles.
  • At least 3 years of experience working with Medical Device Software or regulated healthcare technology.
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining software quality documentation in a regulated environment.
  • Proven experience developing and executing test cases, scripts, plans, and procedures for software products.
  • Direct experience designing and executing validation protocols and software verification and validation activities.
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and IEC 62304.
  • Working knowledge of IEC 60601 and other relevant medical device standards.
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong organizational capabilities and attention to detail.
  • Experience with test management tools such as Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with bug-tracking systems and software development lifecycle tools.

Bonus Points

  • Experience supporting FDA 510(k), De Novo, or PMA submissions involving software documentation.
  • Practical experience applying both ISO 13485 and IEC 62304 during medical device software development.
  • Experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating automated testing with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Prior experience establishing quality processes and testing practices for products developed from scratch.
  • Experience working in a startup or new product development environment.
  • Certifications such as Certified Software Quality Engineer, Certified Software Test Engineer, or Regulatory Affairs Certification.

How You Work

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to software quality.
  • Excellent technical writing skills, with the ability to create clear, precise, and traceable quality records.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Strong ownership mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to balance quality rigor with development velocity.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to influence without authority.
  • Confidence in identifying, communicating, and escalating quality and compliance risks appropriately.

Values We Seek

  • MedTech Experience: Passion for healthcare technology and improving patient outcomes through quality software.
  • Communication Skills: Clear, concise, and timely communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Documentation Discipline: Ability to produce precise, compliant, and traceable software quality records.
  • Quality Mindset: Commitment to maintaining high standards of software quality, compliance, and patient safety.

Why Join Dash

What We Offer

  • A high-impact individual contributor role supporting a Medical Device Software product from the ground up.
  • The opportunity to shape software quality processes, testing strategies, and validation activities for a new product line.
  • A collaborative team at our Ahmedabad delivery center with exposure to Medical IoT, artificial intelligence, and digital health initiatives.
  • Competitive compensation, performance-based bonuses, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Professional development support for certifications, training, and industry conferences.
  • Flexible work arrangements and a culture that values quality, innovation, and patient safety.

title: Pharmacy Tech-Methodist
description:
Overview

Functions as a Pharmacy Technician as defined by the Iowa Board of Pharmacy. Assists pharmacists in preparing and distributing sterile and non-sterile medications and maintaining accurate medication records. All duties are performed under the supervision of a registered pharmacist.

Why UnityPoint Health?

At UnityPoint Health, you matter. We’re proud to be recognized as a Top 150 Place to Work in Healthcare by Becker's Healthcare several years in a row for our commitment to our team members.

Our competitive Total Rewards program offers benefits options that align with your needs and priorities, no matter what life stage you’re in. Here are just a few:

  • Expect paid time off, parental leave, 401K matching and an employee recognition program.
  • Dental and health insurance, paid holidays, short and long-term disability and more. We even offer pet insurance for your four-legged family members.
  • Early access to earned wages with Daily Pay, tuition reimbursement to help further your career and adoption assistance to help you grow your family.

With a collective goal to champion a culture of belonging where everyone feels valued and respected, we honor the ways people are unique and embrace what brings us together.

And, we believe equipping you with support and development opportunities is a vital part of delivering an exceptional employment experience.

Find a fulfilling career and make a difference with UnityPoint Health.

Responsibilities

PROFESSIONALISM

  • Fosters a positive work culture centered on honesty, openness, and integrity
  • Builds and maintains relationships with members of the health care team by placing an emphasis on open communication
  • Inspires and motivates members of the health care team by promoting department morale
  • Strives to ensure the success of the team as a whole over personal success
  • Effectively balances the responsibilities of the team and individual team members
  • Demonstrates a commitment to the development and achievement of common goals within the department and hospital system
  • Integrates and demonstrates FOCUS values and Expectations for Personal and Service Excellence to guide professional behaviors, while adhering to the policies and procedures of UPH-DM
  • Demonstrates a commitment to the improvement of patient care, customer satisfaction, and team member performance
  • Encourages and provides constructive feedback to identify opportunities for improvement within the department

OPERATIONAL FUNCTIONS

  • Prepares and distributes medication products to fulfill medication orders
  • Utilizes automation to assure safe and accurate distribution and secure storage of medications
  • Compounds sterile medications in an appropriate clean room environment to assure a safe, accurate and sterile product, in accordance with facility, state, and federal laws and regulations (including USP 797 and 800)
  • Demonstrates competency, precision, and accuracy in the preparation of compounded products
  • Compounds non-sterile medications in an appropriate compounding area to assure a safe and accurate product in accordane with facility, state and federal laws and regulations (including USP 795)
  • Answers the telephone, identifying self and department and directing calls to appropriate personnel in a professional and courteous manner
  • Ensures appropriate and adequate medication inventory by restocking, rotating stock, removing expired medications, packaging medications, and ordering supplies
  • Accurately performs data entry for patient billing
  • Ensures proper medication storage
  • Maintains a neat, clean, orderly, and secure department

COMPLIANCE

  • Ensures the appropriate preparation and distribution of medications in accordance with facility, state, and national laws and regulations
  • Assures compliance with HIPAA, DNV, OSHA and other state and federal regulations guiding healthcare
  • Adheres to policies and procedures of UPH-DM
  • Prioritizes the importance of preventing errors, accidents, and infections within the workplace and reports potential or actual concerns immediately
  • Completes all competency and skills assessment requirements
  • Participates in and completes pharmacy technician orientation

Qualifications

Education: Must be high school graduate or equivalent. Must be able to proficiently read, write and speak English. Must have strong math skills, with some basic algebra. Some college training preferred

Experience: One year of experience in a hospital or retail pharmacy desirable. Experience in a health care facility desirable. Proficient in using computer systems

License(s)/Certification(s): Must be registered as a Pharmacy Technician or Pharmacist-Intern (if enrolled in a college of pharmacy) with the Iowa Board of Pharmacy, prior to the commencement of employment. Must be a Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) by the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) or other nationally recognized certification provider. Must maintain a current Iowa Pharmacy Technician or Pharmacist-Intern registration and be in good standing with the Iowa Board of Pharmacy. Must provide a photocopies of renewal certificates to the Pharmacy Management Team prior to the expiration dates of current certificates.

title: Técnico/a de Almacén (Sector Espacial)
description:
ARQUIMEA es una empresa tecnológica que opera a nivel global, ofreciendo soluciones y productos innovadores en sectores altamente exigentes. Nuestras áreas de actividad incluyen Aeroespacio, Defensa y Seguridad, Big Science, Biotecnología y Fintech.

ARQUIMEA SPACE es una empresa multinacional fundada en 2005, con sede en Madrid, dedicada al diseño y desarrollo de sistemas y componentes electrónicos, microelectrónicos y electromecánicos, incluyendo actuadores y mecanismos inteligentes, sistemas de sensorización, circuitos integrados (IC) y aviónica. Los productos y tecnologías de ARQUIMEA están orientados a mercados que requieren altos niveles de innovación, calidad, rendimiento y fiabilidad, como el aeroespacial, defensa y seguridad, automoción, salud e industria.

Actualmente, ARQUIMEA SPACE busca incorporar un/a Técnico/a de Almacén, con ubicación en nuestras oficinas centrales en Torrejón de Ardoz (Madrid).

Función principal y alcance:

  • Operario de almacén y logística.

Funciones principales:

  • Funciones de gestión logística interna, abastecimiento a producción y control de materiales, garantizando el correcto flujo de entradas y salidas de mercancía.

  • Requerido trabajar de forma coordinada con los departamentos de producción, compras y logística y bajo la supervisión del responsable de almacén.

  • Recepción física de mercancías y materiales.

  • Verificación y revisión de albaranes de proveedores.

  • Registro y recepción de materiales en el sistema informático.

  • Movimiento de materiales, su ubicación y organización en estanterías y zonas de almacenamiento.

  • Comprobación, preparación y suministro de vales de material a fábrica/producción.

  • Gestión de devoluciones de material desde producción.

  • Control y seguimiento de stocks e inventarios.

  • Registro y descuento de salidas de material en el sistema.

  • Preparación de documentación para subcontratación de operaciones.

  • Carga, descarga y movimiento interno de materiales.

  • Manejo de carretilla elevadora y puente grúa.

  • Manejo de maquinaria de corte de perfil y barras, grabadora laser y pequeñas máquinas/herramientas.

  • Mantenimiento del orden y limpieza del almacén.

  • Cumplimiento de las normas de seguridad y prevención de riesgos laborales.

Formación y competencias requeridas:

  • Manejo habitual de sistemas de gestión de almacén o ERP.

  • Conocimientos de control de stock e inventarios.

  • Carnet de carretilla elevadora en vigor. Experiencia demostrable en manejo de carretilla elevadora. Se realizará una prueba.

  • Experiencia en manejo de puente grúa.

  • Permiso de circulación de vehículos B2.

Competencias requeridas:

  • Capacidad de organización y trabajo en equipo.

  • Persona responsable, proactiva, rigurosa y ordenada.

  • Experiencia mínima requerida:

title: Mid Weight Designer
description:
Job Title: Mid-Weight Designer

Location - Belgrade

About BOYLE Sports

Our partners BOYLE Sports are on a mission to shake up the betting and gaming landscape. With 400+ stores in Ireland and UK, and a fast-growing digital presence, they are building a bold, ambitious brand, and need a Mid-Weight Designer who can help them look as good as they sound.


The Role

As Mid-Weight Designer, you'll be a core part of the creative engine that powers BOYLE Sports. From campaign banners and landing pages to digital ads and multi-channel assets, you'll produce work that turns heads, drives clicks, and keeps our brand looking sharp across every touchpoint.

You'll sit within our in-house Brand team, meaning you'll go deep on one brand, build real creative consistency, and have genuine ownership over how BOYLE Sports looks across every channel. If you're agency-trained and ready to focus your skills on a single ambitious brand, this is the move.

You'll also be at the forefront of how we use AI in our creative workflow, using generative tools to accelerate ideas, explore concepts, and push production further and faster.


What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Digital design production — delivering high-quality design across Sportsbook, Retail, Gaming, and Acquisition channels, consistently on-brand and built to perform

  • Multi-channel asset creation — producing banners, landing pages, web assets, and digital campaigns for ATL and BTL divisions across multiple formats and platforms

  • Motion and video production — creating motion graphics, animated banners, and short-form video content for social, web, and campaign use. Editing and cutting down footage for multi-platform delivery, from teaser clips to full campaign edits

  • Design acceleration — helping reduce cycle time through specialist capacity, enabling faster campaign deployment and greater market responsiveness

  • Cross-functional collaboration — working alongside motion designers and video editors on larger productions, and supporting print workflows

  • Champion AI-assisted design — integrating generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, RunwayML, and Flora AI into day-to-day production to accelerate ideation and output, including AI-assisted video generation and motion concepting

  • Team mentoring & capability building — supporting the growth of junior designers and helping design leads stay focused on strategic direction and brand governance


What We're Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience in a digital design role, ideally within a fast-paced in-house or agency environment

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma

  • Specialist motion and video skills — confident producing motion graphics, animated assets, and short-form video edits using After Effects and Premiere (or equivalent), with a portfolio/reel demonstrating strong pacing, typography-in-motion, and platform-native video content (social, web, display)

  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools such as Midjourney, Nano Banana, RunwayML, and Flora — able to integrate AI-assisted workflows intelligently into production, including AI video and motion tools

  • Ability to manage multiple briefs simultaneously and deliver to tight deadlines

  • Strong eye for detail, typography, and layout across digital and motion formats

  • A collaborative, team-first attitude with clear and confident communication


Bonus Points

  • Experience in the betting, gaming, or sports media industry — familiarity with Sportsbook or iGaming creative environments is a strong advantage

  • Background working across both ATL and BTL campaigns

  • Familiarity with print production workflows

  • Experience helping to define or document AI design workflows within a creative team

  • Experience with sound design, colour grading, or basic 3D/motion tools (e.g. Cinema 4D, Blender) for elevated animated output


Why BOYLE Sports

We're building something big, and we want your work to help lead the way visually. If you're ready to own your craft, embrace new tools, and do your best creative work in a team that gives you the space to do it, send us your portfolio (including a motion/video reel) and show us what you've got.

BOYLE Sports is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

title: Embedded Linux contractor

Are you an experienced Embedded Linux Software Developer who enjoys working close to the technology, solving complex challenges and building reliable solutions? At AddSecure, you'll have the opportunity to develop software that supports critical alarm communication, working with embedded Linux, C and communication protocols in an international development environment.

AddSecure is a leading European provider of secure IoT connectivity and end-to-end solutions. We help customers optimize their operations, drive business value, and secure vital functions.

Our Smart Alarms business unit delivers secure and reliable communication solutions between alarm systems and alarm receiving centers to protect lives, homes, businesses, and assets.

We are seeking a Contractor specializing in embedded Linux systems to join our team. The ideal candidate will have extensive expertise as a software developer, with a strong focus on C and protocol conversion. The development team is centered in Theale, near Reading, UK with colleagues in the Nordic region.

About the job

You will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining our software solutions, ensuring they meet high-quality standards and fulfill business requirements. Initial responsibilities include:

  • Design and develop new robust protocol handlers for alarm panels using C. These protocols are typically over RS485 or Ethernet.

  • Add local web page UI elements and JSON configuration.

  • Redesign and rewrite existing C++ software in C using small modular processes.

  • Maintain code quality via unit tests, system tests in Python and code reviews.

About you

You are a strong software developer who we can depend on to develop and maintain solutions that meet our customers’ requirements. Additionally, you will have:

  • Minimum 3 years experience as a software developer for embedded Linux products.

  • Very proficient with git (clean commits, fixup with review feedback) and Agile development methodologies.

  • Strong commercial experience developing production embedded Linux software in C.

  • Ability to read, understand and make minor changes in C++ codebase.

  • Reasonable Python skills for writing automated tests.

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools, or willing to adopt them where they can improve development productivity and quality.

  • Good knowledge of IP technologies such as DHCP, DNS, routing, etc.

  • Awareness of different character encodings and conversion.

  • If needed, can investigate problems on low-level interfaces such as RS232, RS485 and use Wireshark, etc.

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Good understanding of software security principles and best practices.

Other desirable experience includes BACnet, MQTT and JSON.

We use a competence-based recruitment process that may include psychometric assessments, interviews, reference checks, and background checks. As part of the process, candidates may complete assessments provided by Alva Labs to support a fair and structured evaluation.

title: Salesforce Business Analyst II-UK
description:
Salesforce Business Analyst - Customer Operations

(UK - Harrogate or Remote)

WHO WE ARE

Certinia delivers a Services-as-a-Business platform that powers and connects all aspects of services operations, from services estimation and delivery to customer success management and financial planning and accounting. The company’s Professional Services Automation (PSA), Customer Success (CS), and Financial Management (FM) solutions—delivered on Salesforce’s leading cloud platform—provide the ability to run a connected services business, deliver with intelligence, and achieve business agility. Headquartered in Austin, Texas with presence around the world, Certinia is backed by Haveli Investments, TA Associates, General Atlantic and Salesforce Ventures. For more information, visit.

THE ROLE

The focus of this position is to work closely with the Customer Operations business unit to gain in-depth understanding of their business strategy and processes, services and roadmap for the use of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, PS Cloud and CS Cloud at Certinia. You will provide strategic business analysis services to the internal business units who utilize the Salesforce suite of products.

You will be expected to translate knowledge of their strategic business goals into a best in class implementation of Salesforce to deliver the ‘First and Best’ initiative. You will own the requirements gathering process for Salesforce, with a specific focus on a holistic design. You will see the value in optimizing business processes, using technology to deliver productivity improvements, automation and business decisions from real time, accurate data. You will consider how AI can help optimize workflows and help with scaling the Certinia business. Working with business stakeholders, the BA will consider the impact of business process change on the architecture of the Salesforce org. With this understanding, business requirements will be documented to a detailed level to enable our Salesforce administrators to implement directly, with limited iterations.

In addition, the BA will advise on operational implications of proposed changes, maintaining an overall strategic view of business processes. The BA will be able to manage medium sized projects.work with the project manager for each project or enhancement to define test plans and drive change management. The Salesforce Business Analyst will report to the VP, Global Business Operations.

WHAT YOU WILL DO IN THIS ROLE

  • Support the implementation the Customer1 strategy (a best in class Certinia & Salesforce implementation), by building relationships and partnerships with Services, Customer Success, Support and Training; identifying business needs; determining processes and practices; monitoring progress and results; recognizing and capitalizing on improvement opportunities
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to get an in-depth understanding of their core business processes
  • Assist in the overall solution architecture of Salesforce, delivering best practices architectures aligned to the stakeholders’ desired outcomes, including applications, systems, data & analytics, integrations, business processes, and technology
  • Own the requirements gathering process for the Sales Cloud, Service Cloud and PSA to implement and optimize our processes
  • Translate requirements into clear and concise documentation needed to implement requirements by a Salesforce administrator without deep understanding of the related business area
  • Help define the requirements gathering approach for the Salesforce Administrator team, including key artifacts and best practices, eg : process models, data models, capability diagrams, value chain diagrams and other artifacts as needed
  • Create robust testing plans for features and solutions created by the Salesforce Administrator team, to ensure the solution fulfills all new business requirements and functions correctly without breaking existing functionalities
  • Coordinates with the business to ensure they properly test new features before deployment to production
  • Drive projects to completion, either supporting project management directly or take project management lead on smaller projects

WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE

  • 3+ years experience working as a business analyst, Product Owner or similar role, on Salesforce
  • Understanding of business processes, specifically in services and support.
  • Strong conceptual understanding and ability to clearly and concisely document complex workflows in a simple, elegant manner
  • Ability to analyze complex business/technical problems, synthesize solutions, and communicate options to a wide group of stakeholders
  • Strong personality, able to work with, challenge and convince key stakeholders, driving to outcomes, with a determined focus to get things done
  • Detailed operational understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud & Service Cloud
  • Structured approach to project execution, ensuring that all parts are moving and taking active ownership to drive to successful outcomes
  • Understanding of Agile Methodology and the use of JIRA to run sprints.
  • Proven track record of delivering medium projects to budget and deadlines

PREFERRED/NICE TO HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Consulting experience, implementing multiple different ERP vendor solutions
  • Knowledge of FinancialForce PS Cloud.
  • Salesforce Trailheads or Admin Certifications
  • Project Management certification
  • Agile methodologies

Leasing Agent

Grow Your Leasing Career and Help Our Communities Thrive!

Shelter Corporation is seeking an enthusiastic, organized, and service-focused Leasing Agent to join our team at Austin Pointe Apartments in San Antonio, Texas.

As part of Team Shelter, you'll play an important role in helping prospective residents find their next home while supporting leasing activity, occupancy goals, resident satisfaction, and the overall success of our community.

From conducting apartment tours and following up with prospective residents to coordinating move-ins and building positive resident relationships, you'll help create a welcoming experience at every stage of the leasing process.

If you're personable, goal-oriented, detail-oriented, and passionate about helping people find their next home, we'd love to hear from you!

What You'll Do

As a Leasing Agent, you'll...

  • Conduct engaging apartment tours, showcasing available homes, community amenities, and property features to prospective residents.

  • Respond promptly to prospective resident inquiries, maintain consistent follow-up, and guide prospects through the leasing process from initial inquiry to move-in.

  • Support leasing, occupancy, and conversion goals by building strong prospect relationships and helping turn inquiries and tours into completed applications and move-ins.

  • Maintain knowledge of available apartment homes, rental rates, lease terms, community features, and local market conditions.

  • Support marketing and outreach initiatives, including maintaining accurate online listings, social media activities, and community promotions.

  • Process rental applications, coordinate applicant screening, prepare lease agreements and related documentation, and collect applicable fees and deposits.

  • Coordinate move-ins and move-outs, including resident communications, required documentation, and apartment readiness.

  • Assist with lease renewals, resident retention initiatives, and community engagement activities that promote positive resident relationships and satisfaction.

  • Respond to resident questions and concerns professionally, providing timely follow-up and supporting respectful resolution of issues.

  • Maintain accurate prospect, resident, and leasing records within Yardi, CRM, and other company systems, including lead statuses, follow-up activities, and required documentation.

  • Follow applicable Fair Housing requirements, company policies, and leasing procedures throughout the application and resident experience.

  • Inspect model apartments, available homes, common areas, and amenities to help maintain a welcoming, clean, and tour-ready community.

  • Partner with property management and maintenance teams to coordinate apartment turns, work orders, resident service needs, and overall community operations.

  • Assist with leasing activity reports, occupancy tracking, renewal information, special projects, and other responsibilities that contribute to the success of our communities and Shelter.

What We're Looking For

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Previous experience in leasing, sales, customer service, hospitality, property management, or a related field preferred.

  • Experience conducting sales presentations, providing customer service, and building positive customer relationships preferred.

  • Knowledge of multifamily leasing practices and Fair Housing requirements preferred.

  • Experience with Yardi, CRM platforms, or similar property management and customer management systems preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong sales, customer service, and interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and connect with prospective and current residents.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to confidently present apartment homes and community features.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple prospects, follow-up activities, and competing priorities.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately process applications, prepare lease documents, and maintain prospect and resident records using property management and CRM systems.

  • Ability to navigate resident concerns and challenging conversations with professionalism and sound judgment.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with property management, maintenance associates, and other team members.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn new leasing, property management, and communication systems.

  • Willingness to learn new skills, participate in ongoing training, and continuously improve leasing and customer service performance.

  • Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills preferred.

Physical & Additional Requirements

  • Ability to regularly move throughout the assigned community, including apartment homes, model units, common areas, offices, amenities, and outdoor areas.

  • Ability to conduct apartment tours and property inspections, including walking, standing, and navigating stairs as needed.

  • Ability to perform work in both indoor and outdoor environments as responsibilities require.

  • Ability to use standard office equipment, computers, and property management technology.

  • Ability to work weekends or adjusted schedules as operational needs require.

  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Why Join Shelter?

Since 1993, Shelter Corporation has been creating value for residents and property owners through thoughtful, comprehensive property management. Today, we manage multifamily communities across Minnesota, Florida, and Texas, with experience spanning affordable, market-rate, active adult, and other multifamily housing.

At Shelter, we believe successful property management starts with strong communities, engaged associates, and a commitment to doing the right thing. Our values - Integrity, Competence, Fun, Accountability, Dedication, and Innovation - guide how we serve our residents, support one another, and care for the communities entrusted to us.

Beyond competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, Shelter is committed to creating a supportive workplace where associates can grow professionally, contribute meaningfully, and take pride in the communities they serve.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Shelter Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Ready to grow your leasing career and help us open doors? We invite you to apply and become part of Team Shelter.

title: Specialized Talent Administrator & Coordinator
description:
The Specialized Talent Administrator & Coordinator is responsible for providing administrative support to the talent acquisition process through pre-hire and post-hire activities, facilitating a variety of logistical and recruitment activities to service a particular client program or teams.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assist with recruitment and interview process
  • Complete phone interviews and document candidate responses, effectively screening in or out of the recruitment process based on position requirements
  • Develop interview schedules to ensure qualified candidates are evaluated
  • Update candidate statues in the appropriate recruitment systems (Applicant Tracking System (ATS), proprietary systems, etc.)
  • Timely review of applicants who have applied via the ATS
  • Schedule complex phone, video and in-person interviews with Recruiters or Hiring Managers
  • Coordinate candidate background, medical and reference checking processes
  • Coordinate aspects of the on-boarding and off-boarding processes
  • Edit and post positions to the ATS accurately and within the specified timeframes
  • Administratively manage posting of roles to candidate generation channels
  • Ensure recruitment team are appropriately updated on progress, escalate concerns or obstacles
  • Provide metric and pipeline reporting
  • Provide other administrative support to recruitment team as needed

Position Requirements

Education:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Completed Cielo TalentCloud ACE certification preferred

Experience:

  • Experience as a Talent Administrator & Coordinator for a minimum of 6 months preferred
  • Experience in a business or office environment
  • Customer service or administration preferred

Exposure:

  • Strong recruitment administration skill-set / competencies.
  • Knowledge of commonly-used concepts, practices, and procedures within talent acquisition strongly preferred.
  • Fluent in English and Hindi
  • Strong communication skills, verbal and written
  • Demonstrated proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite, including Outlook.
  • Ability to prioritize and organize own work
  • Desire to provide a high level of customer service to colleagues and clients

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Community Impact Coordinator - Care Campus
description:
About the Role

The Skid Row Care Campus is a comprehensive, low-barrier service center providing individuals experiencing homelessness with access to hygiene facilities, case management, health and behavioral health services, and connections to housing and other essential resources. The Campus offers a safe, welcoming, and trauma-informed environment that promotes dignity, stability, and pathways to long-term housing.

The Community Impact Coordinator builds and strengthens relationships between the Care Campus and the diverse community it serves. The position develops partnerships with Skid Row residents, individuals with lived experience, community-based and social justice organizations, service providers, neighborhood stakeholders, faith communities, advocacy groups, law enforcement and public safety partners, local government and elected officials’ offices, and other community partners to promote collaboration, trust, community engagement, and shared impact.

What You'll Do

Community Engagement and Relationship Building

  • Develop and maintain authentic, collaborative relationships with Skid Row residents, individuals with lived experience, community leaders, grassroots organizations, social justice and advocacy groups, neighborhood stakeholders, faith communities, law enforcement and public safety partners, local government and elected officials’ offices, and other community partners.
  • Maintain a regular presence in the Skid Row community and participate in relevant neighborhood meetings, coalitions, events, forums, and community activities.
  • Serve as an accessible point of contact for community members, organizations, public agencies, and other stakeholders seeking to engage with the Care Campus.
  • Proactively engage stakeholders to better understand community priorities, concerns, strengths, resources, and opportunities for collaboration.
  • Build relationships across diverse perspectives and organizations while promoting respectful dialogue and constructive partnership.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen trust, communication, and collaboration between the Care Campus and the surrounding community.

Government and Public Safety Partnerships

  • Develop and maintain productive working relationships with relevant law enforcement and public safety partners, including the Los Angeles Police Department (LAPD), to support communication and coordination regarding issues affecting the Care Campus and surrounding community.
  • Build relationships with local elected officials’ offices, government agencies, and other public-sector stakeholders connected to Skid Row and the Care Campus.
  • Serve as a liaison for routine communication with government and public safety partners, coordinating with Care Campus and organizational leadership as appropriate.
  • Facilitate meetings, site visits, introductions, and other engagement opportunities between Care Campus leadership and public-sector partners.
  • Help communicate community and campus concerns to appropriate public-sector partners and support collaborative problem-solving when appropriate.
  • Track requests, commitments, concerns, and follow-up items resulting from meetings or engagement with government and public safety partners.
  • Coordinate with organizational External Affairs, Communications, Government Relations, or other designated leadership on matters involving elected officials, government agencies, media-sensitive issues, or broader public policy considerations.

Safety, Crisis, and Overdose Response

  • Maintain awareness of participant, community, and environmental safety while working on the Care Campus and in the surrounding Skid Row neighborhood.
  • Recognize and appropriately respond to behavioral health crises, medical emergencies, suspected overdoses, escalating situations, and other safety concerns within the scope of the position.
  • Use trauma-informed engagement and trained de-escalation techniques when appropriate and seek assistance from Safety, clinical staff, emergency responders, or other appropriate resources when additional intervention is needed.
  • Complete all required organizational and program-specific training, including harm reduction, overdose recognition and response, opioid overdose reversal using naloxone (Narcan), de-escalation, emergency response, CPR, and other health and safety training as assigned.
  • Respond within the scope of training to suspected overdoses and other medical emergencies, including administering naloxone (Narcan) when indicated and activating appropriate emergency response resources in accordance with established protocols.
  • Promptly report significant safety concerns, incidents, or community conditions to appropriate Care Campus leadership.
  • Maintain professional boundaries and follow established procedures when responding to challenging or potentially unsafe situations.

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum of five years of experience in community engagement, community outreach, community relations, organizing, public affairs, human services, homeless services, or another community-facing role.
  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining relationships with diverse community members, organizations, and stakeholders.
  • Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness, communities with complex social-service needs, or within the Skid Row/Downtown Los Angeles community strongly preferred.
  • Experience engaging with public agencies, government representatives, advocacy organizations, public safety partners, or other external stakeholders preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in human services, social work, sociology, public administration, public health, communications, community development, or a related field preferred, but not required.
  • An equivalent combination of relevant education, professional experience, community-based experience, and transferable skills may be considered.
  • Strong communication and listening skills
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust across differing perspectives
  • Sound judgment and professional boundaries
  • Ability to facilitate meetings and follow through on commitments
  • Comfort working independently in a highly visible community-facing role

    Our Values

    Dignity | Community | Integrity | Partnership | Social Justice | Radical Care

    Work Environment

    Regular use of a computer and HR technology platforms is required, along with the ability to manage detailed records and sustained periods of screen-based work. The role follows a hybrid work arrangement with regular onsite presence and occasional travel among Los Angeles-area locations. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

    The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

    Physical Demands:

    The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

    While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, sit, walk, stoop, talk, hear, reach above and below shoulders; use hand and finger dexterity, keyboarding and making and receiving telephone calls. The employee may be required on occasion to lift and or carry up to 20 lbs.

    EEO:

    SJC (St. Joseph Center) provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetics or status as a veteran. In addition to federal law requirements, SJC complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

    Benefits:

    Excellent Benefits package available.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

Ready To Own Complex Pipeline Work End-to-End on a Data Platform Built to Power Analytics and AI at Scale?

Why This Role Matters

Data Platform Engineering exists to make the handoff from product data to analytics insight reliable and invisible. As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you’re the person teammates trust to get complex pipeline work right — designing, building, and operating the pipelines, transformations, and data quality systems that Reporting & Analytics depend on every day. You own your work from design through production, and you build it in ways others can reuse.

What You'll Actually Do

Design and build scalable data pipelines: Develop and operate pipelines that move data from product systems into the data lake reliably and at scale.

Build and maintain curated datasets: Construct and sustain large-scale transformations and curated datasets on open table formats consumed by Reporting & Analytics.

Implement data quality and monitoring: Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage so problems are caught before users notice them.

Apply PII/PHI security and privacy controls: Implement access management, masking, encryption, and auditability across the platform to meet regulatory requirements.

Onboard new data sources: Bring new product delivery team data sources onto the platform cleanly and quickly, defining the data contracts behind them.

Tune performance and manage cloud cost: Optimize pipeline and table performance while monitoring and controlling cloud infrastructure costs.

Contribute to design and code reviews: Participate in architecture and code reviews, sharing knowledge and raising the technical quality of the team’s output.

Support on-call and incident response: Share on-call responsibility for the platform and respond to incidents with urgency and thoroughness.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education & Experience

  • 5+ years in data or software engineering, with at least 3 years focused on data platforms or big data
  • Production experience building and running data systems at real scale
  • Experience in healthcare, benefits, insurance, or another regulated industry a plus

Technical Skills

  • Heavy hands-on experience with large-scale data transformation
  • Strong experience building and operating data pipelines and data lakes
  • Hands-on experience with open table formats — Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake — including schema evolution, partitioning, and time travel
  • Solid experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar
  • Practical experience with data governance covering data quality, PII/PHI handling, and freshness monitoring
  • Strong SQL and Python proficiency
  • Apache Spark experience preferred
  • Apache Kafka and event-driven architecture experience preferred
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices as data producers preferrd

Our Commitment: Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to talent@personifyhealth.com. View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers.

title: Product Owner- Customer Risk
description:
Product Owner - Customer Risk

Are you ready to redefine the financial industry? Are you looking to leave an impact on the financial lives and futures of over 2.5 million customers across the Nordics? Then Nordnet is the place for you!

In brief

At Nordnet, we exist to ensure the most inspiring savings experience. Through leading UX, cutting-edge financial products, and automated and inspiring customer journeys, we are building the best platform for savings and investments, enabling higher returns for our customers. Nordnet is customer-focused and product-led.

We are now seeking an experienced Product Owner to lead our teams working closely with Customer Risk within the Product Platform area. These teams build the systems that keep Nordnet and our customers safe: customer due diligence, risk classification, politically exposed persons and sanctions, enhanced due diligence, and the information we provide to authorities. 2027 is an exciting time to join as the new EU Anti-Money Laundering Regulation (AMLR) applies from July 2027, and you, together with our Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) department will drive the product side on how Nordnet meets it, for private customers, minors and companies across our Nordic and German markets. We are looking for someone who can carry that work and keep building the product long after the deadline has passed. The Product department consists of the Chief Product Officer, Area Product Owners, and Product Owners within the different domains.

This is part of the role

As Product Owner for Customer Risk at Nordnet, you own the product vision, roadmap and delivery for our anti-money-laundering and customer-due-diligence platform. You translate regulation into products that are compliant by design, efficient for our operations teams and as smooth as possible for our customers. On a daily basis, you work with a skilled, AI-first engineering team, our FCP experts, Compliance, and the teams that work on customer sign-up and customer data. Together with FCP and Compliance, you turn regulatory requirements into clear product decisions, and help other teams build it right the first time.

Key responsibilities:

  • Product innovation: Shape the due diligence and customer-risk experience so it is compliant, efficient for operations and low-friction for customers.

  • Roadmap ownership: Lead the team roadmap by defining feature scope and prioritizing deliverables in collaboration with business owners and stakeholders.

  • Stakeholder communication: Maintain transparent communication with stakeholders regarding roadmap progress, changes, and potential blockers.

  • Risk & compliance: Proactively identify and mitigate product risks while ensuring all features meet stringent regulatory and legal standards.

  • Engineering leadership: Guide development teams through complex technical problem-solving to deliver impactful products and a high-performance user experience.

This is you

You have built products in, or worked closely with, FCP, and you care about why the rules exist, not just what they say. You have an interest within savings and investments and you have previous working knowledge and experience from digital product development within the financial service sector. You are comfortable saying "not now" and explaining why. You take a "low-ego, high-impact" approach. You take ownership of outcomes, stay calm and structured under pressure, and make the people around you better by sharing what you know.

You have:

  • A minimum of 3-5 years of experience as product owner or similar role within onboarding, risk assessment, customer due diligence or FCP in a bank, broker, fintech, payments company, consultancy or RegTech provider.

  • Passion for creating smooth customer journeys, even where regulation adds friction.

  • Ability to navigate the complex, competitive, and regulated finance landscape

  • High personal initiative with a natural ability to lead by example, inspire others, and drive results

We offer

Nordnet started from a passionate belief that changing the hierarchical financial world was possible. You will become part of a journey that has only just begun towards the vision of making our customers the best investors they can be. We’re over 1000 employees in Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen and Germany. Since November 2020, Nordnet (SAVE) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm main market with a market capitalization of SEK91bn.

This role is based in Stockholm with the working language English

Visit us on:,,,,,

Application

If you have questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Linnea Liljedahl, Linnea.liljedahl@nordnet.se

Apply today – we will start interviewing immediately. Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system, hence no email applications will be considered. We want to inform you that Nordnet conducts mandatory credit and background checks, as well as drug testing as a part of our recruitment process. We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Part-Time Shift Leader
description:
Job Summary

The Shift Leader plays a key role in assisting the Store Manager with daily store operations, training associates, and ensuring exceptional customer service. This role contributes to achieving business KPIs, upholding store standards, and assisting with various operational tasks, including cashiering, opening and closing, merchandising, customer engagement, cash management, store upkeep, and shipment processing. Additionally, the Shift Leader will actively promote the store’s membership program to foster customer loyalty. By fostering a positive and energetic environment, the Shift Leader helps ensure that Life is for Fun for both the team and customers, creating a dynamic and enjoyable atmosphere that drives success and delivers memorable experiences.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead by example to drive sales, meet store KPI goals, and exceed customer expectations.

  • Assist the store manager in training and developing sales associates to ensure strong product knowledge and customer engagement on the sales floor & at the register.

  • Help support daily operations, including replenishment, fronting, store maintenance, cash handling, and merchandising.

  • Maintain store appearance, ensure proper stock levels, and implement visual merchandising updates.

  • Open and close the store, ensuring the store is recovered and clean and in compliance with safety and operational procedures.

  • Be empowered to resolve customer concerns professionally and escalate issues to Store Manager when necessary.

  • Support Loss Prevention efforts and ensure adherence to all company policies designed to prevent loss.

  • Maintain a professional attitude, demonstrating enthusiasm and sincerity that aligns with MINISO USA’s customer commitment.

  • Process sales transactions accurately and efficiently using point-of-sale systems.

  • Participate in store promotions and sales events to support overall business objectives.

Additional Qualifications

  • Strong leadership, interpersonal, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to multitask and maintain composure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic knowledge of retail operations and POS systems.
  • Ability to travel between store locations as needed.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent; associate degree preferred.
  • 1+ years of experience as a keyholder, supervisor, or shift leader, preferably in the retail industry.

Pay Range

USD $14.00 - USD $19.00 /Hr.

title: X Ray Technologist $10,000 Tuition Reimbursement
description:
Overview

Bonus up to $10,000

Center Address: 1419 Knecht Avenue Baltimore, MD 21227Shift: Monday-Friday 8am-5pm

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At Concentra, you will be a vital member of our patient care team and play a crucial role in providing exceptional care to our patients. Our mission is to improve the health of America's workforce, one patient at a time. Join us at Concentra and see how your clinical competency and compassion can make a meaningful difference in the lives of the patients you serve.

The Radiologic Technologist & Medical Support Specialist performs routine will perform routine x-ray examinations in accordance with Concentra policies, practices, and procedures and applicable regulations under direct supervision of the treating clinician, as well as supports in other needed areas of the facility. This role requires efficient and accurate delivery of one-on-one patient care while thriving in a fast-paced environment. The RT MSS ensures that every patient is treated with quality clinical care and receives an excellent patient experience from welcoming, respectful, and skillful colleagues.

Responsibilities

Radiologic Technologist Duties

  • Prepare patients for radiologic procedures. Escort patients to dressing and x-ray rooms, provide verbal and/or written instructions and assist patients in positioning body parts to be radiographed. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure patient care, safety and comfort during the x-ray exam.
  • Operate radiologic equipment to produce images of the body for diagnostic purposes. Position radiologic equipment and adjust controls to set exposure time and distance according to specification of examination. Take x-rays following established radiologic requirements and regulations to ensure patient care and safety.
  • Use radiation safety measures and protection devices to ensure safety of patients and team members
  • Ensure radiologic equipment remains in working order. Report equipment malfunctions to Center Operations Director
  • Ensure all Radiology workflows are followed and all Radiology reports cross correctly to EMR
  • Follows documentation procedures and completes required documentation related to patient x-ray visit.
  • Maintain all x-ray equipment, including calibration, QA/QC procedures, and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures

Medical Assistant Duties

  • Perform Department of Transportation (DOT) and Non-DOT drug and alcohol testing
  • Prepare patients for physical examinations, including taking vital signs and any required or requested ancillary testing including but not limited to vaccines and injections, phlebotomy, PFTs, audiogram testing and respirator fit testing (in accordance with state regulations)
  • Perform rapid screening tests (influenza, strep, mono, glucose, etc.)
  • Assist providers during examination and treatment
  • Responsible for performing routine medical procedures as ordered by treating clinician as well as triaging emergent patients as needed
  • Prepare and assist clinician with procedure set up and injury care
  • Apply bandages, dressings and splints as ordered by the treating clinician
  • Dispense medications and DME as ordered by the treating clinician in accordance with state regulations
  • Complete quality assurance activities on equipment and medical devices as well as testing processes used in the center
  • Maintain supplies, clean rooms and equipment, and stock exam rooms
  • Maintain and operate all medical devices and equipment, including calibration and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures
  • Notify supervisor immediately if equipment is not functioning properly, supplies are needed, or facility is not operating as expected
  • In partnership with center leadership, assist with patient flow and volume
  • Keep patients informed of expected wait times during all aspects of the center visit
  • Responsible for clerical tasks in both the front and back office associated with patient care and proper record keeping
  • Ensure accuracy in documentation
  • Perform front office duties: greet patients, obtain authorization, check in/out, communicate wait times, answer multi-line telephone system, and distribute employer results/paperwork as needed
  • Follow HIPAA guidelines and safety rules
  • Attend center staff meetings or huddles as required
  • Assist in maintaining a neat, clean, and orderly appearance throughout the facility
  • Complete any applicable training including but not limited to clinical competency training that occurs monthly.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Education Level: High School Diploma or GED
  • Graduate of an accredited school of radiologic technology and applicable certification by the state in which employed.
  • Registered with The American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) and has active and valid certification.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification

Job-Related Experience

  • Customarily has at least six months or more of medical assistant experience with knowledge of medical procedures and medical terminology
  • Working knowledge of occupational medicine requirements (state specific) is preferred with prior medical office, healthcare and/or customer service-related experience.

Job-Related Skills/Competencies

  • Concentra Core Competencies of Service Mentality, Attention to Detail, Sense of Urgency, Initiative and Flexibility
  • Ability to make decisions or solve problems by using logic to identify key facts, explore alternatives, and propose quality solutions
  • Outstanding customer service skills as well as the ability to deal with people in a manner which shows tact and professionalism
  • The ability to properly handle sensitive and confidential information (including HIPAA and PHI) in accordance with federal and state laws and company policies
  • Able to communicate both verbally and in writing in a clear, and professional manner
  • Teamwork focus with peers and center leadership team; ability to maintain working relationship with all levels of colleagues
  • Must participate in initial and ongoing training as required
