title: Junior Engineer
description:
Junior Engineer

Are you looking to develop your engineering career and gain practical experience in product design, testing and manufacturing?

We are looking for a Junior Engineer to support the design, development and improvement of industrial valves and associated components used across the oil, gas, hydrogen and wider energy sectors.

Working alongside experienced engineers, you will contribute to technical projects while building your knowledge of valve technology, materials, pressure-containing equipment and industry standards. Training and guidance will be provided to support your development.

About Us

We are a family-owned global company that produces ultra critical valves for the world’s oil, gas and hydrogen industries, where exceptional quality and on time delivery is critical.

With operations spanning the UK, USA, Dubai, Malaysia and India, and a world-class Research & Development centre in Knutsford, we have ambitious plans to grow beyond our £100m turnover.

Our business model is to sub-contract our components, then assemble at our facilities in Knutsford and Chennai. Our culture is agile, entrepreneurial and decisive. There are no layers of bureaucracy, endless committees or slow-moving approval processes. We value common sense, accountability and action.

What you’ll be doing

  • Assisting with the design and development of industrial valves and components.

  • Producing and updating 3D CAD models, component drawings and assembly drawings.

  • Supporting the selection of materials, seals and components for different operating conditions.

  • Carrying out basic engineering calculations under supervision.

  • Assisting with valve assembly, pressure testing and performance evaluation.

  • Supporting Production with technical queries relating to machining, assembly and drawings.

  • Helping investigate product performance issues, manufacturing defects and customer technical queries.

  • Updating drawings, bills of materials and technical records following approved engineering changes.

  • Working with Quality, Purchasing and suppliers to clarify technical requirements.

  • Contributing ideas to improve product performance, reliability, manufacture and cost.

What we’re looking for

You will have a basic understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials and manufacturing, together with a practical approach to solving problems and a willingness to learn.

You should also bring:

  • Experience using SolidWorks or another 3D CAD package.

  • Mechanical engineering or assembly experience.

  • Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively.

  • Confidence using Microsoft Word, Excel and other PC applications.

  • A methodical approach and attention to detail.

Knowledge of machining processes, engineering tolerances and assembly methods would be useful. An interest in industrial valves, fluid control systems or precision engineering is welcome, but previous valve industry experience is not essential.

Develop your engineering career

This role offers the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers and gain exposure to the full product lifecycle, from initial design through to manufacture and testing.

To apply, please submit your CV outlining your relevant experience.

title: Head of Commercial Finance
description:
Closing date for applications: 3rd November 2026

Who are we?

Newmedica, part of the Specsavers group, is one of the leading providers of NHS ophthalmology services in England, delivering outpatient appointments, diagnostic testing and eye surgery to change lives through better sight and eye health.

We’re proud to have been certified as a Great Place to Work for the third year running and listed among the UK’s top 30 Best Workplaces™ for 2026 —recognition that reflects how colleagues feel about working here.

Our Purpose is to change lives through better sight and eye health, and our Vision is to end avoidable sight loss in every community we serve; we live our values every day – Commercial, Courageous, Compassion, Collaborative and Curious.

Role Overview



We have an exciting opportunity for a Head of Commercial Finance to join the Newmedica team. This is a hybrid role with 1-2 days per week in the office.


Reporting to the Finance Director, you’ll act as a strategic business partner to the Newmedica Leadership Team, Joint Venture Partners and Support Office budget holders. You’ll provide commercial insight, financial leadership and challenge to support key operational and strategic decisions across the business.


This is a highly visible role, sitting at the heart of Newmedica’s growth agenda. You’ll help shape investment decisions, support long-term business planning and ensure financial performance is clearly understood across our Joint Ventures and Support Office functions.


Leading a team of five finance professionals you’ll foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration and continuous improvement, helping your team and stakeholders make informed, commercially sound decisions that support sustainable growth.


What Will I Be Doing?


You'll lead and develop the Commercial Finance team, creating a high performing environment where colleagues are supported, challenged and empowered to grow. You’ll oversee financial planning, budgeting and forecasting processes across both our Joint Ventures and Support Office functions, ensuring risks and opportunities are identified and managed effectively.


A significant part of the role involves partnering with senior leaders to evaluate commercial opportunities, operational initiatives and investment decisions. You’ll provide insight and challenge to support decision making, helping the business balance strategic priorities with commercial performance.


You’ll take ownership of finance reporting to the Board and Senior Leadership Team, delivering meaningful analysis that drives informed discussion and action. Working closely with our Data team, you’ll also help develop reporting capabilities that combine financial, operational and clinical performance information to deliver deeper business insight.


In addition, you’ll play a key role in supporting our future growth plans, including private service development, activity planning and contract discussions with NHS partners. You’ll provide financial leadership across Joint Ventures, ensuring performance is understood, opportunities are maximised and challenges addressed proactively.


What Skills and Experience Do I Need?


We’re looking for a qualified Accountant with significant post-qualification experience and a proven track record of operating in a commercially focused finance leadership role.


You’ll have highly developed commercial and analytical skills, alongside the ability to interpret complex information and translate it into meaningful business recommendations. You’ll be comfortable working in an environment where priorities evolve and ambiguity exists, making sound decisions based on the best available information.


You’ll be an inspiring people leader, with experience coaching and developing finance professionals and creating high performing teams. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills are essential, with the confidence to influence, challenge constructively and build effective relationships across the organisation.


Most importantly, you’ll be a proactive and forward-thinking finance leader who enjoys improving processes, driving change and helping a growing organisation achieve its ambitions.


What we’re offering

  • Up to £100,000 depending upon experience
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays plus 1 day birthday leave
  • On target bonus of 20%
  • £6,6000 car allowance
  • Group profit share scheme
  • A company pension scheme
  • Private health and dental care
  • Access to a range of benefits including free eye tests, discounted or free glasses, a free 24/7 well-being/counselling/advice service and a retail/technology discount scheme.
  • An environment where your learning and development is supported through a range of various learning tools and courses.



If you are shortlisted, you will be asked to complete a short video interview as the next stage of the process.



Our employment offers are subject to receipt of satisfactory pre-employment checks. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK and a Disclosure and Barring Service check will be necessary in the event of a successful application which we will pay for.

At Newmedica, we actively promote diversity and equal opportunities, and we are committed to this in both the running of our services and how we recruit our staff. We actively encourage applications from everyone with the essential requirements of the job, regardless of any protected characteristics.

Newmedica is fully committed to safeguarding the welfare of all people, irrespective of gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, race, language, religion, ethnic or social origin.

Our goal is to bring fusion electricity to the grid by developing the power stations of tomorrow and the skilled workforce to deliver them.

As Intellectual Property Manager, you will lead IP activity for a key UKAEA division, helping to identify, protect and commercialise innovations in fusion energy.   • Support the development of a pipeline of innovations with commercial potential.
  • Raise awareness of IP across UKAEA by delivering training and providing guidance to technical and business colleagues.

What You’ll Bring

  • A degree in a scientific or engineering discipline, supported by a strong technical background.
  • Part or full qualification as a Chartered or European Patent Attorney, or significant experience within an in-house patent or IP team.
  • Experience of leading patent drafting strategies alongside inventors and external patent attorneys.
  • Experience of reviewing and providing strategic advice on IP terms within contracts.
  • Experience of managing an IP portfolio.
  • Experience of patent prosecution and responding to patent office actions.

UKAEA is an onsite organisation, and this role requires regular onsite presence (usually between 3-5 days in any given week) in line with business needs. We actively support flexible working arrangements where this is compatible with the role.

Benefits

title: Part-Time Shift Leader
description:
Job Summary

The Shift Leader plays a key role in assisting the Store Manager with daily store operations, training associates, and ensuring exceptional customer service. This role contributes to achieving business KPIs, upholding store standards, and assisting with various operational tasks, including cashiering, opening and closing, merchandising, customer engagement, cash management, store upkeep, and shipment processing. By fostering a positive and energetic environment, the Shift Leader helps ensure that Life is for Fun for both the team and customers, creating a dynamic and enjoyable atmosphere that drives success and delivers memorable experiences.

title: Regional Learning and Organisational Development Coordinator - South
description:
We’re looking for a Regional Learning and Organisational Development Coordinator to support Priory sites across the South. You’ll play a key role in helping our sites meet training and compliance requirements by coordinating mandatory and specialist training, while supporting wider learning and development needs.

You’ll work closely with colleagues across the region, with monthly team meetings held in Leicester and travel to Priory sites in our South region occasionally.

This role is offered on a fixed term basis for 18 months.
You’ll coordinate learning and development across Priory sites in the South, helping colleagues access the training and support they need while ensuring we meet our compliance requirements.

  • Supporting colleagues: Respond to learning and development queries by email and telephone, managing the Learning Inbox and ensuring colleagues receive timely, helpful responses.
  • Coordinating training: Organise mandatory and specialist training, working with site teams and preferred training providers to maximise attendance and make the most of available training.
  • Monitoring compliance: Use our Learning Management System (LMS) to track training completion, identify gaps and support sites to achieve Priory’s 90% compliance target.
  • Providing site support: Build strong relationships with Site Learning Administrators, Site Leads and other stakeholders, offering guidance on Priory Academy systems, processes and learning requirements.
  • Reporting and administration: Produce accurate reports on training compliance and attendance, raise purchase orders, support invoice queries and maintain accurate records.
  • Improving how we work: Identify opportunities to improve processes, share best practice and support wider learning and development projects across Priory.
You’ll be organised, proactive and detail-focused, with the confidence to manage your workload independently and support colleagues in a busy, fast-paced environment.

You’ll also bring:
  • Experience in an administrative role, ideally within HR, learning and development or a training department.
  • Strong IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office, software platforms and systems to manage information and produce reports.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to respond to queries, present information clearly and build effective working relationships.
  • Good analytical skills, sound judgement and the confidence to challenge existing processes and suggest improvements.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
You’ll be comfortable working independently as well as part of a wider team, bringing a positive attitude, diligence and a willingness to learn and improve.
We want you to succeed at Priory and thrive in your role. You will be well supported with regular career conversations. We also offer full training and numerous pathways into leadership and qualified clinical positions to help you shape your career with us.

title: Décapeur(se) de wagons / Railcar blaster
description:
Overview

La fonction primaire du Décapeur de Wagons consiste à effectuer des travaux de décapage à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur des wagons ferroviaires afin d'enlever les résidus, la peinture et autres substances étrangères.The primary function of the Shot Blast Operator is to operate blasting equipment to remove scale, paint and other foreign substances from inside and/or outside of railcars and other materials.

Responsibilities

GATX est reconnue à l’échelle mondiale comme leader en location d’actifs de transport et contrôle l’un des plus importants parcs de wagons ferroviaires au monde. L’un des aspects clés de la croissance et du succès à long terme de GATX est la capacité d’attirer des gens de talents de partout dans le monde et de les maintenir en poste.

Notre Centre de maintenance de wagons qui se trouve sur la Rivière des Prairies à Montréal recherche des personnes motivées et dynamiques pour son service de décapage. Le/la candidat(e) privilégié(e) est doté(e) au moins d'un Diplôme d’étude secondaire ou equivalent, a une solide culture envers la satisfaction de la clientèle et est en mesure d'exercer des travaux de décapage sur les wagons de manière sécuritaire et efficace, selon les normes établies.

Autres exigences :

  • Accepte de faire des heures supplémentaires au besoin.
  • Sa santé lui permet d’effectuer des tâches physiques et de manipuler une charge de 100 lb.
  • Est respectueux envers les autres, honnête, capable de travailler en équipe et fiable.
  • Capable de travailler dans des espaces confinés et des hauteurs.

Être familié avec le SIMDUT et le TMD est un atout.

Salaire de départ: 27. 22$/ heure avec une possibilité d’avancement pour le candidat retenu.

GATX is recognized worldwide as a leader in transportation asset leasing and manages one of the largest railcar fleets in the world. A key factor in GATX’s long-term growth and success is its ability to attract and retain talented people from around the globe.

Our Railcar Maintenance Center located in Rivière-des-Prairies, Montréal, is seeking motivated and dynamic individuals to join its Blasting Department. The ideal candidate will possess at least a high school diploma or equivalent, have a strong commitment to customer satisfaction, and be able to perform railcar blasting operations safely and efficiently in accordance with established standards.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be willing to work overtime as required.
  • Must be physically capable of performing demanding tasks and handling loads of up to 100 lbs.
  • Must be respectful of others, honest, dependable, and able to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Must be able to work in confined spaces and at heights.

Knowledge of WHMIS (Workplace Hazardous Materials Information System) and TDG (Transportation of Dangerous Goods) is considered an asset.

Starting wage: $27.22 per hour, with opportunities for advancement for the successful candidate.

Qualifications

POURQUOI APPLIQUER CHEZ GATX?

  • Excellentes conditions de travail
  • Salaires compétitifs
  • Vaste gamme d'avantages sociaux y compris la couverture aux soins médicaux, dentaire, vision, assurance vie et un plan de retraite.

title: Personlig assistent till kvinna i centrala Borlänge
description:
Söker du ett givande arbete som personlig assistent? Bli en del av mitt härliga team i centrala Borlänge!

Jag är en social och positiv kvinna på 50+ som uppskattar sång, gemenskap och möten med människor. Jag bor i en lägenhet på markplan med en fin uteplats i centrala Borlänge. Då jag använder rullstol/permobil behöver jag stöd i min vardag kring allt som rör mina dagliga rutiner, vilket gör att jag söker dig som är pålitlig, engagerad och vill hjälpa mig att leva det liv jag önskar.

Om tjänsten
Vi söker nu en ny kollega för fasta arbetspass på måndagar och torsdagar:

  • Måndagar: kl. 15.15–21.45 (dubbelbemanning)

  • Torsdagar: kl. 10.00–16.30 (dubbelbemanning)

Assistansen bedrivs dygnet runt, delvis med dubbelbemanning. Det är meriterande om du har möjlighet att arbeta extra vid behov, exempelvis vid sjukdom och semestrar.

Din profil
Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personliga lämplighet. För att trivas i rollen ser vi gärna att du är:

  • Lugn, trygg och tålmodig: Du har en stabil personlighet och ett gott bemötande.

  • Glad och flexibel: Du har nära till skratt, en positiv inställning och värdesätter ett gott samarbete med dina kollegor.

  • Kommunikativ: Du behärskar det svenska språket väl i både tal och skrift för att säkerställa god kommunikation och trygghet i vardagen.

Vad vi erbjuder
Hos mig blir du en del av ett glatt, sammansvetsat och stöttande team. Du kommer att få en grundlig introduktion av dina kollegor så att du känner dig helt trygg och bekväm med rutiner och användning av hjälpmedel.

Låter det här som en tjänst för dig? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!


VILKA ÄR VI?

Vi Omsorg är ett assistansbolag med hjärtat i Dalarna. Vi finns till för att skapa kvalitativ assistans för våra kunder och strävar efter ständig förbättring för att hålla oss aktuella. Hos oss har kunden ett stort inflytande över vem som ska anställas som assistent och hur assistansen ska utföras. Samtidigt som vi erbjuder våra kunder individspecifik assistans riktar vi stort fokus på våra medarbetare och värnar om deras arbetsmiljö.

Vad kan vi erbjuda dig?

  • En utvecklande och lärorik arbetsmiljö

  • Kollektivavtal

  • Förmånskort

  • Aktiviteter för både kunder och assistenter

Vill du veta mer om oss? Besök gärna vår hemsida:

ATT ARBETA PÅ VI OMSORG

Som anställd personlig assistent hos oss omfattas du av kollektivavtal samt avtalspension. Du är försäkrad på och till/från arbetet om något oförutsett skulle inträffa. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag till alla våra anställda. Dessutom anordnar vi aktiviteter som riktar sig både till dig som anställd och till kunden du arbetar med. Vi är måna om att du som medarbetare ska trivas hos oss!

För anställning hos oss på Vi Omsorg behöver du ha ett BankID och godkänner att använda ditt BankID i tjänsten. En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och/eller lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete i Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned på Skatteverkets hemsida här. För att kunna jobba som personlig assistent behöver du vara minst 18 år.

Registerutdrag: För anställning hos oss krävs utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Det är viktigt att utdragen beställs i god tid, eftersom Polisens handläggningstid kan variera.
Med anledning av lagändring från den 1 mars 2026 utökas registerkontrollen till att omfatta både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag från misstankeregistret.
Du beställer enkelt utdragen med BankID via denna länk:

Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag enligt de nya reglerna.

DELA KANDIDATER MELLAN BOLAGEN

Din ansökan kan komma att delas med våra systerbolag om din profil matchar en annan tjänst inom Team Olivia. Du ger ditt medgivande i ansökan.

FÖR DIG MED ANSTÄLLNINGSSTÖD

Om du som söker har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd tar vi som arbetsgivare på Vi Omsorg även detta i beaktning vid en eventuell anställning. Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

title: Corporate Legal Intern (Long-Term)
description:

This hybrid internship is designed for law students who have completed their first year of law school and have a strong interest in corporate law, international law, and contract law, particularly within a post-integration business environment. The internship will begin on a part-time basis during the spring semester, with hours increasing to 40 hours per week during Summer 2027, and will continue through the summer term.   • Draft, review, and organize contracts, agreements, and other legal documents
  • Participate in due diligence activities related to mergers, acquisitions, and integrations
  • Help maintain contract databases and legal records
  • Prepare summaries, memoranda, and presentations for internal legal and business stakeholders
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including compliance, finance, and business operations

title: Area Director of Family Services
description:
Overview

At Upbring, our team is united by a shared mission: to break the cycle of child abuse and advance the wellbeing of children, families and communities, empowering them to thrive. As servant-leaders, we lead by example, working passionately to create a brighter future for those we serve. Every day, we strive to embody our core values:

  • We are Warriors: Fierce, resilient, and courageous, we face challenges head-on with unwavering loyalty and passion.
  • We are Servants: We dedicate ourselves to serving others, empowering those around us to thrive.
  • We are Family: We work together as a supportive, caring community, creating a sense of belonging and strength.

Joining Upbring means becoming part of a family of passionate individuals who are fearless in their pursuit of lasting change. Together, we are making a difference, one life at a time.

Your MIssion in Action

The Area Director provides management and oversight of a branch office within the agency’s Foster in Texas (FIT) program. The Area Director is an experienced leader who can manage staff both directly and indirectly. The Area Director provides strategic leadership, operational oversight and compliance management of a branch office within the agency's FIT program. The Area Director ensures the highest standards of child wellbeing are met by supervising staff, maintaining regulatory compliance, fostering positive relationships with stakeholders, and driving continuous improvement in service delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and evaluate program services and quality of care to ensure they are always being provided in compliance with all licensing standards and regulatory requirements
  • Oversee and manage the placement process, which includes intake and eligibility, verification, assessment, and referral services
  • Oversee and manage the recruitment and verification of in-process families
  • Ensure all foster care homes meet full licensing requirements
  • Oversees quality audits, case reviews, and quality assurance initiatives to maintain high standards of care
  • Provide servant leadership, direction, and support to the branch office staff
  • Ensure operational efficiency by implementing best practices and streamlining meetings and workflows
  • Prepare monthly reports on program services and activities; submit all reporting requirements in a timely manner
  • Review, approve, and sign off on all monthly and annual status reports, discharge summaries, and incident reports
  • Demonstrate efforts to manage a budget within budget limits and constraints
  • Identify funding opportunities, grants, and partnerships to support program growth
  • Serve as an advocate for program services by recommending program improvements and enhancements to meet the needs of the foster care children and their families
  • Maintain a caseload, as needed
  • Travel as needed to perform home visits to ensure licensing standards are being met along with the well-being and safety of the children
  • Provide emergency and on-call services when needed
  • Lead collaborative efforts and activities with the interdisciplinary and treatment teams, staff, and medical and non-medical providers to ensure all foster care children are receiving the quality of services needed to meet their individual treatment and behavior plans
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with foster families, child wellbeing agencies, and community partners
  • Represent Upbring at meetings, conferences, and community events
  • Foster a positive and collaborative work environment that aligns with Upbring's Mission and Values
  • Coach and support staff to ensure they have the necessary tools and resources needed to optimize performance, ensure established program goals, and achieve operational excellence
  • Communicate with direct reports in periodic one-on-one meetings
  • Organize and deliver regularly scheduled staff meetings to communicate present, on-going, and future updates of pertinent information, projects, and initiatives
  • Work closely with management team to interview, hire, and onboard new employees who are strong cultural fits for Upbring
  • Work in collaboration with leadership and the People and Culture Team to arrange training; when needed, coordinate and/or provide in-service training for staff development
  • Regularly review employee performance, including goals and progress, to provide developmental feedback: use applicable agency development tools to facilitate growth and development in staff
  • Draft and issue the 90-day and annual evaluations, along with supporting documentation, as per established procedures; work in collaboration with staff to set goals during evaluation period

Qualifications

Area Director of Family Services Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or closely related field
  • Child Placement Management Staff (CPMS)
  • Three (3) years relevant experience in foster care, child welfare, or adoption
  • Two (2) years supervisory or management experience
  • Valid TX driver’s license and auto insurance coverage
  • At least 21 years of age

Area Director of Family Services Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or closely related field
  • LCPAA, LMSW, LCSW, LMFT, or LPC
  • Three (3) years supervisory or management experience
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish based on service area and service population)

Travel

  • This position may be required to travel up to 10%

Perks at Upbring

  • Competitive PTO & paid holidays
  • Health, dental, vision insurance & more
  • 403(b) Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Discounted Gym Memberships

Physical Demands & Work Conditions

  • This position requires sitting and looking and using a computer for long periods of time
  • Position has constant exposure to children
  • Position requires frequent standing and walking
  • Lift, push, pull, move up to 25 lbs.
The physical requirements for this position with or without reasonable accommodation are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this position successfully. While performing this position the employee with or without reasonable accommodation should have the ability to walk, stand, sit, kneel, speak, and hear with aid, see, read, reach with arms and hands, lift and/or move up to specified weight, and use equipment that is essential to performing the job, such as a computer, copier, fax machine, telephone, and automobile, if applicable. Specific vision requirements of this position may include color vision, seeing things close up, and the ability to adjust focus.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

Role Purpose:

  • This Testing role is responsible for providing technical leadership and ensuring the successful implementation of the Testing horizontal stream of the Transformation program

  • This position involves assessing and executing a comprehensive testing strategy that includes both manual and automated testing processes. The Testing Lead will review the existing design and implement a robust automated testing framework, ensure the SI configures appropriate testing tools, and will oversee the creation of detailed test plans and scripts and their execution

  • This role requires strong leadership to guide the testing team, manage resources, and maintain high standards of quality assurance through rigorous validation and continuous improvement practices.

  • The Testing Lead will work closely with other functional business and tech leads, stakeholders, and end-users to ensure the SAP system meets all technical and business requirements through the various phases of Testing

  • This role will align with functional technology streams in the program to ensure that the requirements of each functional area are effectively captured in this streams’ scope, and to ensure that dependencies required of functional streams are well managed into Testing

  • This role requires knowledge of SAP and enterprise systems, strong leadership capabilities, and excellent communication skills to work with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and vendors.

What you'll be doing


Technical skills and experience

All of the below are assumed to be in collaboration/cooperation with the System Integrator:

Testing Strategy Development:

· Develop and define the overall testing strategy for the SAP transformation programme, ensuring alignment with project objectives and timelines.

· Design and implement a robust automated testing framework tailored to the SAP system’s specific requirements.

Automation Strategy and Implementation:

· Develop a comprehensive automation strategy that outlines the scope of automation, including which tests to automate based on risk and frequency.

· Lead the transition from manual to automated testing processes, ensuring seamless integration and minimal disruption.

Test Planning & Management:

· Create comprehensive test plans that cover all phases of testing including unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Plan and schedule all test activities across different stages of the project lifecycle.

· Manage resources, timelines, and budgets allocated for testing activities to ensure effective test coverage.

Test Case Development:

· Oversee the development and maintenance of detailed test cases and test scripts based on business requirements and technical specifications.

· Oversee the development of automated test scripts that are maintainable, reusable, and effective.

· Ensure that test cases cover all functional and non-functional requirements of the SAP system.

· Regularly review and update test scripts to accommodate changes in system requirements and functionality.

Team Leadership & Coordination:

· Train testing team members on the use of automated testing tools and the maintenance of test scripts.

· Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement, encouraging team members to enhance their automation skills. Lead and mentor the testing team, providing technical guidance and support as needed.

· Engage with functional tech leads, business leads and business stakeholders to gather feedback during testing phases and ensure the SAP system meets business needs and expectations.

· Facilitate testing rounds, ensuring effective participation and feedback from end-users.

Test Execution & Monitoring:

· Manage the execution of test cases, monitor the testing process, and ensure adherence to established timelines and standards.

· Identify and resolve testing bottlenecks or delays, ensuring efficient progress of testing activities.

· Coordinate with other project leads (e.g., Data Migration Lead, Integration Lead) to ensure integration points and dependencies are appropriately tested.

Issue Management:

· Track and manage defects identified during testing, prioritizing issues based on severity and impact on the project.

· Work closely with development teams to ensure timely resolution of issues and re-testing of solutions.

Performance and Load Testing:

· Utilize the automated testing framework for performance and load testing, ensuring the SAP system can handle projected transaction volumes and user loads.

· Analyse performance test results and make recommendations for system enhancements and optimizations.

Continuous Testing Integration:

· Integrate automated tests into the continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline to ensure ongoing system integrity.

· Monitor the effectiveness of automated testing within the CI/CD pipeline and make adjustments as necessary.

Reporting & Documentation:

· Provide regular updates and reports to project stakeholders regarding test progress, results, and issues.

· Maintain comprehensive documentation of testing processes, outcomes, and lessons learned.

· Develop quality metrics to measure the effectiveness of automated testing and identify areas for improvement.

· Provide detailed reports on automation coverage, defect detection rates, and other relevant metrics to stakeholders.

Post-Implementation Support:

· Oversee post-implementation testing to ensure the SAP system operates as expected in the live environment.

· Provide ongoing support and guidance during the stabilization period after go-live

What you’ll need to succeed

Technical skills:

· Strong understanding of business processes and how they are supported by SAP systems.

· Experience working with SAP and enterprise systems is mandatory, in design, deployment, testing and support

· Experience managing large hybrid teams comprised of internal and external resources

· Experience managing external vendors to a budget / target and ensuring close scope management

· Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in SAP technology implementation and management.

· Proven experience as a technical lead or similar role in large-scale transformation programs

Behavioural skills and certification:

· Strong leadership and team management abilities

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

· Problem-solving and analytical skills

· Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

· Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality.

· Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership.

· Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

· Committed to continuous learning and professional development.

Education and Professional Certification:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

Relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, ITIL, SAP certifications) is a plus

What we can offer you

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

title: RF Communications Engineer – Atlantic City, NJ (Onsite) – 15+ Years
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior RF Communications Engineer to support a major Aviation Client in Atlantic City, NJ. The selected candidate will be responsible for the design, integration, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of RF and communications systems. The role requires extensive hands-on experience with RF technologies, VHF/UHF radio systems, communications protocols, networking, VoIP, and Test & Evaluation (T&E) activities.

Responsibilities :

  • Design, configure, integrate, test, and troubleshoot RF and communications systems.
  • Perform RF measurements, testing, analysis, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Support analog and digital VHF/UHF radio system integration, operation, and testing.
  • Develop and execute Test & Evaluation (T&E) documentation including test plans, procedures, requirements traceability matrices (VRTMs), and test reports.
  • Establish, operate, and maintain communications testbeds and test environments.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot routers, switches, and communication networks.
  • Support VoIP systems and communication interfaces.
  • Conduct communications site surveys and support facility installation activities.
  • Perform requirements analysis, verification, and interface documentation support.
  • Prepare technical documentation and provide project status updates.

  • 15+ years of experience in RF Communications Engineering.
  • Experience with RF systems design, integration, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong knowledge of RF characteristics including VSWR, gain, noise figure, impedance, output power, intermodulation, selectivity, and interference.
  • Experience with RF components including amplifiers, attenuators, filters, mixers, switches, and circulators.
  • Hands-on experience with analog and digital VHF/UHF radio systems.
  • Experience with communications system integration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with communications protocols including TCP/IP, RS-232, RS-422, ATM, SONET, ISDN, Frame Relay, and GPIB.

  • Knowledge of OSI and TCP/IP reference models.
  • Experience configuring and maintaining routers and switches.
  • Experience with VoIP protocols including SIP, RTP, and MGCP.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

  • Aviation communications systems experience.
  • LabVIEW/TestStand automated test suite experience.
  • Microwave radio systems experience.
  • Satellite communications experience.
  • Knowledge of EUROCAE ED-137.
  • Experience with network simulators, traffic generators, and protocol analyzers.
  • PCB design and fabrication experience.
  • Software development experience with C, C++, Java, Python, Linux, RTOS, embedded systems, or object-oriented methodologies.
  • Experience leading or mentoring technical teams.
  • Location: Atlantic City, NJ (Onsite)
  • Employment Type: Contract (C2C)
  • Duration: 12 Months with Possible Extension
  • Experience Required: 15+ Years
  • Visa Restriction: No OPT / CPT
  • Industry: Aviation
  • Candidates must have strong hands-on RF communications and testing experience in complex communications environments.

title: Lead Data Platform Engineer
description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

Ready To Architect and Build the Data Platform That Connects Every Product, Pipeline, and AI Initiative at Personify Health?

Why This Role Matters

Data Platform Engineering is a new organization with a clear mandate: make the handoff from product data to analytics insight reliable, governed, and invisible. As Lead Data Platform Engineer, you shape that from the ground up — designing the architecture, setting the standards, and shipping the pipelines that power reporting, AI use cases, and data-driven product features. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You’ll set the direction and still write code.

What You'll Actually Do

Lead platform architecture and delivery: Own the end-to-end data platform — ingestion, lake layout, transformation layers, and serving — continuously improving reliability, performance, and scale.

Design and build large-scale pipelines: Integrate product systems, member and client data, claims and eligibility feeds, and third-party sources into a scalable, well-governed data platform.

Own the open table format layer: Design and maintain the Iceberg or Delta Lake layer — including table design, partitioning, compaction, schema evolution, and long-term maintenance.

Define and enforce governance standards: Build the platform’s governance framework covering data quality, PII/PHI classification and controls, freshness SLAs, and lineage — and hold the broader team to it.

Set engineering standards and orchestration patterns: Establish CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, alerting, and orchestration standards that the team adopts and operates against.

Define data contracts with product teams: Set standards for how product delivery teams produce data and influence their services to make downstream consumption cleaner and more reliable.

Enable analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives: Partner with analysts and data scientists to operationalize advanced analytics, predictive models, and AI use cases on top of the platform you build.

Lead technically and develop engineers: Mentor engineers, lead architecture reviews, and take point on technical response to major incidents.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education & Experience

  • 8+ years in data or software engineering, including 5+ years focused on data platforms or big data
  • Demonstrated record of technical leadership across teams
  • Extensive production experience designing and scaling data systems that others depend on
  • Experience in healthcare, benefits, insurance, or another regulated industry a plus

Technical Skills

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in large-scale data transformation including performance tuning and cost optimization
  • Expert-level knowledge of open table formats: Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake
  • Strong experience architecting and operating data pipelines and data lakes
  • Experience designing and rolling out data governance frameworks covering quality, PII/PHI management, access control, and freshness monitoring
  • Experience designing orchestration strategy at platform level
  • Advanced SQL and strong Python proficiency
  • Apache Spark including performance tuning at scale preferred
  • Apache Kafka and event-driven architecture experience preferred
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and microservices as data producers preferred
  • Exposure to ML operationalization or AI platforms preferred

Our Commitment: Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to talent@personifyhealth.com. View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers.

title: LUCA SAP Finance Project Manager (m/f/d)
description:
**Company Description**

**About us**

Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.

Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale.

Are you striving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us!

**Job Description**

**The LUCA program**

LUCA is METRO’s strategic SAP S/4HANA Finance transformation program. It safeguards business continuity and addresses security and compliance risks while enabling greater standardization, harmonization and centralization across Finance. Alongside new-country rollouts, the program continuously evolves and supports the productive solution used by countries already live on LUCA.

**Purpose of the role**

Based in Düsseldorf, Germany, the SAP Finance Project Manager will lead the delivery of change projects for LUCA countries already operating on the productive SAP S/4HANA Finance solution. Typical assignments include the implementation of new electronic-invoicing mandates, other legal and regulatory requirements, and business-driven changes that affect Finance processes, integrations, data, controls and operational procedures.

The role is designed for an experienced SAP Financials professional who has moved into project coordination and delivery management. The Project Manager must understand Finance requirements and SAP solution implications well enough to structure work, challenge plans, connect the correct experts and drive decisions, while remaining accountable for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk and stakeholder alignment in a large international SAP landscape.

Your responsibilities

End-to-end project delivery

  • Own the delivery of assigned SAP Finance projects for LUCA live countries from initiation and scoping through design, build, testing, deployment, hypercare and closure.
  • Translate legal, regulatory and business change requests into structured projects with clear objectives, scope boundaries, deliverables, milestones, governance, resource needs and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering functional design, technical implementation, interfaces, data, testing, cutover, communication, training and operational readiness.
  • Manage scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions and change control, ensuring that deviations are visible and addressed early.
  • Prepare concise status reporting, decisions and recommendations for LUCA governance, country stakeholders and management.

Regulatory and business change delivery

  • Coordinate the implementation of country-specific electronic-invoicing mandates and other legal or tax-driven changes, working with Finance local, central, system implementors, and partner-system specialists.
  • Lead business-change projects that enhance or adapt live SAP Finance processes, ensuring alignment with the LUCA global template and the needs of productive operations.
  • Ensure requirements are sufficiently clear, approved and traceable, and that legal effective dates and business deadlines are translated into realistic delivery plans.
  • Coordinate impact assessments across SAP Finance, SAP Ariba where relevant, master data, reporting, authorizations, interfaces and non-SAP partner systems.
  • Protect productive operations by ensuring controlled releases, appropriate regression testing, cutover planning, support readiness and post-go-live monitoring.

Functional and technical coordination

  • Use prior SAP Financials experience to understand end-to-end process impacts, ask informed questions and facilitate productive alignment between business and technology teams.
  • Coordinate solution architects, functional consultants, developers, integration teams, test teams, release management, AMS, country organizations and external partners.
  • Identify interdependencies across processes, systems, countries and concurrent initiatives, assign ownership and drive decisions and actions to closure.
  • Challenge delivery proposals, estimates and solution approaches constructively, while relying on accountable architects and specialists for detailed design authority.
  • Ensure project outputs are documented, supportable and handed over effectively to the relevant live-country and service-management organizations.

Testing, deployment and stakeholder management

  • Work with LUCA Test Management to define the test approach, business participation, environments, data, entry and exit criteria, defect governance and acceptance evidence for each project.
  • Coordinate country UAT and business acceptance, ensuring the right stakeholders are mobilized and that open defects and residual risks are transparent before deployment.
  • Plan and govern cutover and production deployment activities with clear responsibilities, sequencing, readiness checks, fallback considerations and management communication.
  • Act as the central project contact for country Finance stakeholders, LUCA teams, METRO Digital, the System Integrator and other delivery partners.
  • Build trust across cultures and time zones through transparent communication, dependable follow-up, pragmatic issue resolution and timely escalation.

**Qualifications**

**Required key competencies and qualifications:**

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Informatics, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • At least 8 years of relevant experience in SAP Finance delivery, including substantial earlier experience in SAP Financials followed by a successful move into project coordination or project management.
  • Solid functional understanding of SAP S/4HANA Finance processes and integration points, with experience in one or more areas such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Controlling, tax or financial interfaces.
  • Proven experience delivering SAP changes or projects in a large, international and multi-country SAP landscape.
  • Experience managing legal, regulatory, tax, electronic-invoicing or other deadline-driven change initiatives is highly advantageous.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, country organizations, AMS providers, System Integrators and technology partners without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Experience across testing, UAT, cutover, release, deployment and hypercare in productive SAP environments.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Ariba, invoice-management solutions, integration platforms or partner-system landscapes is advantageous.
  • Confident use of project planning, collaboration and reporting tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, PowerPoint and Excel.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or SAP certification is advantageous but not required; retail or wholesale experience is beneficial.
  • Visible “can-do” attitude, with the energy and persistence to move complex topics forward, remove obstacles and find pragmatic paths to delivery.
  • Strong ownership and accountability, combined with disciplined planning, follow-up, risk management and escalation.
  • Ability to understand functional and technical discussions, structure ambiguity and translate complex issues into clear actions and decisions.
  • Confident, articulate communication and stakeholder-management skills across business, Finance, technology, vendors and senior management.
  • Collaborative and culturally aware working style suited to distributed international teams and multiple country stakeholders.
  • Calm and solution-oriented under pressure, particularly when managing fixed legal deadlines or production-critical changes.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; willingness and ability to travel when required.

**Additional Information**

**What do we offer at METRO.digital?

  • **Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment.**

At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup.

  • **People development: when you grow so do we!**

We want you to become the best version of yourself with individual and company-wide programs and trainings for people development. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation ... it´s time to upskill your career.

  • **Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring!**

We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey.

Want to know more about all our benefits? [Discover more here](https://metro.digital/about/life-at-metro).

Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now!

Position grade within our career framework: Project Manager Grade 3 (Md9).

title: Senior Principal Contracts Specialist
description:
Basic Qualifications

Education Requirements:

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience is required plus a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.

Clearance Requirements:Department of Defense Secret security clearance obtainable within reasonable time based on requirements. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

Overview:A Contracts Specialist is responsible for supporting the management of the company's contractual agreements with customers, in the drafting, negotiation, and execution of contracts, as well as ensuring compliance with contract terms and conditions. The Contracts Specialist also maintains accurate contract records and databases and assists in identifying and mitigating any contract-related risks. title: Youth Advocate (Lena’s House) PT Sat & Sun 3-11pm
description:
Youth Advocate (Lena’s House) PT Sat & Sun 3-11pm

In-Person Part-Time (16 hours per week) Position in Hayward, CA (Non-Exempt)

Who We Are

Ruby's Place dba Restorative Pathways (RP) is an innovative nonprofit committed to ending domestic violence, human trafficking, and violent crime through hope, advocacy and connection. Our services include emergency shelter, transitional housing, rental subsidies, mental health services, substance recovery, and wrap-around services. All our services are trauma-sensitive and client-centered and are provided at no cost to our clients. All programs are low barrier.

RP is led by survivors with a focus on reflection, innovation, and connection. We believe in fostering relationships, both in our direct service work and throughout our internal work culture. We aim to cultivate a workplace that appreciates and emphasizes the voices of those most impacted by violence. We recognize these voices are vital to interrupting the cycle of violence and transforming lives towards safety, unity, and trust.

Who You Are

You have a strong commitment to preventing interpersonal violence as well as an understanding of, and sensitivity to, serving diverse populations. You have excellent interpersonal skills and strong techniques for relationship building. You believe people should determine their own path towards healing, and have an orientation towards survivor-centered services.

You either have lived or have professional experience with the immigrant, latinx community and are in touch with the challenges that newcomers face when immigrating. You are compassionate, understanding and hold passion to work with this specific community. You are a go-getter who enjoys fast paced environments. You enjoy working both collaboratively and independently. You are adept at time management and highly organized with a proven ability to ensure you can meet deadlines, plan, organize and execute. You are comfortable working as part of a team and are an accountable collaborator. You excel at organizing, prioritizing, and following through on multiple time-sensitive projects. You are flexible, creative, and take initiative in handling emergencies.

What qualifications are required for this position?

You are also:

  • In possession of a high school diploma or equivalent and either
  • Two years of full-time experience, or its equivalent, working with the population to be served or equivalent education or experience as determined by CDSS or
  • Two years’ experience as a member of the social work staff in a group home or short-term residential therapeutic program
  • 21 years of age or older.
  • Someone who exhibits integrity and good moral character to provide appropriate care to UC;
  • Someone with the relevant experience and/or qualifications to work with UC and UC with special needs.
  • Be able to show proof of immunity to vaccine-preventable diseases transmitted by the respiratory route if working directly with UC, including Varicella, TDap or Tdap, Influenza, Fully vaccinated against COVID-19
  • Someone who has not engaged in any form of child abuse or neglect, including domestic violence or has not been convicted of engaging or attempting to engage in sexual abuse facilitated by force or Is undergoing civil or administrative adjudication.
  • In possession of, or will complete after hiring, the State mandated 40-hour Domestic Violence counselor certification.
  • Able to lift 25 lbs.
  • In possession of a valid CA driver's license, proof of insurance, and be approved by Restorative Pathways insurance as a driver in order to drive agency vehicles.
  • Able to complete a background check, fingerprinting (Live Scan), and completion of all Community Care Licensing requirement documents. Able to meet all licensing requirements of Community Care Licensing.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experienced in child welfare and/or case management, crisis intervention, peer counseling.
  • Experienced in working with survivors of human trafficking and domestic violence.
  • Experienced working with the immigrant community.
  • Experienced in working in a residential setting providing direct services to survivors.
  • Understanding of the dynamics of trauma-sensitive care, as well as an understanding of, and sensitivity to, serving diverse populations and languages as it relates to family dynamics and other aspects of cultural practice.

What You Will Do

The function of the Youth Advocate is to provide necessary shift coverage for the overall operation and function of Restorative Pathways shelter for self-identified young women with a reported history of sex/labor trafficking, domestic violence, or who are at risk of such abuse. Additionally, the Youth Advocate will provide support and assistance to Case Management staff.

Responsibilities include

  1. Monitor the facility during the day, evening, and/or overnight shifts.
  2. Provide emotional support to residents.
  3. Practice active listening with residents.
  4. Perform telephone screening for potential clients.
  5. Basic maintenance and cleaning tasks (cleaning, chore supervision, stocking, and general supply inventory).
  6. Assist with data entry, filing and additional clerical duties.
  7. Provide confidential, holistic, client-centered, trauma-informed services.
  8. Orient new residents to the facility.
  9. Provide back-up in-person or phone shift coverage to other Shelter Programs as necessary
  10. Assist with general program operations.
  11. Fill out a functional timesheet by assigned due dates and in compliance with the time allocations.
  12. Actively participate in reflective supervision
  13. Create and maintain documentation of processes and procedures in relation to duties of the job
  14. Other duties as assigned.

Working Conditions

You are expected to be available on-site at all times during your scheduled shift hours and days, Sat-Sun 3-11pm. You must be able to stand for long periods of time and perform physical activities, including lifting up to 25 pounds. You will be subject to frequent interruptions and must be able to multitask and handle stress.

Local travel in the greater Bay Area may be required.

Applying

The pay scale for the Youth Advocate (Lena’s House) is $29.87 per hour (non-exempt) with benefits that come with working at Restorative Pathways at part-time hours include immediate vesting in our 403(b) with a generous match. This is a part-time, 16 hours per week, hourly position. This is an in-person position. Applicants must be located in the greater Bay Area.

If all this sounds like a good fit for you, please submit your resume and, instead of a traditional cover lever, respond to the following three prompts:

  • Why do you want to work for Restorative Pathways and why are you a good fit for this role? (200 words max)
  • Using the qualifications listed above (under Who You Are section), please list the top 5 qualification(s) that you feel you currently excel in and 2 qualifications you feel you will need to work toward proficiency. Please provide a brief explanation for each (a few sentences).
  • Please describe your professional goals and how you see this position at Restorative Pathways supporting those goals.

At Restorative Pathways, we are committed to workplace diversity and providing equal employment opportunities. Please also note that we are going to be especially excited about candidates who understand the unique nature of a mission-driven organization and have lived experience or direct experience working with survivors of domestic violence, human trafficking, or violent crime.

title: Senior Client Experience Executive
description:

Working within the pension side of the employee benefits team, a key part of this role is to be the main point of contact for a number of clients, (usually HR teams).

The role holder will be required to manage their own administrative tasks in addition to supporting more junior members of the team.

Juggling multiple pieces of work, this busy role will see the job holder get involved in more in-depth client support tasks, such as governance, feedback reports, uploads and assessments.

Communication is a key part of this role to keep clients and Consulting Partner’s updated. The role holder will need to have a warm and professional demeanour both on the telephone and in written form and the ability to build good relationships with our corporate clients

Key skills and personal attributes:

  • Having a thorough understanding of the EB processes, client file requirements and the regulatory requirements imposed by the FCA and deliver against these to agreed service standards.

  • Following Secondsight processes to deliver what clients perceive to be a personalised and high quality service.

  • Being proficient in the upload of client contribution and assessment files.

  • Managing and producing client governance reports.

  • Familiarising yourself with each client’s circumstances, objectives and timescales to ensure that we are able to deliver against or where possible exceed the clients expectations. Checking back at the end of the process to ensure all meeting actions have been completed.

  • Building relationships with your clients and managing any client queries, responding in a timely fashion and within SLA times.

  • Organising and attending client meetings.

  • Sending regular communications and updates to corporate clients.

  • Managing client feedback, supporting with the annual DCJ with your clients.

  • Supporting where required with advisor prep and advisor meeting days.

  • Assisting with the production of monthly MI by maintaining central spreadsheets and activity logs.

  • Providing regular updates to the Practice Manager and Partners in the practice.

  • Supporting on the production of client engagement letters with Consulting Partners.

  • Supporting when required in any new client acquisition work.

  • Supporting with the training and mentoring of junior team members.

  • Undertaking any other duties where required.

About us

Foster Denovo currently boast over 120 Financial Advisers supported by around 300 employees across eight Foster Denovo offices throughout the UK. We have the scale and resource to provide exceptional advice and service to our clients, advisers and employees.

Our stakeholder community is an invisible bond that gives Foster Denovo its solid foundations. It also means that our people care about our reputation and brand. And as such, we aim to delight every client we come into contact with.

When you join the Foster Denovo family, you benefit from our enviable reputation and years of industry experience. In everything we do, we’re driven by a firm set of core values, and our friendly, stakeholder culture has been praised by employees, clients and partners alike.

Foster Denovo are also proud to hold the platinum investors in people accreditation which shows a clear commitment to the people who make us an employer of choice.


What we offer you:

Foster Denovo has an open, mutually supportive, knowledge-sharing culture. It’s a culture that has created the space to think differently for the benefit of our clients.

Our benefits package includes:

  • 25 days holiday (increasing by an additional day per annum up to 30 days)

  • Discretionary bonus

  • Foster Denovo will match your personal pension contribution up to a maximum of 7.5%

  • Life assurance of up to 4 x your salary;

  • Income protection of 75% of your basic salary in the event of long term sickness

  • Employees can use our financial advisers within the company for any financial advice or knowledge

  • Interest free season tickets loans, eye care and childcare vouchers.

  • Shopping discounts benefits portal (discounts on holiday, gym and high street retailers)

title: Senior Strategist, Creative Strategy
description:

In 2017, Karla Otto merged with K2 to form THE INDEPENDENTS, a global marketing, design, and communications group. This collective brings together industry leaders who share a commitment to innovation, excellence, and thoughtful collaboration across the luxury and lifestyle sectors.

At Karla Otto, our team of expert strategists, designers, planners and publicists are dedicated to delivering exceptional results and establishing long-term partnerships with our clients. We are passionate about the world of fashion, beauty, and luxury, with everyone bringing their unique expertise and insights to the table. We are driven by a shared commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the ever-evolving industry landscape.

To help support our future growth as an agency, we are looking for a Senior Strategist, Creative Strategy to join our team based in our Milan Office.

Key Responsibilities:

CREATIVE

  • Lead creative strategy and concept development on assigned Italian client briefs, from identifying the opportunity through to campaigns, content, experiences and programming, alongside selected global clients and pitches.

  • Translate cultural and creative shifts into original thinking for client work and new business.

  • Develop the creative, strategic direction and quality of assigned work, aligning with the Senior Director and CBO on strategic direction and departmental standards.

  • Identify and shape experience-led and Insights-led opportunities

  • Identify and recommend talent, creators, partners and collaborators, working with the Talent team where relevant.

  • Support client conversations, presenting strategic and creative recommendations and identifying opportunities to develop the work.

NEW BUSINESS & GROWTH

  • Build out creative responses on assigned Italian and relevant global pitches, with strategic and commercial guidance from the CBO.

  • Build integrated proposals with Insights, Communications, Talent, Beauty, Strategy, Special Projects and other divisions.

TEAM & DIVISION DEVELOPMENT

  • Guide colleagues and external collaborators, giving clear creative feedback and supporting the development of junior team members.

  • Maintain and grow the external creative network required to deliver work at the right standard.

Key Attributes:

  • 6–8 years’ experience in creative strategy, creative direction or an equivalent agency role, with a focus on social and digital channels, programming and experiential work.

  • A strong portfolio spanning campaigns, content, experiences, programming and brand platforms.

  • Strong creative problem-solving and conceptual thinking, with a highly developed visual eye and excellent art direction judgement.

  • Deep reference knowledge across fashion, art, design, music, film and photography, with the instinct to spot what is emerging, anticipate where culture is moving and translate this into original creative thinking.

Annual gross salary: €40,000–€50,000, depending on experience.

We aspire to have a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourage qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join our team!

title: Employment Specialist - ACT Team
description:
Why Prairie Ridge?

At Prairie Ridge Integrated Behavioral Healthcare, our mission is to empower individuals to live healthy, purpose-filled lives on their terms. We believe in the potential of every person and recognize that meaningful care starts with understanding their experiences, strengths, and goals. Through personalized, whole-person care, we help individuals build the skills, connections, and support they need to move forward.

Our work is guided by five core values: Unyielding Empowerment, Relentless Resiliency, Inspirational Integrity, Active Accountability, and Radical Respect. These values shape how we care for the people we serve, work alongside one another, and connect with our communities. We value the different experiences and perspectives each team member brings and the collaboration it takes to provide thoughtful, coordinated care.

As part of our new Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) team serving the Marshalltown area, you’ll have the opportunity to help build something meaningful from the beginning. You’ll work alongside colleagues from different professional backgrounds to bring treatment and practical support directly to individuals in their everyday lives, helping them work toward greater stability, independence, and the goals that matter to them.



What Is the ACT Team?

Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) is a team-based approach to supporting adults living with serious and persistent mental illness. The team brings treatment and practical support into people’s homes and community settings, helping them manage symptoms, navigate challenges, and work toward their personal goals. Team members from different professional backgrounds work closely together to provide coordinated, individualized care.




As the Employment (Vocational) Support Specialist, you will help individuals receiving ACT services explore their interests, build job skills, and pursue employment goals. You’ll develop relationships with community partners and employers, identify job opportunities, and provide individualized coaching and ongoing support to help individuals find and maintain employment. Working alongside the ACT team, you’ll advocate for individuals, monitor their progress, and participate in the on-call rotation.



DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Engage patients in job skill development and conduct interest and skills assessments.
  2. Work with community partners on job development and job placement options.
  3. Engage in job coaching and counseling with ACT Team members in need of these services.
  4. Facilitate support groups and provide direct follow-up support.
  5. Participate in ACT Team consultation meetings and in the on-call rotation.
  6. Monitor client progress in the services received and facilitate updating the individual service goals.
  7. Advocate for the client with potential employers.
  8. 8. Treat all individuals with dignity and respect while maintaining agency standards of confidentiality, professionalism and objectivity.
  9. 9. Maintain all HIPAA and 42 CFR confidentiality requirements and regulations as outlined in CARF policies and procedures.
  10. 10. Comply with agency policies, procedures and regulatory standards.
  11. All other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED FOR POSITION

  1. Master’s degree in Human Service and (1) year of practical experience OR Bachelor’s degree in Human Service such as sociology, social work, psychology, criminal justice, gerontology, counseling, education, or nursing and (3) years of experience in a related field. Networking experience preferred.
  2. Valid Driver’s License
  3. Vocational rehabilitation experience preferred.
  4. Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and/or weekends if necessary.
  5. Travel is required as this is a community-based job position.
  6. Supportive of the mission of Prairie Ridge and the patients we serve.
  7. Proficiency in oral and written communication skills, as well as documentation requirements.
  8. Technology skills allowing for proficiency in use of electronic health record.
