title: Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems
description:
Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement—replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at .

As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈

You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.

You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.

This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.

  • You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.

  • You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.

  • You will bring product thinking to ambiguous requirements, working closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to distinguish reusable platform needs from customer-specific preferences.

  • You will use AI agents to produce much of the implementation. We expect you to design the solution, direct agents effectively, challenge their assumptions, review their output, and establish the tests and evidence needed for safe production deployment.

  • You will lead when your knowledge makes you the right person to lead, follow through on what you take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

Experience with performance calculations, valuations, fees, reporting, reconciliation, corporate actions, or portfolio-management systems would be particularly valuable.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. Autonomy works only when paired with initiative, collaboration, sound judgment, and follow-through.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be technically strong enough to recognise weak abstractions, incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, security problems, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

  • Trust and meaningful responsibility from your first day, with the opportunity to influence both our platform and how we build it.

  • Difficult and consequential problems involving financial data, product design, reliability, security, and real operational workflows.

  • The opportunity to define an AI-native approach to developing complex financial software and see your work reach customers quickly.

  • An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

  • Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows into a European market leader.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
You will report directly to the Infrastructure Engineering Manager in a newly formed SME team. Providing the group Service Ops team with support and expertise on all aspects of the databases & applications.

You will constantly identify opportunities to improve our service to our customer base, so that SLAs are exceeded, and customer feedback is consistently high.

Troubleshoot data quality and consistency problems which may result in application issues.

Provide aid to colleagues across the business with any issues related to our databases and applications, including support of Development, Testing and Internal systems.

This role requires expertise across both on-premises SQL Server and Azure-hosted database services, to ensure consistent support, monitoring and resilience regardless of where a database is hosted.

Work with the Infrastructure Ops, Infrastructure Engineering and Application Ops where required, to provide input and expertise on the strategic direction of our platforms and systems.

From time to time the role will also undertake specific project activities.
  • To maintain a high level of Database and Application availability & performance. This will be done by monitoring, measuring, and improving the database schema & queries wherever possible.
  • Manage the monitoring of all SQL databases and servers to ensure that we are alerted to performance issues prior to them impacting customers.
  • Provide support to both Internal & External customers, assisting with the ParentPay database / data queries and related data quality and application problems.
  • Undertake capacity planning to ensure that there is adequate capacity within the system to cope with long term growth plans and peak trading period.
  • Work with Development to ensure that bottlenecks that might affect performance are identified and eliminated.
  • Assist with the production of ad-hoc reporting for management and external customers via data extract or SRS report production.
  • Ensure data security and best practices are maintained, including evidence of backup schedules, encryption, retention and restore testing.
  • Introduce new tools and methodologies to improve efficiency across the estate.
  • Support SQL Server instances through their lifecycle (maintain, update, migrate), on-premises and in Azure.
  • Ensure incidents, tasks and changes are accurately documented and progressed in ServiceNow.
  • Proven experience of at least two years as a database administrator in an enterprise environment, with the ability to create and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures, using SQL Server and T-SQL
  • Working knowledge of database monitoring tools across both on-premises and Azure-hosted environments.
  • Working knowledge of ITSM tooling for accurate documentation and progression of incidents, tasks and changes.
  • Awareness of backup/DR requirements, including encryption, retention and restore-testing practices, across on-premises and Azure-hosted databases.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience in performing migrations/upgrades of SQL Server
  • Knowledge of infrastructure (compute, storage, networks), primarily on-premises with growing exposure to Azure-hosted database services.
  • Ability to take personal responsibility for training and self-development

title: Medical Center Manager
description:
Overview

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At Concentra, you will be a vital member of our patient care team and play a crucial role in providing exceptional care to our patients. Join us at Concentra and see how your clinical competency and compassion can make a meaningful difference in the lives of the patients you serve.

The Center Operations Director (COD) is responsible for ensuring an optimal level of care and customer service is delivered to all customers. The COD leads and manages all center support staff and oversees the daily operations of the medical facility. The COD is also responsible for coordinating center activities, general facility management, overseeing patient flow throughout the center, and supporting the medical and therapy providers in the delivery of patient care. Daily interaction with colleagues and patients is required through hands-on center activity including patient registration, check-out and patient care.

Responsibilities

title: Data and AI - AI Engineer
description:
Joining Wavestone’s UK Data & AI Service Line offers the opportunity to help shape large-scale AI and data transformations for FTSE100 organisations and enterprise clients. Our team is rapidly growing as clients increasingly rely on us to design, build, and scale modern AI solutions across their organisations.

You will be part of a high-performing consulting and engineering team delivering both advisory and hands-on implementation across AI strategy, AI engineering, GenAI solutions, and modern AI architecture patterns.

This role is intentionally platform-agnostic. While experience with tools such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI models (e.g. Codex / GPT), and other frontier or open-source LLMs is valuable, we are primarily looking for individuals who understand core AI engineering principles and can apply them across ecosystems.

This is an ideal role for someone who combines:

  • Strong understanding of AI/GenAI systems and architecture

You will design and implement end to end AI solutions, develop high‑quality code in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, and build agentic systems, automation workflows, RAG pipelines, and model‑orchestration layers. You will guide clients through complex technical decisions, ensure solutions integrate seamlessly into enterprise ecosystems, and maintain accountability for delivery quality, timelines, risks, and overall engagement success.

You will help identify opportunities, shape solution approaches, and contribute to proposals, RFP responses, and go‑to‑market initiatives. You will also develop compelling demos, prototypes, and technical narratives that demonstrate the value and feasibility of modern AI solutions, supporting the growth of Wavestone’s Data & AI footprint across key accounts.

You will contribute to thought leadership through articles, insights, and event participation, and help develop reusable accelerators, toolkits, and playbooks that address common client challenges. Your work will strengthen our market presence and help position Wavestone as a leader in practical, scalable AI delivery.

You will help build internal capability through knowledge‑sharing, training, and the development of reusable methodologies and frameworks. Where appropriate, you may also contribute to line management and career development within the practice.
  • Maintain Expertise : Stay at the forefront of the rapidly evolving AI/GenAI landscape, maintaining deep expertise in LLMs, agentic systems, RAG patterns, evaluation techniques, and cloud‑native AI tooling. You will continuously explore emerging technologies and engineering patterns, bringing forward new ideas that enhance client delivery and strengthen Wavestone’s internal capability.

  • Strong hands-on programming skills (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript)

  • Experience designing and implementing:

Desirable Experience

  • Experience across multiple AI platforms (e.g., Claude, GPT, open-source models)

  • Familiarity with orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.)

  • Experience optimising AI systems for performance, cost, and reliability

  • Knowledge of enterprise architecture and regulated environments

  • Experience with AI agents, copilots, or automation systems

  • Exposure to AI governance, safety, and responsible AI practices

  • Contributions to thought leadership, open-source, or internal capability building

Our commitment: Wavestone values and Positive Way

Diversity and Inclusion

At Wavestone, we celebrate diversity and inclusion. We have a strong global CSR agenda and an active Diversity & Inclusion committee with Gender Equality, LGBTQ+, Disability Inclusion, Social Mobility and Anti-Racism networks.

If you need flexibility, assistance, or an adjustment to our recruitment process due to a disability or impairment, please reach out to us to discuss this.

title: Severo Ochoa Postdoctoral Researcher in Exposome Research
description:
The Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) is a cutting-edge institute addressing global public health challenges through research, translation into policy and education. ISGlobal has a broad portfolio in communicable and non-communicable diseases including environmental and climate determinants, and applies a multidisciplinary scientific approach ranging from the molecular to the population level. Research is organized in five programs: Climate, Air Pollution, Nature and Urban Health; Environment and Health over the Lifecourse; Global Viral and Bacterial Infections; Malaria and Neglected Parasitic Diseases and Maternal Child and Reproductive Health. ISGlobal is accredited with the Severo Ochoa distinction, a seal of excellence of the Spanish Science Ministry.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

In the framework of our Centre for Excellence Severo Ochoa Programme (CEX2023-001290-S), ISGlobal is seeking a motivated postdoctoral researcher to work to reinforce exposome research at ISGlobal, in particular focused on the integration of (multi-)omics approaches in exposome studies across the life course. Using the exposome as an overarching framework, the postdoctoral researcher will carry out epidemiological studies to investigate the biomarkers and molecular mechanisms characterising the effects of a range of environmental risk factors (lifestyle, air pollution, chemical toxins, microplastics, urban factors, climate and climate change induced hazards) on health trajectories in childhood and adulthood. Prospective cohort studies, set up as part of our international projects, will be used as the basis for in-depth molecular studies (e.g. metabolome, proteome, microbiome, epigenome, immunome). Unique data resources in European birth, child and adult cohorts are available for this work.

The postdoctoral researcher will be involved in the evaluation of tools and resources gathered in the International Human Exposome Network (IHEN) HEurope project (, via demonstrator projects, particularly in the context of international cohorts and the urban and social exposome. This will provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to a high-impact international network at the forefront of exposome science.

The researcher will be based in the research group of Augusto Anguita , with co-supervision from other ISGlobal investigators with expertise in exposome research.

This position will be supported by funding from the “Centro de Excelencia Severo Ochoa 2024-2028” Program (CEX 2023-0001290-S) from the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation, and the Spanish Research State Agency (MCIN/AEI/10.13039/501100011033).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop research projects using the exposome datasets from several exposome-related cohorts spanning the life course, specifically with focus on biomarkers and molecular mechanisms characterising the effects of a range of environmental risk factors on health.

  • Scientific Leadership

  • Coordinate the implementation of a multi-cohort exposome research network focused on urban and social exposome.

  • Coordinate contacts with exposome-related cohorts and data sources globally and contribute to building a catalogue of these resources.

  • Liaise with international partners to ensure harmonized approaches to data processing, exposure modelling, and statistical analyses.

  • Data Analysis and Methodological Work

  • Develop and implement analytical pipelines in R or Python for the analysis of longitudinal exposome data with repeated measures.

  • Conduct meta-analyses across cohorts to assess the associations between exposome variables and health outcomes (e.g., blood pressure).

  • Document and interpret results in a structured and reproducible manner.

  • Work with the Severo Ochoa exposome WG to identify opportunities for exposome research in LMICs.

AUXILIAR TASKS

This job description reflects the present requirements of the post but may evolve at any time in the future as duties and responsibilities change and/or develop providing there is appropriate consultation with the post-holder.

This job description is not a definitive or exhaustive list of responsibilities but identifies the key responsibilities and tasks of the post holder. The specific objectives of the post holder will be subject to review as part of the individual professional assessment process.

SKILLS

  • Responsible, flexible and with problem solving skills.

  • Eager to learn and proactive.

  • Excellent writing skills.

  • Strong organization and team-working skills

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills

  • Team player, yet capable of working autonomously, rational and critical thinker

The post holder will adhere to ISGlobal principles contained in People management policy, including Equity, diversity and health safety. The post holder will respect, and be accountable to ensure ISGlobal policies and procedures.

TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS

  • PhD in epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, data science, environmental health, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in coordinating scientific or research projects, preferably involving international and/or multi-cohort collaborations.

  • Proficiency in R and/or Python for data processing, statistical analysis, and visualization.

  • Strong understanding of exposome concepts, longitudinal data structures, and meta-analysis methodologies will be an asset.

  • Familiarity with exposome-related tools and platforms (e.g., Molgenis, FAIR principles) will be an asset.

  • Experience working with urban or social determinants of health will be an asset.

  • Knowledge of data governance and data sharing practices in international health research will be an asset.

CONDITIONS

  • Contract: full time, 16 months.

  • Salary: According to ISGlobal internal salary scale.

  • Work-Life Balance: 36 days off per year (23 vacation days + 13 personal days)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

HOW TO APPLY

Applicants must complete the application form and upload a CV and a Cover Letter. Each document must be clearly named with the candidate’s name and surname.

Applications will remain open until 3rd of November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates may be contacted and interviewed as applications are received. Interviews may take place during the application period.

We encourage diverse applications, including but not limited to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, physical abilities, and political beliefs.

SELECTION PROCESS

The selection process is designed in two phases:
1- Interview phase of a technical nature, with the team that requires the incorporation. To assess the person's skills and CV.
2 - Meeting with HR with the finalist(s) to finish assessing the profile and discuss contractual and institutional issues.

If needed any technical test could be passed. A Psychological Competency Evaluation Test will be required for the structural or transversal positions.

In accordance with the OTM-R principles, a gender-balanced recruitment panel is formed for every vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will start the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. A profile questionnaire as well as a technical exercise may be required during the process.

In ISGlobal we are committed to maintaining and developing a work environment in which the values and principles of our organization are respected and equal opportunities between women and men be promoted in each of the areas in which we operate, not tolerating discrimination based on criteria such as age, gender, marital status, race, ethnicity, functional diversity, political leanings, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.

We confirm our commitment towards the value of the diversity of our staff and student population and seek to promote peace, equity, diversity and inclusion as essential elements in contribution to improving health worldwide.

title: Inginer Proiectant Electric
description:
Cautam un inginer cu gandire de ansamblu, pasionat de tehnologie, care combina gandirea logica si riguroasa cu creativitatea tehnica si care este interesat nu doar sa proiecteze solutii, ci sa inteleaga cum acestea pot fi integrate intr-un produs complex si imbunatatite permanent.

Ce vei face

  • Vei analiza cerintele functionale ale proiectelor si vei dezvolta conceptele electrice corespunzatoare;

  • Vei defini arhitectura electrica a sistemelor si vei propune solutii tehnice optime, inclusiv selectia componentelor si echipamentelor;

  • Vei elabora scheme electrice preliminare si documentatia tehnica necesara dezvoltarii produsului;

  • Vei identifica si evalua tehnologii, componente si solutii noi care pot fi integrate in proiecte;

  • Vei analiza si evalua furnizori si solutii tehnice disponibile pe piata;

  • Vei contribui la definirea specificatiilor tehnice pentru achizitia, dezvoltarea si testarea componentelor;

  • Vei realiza sau coordona realizarea de prototipuri, bancuri de testare, mock-up-uri si machete pentru validarea solutiilor;

  • Vei participa la testarea si validarea prototipurilor si a solutiilor dezvoltate;

  • Vei analiza rezultatele testelor, vei identifica problemele tehnice si vei propune solutii de imbunatatire;

  • Vei asigura documentatia tehnica aferenta solutiilor dezvoltate;

  • Vei contribui la dezvoltarea si consolidarea know-how-ului tehnic intern;

  • Vei contribui la standardizarea si reutilizarea solutiilor tehnice in proiectele viitoare.

Cum poate arata o zi obisnuita in acest rol:

  • Analizezi cerintele tehnice pentru un nou proiect si definesti arhitectura electrica preliminara;

  • Discuta cu echipa de inginerie despre integrarea unui nou modul electronic in vehicul;

  • Analizezi solutii tehnice si componente disponibile de la diferiti furnizori;

  • Lucrezi la o schema electrica sau la un model de sistem in software-ul de proiectare;

  • Participi la testarea unui prototip sau a unui banc de testare;

  • Analizezi rezultatele testelor si identifici cauzele unor probleme de functionare;

  • Colaborezi cu colegii din proiectare mecanica, IT, automatizari si productie pentru rezolvarea unei probleme de integrare;

  • Actualizezi documentatia tehnica si BOM-urile;

  • Evaluezi o tehnologie noua si propui modul in care aceasta ar putea fi utilizata intr-un viitor proiect.

Cerinte

Studii si experienta

  • Studii superioare finalizate in Inginerie Electrica, Automatizari, Mecatronica sau domeniu tehnic relevant;

  • Minimum 3 ani experienta in proiectarea si dezvoltarea sistemelor electrice;

  • Experienta relevanta in domenii precum automotive, vehicule speciale, echipamente medicale mobile, automatizari industriale sau alte produse tehnice complexe;

  • Experienta in proiecte de dezvoltare de produs nou, de la concept si prototip pana la validare si introducerea in productie;

  • Experienta cu software de proiectare electrica – EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical sau solutii similare.

Competente tehnice esentiale

  • Cunostinte solide de proiectare a circuitelor de alimentare, semnal si control;

  • Experienta in proiectarea schemelor electrice, inclusiv circuite monofazate si trifazate 230/400 V AC;

  • Capacitatea de a interpreta documentatie tehnica, de a realiza si gestiona BOM-uri electrice;

  • Cunostinte privind integrarea sistemelor electrice cu module IT si solutii software;

  • Cunostinte de baza privind automatizarile si programarea controlerelor, de exemplu PLC, Arduino sau sisteme similare.

title: Senior Director - Care Campus
description:
About the Role

The Skid Row Care Campus is a comprehensive, low-barrier service center providing individuals experiencing homelessness with access to hygiene facilities, case management, health and behavioral health services, and connections to housing and other essential resources. The Campus offers a safe, welcoming, and trauma-informed environment that promotes dignity, stability, and pathways to long-term housing.

The Senior Director provides overall leadership and accountability for the Care Campus, bringing together programmatic and operational functions to deliver safe, effective, integrated, and participant-centered services.

This is the senior site leadership role, with accountability for Campus performance, contractual compliance, service quality, participant experience and safety, staff effectiveness, operational performance, partnerships, and alignment across multidisciplinary teams. The Senior Director leads the Associate Director of Site Operations, program managers, and other assigned leaders and serves as the senior site-level escalation point for significant programmatic, operational, staffing, safety, participant, partner, and community matters.

Key Responsibilities

Campus Leadership

  • Provide overall leadership, direction, and accountability for the Care Campus and establish a culture centered on participant dignity, safety, service quality, collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence.
  • Lead and develop the Associate Director of Site Operations, program managers, and other assigned site leaders.
  • Establish clear responsibilities, decision-making authority, communication expectations, and escalation pathways across programmatic and operational functions.
  • Maintain a visible and engaged leadership presence and ensure appropriate leadership coverage and continuity of essential services.

Program & Service Leadership

  • Oversee ICMS case management, client support, participant engagement, service coordination, and other programmatic services.
  • Ensure services are participant-centered, trauma-informed, culturally responsive, and aligned with harm-reduction and Housing First principles.
  • Promote strong connections to housing, healthcare, behavioral health, public benefits, outreach, and other supportive resources.
  • Monitor participant access, service utilization, outcomes, service quality, grievances, accommodations, and barriers to engagement or service coordination.

Operational & Safety Leadership

  • Provide senior oversight of Campus operations through the Associate Director of Site Operations.
  • Ensure staffing structures, operational systems, Safety, Hygiene, facilities coordination, site procedures, and continuity planning effectively support participant services.
  • Maintain overall accountability for participant, employee, visitor, and Campus safety.
  • Provide senior site leadership during critical incidents, emergencies, major disruptions, and other high-risk situations.
  • Ensure significant incidents are appropriately reported, escalated, documented, reviewed, and addressed and that corrective actions and risk-mitigation strategies are implemented.

People & Culture

  • Lead, coach, and develop site leaders and hold managers accountable for effective supervision and management of their teams.
  • Monitor staffing levels, vacancies, turnover, attendance patterns, training, and other workforce factors that may affect services.
  • Partner with People + Culture on workforce planning, recruitment, retention, employee relations, and significant performance matters.
  • Foster a workplace characterized by professionalism, accountability, teamwork, inclusion, communication, and respect.

Partnership & Community Engagement

  • Develop and maintain productive relationships with funders, public agencies, healthcare and behavioral health organizations, housing providers, community-based organizations, businesses, neighborhood stakeholders, and service partners.
  • Provide strategic oversight of partner relationships and service integration.
  • Represent the Campus in funder, community, stakeholder, and partner meetings and address escalated or sensitive external concerns.

Contract, Quality & Performance Management

  • Maintain overall accountability for contractual performance and achievement of Campus and program objectives.
  • Monitor key performance indicators, participant outcomes, service utilization, staffing, incidents, documentation, and other measures of performance.
  • Ensure required data, reporting, documentation, and corrective actions are timely, accurate, and sustained.
  • Partner with Compliance, Quality, Data, Finance, Contracts, and other organizational functions on monitoring, audits, program reviews, and performance improvement.

Fiscal & Organizational Stewardship

  • Partner with Finance and organizational leadership to monitor expenditures, staffing levels, resource use, and significant program needs.
  • Identify fiscal, staffing, equipment, or resource risks that may affect services or contractual performance.
  • Promote responsible use of staffing, space, supplies, equipment, and other Campus resources.
  • Lead cross-functional coordination across Programs, Operations, People + Culture, Compliance, Finance, Contracts, Data, IT, Facilities, Communications, and other organizational departments.

Continuous Improvement

  • Regularly evaluate Campus performance, service integration, staffing models, workflows, participant experience, operational effectiveness, and emerging needs.
  • Use participant feedback, employee input, partner feedback, performance information, incidents, and operational experience to identify systemic barriers and strengthen services.
  • Lead improvements that support a more integrated, responsive, safe, and effective Care Campus.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, public administration, human services, nonprofit management, healthcare administration, or a related field required; master's degree preferred.
  • At least five years of progressively responsible leadership experience in homeless services, behavioral health, social services, healthcare, supportive housing, or a related field.
  • At least three years of management experience overseeing managers, supervisors, multidisciplinary teams, or complex programs.
  • Experience leading a high-volume, complex, multi-service environment strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness and people with complex behavioral health, substance-use, medical, housing, and social-service needs strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing publicly funded programs and working with government agencies, funders, and community partners preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of homelessness services, trauma-informed care, harm reduction, Housing First, crisis intervention, and person-centered services.
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate programmatic and operational functions, lead other leaders, establish accountability, and make sound decisions in complex or rapidly changing circumstances.
  • Strong relationship-building, strategic decision-making, communication, conflict-resolution, problem-solving, and performance-management skills.

Our Values

Dignity | Community | Integrity | Partnership | Social Justice | Radical Care

Work Environment

Regular use of a computer and HR technology platforms is required, along with the ability to manage detailed records and sustained periods of screen-based work. The role follows a hybrid work arrangement with regular onsite presence and occasional travel among Los Angeles-area locations. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, sit, walk, stoop, talk, hear, reach above and below shoulders; use hand and finger dexterity, keyboarding and making and receiving telephone calls. The employee may be required on occasion to lift and or carry up to 20 lbs.

EEO:

SJC (St. Joseph Center) provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetics or status as a veteran. In addition to federal law requirements, SJC complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Benefits:

Excellent Benefits package available.

title: Εργαζόμενος/μενη παραγωγής δομικών υλικών στο Εργοστάσιο Θεσσαλονίκης
description:
Knauf σημαίνει ευκαιρία. Γνωρίζουμε ότι ο καθένας αντιλαμβάνεται διαφορετικά τις ευκαιρίες και είμαστε υπερήφανοι που βλέπουμε ευκαιρίες σε όλους. Αυτός ο συναρπαστικός ρόλος εντός της ομάδας Παραγωγής θα μπορούσε να είναι η τέλεια επόμενη ευκαιρία για να χτίσεις μια μοναδική καριέρα, σε μια κουλτούρα που βασίζεται σε αξίες με σαφή στόχο να κάνουμε το αύριο ένα σπίτι για όλους μας.

Είμαστε ένας παγκόσμιος κατασκευαστής δομικών υλικών και εντός του Ομίλου μας, τα 40.000 μέλη της ομάδας μας σε 96 χώρες με 300 εργοστάσια, παρέχουν μια τεράστια ευκαιρία σε όποιον έχει φιλοδοξία και ενέργεια. Εκτιμούμε την συμβολή όλων εξίσου και σου ζητάμε να φέρεις ολόκληρο τον εαυτό σου στη δουλειά, για να εμπλουτίσεις περαιτέρω την εταιρεία, καθώς μαζί επιτυγχάνουμε περισσότερα σε ένα ασφαλές περιβάλλον που συμπεριλαμβάνει όλους μας.

Η KNAUF GREECE είναι υπερήφανη που είναι μέλος του Ομίλου Knauf. Έχουμε μια κληρονομιά 32 ετών στην παραγωγή δομικών υλικών με βάση τον γύψο και έχουμε μεγάλα σχέδια για το μέλλον.Η παγκόσμια παρουσία μας σε περισσότερες από 96 χώρες συνεχίζει να αυξάνεται και αναζητούμε παθιασμένους, φιλόδοξους ανθρώπους για να μας βοηθήσουν να επιτύχουμε τους στόχους μας. Όλοι μας καθοδηγούμαστε από τις ίδιες βασικές αξίες και πιστεύουμε στις ισχυρές δυνατότητες των μεγάλων εταιρειών να έχουν θετικό αντίκτυπο στον κόσμο. Αναζητούμε τώρα να εντάξουμε έναν ακόμη συνάδελφο στην ομάδα της Θεσσαλονίκης ως Εργάζόμενος/μενη Παραγωγής Δομικών Υλικών.

Μπορείς να πεις «ναι»;...

Αντιμετωπίζεις τους συναδέλφους σου με σεβασμό;

Έχεις πάντα στο μυαλό σου τον πελάτη;

Λειτουργείς με γνώμονα τις μελλοντικές γενιές;

Σου αρέσει να αναζητάς ευκαιρίες για να αναπτυχθείς;

Έχεις αποδεδειγμένο ιστορικό επίτευξης αποτελεσμάτων;

Τα βασικά σου καθήκοντα περιλαμβάνουν την υποστήριξη της γραμμής παραγωγής.

Με τι θα ασχολείσαι;

  • Εργασία στις θέσεις γραμμής παραγωγή

  • Χειρωνακτική εργασία

  • Χειρισμός περονοφόρου

  • Πενθήμερη εργασία σε βάρδιες

Τι θα θέλαμε να έχεις:

Ενδιαφερόμαστε για εσένα ως άτομο, τη στάση, τις συμπεριφορές και τις αξίες σου. Εφόσον έχεις τη θέληση να μάθεις οτιδήποτε χρειάζεσαι για τον ρόλο που δεν έχεις ήδη, θέλουμε να σου μιλήσουμε:

  • Απόφοιτος/η Λυκείου

  • Κάτοχος διπλώματος οδήγησης Β’ κατηγορίας

  • Επικοινωνία

  • Ευελιξία

  • Ομαδικότητα

Παρέχουμε:

  • Συνεχή εκπαίδευση

  • Ιδιωτική ασφάλιση

  • Μισθό : αναλόγως προσόντων

Τι ακολουθεί;
Εκτιμούμε ότι ο χρόνος σου είναι πολύτιμος και η υποβολή αίτησης για μια νέα θέση εργασίας μπορεί να είναι μια μακρά διαδικασία - γι' αυτό δεσμευόμαστε να απαντήσουμε στην αίτησή σου το συντομότερο δυνατόν.

title: PPC Strategist
description:
We're looking for an ambitious Paid Media Strategist to join the team and help us continue to deliver award-winning results for our clients.

SALARY: £29,800

See our: Impression's Benefits Booklet to find out more

The Role:

  • Working as part of a team to manage, optimise, and drive continuous growth through Paid Search and Shopping on some of our biggest accounts.

  • Taking ownership of the entire client life-cycle for some of our small-medium accounts; devising strategy, building campaigns, optimising for growth, sharing results.

  • Ensuring proactive delivery of PPC performance, escalating account issues to your team lead and working together to solve challenging problems.

  • Innovating and always trying to find a ‘better way’ of delivering great results for your clients, whether that be through campaign testing, scripting, or recommending new channels etc.

  • Working closely with our amazing clients, building productive relationships in order to deliver the best performance for their businesses.

  • Challenging yourself, your team, and your clients to ensure we’re always collectively driving in the same direction whilst being respectful, fair, and focused on results as we do it.

  • Getting involved with new business pitching, showcasing your expert knowledge to receptive prospects.

What we're looking for:

  • You have at least 2 years experience managing high performance Paid Media campaigns, with a focus on Search and/or Shopping.

  • You’ve been involved in scaling accounts through hands-on optimisation, and are beginning to take on elements of Paid Media strategy.

  • You are an engaging, confident communicator, with experience presenting results and updates to key client stakeholders.

  • You have an appreciation for the craft of PPC, with an advanced understanding of Google Ads (Search, Shopping and Display).

  • You’re fluent in all things spreadsheets, and have a fondness for investigation through data.

  • You enjoy working with others as a part of a team, and want to continue working in a collaborative environment to meet shared goals.

  • Experience with SA360 / Kenshoo is a bonus to manage PPC campaigns - but your commitment to learning means that you’re constantly trying new tools and features.


Flexible working at Impression without losing team connections
We love the focus of deep work at home, but we value team connections just as much. That’s why we practice a hybrid model with a minimum of one purposeful Pulse Day in the office per week to catch up and collaborate. To maximise our time together, the Paid teams head into the office on Wednesdays.

title: Internal Communications Officer
description:
At World Animal Protection, effective communication helps connect our people to our purpose, priorities and impact. We are looking for an Internal Communications Officer to create clear, engaging and meaningful communications that inform, inspire and connect colleagues across our global organisation.

Working closely with teams across the organisation, you will help deliver high-quality internal communications that bring organisational strategy, change and impact to life. You will create engaging content, internal communications plans, and help ensure that messages are relevant, inclusive and accessible for diverse audiences across regions and cultures.

This is an exciting opportunity for an internal communications professional who enjoys building relationships, creating compelling content and helping organisations engage and connect with their people.



  • Partnering with internal stakeholders to deliver internal communications that support organisational priorities and objectives; translate organisational strategy, change and transformation and impact into communications that resonate with global audiences.
  • Supporting the development and delivery of communications plans for key organisational initiatives and programmes; providing practical communications advice and support to stakeholders across the organisation.
  • Creating clear, engaging and high-quality content including producing written and basic video materials.
  • Managing the global internal content calendar across a range of internal communications channels.
  • Supporting the planning and delivery of global internal events and townhalls.
  • Managing and continuously improving internal communications channels; gathering feedback, insight and data to improve communications effectiveness and colleague engagement.
  • Championing inclusive, ethical and purpose-led storytelling across internal communications.

  • Experience in internal communications, employee engagement or organisational communications in complex or changing environments.
  • Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex information for different audiences creatively.
  • Good experience creating graphics and recording and editing videos.
  • Experience using content management systems and email/marketing platforms.
  • Experience developing and delivering internal employee events or townhalls.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills; strong relationship-building and influencing skills.
  • An understanding of global organisations and how to balance local relevance within global frameworks.
  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Sound judgement and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues.
Experience working strategically as well as operationally would be advantageous but is not essential.


Why join World Animal Protection?

You will join a global organisation committed to improving the lives of animals worldwide and play an important role in helping colleagues stay connected to our mission, priorities and impact. Working with diverse teams across regions and cultures, you will help shape communications that strengthen engagement, build understanding and support positive organisational change.



  • All staff are entitled to 24 days of annual leave per calendar year (from January 1 to December 31). In addition, there are 2 Global Wellbeing midyear closure days and 3 additional days to be taken at the end of the calendar year, as determined by World Animal Protection. For part-time staff, holiday entitlement is prorated accordingly

title: Restaurantchef til Donna
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for en stor italiensk restaurant, hvor værtskab, mennesker og god drift går hånd i hånd?

Brænder du for at skabe gode gæsteoplevelser og samtidig sikre, at hverdagen fungerer for både gæster og medarbejdere? Er du en tydelig og nærværende leder, som trives bedst ude på gulvet sammen med dit team? Og har du den økonomiske forståelse, der skal til for at drive en stor restaurant sundt og effektivt?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter til Restaurant Donna.

Restaurant Donna er en stor italiensk restaurant på Hotel Bella Grande, hvor vi serverer klassiske italienske retter og drinks til både frokost og middag. Restauranten rummer flere forskellige stemninger – fra den livlige restaurant og den afslappede cocktail lounge til den lyse atriumgård. Vores ambition er at skabe følelsen af at være lidt længere sydpå – med godt værtskab, god energi og en restaurant, man har lyst til at blive hængende i.

Som restaurantchef bliver du en central del af den daglige ledelse og får ansvar for, at Donna fungerer – både på gulvet, i køkkenet og bag kulissen. Du skal være tæt på gæsterne og medarbejderne og være med til at sætte retningen for den service og kultur, vi ønsker på Donna.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt ledelsesteam bestående af en overordnet restaurantchef, en assisterende restaurantchef, inspektører og dig. Sammen har I ansvaret for den daglige drift, og du får blandt andet ansvar for varebestillinger, planlægning, vagtplaner, oplæring, rekruttering og udvikling af medarbejdere.

Du skal samtidig have blik for forretningen. Du forstår betydningen af lønprocenter, drikkevareprocenter, vareforbrug og leverandører – og du ved, at god økonomi og gode gæsteoplevelser følges ad.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har flere års erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen og gerne erfaring med ledelse

  • Er en nærværende leder, som trives med at være på gulvet sammen med dit team

  • Har et højt serviceniveau og går forrest, når det gælder værtskab

  • Er god til mennesker og kan skabe tydelige rammer, motivation og arbejdsglæde

  • Arbejder struktureret og effektivt – også når der er travlt

  • Har en god økonomisk forståelse og kan omsætte den til den daglige drift

  • Er stærk i samarbejdet og kommunikerer sikkert på både dansk og engelsk

Vi tilbyder

  • En central lederrolle i en stor og spændende restaurant

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både drift, service og medarbejderkultur

  • God løn og pensionsaftale med PFA inkl. sundhedsforsikring

  • Personalefordele, bl.a. gratis holdtræning flere gange ugentligt med dine kollegaer

  • En arbejdsplads med dygtige fagfolk, stærke fællesskaber og godt sammenhold

  • En fleksibel vagtplan og en struktureret tilgang til driften

  • Gode værktøjer og mulighed for at udvikle dig som leder

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

title: Business & Project Development Manager (m/f/d)
description:
KEON is a French group specialising in the development, investment, construction and operation of biomethane projects. With headquarters in Paris and teams in Nantes, the Group combines expertise across the value chain, from feedstock supply and plant construction to operations and the commercialisation of biomethane and biogenic CO₂.

Alongside greenfield development, KEON invests in existing biogas businesses and converts combined heat and power (CHP) plants into biomethane projects, including grid injection, bioCNG and bioLNG.

In Germany, we position ourselves as a partner for plant owners seeking a long-term future for their businesses, particularly as EEG support expires or succession becomes a priority.

To help build our German business from Hamburg, we are looking for a Business & Project Development Manager.

Your role

Identify, assess and develop biogas and biomethane investment opportunities across Germany. You will lead opportunities from initial contact through commercial assessment, acquisition negotiations and project development, working closely with the German management team and Group specialists.

Key responsibilities

  • Originate acquisition, partnership and development opportunities, building relationships with plant owners, farmers, advisers and local partners.

  • Assess commercial potential, conversion options and project economics; identify key risks and recommend next steps.

  • Coordinate due diligence and the preparation of offers, and support negotiations and transaction closing with Group specialists.

  • Develop commercially viable arrangements for feedstock supply, land access, biomethane offtake and digestate management.

  • Coordinate technical studies, permitting, grid connection and commercial, legal and financial structuring.

  • Prepare investment proposals and guide projects towards investment approval and readiness for construction.

  • Maintain the opportunity pipeline and report progress, risks and priorities.

  • Represent KEON at industry events and in discussions with project stakeholders.

Your profile

  • A degree in engineering, business, agricultural sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • Relevant experience in biogas or biomethane business development or project development, ideally including acquisitions or partnerships.

  • A sound understanding of the German agricultural and biogas market, permitting processes and project economics.

  • Strong commercial judgement, negotiation skills and the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams.

  • Confidence in building trusted relationships with plant owners and agricultural partners.

  • An independent, structured and hands-on approach, with the motivation to help build a growing business.

  • Fluent German and professional working proficiency in English.

  • Willingness to travel regularly within Germany.

What we offer

  • The opportunity to help shape KEON’s German business from an early stage.

  • Direct collaboration with the CEO Germany and access to the Group’s technical, operational, commercial and investment expertise.

  • Responsibility across acquisitions and project development, with visible influence on project outcomes.

  • Hybrid working based in Hamburg and collaboration with an international team.

title: Job title (Remote)
description:
🧬 About us

We’re iubenda, the team turning compliance into a growth engine. We help over 110K businesses all around the world build trust, boost performance, and grow without limits. Now part of team.blue (), we’re scaling privacy tech with confidence, creativity, and a little bit of attitude. Join a team that moves fast, thinks big, and makes privacy feel exciting again!


🎯 Mission & Core Purpose

You’ll be our most senior security expert and the owner of iubenda’s security posture across AI, infrastructure, and code. You’ll set the direction, turn it into practical standards, and work closely with engineering, product, and leadership to make sure it’s applied. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with company-wide influence and direct access to senior leadership. You’ll also own the security, technology, and AI risks in iubenda’s Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) portfolio. From 1 March 2027, ERM is led by the Chief of Staff, and you’ll report to them. Until then, you report to the CEO.

💼 Key Responsibilities

• Own the security strategy and roadmap, and keep leadership informed on risks and priorities
• Define and drive the security architecture for our platform, cloud infrastructure, and internal systems
• Own AI security, including the safe and compliant use of AI tools internally (GDPR, EU AI Act), the security of AI features in our products, and our defences against AI-powered attacks, acorrding to standards and best practices (e.g. OWASP AI Testing guide)
• Build secure development practices into the engineering lifecycle, including code review standards, dependency management, and automated security testing
• Maintain security policies and lead threat modeling and risk assessments for new products, features, and vendors, including the ownership, access, and renewal of critical infrastructure vendors such as cloud, DNS, and certificates
• Lead incident response from a technical and coordination standpoint, update Incident response plan in accordance to the lesson learned outputs
• Own the cybersecurity, data protection, technology, and AI risks in the ERM portfolio. Keep each risk current (likelihood, impact, controls, next review), drive mitigation with the teams that own the work, and report status and escalations in the monthly ERM review led by the Chief of Staff
• Make sure every revenue-bearing platform has a current, tested disaster recovery and business continuity plan
• Keep company data and access under control, including approved storage and file sharing, credential and secrets management, and access removal at offboarding
• Work with Legal and Product on privacy engineering risks, such as tracking that fires before consent or customer data shared with third-party platforms
• Support customer security reviews, audits, and certifications, and represent iubenda with enterprise customers when needed
• Coach engineers on security and raise the bar across teams without formal authority

👤 Your Profile

• Significant experience in security engineering or architecture, ideally in a SaaS environment
• Deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure security and application security
• Hands-on understanding of AI and LLM-related risks, such as prompt injection, data leakage, and model supply chain
• Familiarity with frameworks like ISO 27001 and SOC 2, and with GDPR from a security perspective
• Experience managing risks in an enterprise risk register or framework such as ISO 31000, including scoring likelihood and impact and tracking mitigation to closure
• Experience building and testing disaster recovery and business continuity plans
• The ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain risk in business terms
• Fluent English


🌐 Location

We're a remote-first company. You can work from wherever you're most productive in the world.

title: Revisionsledare / CBAM-verifierare (underleverantör) till Intertek
description:
Intertek ser en ökande efterfrågan på verifieringstjänster inom Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), EU:s mekanism för att minska risken för koldioxidläckage genom att säkerställa att importerade produkter omfattas av motsvarande klimatkrav som produkter tillverkade inom EU. Som CBAM-verifierare granskar och verifierar du beräkningar av inbyggda växthusgasutsläpp för att säkerställa att rapporterade utsläppsdata är korrekta, spårbara och uppfyller gällande krav.

Behörighet för kvalificering

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet inom ett eller flera av följande områden:

• Kvalificerad revisor eller verifierare inom växthusgasverifiering (GHG)

• Verifierare inom EU ETS

• Erfarenhet av industri- eller processrevisioner

• Erfarenhet av hållbarhets- och klimatrapportering

• Erfarenhet av verifiering, datakvalitet eller utsläppsberäkningar

Rollen som underleverantör

Som revisionsledare och CBAM-verifierare genomför du revisioner och verifieringar hos våra kunder nationellt och internationellt. Arbetet omfattar planering, genomförande, rapportering och uppföljning av revisioner samt bedömning av utsläppsdata och tillhörande processer. Du arbetar som underleverantör via eget konsultbolag och erhåller uppdrag från Intertek utifrån kompetensområde, tillgänglighet och kvalifikationer.

Vem söker vi?

• Akademisk utbildning inom teknik, miljö, hållbarhet, energi eller motsvarande område.

• Minst tre års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet.

• Erfarenhet av revision, verifiering eller bedömning av tekniska processer. • God analytisk förmåga och erfarenhet av datakvalitetsbedömningar.

• Kunskaper inom spårbarhetssystem, massbalansberäkningar och verifieringsmetodik.

• Erfarenhet från en eller flera av följande sektorer: järn och stål, aluminium, cement, gödselmedel, vätgas eller elproduktion.

• Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.

• B-körkort.

Du är professionell, analytisk och har hög integritet. Du trivs med kundkontakt, kan arbeta självständigt och har förmåga att skapa långsiktiga affärsrelationer. Du är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och har ett starkt intresse för hållbarhetsfrågor och revision.

Om Intertek

Med fler än 45 000 medarbetare världen över är vi är ett av de största företagen i vår bransch. I vårt dagliga arbete hjälper vi företag världen över att se till att deras produkter är säkra att använda och möter kunders och myndigheters krav på kvalitet och prestanda. Det gör vi genom att revidera deras processer, certifiera deras ledningssystem, granska deras leverantörer, prova, analysera och certifiera deras produkter, inspektera deras tillverkningsanläggningar och skeppningar och arbeta med rådgivning inom regulatoriska frågor, kemikalier och hållbarhet.

Varje dag strävar vi efter att hjälpa våra kunder att ha säkra och socialt ansvarsfulla produkter och tjänster – We bring quality and safety to life!

Har vi fångat ditt intresse?

Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag! Urvalet av ansökningar sker löpande och vi uppmanar dig därför att skicka ditt CV så snart som möjligt. Vi kan tyvärr inte hantera ansökningar via mail utan ansökan görs via länken.

Eventuella frågor besvaras av Jesper Nyman, Operation Manager, jesper.nyman@intertek.com.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Consilio is a global leader in legal consulting and services, helping organisations transform legal operations through technology, process optimisation, and data-driven insights. Quality & Best Practice

  • Ensure solutions align with Ironclad best practices, scalability, and maintainability standards
  • Conduct testing and validation of configurations prior to client deployment
  • Contribute to internal reusable assets, accelerators, and documentation

Adoption & Continuous Improvement

  • Support client training and enablement activities
  • Identify opportunities to optimise client processes through automation and standardisation
  • Provide feedback into the Ironclad Practice for continuous improvement

Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience configuring Ironclad CLM (or comparable CLM platforms such as Sirion, Agiloft, Icertis, Conga)

  • Experience building workflows, templates, and automation within SaaS platforms
  • Ability to interpret solution designs and translate them into technical configurations
  • Familiarity with integrations, APIs, and data structures

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a delivery team model alongside Solution Architects and Project Managers

Soft Skills

  • Detail-oriented with a focus on build quality and accuracy
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple project workstreams
  • Clear and effective communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Proactive problem-solving mindset

What You’ll Be Part Of

  • A dedicated Ironclad Practice delivering best-in-class CLM implementations
  • A collaborative team structure with Solution Architects, Legal Engineers, and Project Managers
  • A high-performance delivery environment focused on innovation and client impact

Why Join Consilio?

At Consilio, you’ll work at the intersection of law and technology—helping global organisations transform their contracting processes through Ironclad. Within our Ironclad Practice, you’ll gain exposure to complex implementations, structured delivery methodologies, and opportunities to grow your expertise alongside experienced architects and delivery leaders.

Work Mode & Shift Timing:

  • Work Mode: Remote
  • Shift: 7 PM - 4 AM IST

Our True North in Action

  • Client Experience | Listen for the “why." Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  • Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect​. Welcome diverse views​. Partner across geographies, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  • Innovation | Always be curious (ABC)​. Challenge the status quo​. Experiment and fail forward​. Build for the future.
  • Grit | Focus on what matters​. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner​. Deliver results you’re proud of.

title: IKT risinājumu klientu vadītājs/-a

  • Izzināt klientu vajadzības, plānot un vadīt tikšanās, piedāvājot klientiem piemērotākos IKT un telekomunikāciju risinājumus

  • Izstrādāt, prezentēt un piedāvāt klientiem pielāgotus risinājumus, nodrošināt darījumu virzību līdz līguma noslēgšanai

  • Sadarboties ar tehnisko komandu un projektu vadītājiem, lai nodrošinātu klientiem atbilstošākos IKT un telekomunikāciju pakalpojumu risinājumus un atbalstu visā pārdošanas un ieviešanas ciklā

  • Pārvaldīt informāciju Bites iekšējās sistēmās, sekot līdzi pārdošanas procesam un identificēt jaunas biznesa iespējas

Mums ir svarīgi, lai Tev ir:

title: Logistic Transportation Pricing Analyst (Bilingual in Korean/ English)
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and driven Logistics Procurement Specialist specializing in Air Pricing to join our Pricing team. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end procurement lifecycle for air freight, including sourcing forwarders and airlines, managing RFQs, negotiating competitive rates, and securing strategic capacity.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management

  • Identify, evaluate, qualify, and register new logistics suppliers, including:
    • Airlines
    • Freight Forwarders
    • GSA (General Sales Agents)
    • CFS (Container Freight Stations)
    • Air Cargo Handling Agents
    • Drayage and Intermodal Carriers
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with logistics service providers.
  • Conduct supplier capability assessments, performance evaluations, and risk analysis.
  • Maintain supplier database and vendor qualification records.

Airline Procurement & Contract Management

  • Source and negotiate direct agreements with airlines, including:
    • Block Space Agreements (BSA)
    • General Sales Agent (GSA) Agreements
    • Special Rate Agreements (SPA) where applicable
  • Negotiate transportation rates, capacity allocations, service commitments, payment terms, and contractual conditions.
  • Coordinate with Legal to review, finalize, and execute transportation agreements.
  • Monitor contract compliance, expiration dates, and renewal opportunities.

RFQ/RFP Management

  • Develop, issue, and manage RFQ/RFP packages for:
    • Samsung business
    • Non-Samsung business opportunities
  • Collect, organize, and validate supplier quotations.
  • Coordinate competitive bidding events among multiple logistics providers.
  • Ensure RFQ submissions comply with procurement standards and customer requirements.

Pricing & Cost Analysis

  • Analyze transportation quotations across multiple cost elements, including:
    • Air Freight
    • Fuel Surcharge
    • Security Charges
    • Terminal Handling Charges
    • Documentation Fees
    • Pick-up & Delivery
    • Customs Brokerage
    • DG Charges
    • Accessorial Charges
  • Build financial simulations and cost comparison models.
  • Perform landed cost and total logistics cost analysis.
  • Conduct market benchmarking for air freight rates, carrier capacity, and transit times.
  • Recommend optimal carrier and forwarder selections based on cost, service, and operational performance.

Procurement Strategy

  • Develop procurement strategies to improve competitiveness and achieve cost savings.
  • Identify sourcing opportunities through market research and industry benchmarking.
  • Evaluate market trends, airline capacity, and seasonal pricing fluctuations.
  • Support annual procurement initiatives and carrier sourcing events.

Business Development Support

  • Partner with Sales to develop competitive logistics solutions for customers.
  • Recommend transportation strategies that improve customers' supply chain performance.
  • Support implementation of new business opportunities by coordinating with operations and procurement teams.
  • Assist in preparing pricing proposals for customer bids and tenders.

Procurement Systems & Reporting

  • Administer internal procurement and quotation management systems.
  • Maintain sourcing documentation and procurement records.
  • Prepare procurement reports, KPI dashboards, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and regulatory requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
    • Sales
    • Operations
    • Finance
    • Legal
    • Customer Service
    • Global Procurement
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across procurement and pricing processes.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree required (Logistics, Supply Chain, Business, or Finance preferred).
  • 4+ years of experience in freight forwarding, 3PL, or logistics sourcing/operations, with a strict focus on Air Freight.
  • Proven, hands-on experience managing RFP/RFQ processes and conducting financial data analysis.

Technical & Professional Skills

  • Advanced Proficiency in Microsoft Excel: Must be comfortable handling large-scale quotation and cost analysis using complex formulas, Pivot Tables, Conditional Formatting, Data Validation, VLOOKUP, COUNTIF, SUMIF, and Power Query
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and sharp negotiation tactics.
  • Excellent collaboration, communication, and interpersonal skills to work effectively with cross-functional global teams.

Work Adaptability & Travel

  • Ability to thrive and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility: Willingness to work additional hours, weekends, or holidays outside of regularly scheduled business hours when required to meet critical business needs.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel up to 20% for business-related needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience working directly within a major Freight Forwarder, Broker Company, or 3PL.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Χειριστής/ Βοηθός Xειριστή Aνυψωτικού Mηχανήματος
description:
Knauf σημαίνει ευκαιρία. Γνωρίζουμε ότι ο καθένας αντιλαμβάνεται διαφορετικά τις ευκαιρίες και είμαστε υπερήφανοι που βλέπουμε ευκαιρίες σε όλους. Αυτός ο συναρπαστικός ρόλος εντός της ομάδας Logistics θα μπορούσε να είναι η τέλεια επόμενη ευκαιρία για να χτίσεις μια μοναδική καριέρα, σε μια κουλτούρα που βασίζεται σε αξίες με σαφή στόχο να κάνουμε το αύριο ένα σπίτι για όλους μας.

Είμαστε ένας παγκόσμιος κατασκευαστής δομικών υλικών και εντός του Ομίλου μας, τα 40.000 μέλη της ομάδας μας σε 96 χώρες με 300 εργοστάσια, παρέχουν μια τεράστια ευκαιρία σε όποιον έχει φιλοδοξία και ενέργεια. Εκτιμούμε την συμβολή όλων εξίσου και σου ζητάμε να φέρεις ολόκληρο τον εαυτό σου στη δουλειά, για να εμπλουτίσεις περαιτέρω την εταιρεία, καθώς μαζί επιτυγχάνουμε περισσότερα σε ένα ασφαλές περιβάλλον που συμπεριλαμβάνει όλους μας.

Η KNAUF ΕΛΛΑΔΑΣ είναι υπερήφανη που είναι μέλος του Ομίλου Knauf. Έχουμε μια κληρονομιά 32 ετών στην παραγωγή δομικών υλικών με βάση τον γύψο και έχουμε μεγάλα σχέδια για το μέλλον. Η παγκόσμια παρουσία μας σε περισσότερες από 96 χώρες συνεχίζει να αυξάνεται και αναζητούμε παθιασμένους, φιλόδοξους ανθρώπους για να μας βοηθήσουν να επιτύχουμε τους στόχους μας.. Όλοι μας καθοδηγούμαστε από τις ίδιες βασικές αξίες και πιστεύουμε στις ισχυρές δυνατότητες των μεγάλων εταιρειών να έχουν θετικό αντίκτυπο στον κόσμο. Αναζητούμε τώρα να εντάξουμε έναν ακόμη συνάδελφο στην ομάδα της Λεμεσού ως Χειριστής ή Βοηθός Χειριστή ανυψωτικού μηχανήματος.

Μπορείς να πεις «ναι»;...

Αντιμετωπίζεις τους συναδέλφους σου με σεβασμό; Έχεις πάντα στο μυαλό σου τον πελάτη;

Λειτουργείς με γνώμονα τις μελλοντικές γενιές;

Σου αρέσει να αναζητάς ευκαιρίες για να αναπτυχθείς;

Έχεις αποδεδειγμένο ιστορικό επίτευξης αποτελεσμάτων;

Τα βασικά σου καθήκοντα περιλαμβάνουν την φορτοεκφόρτωση και την προετοιμασία των παραγγελιών

Με τι θα ασχολείσαι;

  • Εκτέλεση εργασιών φορτοεκφόρτωσης με χρήση περονοφόρων μηχανημάτων

  • Προετοιμασία των παραγγελιών των πελατών προς φόρτωση

  • Έλεγχος των αποθεμάτων και συμμετοχή στη διαδικασία απογραφής

  • Διασφάλιση της τήρησης των οδηγιών ασφαλούς φόρτωσης της εταιρίας και καθημερινός έλεγχος της λειτουργίας των μηχανημάτων

  • Τήρηση των εταιρικών κανόνων Υγείας και Ασφάλειας και συμμετοχή σε ενέργειες συνεχούς βελτίωσης

Τι θα θέλαμε να έχεις:

Ενδιαφερόμαστε για εσένα ως άτομο, τη στάση, τις συμπεριφορές και τις αξίες σου. Εφόσον έχεις τη θέληση να μάθεις οτιδήποτε χρειάζεσαι για τον ρόλο που δεν έχεις ήδη, θέλουμε να σου μιλήσουμε :

  • Απόφοιτος Δευτεροβάθμιας Εκπαίδευσης

  • Κάτοχος διπλώματος οδήγησης Β’ κατηγορίας

  • Εμπειρία 2 ετών σε ανάλογη θέση

  • Δίπλωμα Χειριστή ανυψωτικού (προαιρετικό)

  • Επικοινωνία

  • Ευελιξία

  • Ομαδικότητα

Παρέχουμε:

  • Μισθό αναλόγως προσόντων

  • Ιδιωτική ασφάλιση υγείας

  • Συνεχή εκπαίδευση

Τι ακολουθεί;

Εκτιμούμε ότι ο χρόνος σου είναι πολύτιμος και η υποβολή αίτησης για μια νέα θέση εργασίας μπορεί να είναι μια μακρά διαδικασία - γι' αυτό δεσμευόμαστε να απαντήσουμε στην αίτησή σου εντός πέντε εργάσιμων ημερών.

title: AI-Native Learning Experience Designer - Math (Remote or Onsite in Riyadh)
description:
Role Summary

Domain: Math & Quant

Learning Experience Designers own the learning journey for our students. They systematically apply the best of learning science to create outstanding learning experiences for our students. This role will partner with curriculum leads, teachers, product, and engineering to create learner-centred course designs, multimedia learning assets, assessments, and facilitator guides that support measurable student outcomes.

This role is remote-first and works across time zones to align with our delivery cadence. If you are already based in Riyadh, you are equally welcome to apply and can work from our Riyadh office, full-time or part of the week, whichever suits you.

What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end learning experiences including scope & sequence, unit plans, lesson plans, assessments, and formative checks aligned to Noon learning outcomes.

  • Develop assessment strategies and rubrics that measure mastery and inform iterative improvements to content and instruction.

  • Work closely with product and engineering to translate pedagogical designs into scalable digital experiences and to QA learning flows in the platform.

  • Ensure learning resources are localised for language and other contextual factors.

  • Run rapid prototyping and user testing with students and teachers to validate design decisions and improve engagement and learning gains.

  • Train and support teachers and facilitators on new materials, pedagogical approaches, and use of EdTech tools to enable high-fidelity implementation.

  • Use data and qualitative feedback to iterate on curriculum and content, driving continuous improvement cycles.

Must-Have Requirements

  • AI is already part of how you design. You use it daily in your own practice - drafting and critiquing materials, generating and stress-testing assessment items, prototyping in hours rather than weeks - and you can show us what you have built with it.

  • Bachelor's Degree in STEM, Arts, Education, or a related field.

  • Experience designing digital or blended learning experiences for High School grades.

  • Passion for Math and helping students learn to love Math.

  • Proven experience writing lesson plans, assessments, and facilitator guides informed by learning objectives and evidence-based practices.

  • Strong understanding of formative assessment, feedback design, and differentiation strategies for mixed-ability classrooms.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English; able to produce clear learner-facing content and teacher-facing documentation.

  • Equally comfortable working on-site and remotely, and able to collaborate with remote teams across time zones (GMT +3 overlap preferred).

Highly Advantageous

  • Experience in delivering the American Curriculum at international schools.

  • Experience with adaptive learning systems or analytics-driven personalisation at scale.

  • Prior teaching experience in hybrid or online classrooms.

  • Arabic language ability or experience working in the Middle East educational context.

What We're Really Looking For

  • A pragmatic designer who balances rigour and creativity to build learning experiences that are measurable, scalable, and delightful for learners.

  • A collaborative partner who can work closely with teachers, engineers and product teams to bring ideas into production.

  • An evidence-led practitioner who uses data and user feedback to iterate quickly and improve outcomes.

Who This Role Is (and Isn't) For

  • Ideal for: Instructional designers or learning experience designers who thrive in fast-paced, mission-driven environments and enjoy building for scale.

  • Not for: Those who prefer narrow, specialist roles without cross-functional collaboration or iterative product-style development.

Other details

  • Remote-first with flexibility. Occasional meetings aligned to GMT +3 are required, which is a natural fit if you are already in Riyadh. Riyadh-based candidates may work remotely, from the office, or a mix.

Why Work at Noon?

  • Solving the Biggest Problem in Education: We are tackling one of the most important and challenging issues in the sector - scaling outstanding teachers and making learning engaging.

  • Innovation at a Global Scale: Noon is a leader in edtech innovation; we are not a copycat. We pioneer new ways to deliver world-class education.

  • Strong Financial Position: We have become profitable and are well-funded.

  • International Exposure: Join a dynamic, internationally diverse team that supports personal growth.

  • Mission & Values Driven: We aim to provide equitable access to world-class education.

  • Student First: Help build the first "Open Social Learning Platform," reaching millions.

  • Be Original & Bold: A working environment where you can challenge the status quo and take full ownership of your work.

  • Never Deprive a Learner: We provide the freedom to innovate and learn from "first-time mistakes."

  • Be Better Everyday: Work closely with a leadership team committed to growth and solving global business challenges.

title: Butikskonsulent søges til 3butikken City2
description:
Vil du arbejde med mennesker, udvikle dig og være en del af et stærkt fællesskab? Så kom med på holdet hos 3 som butikskonsulent i vores butik i City2. Butikken er kendetegnet ved et stærkt fællesskab, højt tempo og en positiv energi, der mærkes så snart man træder ind ad døren.

Hos os er det ikke din erfaring, der tæller mest, det er din lyst, energi og vilje til at lære. Du behøver ikke have prøvet kræfter med butik eller salg før – vi lærer dig det hele. Vi leder efter dig, der vil gøre en forskel for andre og være en del af noget større.

Din kommende butikschef Guven beskriver arbejdet i butikken således: "Hverdagen i butikken er fuld af energi. Der er altid gang i salget, masser af kundekontakt og en god stemning blandt kollegerne. Vi hjælper hinanden, og der er plads til alle, så længe man er klar på at tage fat. Og hvis man vil noget med det, er der rigtig gode muligheder for at udvikle sig og komme videre i 3".

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Som butikskonsulent bliver du en vigtig del af et tæt team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har det sjovt imens vi skaber gode oplevelser for vores kunder. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet, at:

  • Lytte til kundernes behov og guide dem til de rigtige løsninger

  • Opnå dine egne salgsmål og være med til at sikre butikkens resultater

  • Gøre opmærksom på kampagner og lanceringer i butikken – vi er dem, der skaber synlighed og energi, når der sker noget nyt

Foruden at hjælpe kunderne fysisk i butikken, vil du også kontakte eksisterende kunder telefonisk, hvor du f.eks. gennemgår deres abonnementer eller yder hjælp via vores kundeservicelinje. Det giver dig bred erfaring med både salg, rådgivning og kundeservice – noget der uden tvivl styrker dit CV.

Vi lægger stor vægt på støtte, samarbejde og udvikling i hverdagen. Hos os må du gerne være ny – vi sørger for at sætte dig godt ind i tingene!

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du behøver ikke at have salgserfaring, men måske kan du genkende dig selv i noget af dette:

  • Du er imødekommende og serviceminded og har let ved at tale med mange typer mennesker

  • Du motiveres af at gøre andre glade og yde god service

  • Du er nysgerrig på at lære og har lyst til at udvikle dig – både fagligt og personligt

  • Du trives i en aktiv hverdag med små succeser og tempo med et godt hold af kollegaer

Uanset om du holder sabbatår, er nyuddannet eller i gang med at skifte retning – så er du velkommen hos os.

Hvad får du hos os?

  • En arbejdsplads med plads til forskellighed, støtte og stærkt fællesskab

  • Onboardingdage på hovedkontoret og grundig oplæring fra erfarne kolleger i butikken, så du bliver hjulpet godt i gang

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både i rollen og i din videre karriere hos 3. Du kan læse mere om mulighederne, bl.a. 3Academy, her

  • Fast grundløn, provision, mobil med betalt abonnement, sundhedsforsikring, pension og gode rabatter

Sådan søger du

Tryk på linket Ansøg Her for at søge stillingen.
Vedhæft dit CV og en ansøgning, hvor du kort fortæller lidt om dig selv og hvorfor du gerne vil være en del af 3.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Join Axians, where innovation thrives on trust and autonomy, and where every challenge is an opportunity to create technology with impact.

INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer responsible for designing, administering, and optimizing database environments that support critical business applications. You will play a key role in ensuring data integrity, performance, availability, and reliability, while collaborating closely with development, operations, and security teams to continuously improve business processes and database platforms.

What You Will Do on a Daily Basis

  • Design, implement, and maintain database solutions to support business-critical systems.

  • Monitor and optimize database performance, availability, and reliability across production environments.

  • Develop and enhance SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and triggers to support data processing and reporting needs.

  • Implement and manage backup and recovery strategies, ensuring compliance with defined data protection requirements.

  • Provide technical support during incident resolution, perform root cause analysis, and contribute to post-mortem reviews.

  • Collaborate with development and operational teams to improve business process outcomes and database efficiency.

  • Manage and administer complex Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments.

  • Evaluate and deploy innovative solutions to automate processes, optimize costs, and improve platform performance.

  • Monitor database health and performance through observability and visualization tools.


Your Key Skills

  • Strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL administration.

  • Advanced SQL development, optimization, and performance tuning skills.

  • Experience with ETL development, monitoring, and optimization processes.

  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis capabilities.

  • Knowledge of database partitioning, indexing, and optimization techniques.

  • Experience with Master Data Services.

  • Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, ELK, or Zabbix.

  • Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD methodologies.


Your Main Qualifications

  • Proven experience managing complex database environments in enterprise contexts.

  • Solid knowledge of backup, recovery, and database maintenance strategies.

  • Experience supporting business-critical applications and resolving high-impact incidents.

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and quality-oriented mindset.

  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
