title: Χειριστής/ Βοηθός Xειριστή Aνυψωτικού Mηχανήματος
description:
Knauf σημαίνει ευκαιρία. Γνωρίζουμε ότι ο καθένας αντιλαμβάνεται διαφορετικά τις ευκαιρίες και είμαστε υπερήφανοι που βλέπουμε ευκαιρίες σε όλους. Αυτός ο συναρπαστικός ρόλος εντός της ομάδας Logistics θα μπορούσε να είναι η τέλεια επόμενη ευκαιρία για να χτίσεις μια μοναδική καριέρα, σε μια κουλτούρα που βασίζεται σε αξίες με σαφή στόχο να κάνουμε το αύριο ένα σπίτι για όλους μας.

Είμαστε ένας παγκόσμιος κατασκευαστής δομικών υλικών και εντός του Ομίλου μας, τα 40.000 μέλη της ομάδας μας σε 96 χώρες με 300 εργοστάσια, παρέχουν μια τεράστια ευκαιρία σε όποιον έχει φιλοδοξία και ενέργεια. Εκτιμούμε την συμβολή όλων εξίσου και σου ζητάμε να φέρεις ολόκληρο τον εαυτό σου στη δουλειά, για να εμπλουτίσεις περαιτέρω την εταιρεία, καθώς μαζί επιτυγχάνουμε περισσότερα σε ένα ασφαλές περιβάλλον που συμπεριλαμβάνει όλους μας.

Η KNAUF ΕΛΛΑΔΑΣ είναι υπερήφανη που είναι μέλος του Ομίλου Knauf. Έχουμε μια κληρονομιά 32 ετών στην παραγωγή δομικών υλικών με βάση τον γύψο και έχουμε μεγάλα σχέδια για το μέλλον. Η παγκόσμια παρουσία μας σε περισσότερες από 96 χώρες συνεχίζει να αυξάνεται και αναζητούμε παθιασμένους, φιλόδοξους ανθρώπους για να μας βοηθήσουν να επιτύχουμε τους στόχους μας.. Όλοι μας καθοδηγούμαστε από τις ίδιες βασικές αξίες και πιστεύουμε στις ισχυρές δυνατότητες των μεγάλων εταιρειών να έχουν θετικό αντίκτυπο στον κόσμο. Αναζητούμε τώρα να εντάξουμε έναν ακόμη συνάδελφο στην ομάδα της Θεσσαλονίκης ως Χειριστής ή Βοηθός Χειριστή ανυψωτικού μηχανήματος.

Μπορείς να πεις «ναι»;...

Αντιμετωπίζεις τους συναδέλφους σου με σεβασμό; Έχεις πάντα στο μυαλό σου τον πελάτη;

Λειτουργείς με γνώμονα τις μελλοντικές γενιές;

Σου αρέσει να αναζητάς ευκαιρίες για να αναπτυχθείς;

Έχεις αποδεδειγμένο ιστορικό επίτευξης αποτελεσμάτων;

Τα βασικά σου καθήκοντα περιλαμβάνουν την φορτοεκφόρτωση και την προετοιμασία των παραγγελιών

Με τι θα ασχολείσαι;

  • Εκτέλεση εργασιών φορτοεκφόρτωσης με χρήση περονοφόρων μηχανημάτων

  • Προετοιμασία των παραγγελιών των πελατών προς φόρτωση

  • Έλεγχος των αποθεμάτων και συμμετοχή στη διαδικασία απογραφής

  • Διασφάλιση της τήρησης των οδηγιών ασφαλούς φόρτωσης της εταιρίας και καθημερινός έλεγχος της λειτουργίας των μηχανημάτων

  • Τήρηση των εταιρικών κανόνων Υγείας και Ασφάλειας και συμμετοχή σε ενέργειες συνεχούς βελτίωσης

Τι θα θέλαμε να έχεις:

Ενδιαφερόμαστε για εσένα ως άτομο, τη στάση, τις συμπεριφορές και τις αξίες σου. Εφόσον έχεις τη θέληση να μάθεις οτιδήποτε χρειάζεσαι για τον ρόλο που δεν έχεις ήδη, θέλουμε να σου μιλήσουμε :

  • Απόφοιτος Δευτεροβάθμιας Εκπαίδευσης

  • Κάτοχος διπλώματος οδήγησης Β’ κατηγορίας

  • Εμπειρία 2 ετών σε ανάλογη θέση

  • Δίπλωμα Χειριστή ανυψωτικού (προαιρετικό)

  • Επικοινωνία

  • Ευελιξία

  • Ομαδικότητα

Παρέχουμε:

  • Μισθό αναλόγως προσόντων

  • Ιδιωτική ασφάλιση υγείας

  • Συνεχή εκπαίδευση

Τι ακολουθεί;

Εκτιμούμε ότι ο χρόνος σου είναι πολύτιμος και η υποβολή αίτησης για μια νέα θέση εργασίας μπορεί να είναι μια μακρά διαδικασία - γι' αυτό δεσμευόμαστε να απαντήσουμε στην αίτησή σου εντός πέντε εργάσιμων ημερών.

title: Machine Learning/AI Engineer
description:
• Project Description:
    Internal AI-driven platform designed to automate and standardize repetitive data processing tasks. The system focuses on use cases such as product categorization, context-aware translation, and structured data enrichment.

    One of the core components, enables users to configure classification pipelines and upload domain-specific knowledge files. Based on this input, the system processes structured datasets (e.g., Excel files with multiple attributes like category, subcategory, size) and assigns accurate values to each field.

    For example, for a given product the system determines the correct classification (e.g., Shampoo instead of Laundry Detergent) using contextual reasoning.

    The processing pipeline runs on Databricks (DBR), where dynamic prompt generation and LLM-based inference are used to enrich and classify data at scale. The platform integrates backend services, AI pipelines, and cloud infrastructure to deliver reliable and reusable AI capabilities across business units.


    Job Description:
    Key Responsibilities:
    1. AI Integration: Connect foundational models (via APIs or open-source hosting) to web applications using clean code.
    2. System Optimization: Monitor latency, manage token usage, handle model caching, and implement evaluation frameworks to minimize hallucinations.
    3. Team Collaboration: Partner with AI engineers and product teams to translate AI use cases into stable product features.

    Required Technical Skills
    1. Languages: Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic)
    2. AI Orchestration: Hands-on experience with frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph.
    3. Data & Infrastructure: Competency in SQL, Docker, Git workflows, and cloud AI suites (AWS, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure AI).
    4. AI Standards: Understanding of prompt engineering, evaluations (e.g., Ragas), and tool-connection protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol).
    5. Preferable knowledge of AI Factory (PyrogAI IPA/IPA0)

title: Senior Legal Talent Coordinator
description:
OVERVIEW

As a Legal Talent team, we serve as trusted advisors within Cravath’s population of attorneys, partnering with senior leadership on onboarding and training planning, professional development programming and strategic initiatives. We are actively looking for a Senior Legal Talent Coordinator – Onboarding & Integration to provide high level support for the onboarding and orientation process for all legal new hires, ensuring Cravath’s standard of excellence is reflected at all stages of integration to the Firm.

This role is responsible for helping to drive a highly visible process and experience that involves collaboration with Firm stakeholders at all levels. Additionally, this role will provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members and support the Legal Talent Manager with the delegation and coordination of team responsibilities. If you excel in a fast-paced team environment and are passionate about driving organizational success, we encourage you to apply.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supports the planning, execution and continuous improvement of the Firm’s onboarding, orientation and integration programs for all legal staff, including high-level, bespoke orientation sessions and the Firm's large-scale annual Incoming Associate onboarding and orientation program;

  • Serves as the primary administrator of the Firm’s Onboarding Portal, including portal set-up, task configuration, system enhancements, automation, reporting and data analysis;

  • Contributes to process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency while maintaining a high degree of accuracy;
  • Maintains a thorough understanding of Firm policies and procedures and communicates and applies them effectively to legal staff hires at all seniority levels;
  • Provides timely updates, recommendations and problem-solving support to Department and Firm leadership;
  • Mentors junior team members and assists in setting priorities and delegating work;
  • Coordinates and executes ad hoc Legal Talent projects, as assigned; and
  • Performs other duties as, assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree;
  • At least five to seven years of experience in onboarding, human resources, legal personnel or legal recruiting, preferably in a law firm or a similarly structured professional services environment;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted point of contact for partners, attorneys, Firm leadership and cross-functional stakeholders;
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and make decisions within established Firm policies and guidelines;
  • Exceptional organizational, project management and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing deadlines and business continuity priorities (project management certification is a plus);
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including the ability to turn onboarding data into accurate reports, actionable insights and process improvements;
  • Advanced proficiency with iCIMS or comparable applicant tracking and onboarding systems, Microsoft Office Suite and related reporting tools, with a proven ability to configure forms, maintain workflows and drive automation;
  • Working knowledge of Form I-9 requirements and USCIS compliance, including the ability to develop guidelines, deliver training and maintain accurate checklists and supporting documentation;
  • Ability to handle confidential information discreetly and to apply data-minimization principles to sensitive biographical, employment and onboarding information;
  • Demonstrated experience training and mentoring junior team members, coordinating work and establishing priorities in a collaborative, fast-paced environment;
  • Familiarity with legal staff integration practices and resources such as NALP preferred; and
  • Ability to work additional hours, including business-related travel, as needed.

This position is located in our New York office, and currently has a hybrid work schedule, but that is subject to change. The estimated salary range for this position is $120,000 to $140,000. The actual salary offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and where applicable, licensure or certification obtained. Market and Firm factors are also considered. In addition to base salary and discretionary bonus(es), we offer a generous employee benefits package including, but not limited to, paid time off, medical, dental, vision care, 401(k) and substantial health club discounts.

title: Team Lead - ACT Team
description:
Why Prairie Ridge?

At Prairie Ridge Integrated Behavioral Healthcare, our mission is to empower individuals to live healthy, purpose-filled lives on their terms. We believe in the potential of every person and recognize that meaningful care starts with understanding their experiences, strengths, and goals. Through personalized, whole-person care, we help individuals build the skills, connections, and support they need to move forward.

Our work is guided by five core values: Unyielding Empowerment, Relentless Resiliency, Inspirational Integrity, Active Accountability, and Radical Respect. These values shape how we care for the people we serve, work alongside one another, and connect with our communities. We value the different experiences and perspectives each team member brings and the collaboration it takes to provide thoughtful, coordinated care.

As part of our new Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) team serving the Marshalltown area, you’ll have the opportunity to help build something meaningful from the beginning. You’ll work alongside colleagues from different professional backgrounds to bring treatment and practical support directly to individuals in their everyday lives, helping them work toward greater stability, independence, and the goals that matter to them.


What Is the ACT Team?

Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) is a team-based approach to supporting adults living with serious and persistent mental illness. The team brings treatment and practical support into people’s homes and community settings, helping them manage symptoms, navigate challenges, and work toward their personal goals. Team members from different professional backgrounds work closely together to provide coordinated, individualized care.



As the ACT Team Leader, you will help build and guide our new team serving the Marshalltown area, overseeing daily operations and the delivery of coordinated, individualized care. You’ll supervise and support staff, manage staffing and service coverage, lead team meetings, and provide clinical direction. Your role will also include hiring and training team members, monitoring service quality and documentation, providing direct clinical services as needed, and participating in the on-call rotation.



DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Provide supervision of clinical services for the ACT Team.
  2. Plan, implement and manage staffing to ensure required level of service to participants.
  3. Facilitate team/staff meetings to encourage transparency amongst the inter-disciplinary team and provide clinical direction as appropriate.
  4. Coordinate with ACT Team members and scheduling of all consultation meetings
  5. Assist patients and staff with any telehealth related IT issues such as getting screens connected, troubleshooting IT and process issues when they arise, making sure patients have necessary information to connect to telehealth services.
  6. Keep support staff updated on any schedule changes with patients or team members related to meetings and consultations.
  7. Respond to emerging clinical and customer service needs in a prompt and professional manner.
  8. Work collaboratively with other members of residential, care management, leadership and administrative staff to meet the customer service and clinical needs of participants and their families, including an on-call rotation with ACT Team members.
  9. Monitor participant level of service and treatment provision by the team in accordance with guidelines for ACT Teams.
  10. Ensure training and clinical supervision is provided within scope of practice.
  11. Monitor the team/staff adherence to clinical documentation standards.
  12. Review case records as to clinical appropriateness (i.e., clinical interventions are appropriate, follow-up services are documented, etc.)
  13. Interview, hire, and train new staff members.
  14. Provision of clinical services as needed.
  15. Assist the program in developing policies and procedures.
  16. Participate in CQI programming.
  17. Treat all individuals with dignity and respect while maintaining agency standards of confidentiality, professionalism, and objectivity.
  18. Maintain all HIPAA and 42 CFR confidentiality requirements and regulations as outlined in CARF policies and procedures.
  19. Comply with agency policies, procedures, and regulatory standards.
  20. All other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED FOR POSITION

  1. Master’s degree in human services or a current Iowa Registered Nurse (RN) license.
  2. Minimum of 3 years of clinical practice with knowledge of, and experience in, use of evidence-based practices.
  3. Preferred experience working as part of an Assertive Community Treatment Team or other community-based mental health service.
  4. Skill in group, individual and/or family counseling as appropriate.
  5. Travel may be required as this is a community-based program.
  6. Supportive of the mission of Prairie Ridge and the patients we serve.
  7. Proficiency in oral and written communication skills, as well as documentation requirements.
  8. Technology skills allowing for proficiency in use of electronic health record.
  9. While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is often required to stand, reach with hands and arms, and climb or balance.
  10. The employee must infrequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or more up to 35 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

title: SIPRNET Network Engineer
description:
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field; or equivalent relevant experience is required, plus a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:Ability to obtain a Department of Defense Secret security clearance is required at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

Put your engineering talent to the ultimate test. At General Dynamics Mission Systems, we create the technologies, products and services that help our service members, intelligence analysts and first responders keep our nation safe. The work we do is so advanced our teams often redefine what’s possible for the world. If you want to be a leader with the company that delivers smart solutions for our nation’s challenges, this is your opportunity. We apply advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, AR/VR, Cloud Native and Quantum Physics to solve our customers’ missions in cyber, RF, undersea, interstellar and everything in between.

The SIPRNET Network Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day operation, maintenance, engineering, security, and troubleshooting of secure SIPRNET and classified network and systems environments supporting critical business and customer missions. This position serves as a technical subject matter expert responsible for maintaining highly available, secure, compliant, and operationally ready SIPRNET infrastructure across geographically dispersed locations.

The successful candidate will provide hands-on and remote network engineering support across SIPRNET environments, including network infrastructure, routing and switching, firewalls, encryption devices, virtualization, and enterprise services. The engineer will troubleshoot complex technical issues, implement approved configuration changes, support new technology deployments, and ensure systems remain compliant with applicable Department of Defense, DISA, NIST, and cybersecurity requirements.

This position requires strong technical knowledge of secure network architecture, classified systems administration, network security, vulnerability management, configuration management, and Cyber Operational Readiness Assessment (CORA) requirements. The successful candidate must be comfortable working independently, responding to operational issues, supporting multiple concurrent priorities, and have the ability to clearly communicate network requirements, technical instructions, and troubleshooting steps to personnel with varying levels of technical experience, including providing effective remote guidance and support.

Travel will be required to support geographically dispersed SIPRNET environments, infrastructure deployments, maintenance activities, inspections, and customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day operation, maintenance, administration, and troubleshooting of secure network infrastructures.
  • Design, develop, configure, test, implement, and maintain secure network engineering solutions supporting SIPRNET operations.
  • Configure, install, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco routers, switches, firewalls, network security appliances, and other network components.
  • Administer and troubleshoot network routing, switching, VLANs, TCP/IP, subnetting, DHCP, BGP, ACLs, firewall policies, and network security technologies.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco Catalyst and Nexus switches, Cisco ISR/ASR routers, Cisco Identity appliances, Palo Alto next-generation firewalls, and related network infrastructure.
  • Implement and maintain network security controls in accordance with U.S. Government COMSEC, NIST, DISA, and Department of Defense requirements.
  • Perform network and systems troubleshooting using packet analysis, monitoring, logging, and diagnostic tools to identify and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Analyze network performance, availability, and security events and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Perform operating system and vendor software patching in accordance with approved configuration management and security requirements.
  • Implement and maintain STIGs, security configurations, and other applicable cybersecurity controls across network infrastructure.
  • Support Cyber Operational Readiness Assessments (CORA), DISA inspections, audits, security assessments, and other customer compliance activities.
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, system documentation, configurations, technical baselines, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting documentation.
  • Support the installation, configuration, testing, and operational deployment of new SIPRNET infrastructure, network technologies, systems, and security solutions.
  • Perform network and systems configuration changes in accordance with established change management and configuration management processes.
  • Support identity, authentication, authorization, and access control technologies, including RADIUS, TACACS, Cisco ISE, and 802.1X.
  • Monitor network and system performance using approved monitoring, logging, and security tools, including Splunk and other enterprise monitoring platforms.
  • Identify and troubleshoot security, availability, configuration, and performance issues and coordinate resolution with appropriate technical teams.
  • Research emerging technologies and technical solutions and recommend improvements to the SIPRNET network and systems environment.

Required Experience

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience supporting SIPRNET or classified network operations in a Department of Defense environment.
  • Strong understanding of SIPRNET architecture, network administration, systems administration, and operational support.
  • Extensive experience with TCP/IP, subnetting, DHCP, routing, switching, packet analysis, network troubleshooting, and network security.
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco network infrastructure and complex network issues in high-availability operational environments.
  • Experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise firewall technologies, including Palo Alto NGFW.
  • Experience with firewall policies, access control lists (ACLs), network segmentation, BGP and enterprise routing protocols, and secure network architectures.
  • Experience with AAA technologies, including RADIUS, TACACS, 802.1X, and Cisco ISE.
  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-53, NIST SP 800-171, RMF, DISA STIGs, vulnerability management, configuration management, and System Security Plans.
  • Experience working within formal change management and configuration management processes.
  • Ability to create and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, system configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical problems.
  • Ability to clearly communicate network requirements, technical instructions, and troubleshooting steps to personnel with varying levels of technical experience, including providing effective remote guidance and support.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

What you’ll experience:

  • Technologies that aren’t just top-notch, they’re often top-secret
  • A team of bold thinkers committed to exploring what’s next
  • Opportunities to gain new knowledge - as it’s discovered

What you bring to the table:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field; or equivalent plus a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience
  • Subject matter expert (SME) in one discipline/field and developing working knowledge in adjacent disciplines/fields
  • Understanding of how domain interrelates with other components within the closed and enterprise networking environment
  • Expert experience within primary domain and resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways
  • CCNA certification
  • Experience supporting Cyber Operational Readiness Assessments (CORA)

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • SIPRNET environments consistently maintain operational and compliance readiness throughout the year.
  • CORA assessments are completed successfully with minimal findings.
  • Standardized administration practices are implemented across all environments.
  • Maintain required certifications and technical proficiency.
  • Operational risks are identified early and communicated effectively.
  • High system availability and reliable service delivery.
  • Increased operational efficiency through process improvements and standardization.
  • Demonstrates strong collaboration, communication, and accountability as a member of the distributed SIPRNET team.
  • Positive partnerships with Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Security, and Program stakeholders.

Salary Note

This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

Combined Salary Range

USD $117,125.00 - USD $124,000.00 /Yr.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

title: Corporate Development Intern (part-time)
description:
At Consilium Safety Group, we don’t just build technology. We create solutions that protect people, assets, and the planet. As a global leader in fire and gas safety, we serve critical industries such as marine, energy, rail, and construction.

With 100+ years of expertise and 55 offices worldwide, we combine deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge innovation to shape the future of SafetyTech. Backed by strong investors, we are now entering an exciting transformation and growth journey, and we’re looking for a driven student to join us for the ride.

About the Role

We’re seeking a part-time intern to join our Corporate Development team at our Gothenburg HQ. This unique internship blends strategic project work with financial and business analysis, offering exposure to the management of a global private equity–owned company.

You’ll gain first-hand experience in strategy, M&A, and performance management, while collaborating directly with senior executives and the Board of Directors. This is not a back-office role – you will own real projects end-to-end and produce output that goes directly to the Corporate Management Team (CMT) and the Board.

This position is ideal for a student who can work around 50% alongside their studies, giving us time to invest in your development and prepare you for a long-term role at Consilium.

The intended internship period is winter 2026/27 through summer 2027, although an earlier start date may be possible. Depending on fit, performance, and organizational needs, the internship may also be extended.

Our goal is for this internship to evolve into a permanent position after graduation, as part of your continued growth within the company.

You’ll support the Corporate Development team with a broad mix of analytical, strategic, and operational projects:

  • Prepare analyses, presentations, and decision material for the CMT and the Board of Directors

  • Conduct research, data collection, and business case analysis to support decision-making

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that highlight performance and progress (e.g. financial KPIs, strategic initiative tracking, M&A pipeline)

  • Exceptional analytical and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity

  • A hands-on self-starter who takes ownership and follows through, and who is curious, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous context

  • Comfortable leveraging relevant AI tools to boost efficiency and output quality – you see AI as a practical accelerator, not a novelty

  • Team-oriented, humble, willing to learn, and comfortable working with senior stakeholders across cultures and functions

  • Genuine interest in corporate strategy, M&A, and private equity–driven growth

Why Join Us?

  • Work directly with the CMT and the Board of Directors, gaining high visibility across the organization

  • Build both strategic and analytical skillsets, a blend that opens many future paths

  • Join a company at a pivotal point of transformation, backed by strong ownership and bold ambitions

  • Be part of a small, hands-on team that values curiosity, collaboration, and tangible results

If you’re ready to learn, contribute, and grow, apply today and help us shape the future of SafetyTech.

title: Senior RF Systems Engineer
description:
ARQUIMEA, we are a technology company operating globally and providing innovate solutions and products in highly demanding sectors.

Our areas of activity are Aerospace, Defense & Security, Big Science, Biotechnology and Fintech.

Main function and scope:

  • Lead the RF system engineering activities for space communication payloads, taking technical ownership of the RF subsystem, ensuring compliance with system requirements and coordination across all relevant disciplines, suppliers, customers, and stakeholders.

Core functions:

  • Act as technical responsible for the RF subsystem, coordinating its design, development, integration, verification and qualification throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Define RF subsystem architectures from concept level, translating mission and customer needs into feasible RF solutions, including architecture trade-offs, frequency plans, RF chains, technology selection, interfaces and preliminary performance budgets.

  • Support new business opportunities and technical proposals, defining preliminary RF architectures, assessing technical feasibility, estimating development needs and risks, and contributing to technical proposals, compliance matrices and customer presentations.

  • Define, manage and maintain RF subsystem requirements, interfaces, verification criteria and technical documentation.

  • Define, develop and maintain RF subsystem architectures throughout the project lifecycle, including frequency plans, RF chains, interfaces, redundancy concepts, operational modes and associated technical budgets.

  • Perform and review RF system analyses and budgets, including link budgets, gain, noise figure, output power, losses, linearity, spurious emissions, filtering and frequency conversion.

  • Coordinate RF engineering activities and ensure alignment between internal teams, suppliers and project needs.

  • Manage technical interfaces with other spacecraft disciplines, including thermal, mechanical, electrical/electronics, digital/FPGA, EMC, AIT and systems engineering.

  • Coordinate technically with external suppliers and subcontractors, including requirements flow-down, technical follow-up, design reviews, technical clarifications and acceptance of deliverables.

  • Act as an RF technical interface with the customer, supporting technical meetings, design reviews, action tracking and resolution of technical issues.

  • Support component and equipment selection and evaluate supplier solutions against RF and system requirements.

  • Define and coordinate RF verification and test activities, including unit, subsystem and payload-level testing.

  • Review test plans, procedures, test results, anomalies and non-conformances, ensuring proper requirement verification and closure.

  • Support and participate in AIT and environmental test campaigns, including RF performance verification before and after environmental testing.

  • Identify and manage RF technical risks, dependencies, assumptions, trade-offs and critical interfaces.

  • Prepare and participate in project milestones and reviews such as SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, QR and AR.

  • Ensure technical consistency and traceability between customer requirements, system requirements, RF design, supplier specifications and verification evidence.

Required experience and candidate profile:

  • Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • +5 years of experience in RF/microwave engineering, preferably including space, defence, satellite communications or other high-reliability systems.

Technical Requirements:

Training / specific knowledge required in:

  • Strong background in RF and microwave systems engineering, preferably for space, defence or high-reliability applications.

  • Experience with RF architectures, including transmit/receive chains, frequency conversion, filtering, amplification and distribution.

  • Knowledge of key RF parameters and analyses: gain, noise figure, P1dB, IP3, phase noise, spurious, harmonics, isolation, return loss and VSWR.

  • Experience defining and managing RF requirements, interfaces and verification activities.

  • Experience with RF test equipment such as VNAs, spectrum/signal analyzers, signal generators and power meters.

  • Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary technical activities and manage interfaces with mechanical, thermal, electronics, digital and system engineering teams.

  • Experience interacting technically with customers, suppliers and subcontractors.

  • Ability to review supplier documentation, technical proposals, test reports and compliance matrices.

  • Strong technical documentation and communication skills in English.

Nice-to-have training / specific knowledge:

• Experience in space communication payloads.

• Knowledge of DRA (Direct Radiating Array) architectures, active antennas, phased arrays or electronically steered antennas.

• Experience with RF systems in Ku, Ka or higher frequency bands.

• Knowledge of RFIC/MMIC technologies, LNAs, PAs, mixers, filters, switches and frequency synthesizers.

• Experience with antenna/RF simulations using CST, HFSS or similar tools.

• Knowledge of ECSS standards and space project lifecycle.

• Experience with environmental qualification and acceptance campaigns.

• Knowledge of EMC/EMI and its interaction with RF subsystem performance.

• Familiarity with RF payload calibration and end-to-end performance verification.

The position is located at our headquarters in Madrid, at Calle Serrano Galvache, 56.

We're looking for curious, creative, tenacious and collaborative people, eager to do things and unafraid to tackle challenges in order to contribute to improving the society in wich we live.

Think Big, Do the Job & Enjoy Life

title: Supervisor, Production
description:
Company Overview

General Dynamics Ordnance and Tactical Systems (OTS) is a global leader in the design, engineering and production of munitions, energetics, weapons, armaments, and missile subsystems around the world. OTS empowers the U.S. military and its allies with an extensive range of overarching product segments applied across all levels of strategic and tactical operations, providing a cutting-edge advantage to our warfighters. Our Ethos of Honesty, Trust, Transparency, and Alignment, are the guiding principles that form the foundation of everything we do. Integrity is paramount, innovation fuels our passion, customer satisfaction is at the core of our mission, and collaboration is key to our success - fostering a culture of teamwork and mutual respect among employees, partners, and stakeholders. Whether you're just starting out on your career journey or are an experienced professional, we offer a robust total rewards package that goes above and beyond with compensation; healthcare, wellness, retirement, and work/life benefits that include career development and recognition programs. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

Job Summary

Supervise hourly employees. Must be capable of training, motivating and organizing work force. Must have technical skills to provide guidance and direction for continual improvement projects. Responsible for the safety, quality and efficiency of assigned processes. Complete daily production reports and maintain Daily Management System communication boards located in production areas. Accountable for the proper logging and tracking of material consumed on assigned production operations. Must be capable of working any shift in support of the production plan.

Impact of the Role

General Profile

  • Working supervisor of a team (spends a portion of time performing the work supervised) or supervises the daily activities of production team members
  • Must have one or more of any direct report type
  • Analyses information to solve on-going problems and implements procedures and approaches to complete work
  • Responsible for results of the team
  • Provides direction to team using extensive knowledge of established precedents and practices
  • Consistent exercise of discretion & judgment

Essential Functions

  • Supervises production operations for assigned units or during an assigned shift.
  • Supervises workers that operate production machinery, assemble items, perform quality control, or package goods for shipment.
  • Notifies maintenance or engineering departments when equipment requires maintenance or repair.
  • Monitors output of assigned area(s) against established schedules or quality goals. Coordinates the flow of work through the department and ensures that department has sufficient levels of inventory to meet demand and is staffed appropriately.
  • Leads and directs the work of other employees and has some responsibility for personnel actions related to hiring, performance, and disciplinary actions with concurrence from the HR Directors & General Managers.

      • Required Qualifications

      • Required education and experience: Associate's Degree and 3-5 years' experience OR Equivalent Combination of Relevant Education &/or Experience
      • Critical professional related technical skills; computer skills: Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

      Preferred Qualifications

      • Preferred education and experience: Bachelor's Degree
      • Discipline/Major: Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations or Business degree preferred
      • Knowledge, skills & abilities: Ability to work as part of a team. Decision-making skills. Problem/situation analysis. Project management skills. Planning skills.

      Physical Requirements

      • Must be able to remain in a stationary position at a desk and/or computer for extended periods of time.
      • Requires regular movement throughout GD-OTS facilities.
      • Must be able to lift up to 45 pounds.
      • May need to stand for long periods of time.
      • Work primarily in a climate-controlled environment with minimal safety/health hazard potential.
      • Work may require employee to work inside and outside with exposure to changing climate and/or operate machinery.
      • May be requested to work a different shift.
      • This position is Safety-Sensitive.

      Travel Requirements

      Up to 25% travel likely.

      Pay Range (USD)

      $69,900 - $94,500

      Pay Transparency Statement

      The salary range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum for salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, internal equity, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the range during the hiring process.

      Benefits

      Employees are eligible for medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, and basic life insurance as well as pre-tax spending accounts. Employees are also able to enroll in the company's 401k plan and are eligible for the Non-Contributory Retirement Contribution. In addition to the benefits discussed above, the company offers the following voluntary benefits: Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Identify Theft Protection, Enhanced Legal Services, Hospital Indemnity Insurance, Educational Assistance, Employee Assistance Program

Other duties may be added or this job description may be amended at any time. This job description does not alter an employee's at-will employment status or create an employment agreement or contract, implied or otherwise.

title: Building Surveyor
description:
Start here. Grow here.

AECOM are looking to recruit an enthusiastic Building Surveyor to join our expanding Glasgow Building Surveying Team. For the successful candidate, they will be undertaking various levels of work expected of a Building Surveyor, whilst reporting into our Senior and Management team. Projects may include live healthcare facilities, live commercial premises, schools, and university buildings mostly based in the Northeast.

We have a strong national Building Surveying community, collaborating, co-operating and delivering daily. Being part of this 60 strong team in 12 offices may involve occasional travel within the UK, and the opportunity for some international travel. In the past 24 months, Surveyors from the UK have worked in Los Angeles, San Francisco and Cologne for example. There are opportunities for surveys in the USA and Middle East in 2026/27.

You will be based in our Glasgow Office; however we operate a ‘Freedom to Grow’ policy where staff have the option of working in the office or from home as they wish, together with the ability to flex their hours. The Surveyor will still be expected to work from the office at least one day per week with the rest of the team.

There is no limitation to career progression within our Building Surveying team, and you will be encouraged to develop to be the best you can be, grow and flourish as a surveyor and developing business, and embark on a long term career with AECOM. You will be fully supported, encouraged and mentored with your journey.

Here’s what you’ll do

  • Contract Administration
  • NEC Supervisor (desired)
  • Condition Surveys including PPM
  • Reinstatement Cost Assessment
  • Specification preparation
  • AutoCAD Drawing and Design work including measured surveys
  • Schedules of Condition
  • Use of Microsoft software platforms such as word, excel and PowerPoint
  • Use of iPad technology

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

  • BSc Hons Building Surveying
  • A Chartered Member of the RICS (desired)
  • NEC Supervisor accreditation (desirable but not essential)

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity

You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.

You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.

AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.

We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Benefits Analyst
description:
Overview

At Shawmut Design and Construction, we take pride in the culture we’ve built as a 100% employee-owned company—one that’s been recognized with more than 100 Best Place to Work awards. We’ve been honored as a National Fortune Best Workplace, a Fortune Best Workplace for Women, Millennials, and Parents, and one of America’s Best Employers by Forbes—along with numerous regional recognitions across our 15 offices nationwide.

Here’s a glimpse into what we offer:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance.
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) – Be an employee-owner!
  • 401(K) with Company Match – Receive a company match up to 4% of your eligible pay.
  • Generous Paid Time Off – vacation and sick time, 12 holidays, summer Fridays, and a yearly volunteer day.
  • The Extras – Cell phone, laptop, tuition reimbursement, pet insurance, financial planning services, and more.

*Please note: this position works out of our Boston office 3x per week, with the option to work from home 2x per week.

Responsibilities

The Senior Benefits Analyst manages day-to-day benefits administration and assigned projects, using data to improve accuracy, manage risk, and strengthen employee service and cost visibility. This person partners with Payroll, HRIS, PST Business Partners, and vendors to resolve issues, improve processes, and meet deadlines.

  • Analyze benefits, payroll, and vendor data to identify discrepancies, patterns, and emerging issues. Validate findings, make corrections, determine underlying causes, and recommend practical corrective actions.
  • Initiates 401(k) contribution file and calculate monthly match
  • Develop an understanding of how plan provisions, system configuration, payroll deductions, and vendor processes interact. Ask thoughtful questions and trace issues across these connections to resolve problems and prevent recurrence.
  • Participate in benefits-related projects, system enhancements, acquisitions, integrations, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Exercise independent judgment in resolving routine and complex issues within established policies and procedures.
  • Audits of enrollments, eligibility, payroll data, deductions, contributions, and benefit data to ensure accuracy, compliance, and data integrity.
  • Participates in annual US benefits open enrollment working closely with other team members
  • Serve as a day-to-day contact for assigned vendors; track service issues, confirm corrections, and escalate unresolved concerns. Monitor recurring problems and recommend service improvements.
  • Partner with HRIS and Payroll to maintain benefits data and troubleshoot file transmissions, eligibility rules, and deduction discrepancies. Test benefits configuration changes and document results.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify administration, automate repeatable reporting, and reduce manual work while preserving accuracy.
  • Updates data systems and vendor online enrollment sites to ensure data integrity.
  • Develops reporting proficiency in data systems to maintain integrity between systems.
  • Prepare and validate data for benefit plan audits, required reporting, Form 5500 preparation, and nondiscrimination testing in partnership with benefits leadership and external advisers.
  • Support regulatory compliance, testing, audits, filings, reporting requirements, and the maintenance of accurate plan documentation.
  • Resource for employee benefits inquiries, providing outstanding customer support and resolving complex benefit-related concerns.
  • Create employee communications, knowledge resources and educational materials
  • Support employees during life events, benefit enrollments, and retirement planning activities.
  • Conduct new-hire benefit orientation sessions and employee communication sessions, as needed

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in benefits administration.
  • Workday experience preferred but not required.
  • Bachelor’s Degree required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated initiative, follow through, resourcefulness, efficiency and attention to detail.
  • Strong working knowledge of MS Office (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Ability to learn new software and applications.
  • Ability to quickly learn organization structure and stakeholders.
  • Ability to create a culture of inclusion and belonging by acting with courage, humility and curiosity; desire to learn about others and self-reflect.

We look forward to hearing from you!

EEO Information

Shawmut prohibits discrimination against any staff member or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, religion, national origin, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, genetic information, disability, creed, citizenship status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Salary Range Information

Boston Base Salary Range: $100,000 - $125,000 The range stated is specific to Boston. Placement within the listed range depends on many factors including, but not limited to years of experience, project size capability (for Construction & Field roles) and internal company equity.

title: Software Engineer, Platform Scale & Reliability
description:
Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. As we serve larger enterprise customers, the expectations placed on our platform increase significantly. Performance, reliability, security, observability, and predictable operation become essential parts of the product.

You can read more about our product at .

As our new Software Engineer, Platform Scale & Reliability 📈

You will help strengthen the technical foundations that allow Performativ to serve more customers, process more data, and support increasingly demanding enterprise use cases.

This is an all-round engineering role rather than a narrowly defined infrastructure position. You will work across services, data flows, APIs, background processing, databases, cloud infrastructure, and operational tooling wherever improvements are needed.

  • You will identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability limitations across the platform, using production evidence to focus effort where it has the greatest impact.

  • You will improve observability through useful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerts that help the team understand system behaviour and diagnose problems quickly.

  • You will strengthen services, data processing, deployment workflows, and operational safeguards so failures are detected early, contained, and permanently resolved.

  • You will contribute across our technology landscape, including Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, containers, and CI/CD tooling, without being limited to one language or system.

  • You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, critically review their decisions and output, and establish the tests and operational evidence needed for safe deployment.

You should bring broad software-engineering experience and a practical understanding of how production systems behave under real usage. Experience with distributed systems, performance analysis, database optimisation, cloud infrastructure, observability, or high-volume data processing would be valuable. Expertise in our exact technology stack is less important than your ability to understand systems, investigate evidence, and deliver sound solutions.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be able to recognise weak designs, incorrect assumptions, missing failure modes, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is remote from the Philippines and requires working hours that substantially overlap with the team’s working day in Copenhagen.

What we can offer you 🌱

  • The opportunity to influence the foundations of a financial platform as it moves into enterprise scale.

  • Broad engineering challenges across applications, data, infrastructure, reliability, and developer tooling.

  • An AI-native development environment where engineering judgment matters more than manually producing code.

  • An ambitious, collaborative team with colleagues in Copenhagen and the Philippines.

  • Strong opportunities to develop your technical breadth and contribute across the platform.

title: Lagerarbetare - plock pack & transportbokningar
description:

Som lager-, pack- och transportbokare hos oss på Dinair i Kinna arbetar du med att plocka, packa och förbereda varor för leverans. Rollen är varierad och innebär bland annat hantering av transporter, godsmottagning, truckkörning, administration och aktivt förbättringsarbete.

Du samarbetar nära kollegor i produktion och lager och bidrar till att våra kunder får rätt produkter i rätt tid.

  • Aktivt bidra till förbättringsarbete och 5S

Vem är du?

För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du:

  • Är ansvarsfull, flexibel och lösningsorienterad

  • Kan arbeta självständigt men också trivs i team

  • Klarar av att hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt och arbeta under tidspress

  • Är noggrann och strukturerad

  • Kan läsa och följa instruktioner (SOP:er)

  • Har god kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska

Krav

  • B-körkort

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och tror att man kommer långt med rätt inställning!

Dinair/AAF är en av Europas största tillverkare och leverantör av ventilationsfilter, stoft- och rökgasfilter med över 100 års erfarenhet. Sedan 2016 ingår vi i AAF International med Daikin som huvudägare. AAF driver forskning samt produktutveckling och har ett komplett produktsortiment av hög kvalité. Vi tar vårt uppdrag på största allvar och lägger stora resurser på att utveckla våra produkter och metoder för att vara i framkant. Det gör att vi kan erbjuda våra kunder de bästa produkterna och smartaste lösningarna.

Dinair AB har huvudkontor i Vadstena och vi finns representerade i hela Sverige med ca 150 anställda. Våra två produktionsanläggningar finns i Horndal och Kinna.

Praktisk information

Ort/Placering: Kinna

Omfattning: Heltid

Ansökningstid: 2025-11-20 Löpande urval – tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista datum

title: Hygiene Manager - Care Campus
description:
About the Role

The Hygiene Manager provides day-to-day leadership for the Care Campus's shower, restroom, and laundry services. This role is responsible for ensuring that hygiene services are safe, clean, accessible, organized, and delivered in a way that protects participant dignity, privacy, and choice.

The Hygiene Manager leads the Hygiene team and is accountable for staffing and coverage, participant flow, sanitation and infection-prevention practices, supplies and inventory, equipment readiness, and coordination of facility and maintenance needs. The role works closely with Safety, Client Support Specialists, Case Management, Facilities, healthcare and behavioral health partners, and other Campus teams to support a safe and welcoming participant experience.

Key Responsibilities

Hygiene Services & Participant Experience

  • Lead daily operations of participant shower, restroom, and laundry services, including opening, shift transition, and closing procedures.
  • Monitor participant flow, service capacity, wait times, utilization, and emerging needs, adjusting operations as needed to maintain accessible and effective services.
  • Maintain consistent practices that protect participant privacy, dignity, safety, and equitable access.
  • Respond to participant concerns, conflicts, complaints, and service barriers and work with other Campus teams to connect participants to additional services and resources when appropriate.

People Leadership & Staffing

  • Supervise, coach, develop, and evaluate Hygiene Leads and Hygiene Specialists.
  • Build and manage staffing schedules, shift assignments, breaks, call-off coverage, and day-to-day staffing adjustments.
  • Establish clear expectations for participant engagement, sanitation, safety, documentation, attendance, teamwork, and professional conduct.
  • Monitor staffing trends such as overtime, vacancies, attendance, and turnover and partner with People + Culture and Campus leadership on recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.

Sanitation, Safety & Infection Prevention

  • Maintain strong cleanliness, sanitation, infection-prevention, workplace-safety, and PPE standards throughout showers, restrooms, laundry areas, and related spaces.
  • Ensure appropriate procedures are followed for bodily fluids, sharps, contaminated materials, wet surfaces, and other exposure or environmental hazards.
  • Maintain procedures for identifying and responding to medical emergencies, behavioral health crises, suspected overdoses, falls, and other safety concerns while protecting participant privacy.
  • Ensure Hygiene staff understand when to involve Safety, clinical staff, emergency responders, or Campus leadership and are prepared to respond within the scope of their training.

Laundry, Supplies & Facility Readiness

  • Oversee laundry operations, including safe handling, tracking, and return of participant belongings.
  • Maintain adequate inventories of hygiene, laundry, cleaning, PPE, and other operational supplies and ensure materials are safely stored and responsibly used.
  • Conduct routine inspections of hygiene areas and equipment and coordinate repairs, preventative maintenance, plumbing, equipment, sanitation, and related facility needs with Facilities.
  • Develop temporary operating solutions when equipment or facility issues affect service availability.

Quality, Compliance & Collaboration

  • Maintain required operational records and service documentation and monitor utilization, participant needs, incidents, and service disruptions.
  • Participate in audits, inspections, incident reviews, corrective-action activities, and quality-improvement efforts.
  • Use participant feedback, service information, staff observations, and incident trends to strengthen operations and service quality.
  • Work closely with Safety, Client Support, Case Management, Facilities, healthcare, behavioral health, and other Campus teams to resolve issues and support coordinated services.

What You'll Bring

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in human services, hospitality, operations, public health, social services, or a related field preferred.
  • Three or more years of progressively responsible experience in homeless services, hygiene services, shelter operations, hospitality, facilities, social services, or another high-volume service environment preferred.
  • Two or more years of supervisory, management, or team-leadership experience preferred.
  • Experience managing frontline staff, scheduling, coverage, and day-to-day service operations strongly preferred.
  • Experience serving individuals experiencing homelessness and people with behavioral health, substance use, medical, or other complex needs preferred.
  • Experience with sanitation, infection prevention, workplace safety, inventory management, or facilities coordination preferred.
  • Strong staff leadership, organization, communication, conflict-resolution, and problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of trauma-informed care, harm reduction, person-centered services, professional boundaries, and de-escalation.
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic systems used for scheduling, documentation, incident reporting, inventory, and communication.

Our Values

Dignity | Community | Integrity | Partnership | Social Justice | Radical Care

Work Environment

Regular use of a computer and HR technology platforms is required, along with the ability to manage detailed records and sustained periods of screen-based work. The role follows a hybrid work arrangement with regular onsite presence and occasional travel among Los Angeles-area locations. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, sit, walk, stoop, talk, hear, reach above and below shoulders; use hand and finger dexterity, keyboarding and making and receiving telephone calls. The employee may be required on occasion to lift and or carry up to 20 lbs.

In addition to federal law requirements, SJC complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

title: Data Platform Specialist | Merivale
description:
Behind every great guest experience is a team making it happen. We’re looking for a Data Platform Specialist to join Merivale’s Technology team, helping turn data into practical insights across our portfolio of restaurants, bars, pubs and events.

Working within our Data team, you’ll help build and maintain reliable data platforms, develop reporting tools and explore opportunities for AI and automation. From improving data pipelines to creating dashboards that support everyday decisions, your work will connect technology with the needs of our venues and head office teams.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and supporting data pipelines, integrations and ELT processes across business applications and platforms.
  • Building and maintaining dbt transformation models, and supporting Snowflake administration, monitoring and performance optimisation.
  • Developing and improving Power BI dashboards, reporting and semantic models, including reusable datasets for self-service reporting.
  • Working with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into practical data and analytics solutions.
  • Maintaining data quality, security and governance through validation, reconciliation and ongoing monitoring.
  • Investigating and resolving data platform issues, maintaining documentation and supporting projects from requirements through to deployment.
  • Supporting AI and machine learning initiatives, including forecasting, reporting and opportunities to automate manual processes.

You’re analytical, curious and comfortable working through complex problems. You can explain technical ideas clearly, build strong relationships and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

You’ll also bring:

  • At least five years’ experience in data platforms and BI analytics roles.
  • Hands-on experience with data warehousing, data modelling, SQL Server and Power BI.
  • An understanding of AI and automation concepts, including machine learning and generative AI.
  • Sound knowledge of data governance, security and quality management.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently and within project teams.
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in IT, Data & Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Python and data automation will be highly regarded, as will experience in hospitality, retail, consumer or multi-site businesses.

Merivale Employee Benefits

  • 25% staff discount across 90+ Merivale venues.
  • Exclusive monthly perks, staff-only rewards and events.
  • Merivale Staff Cellar – access to premium wines at staff pricing.
  • Paid parental leave – with flexible return to work options.
  • Unlimited career growth with endless development opportunities.
  • Merivale Academy – online and in-person training, including Leadership, Guest Experience, F&B.
  • Professional accreditation support – including Leadership and WSET qualifications.

title: X Ray Technician Limited Scope
description:
Overview

Hours: 9a-6p Monday through Friday

Location:3645 N Beach St Fort Worth, TX 76137

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At Concentra, you will be a vital member of our patient care team and play a crucial role in providing exceptional care to our patients. Our mission is to improve the health of America's workforce, one patient at a time. Join us at Concentra and see how your clinical competency and compassion can make a meaningful difference in the lives of the patients you serve.

The X Ray Limited Scope & Medical Support Specialist performs routine x-ray, medical, and testing procedures under direct supervision of the treating clinician as well as supports in other areas of the facility as needed including registration and referral management. This position will also perform routine X-ray examinations in accordance with Concentra policies, practices, and procedures and applicable regulations. This role requires efficient and accurate delivery of one-on-one patient care while thriving in a fast-paced environment. Also will ensure that every patient is treated with quality clinical care and receives an excellent patient experience from welcoming, respectful, and skillful colleagues.

Responsibilities

X-ray Technician Duties

  • Prepare patients for radiologic procedures. Escort patients to dressing and x-ray rooms, provide verbal and/or written instructions and assist patients in positioning body parts to be radiographed. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure patient care, safety and comfort during the x-ray exam
  • Operate radiologic equipment to produce images of the body for diagnostic purposes. Position radiologic equipment and adjust controls to set exposure time and distance according to specification of examination. Take x-rays following established radiologic requirements and regulations to ensure patient care and safety
  • Use radiation safety measures and protection devices to ensure safety of patients and team members
  • Ensure radiologic equipment remains in working order. Report equipment malfunctions to Center Operations Director
  • Ensure all Radiology workflows are followed and all Radiology reports cross correctly to EMRFollows documentation procedures and completes required documentation related to patient x-ray visit.
  • Maintain all x-ray equipment, including calibration, QA/QC procedures, and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures

Medical Support Specialist Duties

  • Perform Department of Transportation (DOT) and Non-DOT drug and alcohol testing
  • Prepare patients for physical examinations, including taking vital signs and any required or requested ancillary testing including but not limited to vaccines and injections, phlebotomy, PFTs, audiogram testing and respirator fit testing
  • Perform rapid screening tests (influenza, strep, mono, glucose, etc.)
  • Assist providers during examination and treatment
  • Responsible for performing routine medical procedures as ordered by treating clinician as well as triaging emergent patients as needed
  • Prepare and assist clinician with procedure set up and injury care
  • Apply bandages, dressings and splints as ordered by the treating clinician
  • Dispense medications and DME as ordered by the treating clinician in accordance with state regulations
  • Complete quality assurance activities on equipment and medical devices as well as testing processes used in the center
  • Maintain supplies, clean rooms and equipment, and stock exam rooms
  • Maintain and operate all medical devices and equipment, including calibration and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures
  • Notify supervisor immediately if equipment is not functioning properly, supplies are needed, or facility is not operating as expected
  • In partnership with center leadership, assist with patient flow and volume
  • Keep patients informed of expected wait times during all aspects of the center visit
  • Responsible for clerical tasks in both the front and back office associated with patient care and proper record keeping
  • Ensure accuracy in documentation
  • Perform front office duties: greet patients, obtain authorization, check in/out, communicate wait times, answer multi-line telephone system, and distribute employer results/paperwork as needed
  • Follow HIPAA guidelines and safety rules
  • Attend center staff meetings or huddles as required
  • Assist in maintaining a neat, clean, and orderly appearance throughout the facility
  • Complete any applicable training including but not limited to clinical competency training that occurs monthly.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • High school graduate or GED equivalent
  • Certifications and/or Licenses:
  • Completion of state approved Limited Scope Technician certificate program and license by the state in which employed, if applicable.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification

Job-Related Experience

  • Customarily has at least six months or more of medical assistant experience with knowledge of medical procedures and medical terminology
  • Customarily has at least six months of demonstrated experience in X-Ray and familiarity with routine medical procedures
  • Working knowledge of occupational medicine requirements (state specific) is preferred with prior medical office, healthcare and/or customer service-related experience.

Job-Related Skills/Competencies

  • Concentra Core Competencies of Service Mentality, Attention to Detail, Sense of Urgency, Initiative and Flexibility
  • Ability to make decisions or solve problems by using logic to identify key facts, explore alternatives, and propose quality solutions
  • Outstanding customer service skills as well as the ability to deal with people in a manner which shows tact and professionalism
  • The ability to properly handle sensitive and confidential information (including HIPAA and PHI) in accordance with federal and state laws and company policies
  • Able to communicate both verbally and in writing in a clear, and professional manner
  • Teamwork focus with peers and center leadership team; ability to maintain working relationship with all levels of colleagues
  • Must participate in initial and ongoing training as required
  • Obtain all certifications required of Medical Support Specialists including but not limited to Drug Screen Collection, Breath Alcohol Certification, Hair and Oral Fluids Collection

No Additional Preferences

title: Junior Software Engineer
location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
description:
What Being a Software Engineer Means to Us


We feed our Software Engineers coffee and doughnuts which provides the fuel they need to produce high-quality software that solves very real problems.


It’s important at this point to note that we call you “Software Engineers” and not “Developers”, “Programmers” or “Coders”. Why? Because you won’t just code up something that’s been designed. You will help us Engineer a solution. You are part of the solution. Part of our world-class team.


You’ll engage with customers, identify their operational challenges and build clever software to solve those challenges. Supported by our experienced teams, you’ll help to drive the prolific spread of fast, reliable Internet access throughout Africa. You’ll work with Internet Service Providers (ISPs) like MWEB, Vox, Cybersmart and Frogfoot.


You’ll help implement solutions using SOLID, our business automation platform, to enable our customers to deliver Fibre, Satellite and other Internet-based products. You’ll work with a variety of software technologies like Mobile Apps, GIS Mapping, Network Integration, Hardware Provisioning and Mobile Money payment platforms.


Bottom line – You’ll make a difference.


Job Description

  • Design and develop high-quality Java applications using cutting edge technologies for Object Relational Mapping, Caching and Service-Oriented Architecture
  • Work with our experienced Software Engineers and learn from our dynamic team
  • Learn about implementing scalable, robust, maintainable software using design patterns and object-oriented principles


Desired Skills and Expertise


  • Required Technical Skills:
    • Good understanding of the Java programming language/syntax
    • Exposure to or good understanding of HTML/CSS and Javascript
    • Experience with SQL and RDBMS database concepts and design
    • Exposure to Object Relational Mapping (e.g. Hibernate, EJB3)
    • Exposure to Java servlet containers (e.g. Tomcat, GlassFish, Jetty)
    • Experience with Java IDEs (e.g. Eclipse, IntelliJ, Netbeans)
    • Practical database experience (e.g. MySQL, Oracle, MS SQL)
    • Good English writing capabilities and communication skills


  • Some Recommended Technical Skills:
    • Exposure/understanding of version control and the software development lifecycle in a team environment
    • Exposure to Linux (e.g. CentOS, UBuntu, Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE, Debian)
    • Good understanding of Internet and LAN/WAN technologies
    • Exposure to accounting and business concepts


  • You as a Person:
    • Must be willing and able to learn new technologies
    • Excellent technical skills and a hunger to learn more
    • A good understanding of broad business processes and principles
    • Excellent communication skills & good interpersonal skills
    • Able to work independently as well as part of a team
    • Dynamic self-starter: highly motivated / enthusiastic / energetic
    • Analytical and objective, with attention to detail
    • Hard working and keen to take on new challenges as part of the team that does so every day


  • Qualifications:
    • Relevant degree in Computer Science or related field or a minimum of three years' development experience in a commercial environment.


Working at SOLID isn’t easy. It isn’t a ‘free ride’. It is detail-oriented. It’s a work-directly-with-the-customer-on-something-that’s-never-been-done-before type job.


Working at SOLID is also about a lot more than just being able to code. We value things like creativity, good communication, attention to detail, confidence, critical problem-solving. Being a quick learner and a good team player are also important.


It is important to us that we help you to grow as a working professional and Software Engineer – to be the best that you can be. So we strive to achieve that on a daily basis.
