title: SAP Datasphere & Analytics Planning Specialist
description:
Would you like to help shape Vattenfall’s next generation of data, analytics, and planning solutions and contribute to our journey towards fossil freedom?

Within Enterprise Collaboration Solutions, our Enterprise Information & Communication Solutions team manages and develops digital solutions supporting information and communication, risk and compliance, planning, reporting and business analytics across Vattenfall.

Our SAP analytics landscape is evolving around SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC), SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), supporting enterprise analytics as well as financial and project planning scenarios.

We work closely with business stakeholders, architecture teams, delivery teams and technology partners to provide reliable services while continuously developing our internal capabilities.

We are now looking for an SAP Datasphere & Analytics Planning Specialist to strengthen our internal team. The role combines hands-on expertise in SAP Datasphere data modelling and SAC Planning with an interest in the evolving SAP Business Data Cloud ecosystem.

What will you do?

As an SAP Datasphere & Analytics Cloud Planning Specialist, you will work across the data and planning landscape, translating business requirements into scalable and maintainable solutions.

You will contribute across the solution lifecycle, from requirements analysis and modelling through development, testing, performance optimization, operational support, and continuous improvement.

A key part of the role is to build capability within the team. We are looking for someone who enjoys working collaboratively, sharing knowledge, and helping colleagues develop their expertise.

Your tasks and responsibilities

  • Design, develop and enhance SAP Datasphere data models, including semantic and consumption-ready models supporting analytics and planning use cases.

  • Develop and maintain SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions, including planning models, stories, data actions, advanced formulas, input forms and related planning components.

  • Support both planning and analytical use cases across SAP Analytics Cloud.

  • Apply performance optimization techniques across Datasphere data models, SAC models, stories and planning solutions.

  • Support the integration and consumption of data from SAP S/4HANA, including an understanding of ABAP CDS Views and clean-core principles.

  • Assist Service Delivery on SAP Datasphere administration topics relevant to ongoing operations and Vattenfall BDC platform.

  • Work with Data Access Controls and user authorization concepts, ensuring appropriate access to data and planning applications.

  • Contribute to SAP BDC data product concepts, including the future development and consumption of standard and custom data products.

  • Develop knowledge and capabilities around SAP BDC Object Store and emerging BDC capabilities as the platform evolves.

  • Work with SAC and Datasphere Seamless Planning concepts and contribute to their adoption within relevant planning scenarios.

  • Participate in requirements analysis, UAT, releases, troubleshooting and operational/SLA support.

  • Advising business stakeholders on core SAP Datasphere modelling across multiple business areas, with the ability to balance local requirements with Group-wide standards, reuse and consistency.

  • Analyze and resolve issues relating to data modelling, integration, planning logic, authorization, and solution performance.

  • Create and maintain technical and user documentation.

  • Actively contribute to knowledge transfer, coaching and training of colleagues to strengthen Vattenfall’s internal SAP analytics capabilities.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, platform management, architects, internal development teams and external delivery partners.


Location
All Vattenfall IT locations (Poland, Netherlands, Germany, Sweden)

Who are you?

You are a hands-on SAP analytics professional who is comfortable working across data modelling and business planning. You understand that successful analytics solutions require more than technical development. You can understand business requirements, translate them into sustainable data and planning solutions, and work collaboratively with different stakeholders.

You enjoy sharing knowledge and seeing strengthening the capability of the wider team as an important part of your role.

We believe you bring

  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP Datasphere, particularly data modelling and semantic modelling.

  • Hands-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, covering both Analytics and Planning.

  • Solid practical experience with SAC Planning, including planning models, data actions, advanced formulas, input forms, and planning stories and applications.

  • Understanding of planning processes, preferably including financial planning and/or project planning.

  • Understanding SAP S/4HANA data structures and ABAP CDS Views, including awareness of clean-core principles.

  • Experience with performance analysis and optimization of data models and analytics/planning solutions.

  • Good understanding of data access, Data Access Controls and user authorization concepts.

  • Understanding integration patterns between SAP source systems, Datasphere, and SAC.

  • Experience working in complex enterprise SAP and analytics landscapes.

  • Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.

  • A collaborative mindset and a strong willingness to share knowledge, coach colleagues, and contribute to team development.

Valuable additional experience

  • SAP Business Data Cloud and its evolving architecture.

  • SAP BDC data products, including consumption and development of custom data products.

  • SAP BDC Object Store concepts.

  • SAC and Datasphere Seamless Planning.

  • SAP Datasphere administration.

  • Experience with Azure, Databricks and/or Snowflake in an enterprise data landscape.

  • SAP BPC, BW/IP, PaPM or comparable enterprise planning technologies.

Personal attributes

  • A strong team player who enjoys working collaboratively.

  • Takes ownership while remaining open to ideas and feedback from others.

  • Willing to actively train, coach and enable colleagues rather than becoming a single point of technical dependency.

  • A pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.

  • Curious and willing to develop skills as SAP BDC, Datasphere and SAC capabilities evolve.

  • Able to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • A structured way of working with a strong focus on quality and sustainable solutions.

Our offer
Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information
We welcome your application in English. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Marta Jura e-mail: martha.jura@vattenfall.com.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall. The screening will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Product Development Leader - Europe
description:
About Stoïk

Stoïk is a European cyber insurer that combines insurance with prevention. Our policyholders get cover, continuous monitoring and an in-house CERT that responds when an incident happens. We are tech-driven, human at heart, and growing fast across Europe with a challenger spirit.

The role

Product Development shapes the protection we offer. As Product Development Leader - Europe, you will own Stoïk's cyber insurance offer across Europe, for all segments we operate in, up to companies with €1Bn in revenue. You will design, launch and improve our policies, and adapt them to each market we enter.

You will play a central role in the Stoïk Insurance Think Tank, where we design, negotiate and innovate around new coverages. Your team will work hand in hand with our Underwriting and Claims teams every day.

  • Reports to: the VP Insurance, directly

  • Works hand in hand with: the Underwriting and Claims teams

  • Also works closely with: our CERT, Product, Legal & Compliance, Sales and Marketing

  • Location: based in one of our offices in Barcelona, Madrid, Paris, Munich or Brussels

Responsibilities

Lead the product strategy

  • Define and own the European product roadmap for our cyber offer, in line with Stoïk's growth plan and new markets.

  • Build, lead and develop the product team, with clear priorities, standards and ways of working.

  • Turn market, threat, legal and regulatory developments into product decisions.

Build and improve our policies

  • Translate our underwriting intentions into clear, legally robust wordings, endorsements and proposal forms, and keep them up to date.

  • Develop new products, extensions, sector solutions and services through the Stoïk Insurance Think Tank, with our CERT and prevention teams, from concept to launch.

  • Adapt our core product to each European market, and run product governance (approvals, product reviews and regulatory documentation) in line with insurance distribution rules.

Work across Stoïk

  • Work hand in hand with Underwriting and Claims on guidelines, appetite and profitability, and use CERT insights to close coverage gaps.

  • Work with Legal & Compliance on each country's regulatory requirements, and support Sales and Marketing with broker materials and launches.

  • Report, update and present on product performance and the roadmap to senior management, carriers, reinsurers and brokers.

Market intelligence

  • Closely monitor what our competitors do: products, wordings, services, pricing and positioning.

  • Gather feedback and ideas from insureds and brokers on new needs and expectations, and feed them into the roadmap.

  • Track cyber threats, claims trends, case law and regulation that affect coverage.

Wording expert and Stoïk ambassador

  • Be the point of contact for any wording question, internally and from brokers.

  • Train our teams and educate brokers on our products, wording changes and what sets our coverage apart.

  • Present at conferences and industry events as a Stoïk ambassador.

Requirements

Experience

  • At least 5 years in insurance product development, wordings, underwriting or claims, across Europe or internationally.

  • Proven cyber insurance experience is required; experience in other commercial lines (D&O, PI, FI, property) is a plus.

  • A track record of drafting and managing policy wordings, and of launching new products or entering new markets.

  • Creativity with wording, and ease drafting technical and complex clauses, are a plus.

  • Experience leading or mentoring a team.

  • Working knowledge of the regulatory framework around insurance products and cyber risk, including product governance (IDD / POG), GDPR and NIS2 / DORA.

Background and languages

  • A legal background (law degree or legal practice) is required.

  • Fluent English, plus fluency in at least one other European language, ideally French, Spanish or German. Any additional language is a plus.

How you work

  • A team player who builds trust with underwriters, claims, CERT, brokers and partners.

  • Strong organisational skills, able to run several product launches at once.

  • Pragmatic and decisive: you ship, learn and improve quickly.

  • Accountable for your results and your team's.

  • A clear writer and confident presenter, able to explain complex coverage simply.

What we offer

  • A senior leadership role shaping cyber insurance products at one of Europe's fastest-growing cyber insurers.

  • Direct access to our in-house CERT, claims data and threat intelligence to build better products.

  • A senior, autonomous team that values ownership and clear decisions.

  • A competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Full working flexibility with the willingness to meet at the office on a regular basis.

  • Regular travel across Europe to meet brokers, partners, our local teams, and to attend industry events.

title: Bilingual Clinician (Spanish-speaking)
description:
Job Title: Bilingual Clinician (Spanish-speaking)

Department: Clinical Services

Reports to: Clinical Programs Director & Bilingual Managing Clinician

Position Status: Full-time (32 hour workweek); Exempt

Location: Cambridge, Boston Area (hybrid: minimum three days in office)

Work Schedule: 32 hours per week

Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000; commensurate with experience

Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled.


BARCC Overview

Founded in 1973, the Boston Area Rape Crisis Center (BARCC) is the oldest and largest rape crisis center in New England, serving as the only comprehensive center for survivors of sexual violence in the Greater Boston Area. BARCC’s mission is to end sexual violence through healing, empowerment, and social change. BARCC empowers survivors of sexual violence to help find healing and seek justice in ways that are meaningful to them and works to provide education and advocacy needed to create social change and prevent sexual violence. We rely on our dedicated staff to do this important work, and our team is growing!


Position Overview

The Bilingual Clinician’s role is to provide comprehensive, high quality, bilingual clinical care in Spanish to survivors of sexual violence and their significant others at BARCC in alignment with BARCC’s mission and philosophy.


Work Environment

BARCC's staff, operations, hours, and location vary by function, type of work, and work style. This is a 32-hour per week full-time position. This position will work in a hybrid schedule with a minimum of two days on-site in BARCC’s Cambridge Office. One on-site evening per week, until 8pm is required for this position. BARCC will engage in an interactive process regarding reasonable accommodations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide intakes, crisis intervention, short-term individual, couples, and family counseling services to BARCC clients at BARCC’s Cambridge office.
  • Develop, revise, and facilitate on and off-site groups.
  • Conduct client sessions during evening hours one night per week.
  • Maintain accurate records of services provided to and on behalf of clients.
  • Ensure that records are completed in a timely manner and comply with BARCC’s record-keeping guidelines.
  • Collaborate with other client services staff on cases requiring multidisciplinary services.
  • Work with supervisors on program improvements and new program development.
  • Provide clinical support and education to volunteers and interns.
  • Observe, track, and communicate client feedback and needs (community response, feedback from allied organizations, client quotes, etc.) that explain the impact and needs of program services to supervisor at least once per year.
  • Attend and participate in developmental, organization-wide, and other meetings.
  • Act in the best interest of the organization, reflecting the values of teamwork, collaboration, and mutual respect.
  • Provide bilingual affidavits for immigration cases when necessary.
  • Review affidavits for immigration cases for other clinicians.
  • Support BARCC in responding to Spanish main line calls.
  • Perform other duties as needed or directed.


Physical Requirements & Essential Functions

  • The role may involve remaining in a stationary position for periods of time during calls, meetings, and general role responsibilities.
  • This role generally requires the ability to communicate in writing and verbally with clients and colleagues, use a computer, phone and other office equipment.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.


Required Qualifications

  • Verbal and written fluency in Spanish and English
  • License-eligible LICSW or LMHC in Massachusetts
  • Commitment to BARCC’s mission. equity, inclusion, and survivor-centered values.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Current LICSW, LMHC, or licensed psychologist in Massachusetts
  • At least two years of related direct clinical experience
  • Experience working directly with survivors of sexual violence.


Benefits and incentives

At BARCC, we understand the hard work and dedication necessary to support our mission-driven organization, which is why we are committed to ensuring our employees are healthy, happy, and secure. We offer the following benefits:

  • 32-hour work week designed to promote healthy work-life balance
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans offered at 85% employer paid
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO): 12 vacation days, 15 paid sick days, minimum 14 paid holidays, two personal days, and two religious holidays per year
  • Parental Leave and Massachusetts Paid Family Medical Leave Act (PFMLA) benefits
  • Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 403(b) retirement plan
  • Commuter benefits
  • Professional Development Allowance and other perks
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness eligible employer
  • The opportunity to make meaningful change and improve the lives of others through mission-driven work, at all levels of the organization.


Hiring process and timeline

Please submit a resume, a cover letter describing your interest in survivor-centered clinical work via our online application system. No phone calls, please. The full hiring process will include a phone-screen interview, first-round virtual interview, and a final team interview with a skills assessment. Reasonable accommodation is provided upon request.


Employment is contingent upon satisfactory completion of any background checks required by applicable law, regulation, contract, or funding requirement. Information obtained through a background check will be considered in accordance with applicable law and BARCC policy, including an individualized assessment where required.


BARCC is an equal opportunity employer committed to workforce diversity and hiring people with diverse life experiences. Survivors, people who are bilingual/bicultural, persons of color, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA+ people are encouraged to apply

title: Customer Advisor  - 12 Hours
description:
Your role in the JoJo story…

Do you dream of a role where you can make meaningful contributions that finish in days well spent? If you're ready to begin a fabulous adventure and you're passionate about retail, we have the perfect role for you!

Each JoJo store is unique whether that’s trading over two floors, having a quirky layout or being situated in an interesting place. They have a life of their own. Our Unique Selling Point (USP) in this ever-changing retail world is the relationship we build with our customers, many of them loyal to our brand and to their local store team. This is where you come in - you’ll be the face of JoJo providing a fantastic level of customer care and service that we are renowned for and one we pride ourselves in upholding always. You’ll be guiding, informing, and assisting our customers in the correct purchase of our huge range of clothing and products. This could be an expectant parent, an excited grandparent or other friends or family.

Our B Corp principles are so important, and every member of our teams will always uphold them. As we move into a digital retail world, offering an Omni-Channel customer service is expected as this builds on customer loyalty. As such most of our stores offer Ship from Store or Click and Collect options, you will take ownership of preparing and shipping all such orders daily.

A peek into your daily adventures:

  • Assisting our customers in many different and sometimes diverse situations, from bra measuring or discussing our maternity wear, to demonstrating a baby carrier to an intrigued parent.

  • Preparing Omni-Channel orders.

  • Liaising with customers in store or via the phone on Omni-Channel orders.

  • Using our digital or virtual learning platforms to continuously develop your knowledge and retail skills.

  • Embracing new product knowledge or learning to increase sales opportunities.

  • Actively listening to our customers’ needs and working out what the best solution is for them.

  • Taking pride in keeping your store looking immaculate.

A typical week would be 3 x 4 hour shifts however, flexibility is required in line with store requirements.

Skills that make you shine:

  • Previous retail, customer service and sales experience

  • Competent IT skills and excellent systems ability, with an aptitude to pick up new systems quickly.

  • The ability to learn and retain a high level of product information and be able to communicate this effectively to our customers.

  • You’ll need a self-developing mentality and a curiosity to learn new products independently.

  • We don’t like hard sales techniques, but you’ll need to demonstrate a level of sales ability, which includes active listening skills, empathy, and an understanding of our customers’ needs.

  • You’ll be working within a small team; therefore, the ability to work harmoniously and respectfully is important.

  • Working in a retail environment requires a level of flexibility, most of our stores are open 7 days a week.

  • We like to keep our stores looking tip-top, so you’ll have a keen eye for detail and play a key role in maintaining our standard.

Please note: We will only recruit individuals who are over the school leaver's age. To find out more about the school leaver age for England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland- Please click the following link:

Just to give you a taste of our culture, we’ll be looking for you to:

  • Be a brand ambassador, safeguarding our values and ethos.

  • Demonstrate honesty and respect in every interaction.

  • Foster collaboration and open, active listening

  • Take ownership of all aspects of the role.

Perks and Benefits:

  • Extra day of annual leave for each year you’re with us, up to 38 days.

  • Is it your birthday? Take it off and celebrate!

  • Let’s celebrate JoJo doing well – non-contractual bonus scheme.

  • Helping plan for the future - enhanced pension scheme.

  • Get on the move - cycle to work scheme.

  • Financial wellbeing app - pay yourself 40% of your earned wages whenever you want.

  • Saving scheme with Smart Money Cymru – You do not need to live in Wales!

  • Flexible work options.

  • Enjoy fabulous social events.

  • Give back with volunteer days to support our communities.

  • Prioritise your well-being with our Health and Wellbeing hub.

  • Specsavers voucher – Get a free sight test and contribution towards glasses (T & C’s) apply.

  • We love our products! Enjoy:

    • 40% off JoJo branded lines

    • 25% off full-price NEXT products

    • 10% off NEXT Beauty products

    • Up to 10% off most branded products

  • Embrace an “It’s up to you” learning environment with ongoing training and development opportunities.

Want to know more about JoJo?

We make happy and helpful clothes and products that let children be children – in all their silly, messy, adventurous, noisy, imaginative joy. But we’re not just about selling products; we’re about creating a warm, community-centric environment for our employees and our customers. From 39 locations across the UK and Ireland and a thriving e-commerce platform, we offer a meticulously designed collection of children’s clothing, toys, and essentials designed with love and care: always with children at the forefront of our minds.

As a B Corp, our commitment goes beyond commerce, we strive for a sustainable future and take pride in our responsibilities to the planet and our communities. At JoJo, every role, every task and every day is an opportunity to support, inspire and contribute to the well-being of our teams and our customers.

We embrace and openly welcome people from different cultures, perspectives, and experiences to create a diverse and enriched environment. We work hard to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people, regardless of background to make sure we grow our company sustainably and with different cultural influences. By encouraging a diverse and inclusive workforce, we aim to create an environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

title: Full Stack Agentic Developer
description:
About Eidra UK

Eidra is a collective of around 1,600 people across design, technology, data and business transformation companies, including Umain, Kurppa Hosk, Above and Curamando. Eidra UK brings that capability together for UK clients from our London base.

Umain is the engineering practice inside Eidra UK. We design, build and run digital products at scale: apps with 400M+ downloads, platforms serving 50M+ monthly active users, and backends handling tens of thousands of requests per second.

We are building Eidra UK around an AI-first way of delivering software. This role sits at the centre of that.

The role

We’re looking for a full stack developer who already works agentically. You write clear specs, run multiple agents in parallel against them, choose the right model for each job, and take full ownership of what ships.

You’ll work on client products end to end, from shaping requirements with stakeholders through to production. You’ll also help define how Eidra UK builds software with agents: the practices, tooling and standards the rest of the team uses.

How we build

We start from a clear spec, break the work into tasks agents can complete, run those agents in parallel, verify the output with tests, evals and review, then ship. The spec is the source of truth. Agents do much of the implementation. You own the spec, the orchestration and the quality of the result.

What you’ll do

Spec driven delivery

  • Define requirements in a structured way: identify the actors, describe their use cases, then derive the features that serve them.

  • Turn client needs into specs that both people and agents can build against: clear scope, acceptance criteria, interfaces and constraints.

  • Keep specs, tests and code in step as the product changes.

  • Break work into units that agents can complete and verify independently.

Agent orchestration

  • Run and coordinate agent swarms: parallel agents, subagents and specialised roles (planning, implementation, review, testing).

  • Build and maintain the supporting tooling: MCP servers, agent skills, prompts, context files and isolated workspaces.

  • Design the checks that keep agent output trustworthy: test coverage, evals, guardrails and human review points.

Model selection and mixing

  • Combine frontier and open-weight models to deliver results.

  • Route work by capability, cost, latency and data sensitivity, including self-hosted or private deployments where client data requires it.

  • Measure model performance on real tasks and change the mix when the evidence says so.

Full stack engineering

  • Build secure, scalable web applications with TypeScript, React and Next.js.

  • Build backend services and APIs with Node.js and NestJS.

  • Create reusable UI components using design system principles.

  • Work with cloud infrastructure (GCP, AWS or Azure), infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Build observable systems with metrics, logging and tracing, including for LLM and agent behaviour in production.

Clients and team

  • Work directly with clients and cross-functional teams across design, product and data.

  • Explain agentic delivery, its trade-offs and its limits to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Share what works: pair with colleagues, document patterns and help raise the agentic practice across Eidra UK.

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of professional full stack experience, with strong TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js and core web fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience delivering production software with coding agents (for example Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar), beyond autocomplete.

  • Strong requirement definition experience, working from actors to use cases to feature definitions with clear acceptance criteria.

  • A working spec driven development practice. You can show specs you’ve written and what agents built from them.

  • Experience running multiple agents in parallel and coordinating their output.

  • Practical experience using both frontier and open-weight models, with a view on when each is the right choice.

  • Strong engineering judgement. You read and review agent output critically and you own the result as your own code.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the consulting instinct to work it through with clients.

  • Curiosity. The tools change monthly and you enjoy keeping up.

Nice to have

  • Building agentic features into client products: tool calling, RAG, MCP servers, multi-agent workflows.

  • Running open-weight models in production (for example vLLM, Ollama or managed inference).

  • LLM evaluation and observability tooling.

  • Contributions to open source agent tooling or published writing on agentic engineering.

  • Tailwind CSS, Storybook and design system work.

  • Experience in a consultancy or agency setting.

Working setup

London is the default office. You’ll work remotely when it suits the team or the client.

Don’t match every point? Apply anyway. We care more about how you think and what you’ve built than about ticking every box.

title: Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations
description:
Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our platform depends on accurate and timely data from custodians, banks, brokers, and other financial institutions. These connections provide the positions, transactions, cash movements, instruments, and corporate actions used throughout the investment-management lifecycle.

You can read more about our product at .

As our new Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations 📈

You will help build and operate the systems that connect Performativ with custodians and other providers of investment data.

The immediate challenge is practical: we need to deliver a growing number of integrations while maintaining the existing portfolio and resolving real production issues. The longer-term challenge is to avoid a scaling trap where every new institution requires another collection of manual processes and bespoke code.

We are building a more automated integration platform with reusable pipelines, mappings, reconciliation, quality controls, and AI-assisted development. Your work will contribute both to integrations customers need now and to the foundations that let the team deliver future integrations faster and more safely.

  • You will develop and maintain integrations covering positions, transactions, cash, instruments, prices, corporate actions, and other investment data across files, APIs, SFTP, and message-based interfaces.

  • You will build reusable ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring capabilities instead of treating each provider as an isolated implementation.

  • You will investigate complex data and production issues across internal systems, external providers, and customer environments, then deliver permanent fixes that prevent known classes of problems from recurring.

  • You will work closely with users, operations specialists, and other engineers to understand the complete workflow and ensure that integrated data is correct and useful throughout the platform.

  • You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their assumptions and output critically, and establish the tests, controls, and evidence required for safe deployment.

You should bring strong backend or data-engineering judgment and experience with production systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience with financial integrations, investment data, reconciliation, ETL pipelines, APIs, structured files, or regulated systems would be valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, and CI/CD tooling is useful, but experience with our exact stack is not essential.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI can help us understand formats, generate mappings, develop implementations, and test integrations faster. It does not replace financial-domain understanding, careful validation, or accountability for the resulting data.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

  • Work on integrations at the centre of a production wealth-management platform.

  • Solve difficult problems involving financial data, external systems, reconciliation, reliability, and operational workflows.

  • Help create an AI-assisted approach to developing and maintaining integrations safely at scale.

  • An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

  • Strong opportunities to deepen both your engineering capabilities and your understanding of investment management.

title: Style Advisor Weekendhulp
description:
About the job

As a Style Advisor at MR MARVIS, you help customers find their perfect (out)fit. With your eye for detail and personal approach, you offer tailored styling advice while creating a warm, inspiring atmosphere that makes every visitor feel welcome and well taken care of. We are looking for someone to help out in our Laren store during the weekends.

What’s on a typical to-do list:

  • Creating a great first impression by welcoming customers, engaging with them, informing them about our brand and store concept, and inspiring them to explore our collection;

  • Advising customers on products, quality, heritage and size selection. You are knowledgeable and exude confidence;

  • Providing expert advice with confidence and pride. This includes finding the right sizes for customers, and offering inspiring styling tips as a complimentary service.

  • Going the extra mile to elevate the customer’s shopping experience — whether that’s pinning long trousers for tailoring or offering a coffee or refreshment.

  • Ensuring the store always looks its best – inside and out.

Ask yourself, are you…

  • Enthusiastic, energetic and commercially minded, as well as patient, flexible, and presentable?

  • A good communicator who can genuinely listen to the customer?

  • Customer oriented?

  • Passionate about styling and not afraid to offer alternative products?

  • Interested in Fashion and Retail and enthusiastic about MR MARVIS (experience in a service-oriented industry such as hospitality or retail is a plus)?

  • Fluent in both Dutch and English?

What you'll get

  • All-in salary starting at €17.74 per hour (for everyone 21 and older), including 8% holiday pay and 25 vacation days on a full-time basis.;

  • A pension scheme, because later is also important;

  • Mobility allowance in case you live further than 8km;

  • The chance to work in a young and fast-growing scale-up in the fashion industry;

  • Monthly "Wellbeing budget for Swapfiets, Treatwell, or several gyms. Want to invest your budget? You can, via Peaks!

  • A challenging position with a lot of responsibility;

  • A free delicious and healthy lunch during your shift;

  • 20% discount on all MR MARVIS products;

  • Unlimited access to OpenUp (a mental wellbeing platform with access to various psychologists and coaches) and the meditation app Meditation Moments;

  • Cool team events

About MR MARVIS

MR MARVIS is an Amsterdam-based menswear brand, dedicated to creating the perfect shorts, trousers and tops. As a Certified B Corporation, we’re proud to be part of a community of companies working together for change, and taking part in collective action to advocate for a shared goal of a global economy that benefits people and the planet.

What started in 2016 with three founders has now grown into a team of 300+ people representing 40+ nationalities. Having established a strong online presence across Europe, we’re now growing our international retail network. Today, you’ll find us in cities such as Amsterdam, Berlin, Paris and London.

We make slow fashion, with timeless design and craftsmanship at the centre. We are dedicated to doing better every day, creating value for our team, our suppliers, our customers, and everyone who interacts with our business.

title: Sr Principal Execution Business Specialist (PPM / EVM)
description:
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of relevant work experience is required, plus a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.

Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

Imagine a world-class engineering environment with exceptional talent and advanced technologies that are often classified. At General Dynamics Mission Systems, you’ll work with amazing engineers to invent the technologies, products, and services that help our service members, intelligence analysts, and first responders keep our nation safe. We provide premium systems and services to the Department of Defense, government agencies, and commercial clients across areas including acoustic sensors, signal processing, combat systems, torpedoes, cybersecurity, knowledge management, and electronic warfare. If you want the chance to lead, it's time to bring your talent to General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS)!

General Dynamics Mission Systems has an immediate opening for a Sr Principal Execution Business Partner Specialist supporting the performance and profitability of programs critical to our nation’s defense and national security missions.

We encourage you to apply if you have any of these skills or experiences:

  • Expertise in Earned Value Management Systems (EVMS), integrated performance management, and cost and schedule development and analysis for complex defense programs.
  • Experience developing work breakdown structures (WBS), Integrated Master Plans (IMP), Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), and time-phased budgets for proposals and programs.
  • Advanced knowledge of Estimate at Completion (EAC), Management Reserve, risk and opportunity management, and subcontractor and material performance analysis.
  • Expertise in EVMS and scheduling tools, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with defense or federal contracting, government procurement, and Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA) and Defense Contract Audit Agency (DCAA) audits.

What you’ll experience

  • Leads cost and schedule baseline development, performance analysis, forecasting, and executive and customer reporting across programs typically exceeding $50 million in annual contract value and $200 million in total program value.
  • Develops integrated, time-phased budgets and master schedules; applies schedule health checks, resource loading, critical path analysis, and schedule risk analysis; and resolves schedule integration and network logic conflicts.
  • Integrates EAC, Management Reserve, risk and opportunity assessments, subcontractor and material data, and contract modifications into program performance and financial reporting.
  • Defines automation requirements; evaluates, implements, and improves EVMS and scheduling tools; and develops processes and technical training to support program execution and EVMS compliance.
  • Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation

What sets you apart

  • Subject matter expertise in EVMS and scheduling best practices, including applying the Program Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK) to executable program processes.
  • At least five years of experience leading teams responsible for EVMS, integrated planning, or scheduling on large, complex programs.
  • Experience integrating unprecedented program requirements across multiple subcontractors, product lines, and geographic locations.
  • Domain expertise in program and product life cycles, material management, financial processes, and contracting structures.
  • PMI Scheduling Professional certification, preferred for an Integrated Master Planner focus.

Our Commitment to You:

  • An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
  • Research-oriented work alongside award-winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security.
  • Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule).
  • Competitive benefits, including 401(k) matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health and wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more.
  • See more at gdmissionsystems.com/careers/why-work-for-us/benefits.

Workplace Options:

This position can be supported 'flex' but requires an on-site in office presence a few days per week. While on site you can based out of any of our 'hubs' (MA, VA, AZ). We are not offering a relocation package.

Salary Note

This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

Combined Salary Range

USD $160,000.00 - USD $170,000.00 /Yr.

Company Overview

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!

Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans

title: Commercial Head of Ekco Operational Technology
description:
About Ekco

🚀 Founded in 2016, Ekco has quickly become one of Europe’s fastest-growing cloud solution providers and your trusted security-first Managed Service Provider.
IT leaders choose Ekco to drive operational efficiency, scale smarter and stay ahead of risk – powered by local expertise, delivered at European scale.

We specialise in helping organisations advance their cloud maturity guiding transformation, strengthening security, and maximising the value of their technology investments.

☁️ In simple terms: we help organisations modernise with confidence securing their systems, optimising their cloud, and keeping them resilient in a rapidly changing world.


🌍 Today, we’re a thriving team of 1,000+ talented and supportive colleagues across the UK, Ireland, Benelux, South Africa, and Malaysia—and we’re continuing to grow.

At Ekco, how we work matters as much as what we deliver. Our people live by four core values that shape everything we do:

  • On It: We take ownership, follow through, and get things done.

  • All In : We collaborate, support each other, and commit fully to shared goals.

  • Connected: We build trusted relationships with colleagues, clients, and partners.

  • Hungry to Grow: We stay curious, keep learning, and push ourselves to the next level.

🏠If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Role

How did Ekco and Datalogix come together? Datalogix is a Cork-headquartered Operational Technology (OT) business with more than 20 years' experience designing, implementing and supporting secure OT infrastructure for enterprise customers in life sciences, pharmaceuticals, general manufacturing and critical national infrastructure. Datalogix now forms the Operational Technology (OT) division of Ekco's Security. Ekco is a security-first managed services provider with more than 2,000 customers in Ireland, the UK, the Netherlands, the Caribbean and North America. Ekco employs over 1,000 people across Europe, Asia and Africa. A key part of Ekco Security’s mission is to serve our customers' converged IT and OT security requirements and to capture the rapidly growing OT new market opportunity.

The Commercial Head of Function for Operational Technology owns the commercial strategy, pipeline and commercial performance of the OT business across Ireland, the UK, the US and the Caribbean. You will turn Datalogix's deep OT expertise into a repeatable, scalable go-to-market engine, grow managed OT security, professional services and support revenue, and lead the integration of OT into Ekco's wider security and managed services proposition, including secure IT/OT convergence.

Day-to-day at Ekco:

Commercial Strategy and Growth

  • Define and deliver the OT commercial strategy, annual revenue plan and market-entry priorities by geography (Ireland, UK, the Caribbean, US) and by sector

  • Own the commercial view of the OT function: bookings, revenue, margin, recurring revenue mix and forecast accuracy

  • Shift the portfolio mix towards multi-year managed services and recurring revenue alongside project and professional services work

  • Identify and develop new service lines, partnerships and acquisition or bolt-on opportunities in OT

  • Win OT new logo’s business in agreed sectors such as life sciences, manufacturing, critical national infrastructure, healthcare and transportation (all modes).

  • Develop agreed volumes and lines of business in existing key Ekco and Datalogix accounts.

Sales and Pipeline Leadership

  • Build and govern a disciplined pipeline, with clear qualification, stage gates and forecasting

  • Personally lead strategic and complex opportunities, including negotiations with senior customer stakeholders (operations, engineering, IT, CISO and procurement)

  • Develop and manage key accounts to deepen relationships, extend contract scope and secure renewals

  • In time, lead, coach and set targets for OT sales, account management and pre-sales roles as the commercial function grows. Initially, this role will be very much a player role, where this individual personally leads the sales and business development efforts. As the OT function and pipeline builds, it is envisaged that the commercial team will also need to build and that this role will evolve to a player-coach role, responsible for building and leading that commercial team.

  • Build and execute a credible go-to-market strategy for OT, profiling target sectors, prospects, existing Ekco customers, working with Ekco internal marketing and internal business development functions to contact and capture new logos and to cross-sell to existing logo’s.

Cross-Selling and Ekco Integration

  • Work with Ekco Security, Professional Services and regional leadership to cross-sell OT into Ekco's customer base and bring Ekco's managed security, SOC and cloud services to Datalogix customers

  • Shape joint propositions for IT/OT convergence, OT security monitoring, network segmentation, resilience and compliance

  • Align commercial processes, CRM, pricing and contracting with Ekco group standards while protecting customer experience

Proposition, Pricing and Partnerships

  • Own OT service packaging, pricing models and commercial terms in partnership with the technical and delivery leads

  • Manage strategic relationships with technology vendors, automation and OT security partners, channel partners and system integrators

  • Maintain a clear view of competitors, market trends and regulation (such as NIS2, CRA and sector-specific requirements) and translate them into customer-facing value

Delivery and Customer Outcomes

  • Partner with the OT CTO and delivery leadership to ensure sold work is scoped realistically, delivered to quality and profitable

  • Support customer success through regular executive engagement, service reviews and escalation management

  • Ensure commercial and contractual risk is understood and managed, including safety, validation and regulatory obligations in GxP and similar regulated environments

Leadership and Culture

  • In time build a high-performing, accountable commercial team that combines technical credibility with commercial discipline

  • Represent the OT function in leadership forums and contribute to Ekco's wider strategy and planning

  • Act as a visible ambassador for Datalogix and Ekco at industry events, customer forums and in the market

What we are looking for:

Essential

  • Significant experience in a senior commercial, sales or business leadership role in OT, industrial automation, industrial cyber security or a closely related technology services business

  • Track record of growing revenue and building teams, including managing quotas, forecasts and budgets

  • Experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder solutions to manufacturing, life sciences, pharmaceutical or critical infrastructure customers

  • Strong understanding of OT environments (for example SCADA, PLC and DCS systems, industrial networks) and of IT/OT convergence and security, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers

  • Commercial acumen: pricing, contract negotiation, margin management and risk

  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills at executive level

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly

Desirable

  • Experience in a managed security or managed services provider

  • Experience selling in multiple markets, or leading a multi-region sales function, UK, US, Caribbean preferred.

  • Experience in a post-acquisition integration or a scaling, private-equity-backed environment

  • Familiarity with relevant standards and frameworks such as IEC 62443, NIST, CRA and NIS2, and regulated environments such as GxP

  • Relevant degree in engineering, business, IT or a related discipline

Benefits / Perks

• ☀️ Time Off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays
• 🎂 Birthday Leave: One extra day off to celebrate
• 💰 Company Pension Scheme • ❤️Health Care
• 📞 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for wellbeing support
• 🏃‍♀️ EkcOlympics: Global team activity challenges
• 📚 Unlimited access to Pluralsight for continuous development
• 🌱 Real opportunities to grow, including international progression

Why Ekco

  • 🏅 Company of the year 2026 Tech Excellence Awards

  • ⭐️ Microsoft’s 2023 Rising Star Security Partner of the Year

  • 🚀 First Irish Microsoft MSP to achieve all four Microsoft Security Specializations

  • 🌈 A culture rooted in diversity, equality, inclusion & belonging

  • 🎉 A commitment to internal mobility and career progression

  • ✨ Flexible, family-friendly working at the heart of our culture

  • 🔐 Proud to be your trusted security-first Managed Service Provider chosen by IT leaders to drive operational efficiency, scale smarter and stay ahead of risk.

title: Konstruktionsingeniør med fokus på AI og digital transformation
description:
Vi søger en erfaren konstruktionsingeniør med minimum 5 års erfaring til vores kontor i Høje Taastrup. I denne rolle får du mulighed for at kombinere klassisk konstruktionsfaglighed med udvikling og implementering af kunstig intelligens i et af verdens største rådgivende ingeniørvirksomheder.

Det, der gør stillingen særlig, er muligheden for at stå i front, når vi udvikler og implementerer AI-værktøjer i vores konstruktionsteam. Du bliver en nøglespiller i den digitale transformation og får stor indflydelse på, hvordan fremtidens projektering og ingeniørarbejde skal udføres.

Vi leder efter en kollega, der både har solid forståelse for bærende konstruktioner og en naturlig nysgerrighed på nye teknologier. En person, som motiveres af at omsætte idéer til konkrete løsninger, der skaber værdi for både projekter, kunder og kolleger.

Du får adgang til WSP’s internationale ekspertmiljøer og stærke faglige netværk på tværs af organisationen. Her kan du samarbejde med AI-specialister og digitale udviklingsmiljøer i andre lande, hente inspiration fra globale initiativer og bringe internationale erfaringer og løsninger i spil i vores danske projekter.

Dit team

Du bliver en del af vores konstruktions-, renoverings- og brandafdeling, som består af cirka 50+ engagerede kolleger.

Afdelingen er organiseret i tre teams, hvor konstruktionsteamet udgør omkring 25+ medarbejdere.

Vi arbejder med både nybyggeri, transformation og renovering inden for kultur-, erhvervs- og boligprojekter.

Vores projekter spænder fra komplekse konstruktioner til større tværfaglige opgaver, og vi samarbejder tæt med både danske og internationale kolleger for at bringe de bedste løsninger i spil.

Her kan du læse mere om vores arbejde inden for Byggeri | WSP

Dine opgaver

Hos WSP får du opgaver, der både udfordrer og udvikler dig – og du står aldrig alene. Vi løser tingene sammen, og hjælper hinanden, når det er nødvendigt.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Identificere områder, hvor AI kan skabe værdi i projekter og arbejdsgange

  • Drive udvikling og implementering af AI-værktøjer i konstruktionsteamet

  • Teste, udfordre og omsætte nye teknologier til praktiske løsninger

  • Inspirere og understøtte kolleger i anvendelsen af AI

  • Samarbejde med internationale AI-specialister og udviklingsmiljøer på tværs af WSP

  • Deltage som fagprojektleder på spændende konstruktionsprojekter

  • Projektere og designe bærende konstruktioner

  • Bidrage til udviklingen af fremtidens digitale projekteringsmetoder

  • Deltage aktivt i den tekniske og faglige udvikling af afdelingen

Personlige kompetencer

Udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen hos os, både fagligt og personligt. Vi deler viden, lærer af hinanden og værdsætter forskellige perspektiver.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet civil- eller diplomingeniør med speciale inden for konstruktioner

  • Har minimum 5 års erfaring med projektering af konstruktioner

  • Har erfaring med projektering gennem byggeriets forskellige faser

  • Har praktisk erfaring med AI, digitalisering eller automatisering, samt med til at udvikle og implementere digitale løsninger

  • Er nysgerrig på nye teknologier og deres anvendelse i praksis

  • Trives med ansvar og har lyst til at drive udvikling

  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og bidrager positivt til teamet

  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og kan formidle nye idéer til kolleger og samarbejdspartnere

Plads til både ambitioner og mennesker

Hos WSP får du en arbejdsplads, hvor du kan være dig selv – og vokse både fagligt og personligt. Du får adgang til vores globale læringsplatforme WSP Learns og WSP Cornerstone, hvor tusindvis af kurser og læringsforløb giver dig mulighed for løbende at styrke både dine faglige og personlige kompetencer.

Vi ved, at arbejdet ikke er alt. Derfor tilbyder vi fleksibilitet i både arbejdstid og hjemmearbejde, så der er plads til familie, venner og fritidsliv.

Vi værner om et godt arbejdsmiljø og en stærk social kultur. Du får en buddy ved din side fra start og en leder, der giver dig retning, mening og plads til at udvikle dig.

Derudover får du attraktive personalegoder som pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring, aktiekøbsprogram og gratis parkering.

For os er det vigtigt at være en arbejdsplads, hvor du føler dig velkommen, værdsat og inkluderet.

Sådan ansøger du

Send os dit CV, din motiverede ansøgning og relevante dokumenter via vores portal.

Vi glæder os rigtig meget til at høre fra dig – og vi inviterer løbende kandidater til samtale.

Om WSP

WSP er en af verdens førende rådgivervirksomheder og kombinerer ingeniør-, rådgivnings- og videnskabsbaseret ekspertise for at udvikle samfund, der skaber værdi for mennesker. Fra lokale rødder til global tilstedeværelse opererer WSP i dag i mere end 50 lande og beskæftiger omkring 83.000 specialister – kendt som Visioneers. Sammen udvikler vi nye løsninger og leverer innovative projekter inden for transport, infrastruktur, miljø, byggeri, energi, vand samt minedrift. WSP er børsnoteret på Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: WSP).

title: Finance Intern H127
description:
