title: Product Manager (Colleague Documents)
description:
About the role

Every colleague at Tesco generates documents — a Right to Work report on day one, a fit note, a contract, a P45 when they leave.
CDMS (Colleague Document Management Solution) is the Global Component that journey teams plug into CDMS rather than building their own document handling, and CDMS owns capture, storage, retrieval, retention and reporting. Right to Work is live in stores through My Tesco today, with absence, recruitment and Central Europe following — around 1.5 million documents a year and nine business areas in the demand pipeline.
This is a genuinely end-to-end role and you will own it. You will set the longer-term platform strategy and run the day-to-day backlog with engineers in Kraków. You will shape the frontend experience managers and colleagues actually use, and you will onboard teams across the business onto it.

About us

Our colleagues work with one goal in mind, helping to make every day a little better for our customers, colleagues and communities all over the world. No two customers are the same, neither are our colleagues.

At Tesco, we champion a balance that lets you thrive both in and out of work. Spend 60% of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely. Whether you're just kicking off your career, juggling passions, or navigating big life events, we're here to support you.

Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. As a Disability Confident Employer, we’re committed to providing a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require.

What our colleagues like the most at Tesco:
  • We develop our own products
  • We make an impact; large scale of operation
  • Accountability and respect are given to us
  • We cooperate and support each other
  • There are great colleagues who are divided into small teams here
  • We can develop and learn new things


What is in it for you


Hybrid working

We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about different flexible working options. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
This role requires you to be based in or near Kraków, as you will spend 60% (3 days) of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely.

Our benefits

Tesco is a diverse and exciting employer, dedicated to being #aplacetogeton, providing career-defining opportunities to all of our colleagues. If you choose to join our business, we will provide you with:
  • Up to 20% yearly salary bonus – based on both individual and business performance
  • Permanent contract from the go – as a sign of our trust in your abilities
  • Tax-deductible expenses (IP)
  • Private healthcare (LuxMed)
  • Cafeteria & Multisport
  • Additional 4 days of paid leave to support your well-being and family life
  • Increase in annual leave (from 20 to 25 days) for those not yet eligible for the full holiday entitlement
  • Learning opportunities – certified technical training and a learning platform (Udemy)
  • Back-to-school day – 1 day off for parents of primary school children
  • Fertility leave – up to 2 weeks of paid leave for IVF treatment
  • Sports activities with a personal trainer in the office
  • Referral bonus
  • MacBook as your work tool
  • PetHelp – support and care for your pets
If that sounds exciting, then we'd love to hear from you!

Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. As a Disability Confident Employer, we’re committed to providing a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require

Technical Knowledge:
• Strong understanding of API design and best practices (essential) — CDMS is consumed by other teams through its APIs
• Working knowledge of cloud services, Azure preferable
• Understanding of document and content management concepts: metadata models and taxonomy, version control, access control lists, retention and deletion rules, OCR and data extraction (preferable, not essential)
• Prior experience with an enterprise content management platform — OpenText/Documentum, M-Files, Kofax, SharePoint or similar — is an advantage
• Understanding of handling personal data at scale: GDPR, data minimisation, retention, legal hold and auditability
• Understanding of Tesco's technical landscape and API infrastructure, or the ability to learn it quickly

Skills Required:
• Excellent written and verbal communication; proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Aha!
• Advanced stakeholder management across engineering, compliance and operations, senior leadership, and external partners
• Superior prioritisation and time management with a value-based approach
• Methodical, analytical problem-solving from first principles
• Quick domain/product area learning capability — colleague documentation is a detailed, regulated domain
• Strong presentation and persuasion abilities, particularly when saying no to a request that would compromise the platform
• Collaborative team player mentality across a distributed UK and Kraków team
• Ownership, responsiveness, and commitment to assigned work
• Decisive decision-making under competing priorities and trade-offs
• Agile expertise including user stories and acceptance criteria
• Strong interpersonal skills; ability to earn team respect and trust

Experience Needed:
• 5+ years Product Management experience in agile/scrum environments, including ownership of a product or capability end to end
• Experience of a shared platform, internal capability or global component consumed by other product teams — where your users are other teams as well as end users (highly preferred)
• A track record of setting product strategy and then delivering against it, not one or the other
• Experience influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority, and holding a position under pressure
• Domain expertise in relevant functional areas/complex domains; HR/People, compliance, or regulated document handling an advantage
• Technical competence to influence solution context and support engineering estimation
• Understanding of technical debt impact and upgrade value
• Experience working with third-party suppliers against a statement of work
• Experience with OKRs (highly preferred)

title: Youth Advocate (Lena's House) FT M-F Overnight 11pm-7am
description:
Youth Advocate (Lena’s House) FT M-F Overnight 11pm-7am

In-Person Full-Time (40 hours per week) Position in Hayward, CA (Non-Exempt)

Who We Are

Ruby's Place dba Restorative Pathways (RP) is an innovative nonprofit committed to ending domestic violence, human trafficking, and violent crime through hope, advocacy and connection. Our services include emergency shelter, transitional housing, rental subsidies, mental health services, substance recovery, and wrap-around services. All our services are trauma-sensitive and client-centered and are provided at no cost to our clients. All programs are low barrier.

RP is led by survivors with a focus on reflection, innovation, and connection. We believe in fostering relationships, both in our direct service work and throughout our internal work culture. We aim to cultivate a workplace that appreciates and emphasizes the voices of those most impacted by violence. We recognize these voices are vital to interrupting the cycle of violence and transforming lives towards safety, unity, and trust.

Who You Are

You have a strong commitment to preventing interpersonal violence as well as an understanding of, and sensitivity to, serving diverse populations. You have excellent interpersonal skills and strong techniques for relationship building. You believe people should determine their own path towards healing, and have an orientation towards survivor-centered services.

You either have lived or have professional experience with the immigrant, latinx community and are in touch with the challenges that newcomers face when immigrating. You are compassionate, understanding and hold passion to work with this specific community. You are a go-getter who enjoys fast paced environments. You enjoy working both collaboratively and independently. You are adept at time management and highly organized with a proven ability to ensure you can meet deadlines, plan, organize and execute. You are comfortable working as part of a team and are an accountable collaborator. You excel at organizing, prioritizing, and following through on multiple time-sensitive projects. You are flexible, creative, and take initiative in handling emergencies.

What qualifications are required for this position?

You are also:

  • In possession of a high school diploma or equivalent and either
  • Two years of full-time experience, or its equivalent, working with the population to be served or equivalent education or experience as determined by CDSS or
  • Two years’ experience as a member of the social work staff in a group home or short-term residential therapeutic program
  • 21 years of age or older.
  • Someone who exhibits integrity and good moral character to provide appropriate care to UC;
  • Someone with the relevant experience and/or qualifications to work with UC and UC with special needs.
  • Be able to show proof of immunity to vaccine-preventable diseases transmitted by the respiratory route if working directly with UC, including Varicella, TDap or Tdap, Influenza, Fully vaccinated against COVID-19
  • Someone who has not engaged in any form of child abuse or neglect, including domestic violence or has not been convicted of engaging or attempting to engage in sexual abuse facilitated by force or Is undergoing civil or administrative adjudication.
  • In possession of, or will complete after hiring, the State mandated 40-hour Domestic Violence counselor certification.
  • Able to lift 25 lbs.
  • In possession of a valid CA driver's license, proof of insurance, and be approved by Restorative Pathways insurance as a driver in order to drive agency vehicles.
  • Able to complete a background check, fingerprinting (Live Scan), and completion of all Community Care Licensing requirement documents. Able to meet all licensing requirements of Community Care Licensing.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experienced in child welfare and/or case management, crisis intervention, peer counseling.
  • Experienced in working with survivors of human trafficking and domestic violence.
  • Experienced working with the immigrant community.
  • Experienced in working in a residential setting providing direct services to survivors.
  • Understanding of the dynamics of trauma-sensitive care, as well as an understanding of, and sensitivity to, serving diverse populations and languages as it relates to family dynamics and other aspects of cultural practice.

What You Will Do

The function of the Youth Advocate is to provide necessary shift coverage for the overall operation and function of Restorative Pathways shelter for self-identified young women with a reported history of sex/labor trafficking, domestic violence, or who are at risk of such abuse. Additionally, the Youth Advocate will provide support and assistance to Case Management staff.

Responsibilities include

  1. Monitor the facility during the day, evening, and/or overnight shifts.
  2. Provide emotional support to residents.
  3. Practice active listening with residents.
  4. Perform telephone screening for potential clients.
  5. Basic maintenance and cleaning tasks (cleaning, chore supervision, stocking, and general supply inventory).
  6. Assist with data entry, filing and additional clerical duties.
  7. Provide confidential, holistic, client-centered, trauma-informed services.
  8. Orient new residents to the facility.
  9. Provide back-up in-person or phone shift coverage to other Shelter Programs as necessary
  10. Assist with general program operations.
  11. Fill out a functional timesheet by assigned due dates and in compliance with the time allocations.
  12. Actively participate in reflective supervision
  13. Create and maintain documentation of processes and procedures in relation to duties of the job
  14. Other duties as assigned.

Working Conditions

This is a 100% in person role. You are expected to be available on-site at all times during your scheduled shift hours and days, M-F 11pm-7am. You must be able to stand for long periods of time and perform physical activities, including lifting up to 25 pounds. You will be subject to frequent interruptions and must be able to multitask and handle stress.

Local travel in the greater Bay Area may be required.

Applying

The pay scale for the Youth Advocate (Lena’s House) is $29.87 per hour (non-exempt). The benefits that come with working at Restorative Pathways at full-time hours include medical, dental, and vision plans, a life insurance policy, significant vacation, sick time, sabbatical, and immediate vesting in our 403(b) with a generous match. Applicants must be located in the greater Bay Area.

If all this sounds like a good fit for you, please submit your resume and, instead of a traditional cover lever, respond to the following three prompts:

  • Why do you want to work for Restorative Pathways and why are you a good fit for this role? (200 words max)
  • Using the qualifications listed above (under Who You Are section), please list the top 5 qualification(s) that you feel you currently excel in and 2 qualifications you feel you will need to work toward proficiency. Please provide a brief explanation for each (a few sentences).
  • Please describe your professional goals and how you see this position at Restorative Pathways supporting those goals.

At Restorative Pathways, we are committed to workplace diversity and providing equal employment opportunities. Please also note that we are going to be especially excited about candidates who understand the unique nature of a mission-driven organization and have lived experience or direct experience working with survivors of domestic violence, human trafficking, or violent crime.

title: Senior Account Director
description:
About Us
Gravity Global is the world’s most awarded marketing consultancy specialising in brands operating in complex markets. Led by strategy, innovation, technology, data, and creativity, we create brand-and-demand marketing programmes that drive transformational growth for our clients.
With 14 wholly owned offices across the US, Europe and APAC, and our Global Talent Hubs in emerging markets, you can build a truly global career in a rapidly scaling organisation that’s shaping the future of marketing.
We are looking for a commercially minded, strategically strong and highly credible client leader with an eye for creative and strong understanding of digital and performance marketing. You will be an expert relationship builder, confident managing multiple large accounts across time zones, and able to spot opportunities that drive both client success and agency growth.

This is an opportunity to step into a senior role within a busy team, helping to lead a group of skilled Account Handlers both formally and informally. Previous experience working in a fast-paced agency environment is essential.

You will join a globally recognised agency with a strong reputation for delivering high-impact work for ambitious brands in complex sectors. across continents and disciplines and we’re looking for passionate individuals who want to make a difference: for our clients, our teams, and the world around us.
  • Act as the main point of contact between a portfolio of global clients, many of which will be large enterprise organisations, and our internal delivery teams across Strategy, Creative, Performance and Digital Marketing, Go To Market, and Digital Experience.
  • Lead the delivery of best-in-market digital strategies that support client business goals and deliver measurable impact.
  • Provide first-rate support to the Associate Director, Client Services, helping to lead, manage and develop a team of Account Handlers.
  • Drive agency growth across your client portfolio through cross-sell, up-sell and increased investment in core services, underpinned by operational excellence, strategic thinking and opportunity spotting.
  • Independently craft commercially sound digital marketing strategies for some of the agency’s largest and most fast-paced clients.
  • Lead cross-functional delivery teams in executing those strategies, often across different time zones.
  • Pivot and strengthen campaigns based on performance, market conditions and emerging opportunities or challenges.
  • Take financial ownership of the clients you work on, ensuring accounts and projects are commercially healthy and profitable.
  • Exceptional client management skills with a proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Demonstrable experience in a similar role within a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Strong strategic ability, with the confidence to think long term while also managing day-to-day priorities.
  • Proven ability to generate commercial growth, ideally within an agency Account Management function.
  • Confidence in presenting to clients and managing complex or challenging situations.
  • Strong financial acumen and commercial awareness.
  • Excellent line management and people development skills, with the ability to mentor, manage and develop direct reports and junior colleagues.
  • Hands-on experience of digital marketing channels. PPC, Social and Digital PR experience would be particularly valuable.
  • Experience using analytics platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics.
While specific benefits may vary by region due to cultural norms, all team members at Gravity Global can expect a supportive, inclusive, and rewarding environment designed to help you do your best work and grow your career.
Key aspects of being part of the Gravity Global community:
  • 💰 Competitive Reward & Pay – we recognise and value your contribution with fair and competitive rewards aligned to local market practices, designed to celebrate excellence and support long-term success.
  • 🚀 Career Growth & Development – we believe development is ongoing, not annual. Through our Continuous Performance Management (CPM) process, which includes regular feedback and coaching, we help you refine your skills, celebrate your achievements, and plan for future success enabling you to reach your full potential.
  • 🤝 Collaboration – be part of a cross-functional, global team that values sharing insights, ideas, and best practices to drive collective success.
  • 🎓 Professional Development – we invest in you through ongoing training and learning programmes designed to expand your expertise and confidence.
  • 🌴 Work-Life Balance – while we expect dedication to client success, we also value your wellbeing, offering flexible working arrangements and plentiful paid time off.
  • 🎉 Community & Recognition – we celebrate our people through social and team-building events, recognise length of service and life milestones, and appreciate individual contributions through our Gravity Gratitude ‘kudos’ recognition programme.
  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family Support – we understand family matters and our people benefit from family-friendly policies such as parental leave, and access to wellbeing resources to help you balance work and family life.
  • 🌱 Purpose & Belonging – we are committed to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) principles, fostering a workplace where positive impact matters. Our people are encouraged to get involved in employee resource groups that champion wellbeing, sustainability and culture.

Important Disclosure:
At Gravity Global, we believe in recognising every team member’s contribution. Your total rewards package – including salary and benefits – will align with country specific labor laws and our company policies. We’ll walk you through all the details during the offer stage.

Gravity Global is an equal opportunities employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion, age, sexuality, disability and other protected status as required by applicable law.

If your experience doesn't align perfectly with the job criteria, but you meet some of the criteria and are excited about the role and Gravity, please don't be put off applying! We would encourage you to apply for the role as you may be just the right person for this role or other roles.

title: X Ray Technologist $3000 sign on bonus
description:
Overview

Are you ready to take your career to new heights? At Concentra, you will be a vital member of our patient care team and play a crucial role in providing exceptional care to our patients. Our mission is to improve the health of America's workforce, one patient at a time. Join us at Concentra and see how your clinical competency and compassion can make a meaningful difference in the lives of the patients you serve.

The Radiologic Technologist & Medical Support Specialist performs routine will perform routine x-ray examinations in accordance with Concentra policies, practices, and procedures and applicable regulations under direct supervision of the treating clinician, as well as supports in other needed areas of the facility. This role requires efficient and accurate delivery of one-on-one patient care while thriving in a fast-paced environment. The RT MSS ensures that every patient is treated with quality clinical care and receives an excellent patient experience from welcoming, respectful, and skillful colleagues.

Responsibilities

Radiologic Technologist Duties

  • Prepare patients for radiologic procedures. Escort patients to dressing and x-ray rooms, provide verbal and/or written instructions and assist patients in positioning body parts to be radiographed. Explain procedures and observe patients to ensure patient care, safety and comfort during the x-ray exam.
  • Operate radiologic equipment to produce images of the body for diagnostic purposes. Position radiologic equipment and adjust controls to set exposure time and distance according to specification of examination. Take x-rays following established radiologic requirements and regulations to ensure patient care and safety.
  • Use radiation safety measures and protection devices to ensure safety of patients and team members
  • Ensure radiologic equipment remains in working order. Report equipment malfunctions to Center Operations Director
  • Ensure all Radiology workflows are followed and all Radiology reports cross correctly to EMR
  • Follows documentation procedures and completes required documentation related to patient x-ray visit.
  • Maintain all x-ray equipment, including calibration, QA/QC procedures, and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures

Medical Assistant Duties

  • Perform Department of Transportation (DOT) and Non-DOT drug and alcohol testing
  • Prepare patients for physical examinations, including taking vital signs and any required or requested ancillary testing including but not limited to vaccines and injections, phlebotomy, PFTs, audiogram testing and respirator fit testing (in accordance with state regulations)
  • Perform rapid screening tests (influenza, strep, mono, glucose, etc.)
  • Assist providers during examination and treatment
  • Responsible for performing routine medical procedures as ordered by treating clinician as well as triaging emergent patients as needed
  • Prepare and assist clinician with procedure set up and injury care
  • Apply bandages, dressings and splints as ordered by the treating clinician
  • Dispense medications and DME as ordered by the treating clinician in accordance with state regulations
  • Complete quality assurance activities on equipment and medical devices as well as testing processes used in the center
  • Maintain supplies, clean rooms and equipment, and stock exam rooms
  • Maintain and operate all medical devices and equipment, including calibration and record keeping in accordance with current policy and procedures
  • Notify supervisor immediately if equipment is not functioning properly, supplies are needed, or facility is not operating as expected
  • In partnership with center leadership, assist with patient flow and volume
  • Keep patients informed of expected wait times during all aspects of the center visit
  • Responsible for clerical tasks in both the front and back office associated with patient care and proper record keeping
  • Ensure accuracy in documentation
  • Perform front office duties: greet patients, obtain authorization, check in/out, communicate wait times, answer multi-line telephone system, and distribute employer results/paperwork as needed
  • Follow HIPAA guidelines and safety rules
  • Attend center staff meetings or huddles as required
  • Assist in maintaining a neat, clean, and orderly appearance throughout the facility
  • Complete any applicable training including but not limited to clinical competency training that occurs monthly.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

  • Education Level: High School Diploma or GED
  • Graduate of an accredited school of radiologic technology and applicable certification by the state in which employed.
  • Registered with The American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) and has active and valid certification.
  • CPR/First Aid Certification

Job-Related Experience

  • Customarily has at least six months or more of medical assistant experience with knowledge of medical procedures and medical terminology
  • Working knowledge of occupational medicine requirements (state specific) is preferred with prior medical office, healthcare and/or customer service-related experience.

Job-Related Skills/Competencies

  • Concentra Core Competencies of Service Mentality, Attention to Detail, Sense of Urgency, Initiative and Flexibility
  • Ability to make decisions or solve problems by using logic to identify key facts, explore alternatives, and propose quality solutions
  • Outstanding customer service skills as well as the ability to deal with people in a manner which shows tact and professionalism
  • The ability to properly handle sensitive and confidential information (including HIPAA and PHI) in accordance with federal and state laws and company policies
  • Able to communicate both verbally and in writing in a clear, and professional manner
  • Teamwork focus with peers and center leadership team; ability to maintain working relationship with all levels of colleagues
  • Must participate in initial and ongoing training as required
  • Obtain all certifications required of Medical Support Specialists including but not limited to Drug Screen Collection, Breath Alcohol Certification, Hair and Oral Fluids Collection
  • Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office such as Word, Excel, Outlook and entry of data into various systems/applications

Additional Data

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Employer Match

title: Youth Advocate (PRYH) PT Sat & Sun 3-11pm
description:
Youth Advocate (PRYH) PT Sat & Sun 3-11pm

In-Person Part-Time (16 hours per week) Position in Oakland, CA (Non-Exempt)

Who We Are

Ruby's Place dba Restorative Pathways (RP) is an innovative nonprofit committed to ending domestic violence, human trafficking, and violent crime through hope, advocacy and connection. Our services include emergency shelter, transitional housing, rental subsidies, mental health services, substance recovery, and wrap-around services. All our services are trauma-sensitive and client-centered and are provided at no cost to our clients. All programs are low barrier.

RP is led by survivors with a focus on reflection, innovation, and connection. We believe in fostering relationships, both in our direct service work and throughout our internal work culture. We aim to cultivate a workplace that appreciates and emphasizes the voices of those most impacted by violence. We recognize these voices are vital to interrupting the cycle of violence and transforming lives towards safety, unity, and trust.

Who You Are

You have a strong commitment to preventing interpersonal violence as well as an understanding of, and sensitivity to, serving diverse populations. You have excellent interpersonal skills and strong techniques for relationship building. You believe people should determine their own path towards healing, and have an orientation towards survivor-centered services.

You either have lived or have professional experience with the immigrant, latinx community and are in touch with the challenges that newcomers face when immigrating. You are compassionate, understanding and hold passion to work with this specific community. You are a go-getter who enjoys fast paced environments. You enjoy working both collaboratively and independently. You are adept at time management and highly organized with a proven ability to ensure you can meet deadlines, plan, organize and execute. You are comfortable working as part of a team and are an accountable collaborator. You excel at organizing, prioritizing, and following through on multiple time-sensitive projects. You are flexible, creative, and take initiative in handling emergencies.

What qualifications are required for this position?

You are also:

  • In possession of a high school diploma or equivalent and either
  • Two years of full-time experience, or its equivalent, working with the population to be served or equivalent education or experience as determined by CDSS or
  • Two years’ experience as a member of the social work staff in a group home or short-term residential therapeutic program
  • 21 years of age or older.
  • Someone who exhibits integrity and good moral character to provide appropriate care to UC;
  • Someone with the relevant experience and/or qualifications to work with UC and UC with special needs.
  • Be able to show proof of immunity to vaccine-preventable diseases transmitted by the respiratory route if working directly with UC, including Varicella, TDap or Tdap, Influenza, Fully vaccinated against COVID-19
  • Someone who has not engaged in any form of child abuse or neglect, including domestic violence or has not been convicted of engaging or attempting to engage in sexual abuse facilitated by force or Is undergoing civil or administrative adjudication.
  • In possession of, or will complete after hiring, the State mandated 40-hour Domestic Violence counselor certification.
  • Able to lift 25 lbs.
  • In possession of a valid CA driver's license, proof of insurance, and be approved by Restorative Pathways insurance as a driver in order to drive agency vehicles.
  • Able to complete a background check, fingerprinting (Live Scan), and completion of all Community Care Licensing requirement documents. Able to meet all licensing requirements of Community Care Licensing.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experienced in child welfare and/or case management, crisis intervention, peer counseling.
  • Experienced in working with survivors of human trafficking and domestic violence.
  • Experienced working with the immigrant community.
  • Experienced in working in a residential setting providing direct services to survivors.
  • Understanding of the dynamics of trauma-sensitive care, as well as an understanding of, and sensitivity to, serving diverse populations and languages as it relates to family dynamics and other aspects of cultural practice.

What You Will Do

The function of the Youth Advocate is to provide necessary shift coverage for the overall operation and function of Restorative Pathways shelter for self-identified young women with a reported history of sex/labor trafficking, domestic violence, or who are at risk of such abuse. Additionally, the Youth Advocate will provide support and assistance to Case Management staff.

Responsibilities include

  1. Monitor the facility during the day, evening, and/or overnight shifts.
  2. Provide emotional support to residents.
  3. Practice active listening with residents.
  4. Perform telephone screening for potential clients.
  5. Basic maintenance and cleaning tasks (cleaning, chore supervision, stocking, and general supply inventory).
  6. Assist with data entry, filing and additional clerical duties.
  7. Provide confidential, holistic, client-centered, trauma-informed services.
  8. Orient new residents to the facility.
  9. Provide back-up in-person or phone shift coverage to other Shelter Programs as necessary
  10. Assist with general program operations.
  11. Fill out a functional timesheet by assigned due dates and in compliance with the time allocations.
  12. Actively participate in reflective supervision
  13. Create and maintain documentation of processes and procedures in relation to duties of the job
  14. Other duties as assigned.

Working Conditions

You are expected to be available on-site at all times during your scheduled shift hours and days, Sat-Sun 3-11pm. You must be able to stand for long periods of time and perform physical activities, including lifting up to 25 pounds. You will be subject to frequent interruptions and must be able to multitask and handle stress.

Local travel in the greater Bay Area may be required.

Applying

The pay scale for the Youth Advocate (PRYH) is $29.87 per hour (non-exempt) with benefits that come with working at Restorative Pathways at part-time hours include immediate vesting in our 403(b) with a generous match. This is a part-time, 16 hours per week, hourly position. This is an in-person position. Applicants must be located in the greater Bay Area.

If all this sounds like a good fit for you, please submit your resume and, instead of a traditional cover lever, respond to the following three prompts:

  • Why do you want to work for Restorative Pathways and why are you a good fit for this role? (200 words max)
  • Using the qualifications listed above (under Who You Are section), please list the top 5 qualification(s) that you feel you currently excel in and 2 qualifications you feel you will need to work toward proficiency. Please provide a brief explanation for each (a few sentences).
  • Please describe your professional goals and how you see this position at Restorative Pathways supporting those goals.

At Restorative Pathways, we are committed to workplace diversity and providing equal employment opportunities. Please also note that we are going to be especially excited about candidates who understand the unique nature of a mission-driven organization and have lived experience or direct experience working with survivors of domestic violence, human trafficking, or violent crime.

title: Assistant Property Manager
description:
Assistant Property Manager

Doral Club Apartments | San Antonio, TX | Market-Rate Apartment Community

Schedule: Full-Time | 40 Hours per Week

Compensation: $21.00–$23.00 per hour

Benefits: Eligible Shelter associates enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; HSA with employer contribution; FSA/DCA options; 401(k) with company match; paid time off and company-paid holidays; employer-paid life insurance; short- and long-term disability coverage; Employee Assistance Program (EAP); and professional development and growth opportunities.

Grow Your Property Management Career and Help Our Communities Thrive!

Shelter Corporation is seeking a dependable, organized, and resident-focused Assistant Property Manager to join our team at Doral Club Apartments in San Antonio, Texas.

As part of Team Shelter, you'll serve as a key operational partner to the Property Manager, supporting leasing, resident relations, rent collections, financial administration, and the overall success of our community.

From assisting residents and managing important financial and administrative processes to coordinating with the maintenance team and supporting occupancy goals, you'll help ensure our community operates efficiently while providing a positive resident experience.

If you're detail-oriented, service-focused, and enjoy balancing administrative responsibilities with meaningful resident interactions, we'd love to hear from you!

What You'll Do

As an Assistant Property Manager, you'll...

  • Support the Property Manager with daily community operations, administrative workflows, and office coverage as needed.

  • Assist with leasing activities, including prospect follow-up, rental applications, lease preparation, renewals, move-ins, and move-outs.

  • Support occupancy and leasing goals through responsive service, timely application processing, and coordination of apartment availability.

  • Work with the Property Manager and resident accountant to maintain accurate resident ledgers, process rent payments, and assist residents with payment portal setup.

  • Assist with delinquency management, resident notices, approved payment arrangements, collections, and related follow-up.

  • Support eviction processes in accordance with company procedures and applicable legal requirements.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to resident questions and concerns, assisting with conflict resolution and maintaining positive resident relationships.

  • Prepare and deliver resident notices, lease communications, and other required documentation.

  • Partner with the Property Manager and maintenance team to coordinate and track work orders, apartment turns, move-in readiness, vendor services, and timely resolution of resident service needs.

  • Maintain accurate resident, leasing, and property records within Yardi and other applicable property management systems.

  • Assist with occupancy, delinquency, leasing activity, monthly financial reporting, and other property performance measures.

  • Follow applicable Fair Housing requirements, landlord-tenant laws, company policies, and established property management procedures.

  • Reinforce operational expectations, support team collaboration, and assume additional Property Manager responsibilities as needed.

  • Support special projects and other responsibilities that contribute to the success of our communities and Shelter.

What We're Looking For

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in multifamily property management, leasing, resident relations, collections, or a related field required.

  • Experience in market-rate multifamily housing preferred.

  • Experience with leasing, rent collections, resident relations, and general property operations preferred.

  • Knowledge of Fair Housing regulations and applicable landlord-tenant laws preferred.

  • Experience with Yardi or a similar property management system preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to effectively manage competing priorities.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with resident files, financial information, and administrative documentation.

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and customer service skills.

  • Ability to communicate professionally and respectfully with residents, applicants, team members, vendors, guests, and community partners.

  • Ability to navigate resident concerns, delinquency discussions, and challenging conversations with professionalism and sound judgment.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with the Property Manager, maintenance team, and other Shelter departments.

  • Ability to accurately maintain records, process transactions, and complete administrative responsibilities using property management systems.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn property management, compliance, and other technology systems.

  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, to perform essential job responsibilities.

  • Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills preferred.

Physical & Additional Requirements

  • Ability to regularly move throughout the assigned community, including residential buildings, common areas, offices, and outdoor areas.

  • Ability to navigate stairs and conduct property and unit inspections as needed.

  • Ability to perform work in both indoor and outdoor environments as responsibilities require.

  • Ability to use standard office equipment and property management technology.

  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

Why Join Shelter?

Since 1993, Shelter Corporation has been creating value for residents and property owners through thoughtful, comprehensive property management. Today, we manage multifamily communities across Minnesota, Florida, and Texas, with experience spanning affordable, market-rate, active adult, and other multifamily housing.

At Shelter, we believe successful property management starts with strong communities, engaged associates, and a commitment to doing the right thing. Our values - Integrity, Competence, Fun, Accountability, Dedication, and Innovation - guide how we serve our residents, support one another, and care for the communities entrusted to us.

Beyond competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, Shelter is committed to creating a supportive workplace where associates can grow professionally, contribute meaningfully, and take pride in the communities they serve.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Shelter Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Ready to grow your property management career and help us open doors? We invite you to apply and become part of Team Shelter.

title: Områdeschef till Transtema - Norrköping/Linköping
description:
Nu söker vi en områdeschef som vill vara med och se till att nätet fungerar. På Transtema får du möjligheten att arbeta i ett nytänkande och växande bolag med stora möjligheter till utveckling!


Om tjänsten
Områdeschefens huvudsakliga uppdrag är att regelbundet följa upp sitt områdes verksamhet och ekonomi då du har verksamhet-, kvalitets- och budgetansvar. I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår också att utveckla arbetsmetoder för att säkerställa att verksamheten drivs på ett optimalt sätt.

Områdeschefen har även ansvar att implementera nya, samt vårda och utveckla befintliga avtal.

Genom ett modernt och naturligt ledarskap stödjer, coachar och engagerar du din grupp för att skapa en god trivsel och en sund och produktiv arbetsmiljö. Du arbetar kontinuerligt på både team- och individnivå med kompetensutveckling och resultatuppföljning.

I rollen som Områdeschef ingår även att ha ett siteansvar, vilket innebär arbetsmiljöansvaret för enheten och området. Ansvaret omfattar såväl att skapa en säker och produktiv arbetsmiljö för områdets medarbetare, som ansvar för lokaler och lagerutrymmen.

Några av dina främsta arbetsuppgifter kommer vara att

  • Ansvar för samtliga avtal inom sitt område, marginalansvar och kvalitetsuppfyllnad.

  • Påverka marginaler, övervaka KPI: er och optimera beläggningen

  • Personal och arbetsmiljöansvar för samtliga medarbetare (främst tekniker och projektörer).

  • Prestationsuppföljning på team och individnivå.

  • Aktivt arbeta med lokal försäljning tillsammans med säljavdelning.

  • Ta ansvar för kompetensförsörjning och utveckling av sina medarbetare.

  • Hantera resursfördelning.

I tjänsten ingår en del resor vilket främst innebär längre dagsturer och någon övernattning i månaden. Ca var 15:e vecka är du även nationell servicechef vilket innebär att du har det övergripande ansvaret för flera regioner och ska finnas tillgänglig dygnet runt.

Vi söker dig som
Har en gedigen erfarenhet inom personalansvar och ledarskap samt framgångsrikt har arbetat med team och projekt med ansvar för budget och lokala affärer. Din förmåga att effektivt planera och strukturera komplexa arbetsuppgifter samt att prioritera är av yttersta vikt.

För att lyckas i rollen som områdeschef krävs:

  • Erfarenhet av personal- och arbetsmiljöansvar

  • Teknisk kompetens

  • Starka språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

  • Goda kunskaper i Officepaketet såsom Excel, PowerPoint mm

  • Ett giltigt B-körkort för resor i tjänsten.

Meriterande är om du innehar en relevant akademisk utbildning samt/eller har erfarenhet inom telekom eller närliggande branscher.

Vem är du?
Du är en skicklig kommunikatör som effektivt såväl delar som tar in information både internt och externt. Ditt engagemang för andras framgångar, kombinerat med äkta intresse för både människor och affärer är tydligt. Proaktivitet och initiativtagande präglar ditt arbete, där ansvarstagande och pålitlighet är självklara inslag. Du trivs med självständigt arbete och kan prioritera även i stressiga situationer. Som tydlig ledare motiverar och coachar du ditt team i rätt riktning, och tar ägandeskap för de uppgifter och projekt du åtar dig.

Om oss
Du kommer vara anställd på Transtema Network Services AB, som är ett helägt dotterbolag inom Transtemakoncernen. Transtema Network Services är en marknadsledande leverantör av fälttjänster inom kommunikationsinfrastruktur i Sverige och ansvarar för installation, underhåll samt drift över hela landet.

Vi arbetar aktivt med hållbarhet utifrån fyra aspekter - våra medarbetare, vår affär, vår miljö och vårt engagemang.

Våra medarbetare är vår största tillgång och vår ambition är att vara branschens mest attraktiva arbetsgivare. Vi har en värderingsstyrd företagskultur och arbetar aktivt med kompetensutveckling, inkludering och att erbjuda en trygg arbetsplats för alla. Vi erbjuder en utvecklande miljö, ett omväxlande arbete och möjlighet till kompetensutveckling. Vår kultur genomsyras av våra värdeord - att tänka nytt, visa respekt och ta ansvar.

Vi på Transtema tror att mångfald bidrar till en mer dynamisk och kreativ arbetsmiljö som gör att fler trivs på jobbet. Vi hoppas därför att du som söker, med din bakgrund och kompetens, kan bidra till att öka vår mångfald.

Övrig information
Transtema som företag arbetar och levererar tjänster till samhällsviktiga aktörer och verksamheter. Mot bakgrund av detta kommer vi att genomföra en bakgrundskontroll av alla som avses anställas. För vissa roller och uppdrag som så kräver kommer även säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt kraven ur säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585) förekomma.
Slumpmässiga drog- och alkoholtester genomförs på våra arbetsplatser.

Urval sker löpande, vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Vid frågor om tjänsten, kontakta rekryterande chef Mikael Lindström, mikael.lindstrom@transtema.com

Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet, men vi tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.

title: Associate Quality Auditor
description:
About the job

Actylis is a global solutions provider with over 75 years of experience, specializing in streamlining the management of critical ingredients and raw materials for our business partners.

We offer both sourcing and manufacturing solutions tailored to meet diverse and evolving needs, ensuring a reliable, agile, and secure supply network. Our commitment to customization allows us to create flexible solutions, whether it’s a unique specification, custom packaging, or tailored logistics strategies.

With deep expertise in quality and regulatory compliance, sourcing and logistics management, analytical services, and R&D support, we reduce complexities and mitigate risks, empowering our partners to focus on growing their business.

In furtherance of that goal, Actylis is seeking new members of the team. This expansion, coupled with a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for challenge and growth, make Actylis the ideal place to work and thrive. We hope you’ll consider joining us!

Position Summary

The Associate Quality Auditor is responsible for supporting Actylis’ supplier oversight program in India by conducting onsite audits of approved and prospective suppliers, toll manufacturers, contract manufacturers, warehouses, repackers, and contract testing laboratories.

The role evaluates whether external partners are operating in accordance with applicable Actylis quality requirements, customer expectations, and relevant quality system standards, including GMP, GDP, ISO 9001, ISO 22000/FSSC 22000, HACCP, and ISO 17025, as applicable to the supplier type and product category.

This position is intended for an early-career auditor with 2–3 years of practical auditing experience. The Associate Quality Auditor will execute structured audits, collect objective evidence, write clear audit observations, and support timely CAPA follow-up under the guidance of Supplier Quality and Global Quality leadership.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

Supplier Audits and Qualification

  • Conduct onsite audits of India-based suppliers, toll manufacturers, contract manufacturers, repackers, warehouses, and testing laboratories in accordance with the approved audit schedule and Actylis supplier qualification procedures.
  • Assess supplier quality systems, manufacturing controls, laboratory practices, documentation, traceability, data integrity, change control, deviation management, CAPA, complaint handling, training, and batch or testing record controls.
  • Support risk-based supplier qualification, requalification, and ongoing supplier monitoring by providing audit outcomes, objective evidence, and follow-up status to Supplier Quality and Global Quality teams.

Global Internal Audit Program Support

  • Support the Global Internal Audit program by assisting with audit preparation, checklist development, document review, audit execution, and follow-up activities across Actylis sites, as assigned.
  • Participate in internal audits under the direction of the Lead Auditor or Global Quality leadership, helping assess compliance with Actylis procedures, GMP, GDP, ISO standards, and applicable quality system requirements.
  • Support tracking of internal audit observations, CAPA commitments, due dates, and closure evidence to help ensure timely completion and readiness for customer, certification, or regulatory inspections.

Compliance Oversight

  • Assess supplier compliance with applicable quality and regulatory expectations, including GMP, GDP, ISO 9001, ISO 22000/FSSC 22000, HACCP, and ISO 17025, based on the nature of the supplier and the products or services provided to Actylis.
  • Identify and document potential quality and compliance risks, including deficiencies related to documentation practices, data integrity, traceability, cross-contamination controls, laboratory controls, supplier quality systems, and CAPA effectiveness.
  • Escalate significant audit findings, repeat observations, overdue CAPAs, or supplier compliance concerns through the appropriate Actylis quality governance channels.

Audit Reporting and CAPA Follow-up

  • Prepare accurate, objective, and timely audit reports that clearly summarize the audit scope, objective evidence reviewed, observations identified, and overall supplier compliance risk.
  • Review supplier responses to audit observations and assess whether proposed corrective and preventive actions are appropriate, timely, and aligned with the identified root cause and compliance risk.
  • Track open audit findings, CAPA commitments, and due dates to support timely follow-up and closure.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Procurement, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Control, site Quality teams, and business stakeholders to communicate audit outcomes and support supplier oversight decisions.
  • Represent Actylis professionally during supplier interactions by applying an objective, respectful, and evidence-based audit approach.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of supplier audit tools, checklists, templates, risk assessment practices, and audit tracking processes.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Food Science, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline.

Experience

  • Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience conducting or supporting supplier audits, internal audits, laboratory audits, GMP audits, food safety audits, or quality system assessments.
  • Practical working knowledge of quality system requirements applicable to suppliers, toll manufacturers, contract manufacturers, warehouses, repackers, and testing laboratories.
  • Formal audit training or certification, such as Internal Auditor, ISO 9001 Auditor, ISO 22000/FSSC 22000 Auditor, ISO 17025 Auditor, Certified Quality Auditor, or equivalent preferred.
  • Experience supporting supplier qualification, vendor management, external manufacturing oversight, toll manufacturing oversight, or third-party laboratory oversight preferred.

Functional/Technical Competencies & Skillsets

  • Working knowledge of GMP, GDP, ISO 9001, ISO 22000/FSSC 22000, HACCP, ISO 17025, supplier qualification, audit lifecycle management, and CAPA principles.
  • Ability to review procedures, specifications, certificates of analysis, batch records, analytical records, validation documentation, quality agreements, and supplier responses to audit observations.
  • Strong understanding of audit principles, objective evidence collection, observation classification, documentation practices, data integrity, traceability, and basic risk assessment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare factual, concise, and well-structured audit reports.
  • Professional, objective, and collaborative approach when interacting with external suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • High level of integrity, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining Actylis quality and compliance standards.

Supervisory Responsibilities: None

Travel Requirements: Regular travel across India is required to conduct onsite audits of suppliers, toll manufacturers, contract manufacturers, warehouses, repackers, and contract testing laboratories. Travel frequency will be driven by the approved supplier audit schedule and business priorities.

Actylis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Actylis US does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Automotive Field Technician
description:
Automotive Field Technician

(m/f)

About Stratio

Stratio keeps public transport running. We monitor fleet health in real time and tell the world's largest operators exactly what's going to fail before it does.

We're a small, technical team of about 50 people, growing our Service organization to keep pace with new installations and client rollouts across Europe.


The role

You'll be responsible for the field work behind the installation, uninstallation, and reinstallation of the Stratio Databox, our in-vehicle data collection unit, following our defined technical processes.

In this role, you'll work directly on client vehicles, at client sites, representing Stratio professionally and making sure every installation meets our technical and quality standards.


What your weeks look like

Installation & field work

You perform field work to install, uninstall, and reinstall the Stratio Databox and connected hardware, following our internal procedures.

Remote support & troubleshooting

You provide field or remote support to diagnose and fix issues affecting the Stratio Hardware Solution, reporting problems together with the proposed solution.

Customer & partner training

You train customers and partners on working with Stratio Hardware solutions, representing Stratio professionally during every visit.

Documentation

You create installation manuals and harnesses according to internal procedures.

Reporting

You report on work progress to your supervisor and project lead.


What we're looking for

Must have:

  • Technical degree or professional experience in the electrical or mechanical field

  • Driver's license (category B)

  • Full availability and flexibility to travel abroad (expect an average of 2 weeks per month traveling)

  • Availability to work weekends/night hours

  • Great level of autonomy and ability to work under pressure

  • Independent user of English

Strong plus:

  • Knowledge working with diagnostic equipment

  • Understanding of in-vehicle communication networks

  • Understanding of OBD, UDS, FMS, ISO 15765, J1939, J1708, KWP2000, or other protocols used in vehicle networks

  • Previous experience in automotive/electrical maintenance

  • Knowledge of other languages (Spanish, French, etc.)


What this is not

This is not a desk job or a remote-first delivery role.

You'll spend a significant part of your time traveling and working directly on vehicles at client sites, often on tight timelines and changing conditions.


Why this is interesting

You'd be the hands making Stratio's technology work in the real world, installing the hardware that keeps some of the world's largest fleets running.

You'd have the autonomy to represent Stratio directly in front of customers, and travel across different countries as you do it.


What we offer

  • All supplementary work and night shifts are paid accordingly;

  • Food Allowance of 10.20€ per working day;

  • All work-related travel is arranged and fully covered by the company. You will also receive a daily allowance for each day spent away from home;

  • Health Insurance to you and your children;

  • Flexible Working Hours;

  • 22 vacation days, plus up to 3 extra time off days according to your tenure;

  • Quarterly Events to discuss Strategy;

  • Autonomy and Ownership Culture;

  • Continuous feedback culture;

  • Innovation Mindset;

  • Career Acceleration.


Location

Coimbra, with full availability and flexibility to travel abroad.


What you can expect from the recruitment

  • Screening call with HR

  • 1st Interview with Hiring Manager (1h) – Onsite with HR and Field Services Coordinator. We want to get to know you better and navigate through your experience, skills and motivation.

  • 2nd Interview with Head of Professional Services (1h) - Cultural fit interview. Maybe be onsite or remote.

  • Live exercise (1h) – Onsite with the Team. We will simulate an installation to assess your readiness for the role and also for you to test if you’d enjoy it.

  • Hiring Proposal

References may be required at any stage of the recruitment process.

AI & Transparency

We use AI-supported tools to help our team through the hiring process, here's how:

  • AI-assisted CV review: summarizes and suggests points for the hiring team to consider and help the team review applications faster; it does not make or influence hiring decisions.

  • Profile anonymization: your name, gender, and other personal identifiers are hidden during early screening to avoid bias.

  • Interview transcription: interviews may be recorded and transcribed to help our team focus on the conversation, with your consent.

Every decision about your application is made by a person from the hiring team. These tools assist our hiring team, they don't replace them.



About Stratio

Stratio is the World’s Leading Real-time Predictive Fleet Maintenance Platform. The company's proprietary technology combines large-scale processing with the latest machine learning techniques to prevent hundreds of thousands of breakdowns from happening every day, thus saving millions of people from the hassle of public transportation delays, postponed deliveries, or late arrival of essential goods.

Stratio’s platform enables zero downtime for 5 of the 10 largest transportation companies in the world and, in 2021, raised an investment of $12 million to boost leadership in predictive fleet maintenance. Fleet operators in Europe, North America, Asia-pacific, and Latin America trust Stratio’s technology to fully leverage the data under the hood to safeguard operations, and keep customers happy. Stratio’s technology has enabled transportation for 1.3 billion people so far.

We want inspiring individuals in our teams, where age, race, gender, sexual orientation, politics and religion do not matter, and seek to create a tolerant and open space for everyone. We strive to provide an inclusive and trustworthy environment.

You can find our Culture Manifesto and more team information here.

Take the road with us!

title: Doradca/-czyni sprzedaży 20h
description:
Jako Doradca/-czyni sprzedaży będziesz osobą, która tworzy pierwsze wrażenie i buduje atmosferę w sklepie, witając naszych klientów i uosabiając filozofię naszej marki. Twoim zadaniem będzie zapewnienie wyjątkowej obsługi na każdym etapie wizyty w sklepie: od rozpoczęcia rozmowy, przez pomoc w przymierzalni, aż po obsługę przy kasie – odegrasz kluczową rolę w tworzeniu wyjątkowych doświadczeń zakupowych. Twoje obowiązki będą obejmować również obsługę dostaw, uzupełnianie brakujących elementów kolekcji i ekspozycję najnowszych produktów na sali sprzedaży.

Będziesz odpowiedzialny/-a za tworzenie atmosfery, w której klienci czują się swobodnie i zainspirowani. Dzięki Twojemu entuzjazmowi i autentycznemu podejściu pomożesz im znaleźć to, czego szukają – a czasem nawet coś, o czym jeszcze nie wiedzieli, że pokochają. Wspólnie z zespołem zadbasz o to, by każda wizyta była wyjątkowym doświadczeniem.

Preferowane, ale nieobowiązkowe:

Oferujemy atrakcyjne benefity i możliwości rozwoju. Jako członek/-kini zespołu otrzymasz 25% rabatu pracowniczego na wszystkie marki Grupy H&M – zarówno w sklepach, jak i online. INKLUZYWNOŚĆ I RÓŻNORODNOŚĆ
