title: Staff Engineer, Software Distribution onPrem
description:
About Qevlar AI

Qevlar is a B2B SaaS scale-up on a mission to boost the productivity of cybersecurity teams with Artificial Intelligence. We build an AI platform that transitions Security Operations Centers from reactive to proactive units through autonomous security alert investigations.

In just three years, we have:

  • Raised a total of $44m in series-A & seed rounds from EQT Ventures, Forgepoint Capital and Partech

  • Deployed our solution with major Enterprises such as Sodexo and GlobalConnect, and leading MSSPs like Orange Cyberdefense

  • Expanded to the US market with a growing North American presence

  • Ended 2025 with a strong multi-million dollar ARR and ambitious goals for 2026

We are launching Qevlar on-premise for customers who cannot let their security data leave their perimeter. Your job is to turn a signed bundle into a running production platform inside their datacentre, and to make each deployment faster than the last.

On these accounts the critical path is rarely the software. It is the security review board, the firewall change request, the PKI team, the change advisory board. Someone has to own that path, with enough technical credibility to be taken seriously by the customer's infrastructure architects: this is your role.

What You Will do

  • Decide what we do not port. Your first deliverable is the on-prem reference architecture and the explicit list of dependencies, services and features that will not cross the boundary. You will hold that line against the rest of engineering, with our backing.

  • Ship the bundle. A Helm chart and an air-gapped tarball that install on vanilla Kubernetes and on OpenShift, with no internet access, in under four hours — by someone who has never seen our code and has only your documentation.

  • Replace the cloud underneath us. Self-hosted Postgres, S3-compatible object storage, secret management, identity federation — behind abstractions clean enough that we never fork the product or let on-prem drift away from SaaS.

  • Package and size the inference layer. Our platform runs agentic investigations, which means sustained LLM throughput. You own the serving stack in the bundle, the VRAM and concurrency sizing matrix customers use to provision their own GPUs, and the distribution and rollback of model weights across an air gap.

  • Build the test harness that makes releases boring. Ephemeral customer-shaped environments, install and upgrade smoke tests across Kubernetes distributions, identity providers and network modes — until validating a release candidate takes a day, not a week.

  • Ship clean. Signed images, SBOMs, minimal base images, no critical or high CVEs at release. Our buyers are security teams; they will scan everything we hand them on day one.

  • Impose the upgrade contract on the whole org. Tested N-3 upgrade paths, backward-compatible migrations, no feature merged without a feature flag, a health check and a support-bundle contribution. Customers will jump from a year-old release straight to the latest, and it has to work.

  • Keep it boringly simple. A product that ships self-hosted cannot grow a new managed dependency every quarter. You get explicit veto power, and you will need it.

Who you are

You have:

  • Shipped software that someone else installs. This is what we screen hardest on. Operating your own cluster is a genuinely different discipline from handing an artifact to a stranger who runs it on infrastructure you will never see.

  • Deep Helm expertise — subcharts, conditional templating, values design — plus OCI registries and real exposure to Kubernetes beyond a single distribution: OpenShift and its SCCs, vanilla, RKE2, k0s, whatever you had to survive.

  • Worked in air-gapped or heavily restricted environments: image mirroring, offline bundles, egress proxies, custom CA bundles, no external DNS.

  • Replaced managed cloud services with self-hosted equivalents — Postgres operators such as CloudNativePG, MinIO or another S3-compatible store, Vault or External Secrets — and lived with the operational consequences.

  • Practical software supply chain security: image signing with cosign or equivalent, SBOM generation, distroless or minimal base images, CVE triage.

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code and CI (Terraform, Ansible, pipeline matrices). Here the test harness is the product.

  • Hands-on experience serving models on GPU — vLLM, NVIDIA NIM or TensorRT-LLM — including VRAM and concurrency sizing and the NVIDIA GPU Operator / Container Toolkit.

  • Strong Go and/or Python. You will change application code, not only YAML.

  • The judgement and the appetite to say no. Staff here means architectural authority and the willingness to use it.

  • Fluent in French and English.

Why join us

  • Work on meaningful problems with real-world impact in cybersecurity

  • A high-impact role in a small, international, fast-moving team where your contributions directly shape the company and its success

  • Shape the future of a product already making noise in AI + security circles

  • A company culture that values autonomy and creativity

  • Opportunity for equity and early ownership

  • We’re flexible on location - you can either work from home or join your colleagues in our beautiful office in Paris’ 9th arrondissement.

If you’re excited about helping security teams adopt cutting-edge AI, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s build the future of cybersecurity together!

Hiring process

  1. Intro Call

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Technical interview

  4. References and Offer

title: IT Support Engineer - Modern Workplace
description:
TGR Haas F1 Team has been a stalwart of the FIA Formula 1 World Championship over the past decade. With more than 200 grand prix starts to our name, we pride ourselves on being an ambitious challenger within Formula 1 - and we want you to be part of that journey.

The first American Formula 1 team to compete in the sport since 1986, TGR Haas F1 Team made an immediate impression with a memorable points-scoring debut at the 2016 Australian Grand Prix. Ten years later, the team is still building momentum, guided by clear objectives and technical partnerships, and fresh from securing its second biggest points haul in a Formula 1 season.

We’re a racing team – not a corporate machine. We have three HQs – Kannapolis in the US, Banbury in the UK and Maranello in Italy – each powered by passionate, loyal and hardworking team ambassadors. At TGR Haas F1 Team, you’ll gain exposure to many areas of the business, enjoy wider visibility, and clearly see your contributions.

Yes, you’ll learn from us, but we expect to learn from you too!

General Summary:

This role reports to the IT Service Delivery Team Lead or their designee and is based in Banbury, UK. The role supports the delivery and contribution of departmental and organisational objectives. Responsible for supporting day‑to‑day operations within their area of responsibility, working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders to ensure high standards of service, compliance, and performance. Adherence to organisational policies and procedures, effective communication with line management, and a commitment to continuous improvement and inclusive ways of working is essential.

Role Principles

  • Act with integrity, always upholding the highest professional and ethical standards.
  • Drive innovation and change to continuously improve ways of working and outcomes.
  • Pursue operational excellence, ensuring efficiency, quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate inclusively, building strong partnerships to achieve shared goals.
  • Maintain a customer‑focused approach, prioritising the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Champion sustainability by embedding responsible and environmentally conscious practices into everyday work.

Key Responsibilities:

Role‑Specific Responsibilities

  • Support the delivery of high-quality IT support and services across the organisation, meeting agreed SLAs and service performance targets.
  • Support, administer and enhance Microsoft 365 and modern workplace services, including SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Autopilot, Power Platform, Entra ID and related technologies.
  • Design, develop and enhance small-scale SharePoint and Power Platform solutions, including low-code automation, workflow improvements, forms, lists, pages and service enhancements that improve user experience, operational efficiency and service quality.
  • Support day-to-day service operations, ensuring incidents, requests and changes are handled effectively with clear communication, prioritisation and timely escalation.
  • Provide 2nd line and where appropriate, 3rd line technical support to our global user base, taking ownership of incidents through to resolution while adhering to defined service levels, policies and procedures.
  • Be a technical escalation point within the Service Delivery team for complex incidents, conducting detailed troubleshooting, root cause analysis and resolution steps.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of knowledge articles, procedures and operational standards.
  • Assist with the deployment of updates and changes to business applications and infrastructure, adhering to change control, information security and risk management policies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service quality, automation, user experience and operational efficiency, contributing to the continual improvement of IT services.
  • Support Microsoft 365 adoption and user enablement, including the effective use of collaboration, productivity and AI-enabled tools where appropriate.
  • Assist with IT asset, software licence and inventory management, ensuring accurate records and compliance.
  • Assist with user lifecycle activities, including onboarding, offboarding, account administration and hardware/software provisioning.
  • Liaise with third-party suppliers and service providers for support, procurement, warranty management and issue resolution.
  • Support F1-specific hardware, software and operational systems as required.
  • Perform scheduled operational checks, system health monitoring and maintenance activities to ensure service stability and availability.
  • Participate in major incident management activities, supporting diagnosis, communication, service restoration and post-incident reviews.
  • Support, coach and mentor junior members of the team, sharing technical knowledge and best practice.

Operational Delivery

  • Carry out day‑to‑day tasks efficiently and within agreed timescales.
  • Ensure work meets expected service, quality, and compliance standards.
  • Demonstrate accountability and professionalism in all activities.

Team & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Build positive working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Participate in meetings, briefings, and forums as required.
  • Respond to queries within scope, escalating more complex matters when necessary.

Compliance & Governance

  • Adhere to relevant legislation, organisational policies, and internal controls.
  • Handle information responsibly, including confidential or sensitive data.
  • Support audit, governance, and risk management activities as required.

Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute ideas and feedback to improve processes and ways of working.
  • Participate in team initiatives, projects, or improvement activities.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Undertake any other reasonable duties consistent with the level and purpose of the role, as assigned by the line manager.

Person Specification:

Essential Qualifications & Experience:

  • BSc, MIS or other IT-related qualification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive IT support experience.
  • Advanced qualification in Microsoft 365 administration and/or development, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven exposure to high-pressure, performance-driven environments.

Resilience & Composure:

  • Maintains calm and focus in high-pressure, fast-paced environments.
  • Able to handle setbacks and adapt quickly to changing circumstances.

Integrity & Discretion:

  • Trusted to manage confidential information and sensitive team matters.
  • Upholds the highest standards of professionalism and ethical conduct.

Team-Oriented:

  • Collaborative mindset with a commitment to team cohesion and shared success.
  • Willingness to mentor and develop talent within the organisation.

Adaptability & Flexibility:

  • Comfortable with occasional travel and flexible hours including weekends when required.
  • Open to innovation and continuous improvement in processes and culture.

Equipment and Applications:

  • Extensive experience of modern Microsoft Windows client environments.
  • Proven experience in administering and enhancing Microsoft 365 services, including SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Autopilot, Power Platform and Entra ID.
  • Practical experience designing, configuring and enhancing SharePoint and Power Platform solutions, including lists, forms, pages, workflows, Power Automate and low-code business process improvements.
  • Advanced knowledge of endpoint management, including device provisioning, application deployment and policy-based configuration.
  • Working knowledge of identity and access concepts sufficient to troubleshoot and escalate effectively, for example Active Directory, group membership, conditional access fundamentals and MFA.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot, automation tools or AI-enabled productivity platforms.
  • Strong awareness of cyber security and threat response.
  • Strong understanding of end-user computer hardware troubleshooting, maintenance and repairs.
  • Strong understanding of core infrastructure concepts, for example DHCP, DNS, VPN and wired/wireless networking.
  • Proven experience of an ITSM platform, for example ServiceNow or equivalent, including accurate ticket logging, categorisation, prioritisation, SLA awareness and clear audit-quality updates.
  • Good knowledge of Apple client environments, including macOS and iOS, user support and device troubleshooting.
  • Applied knowledge of scripting and automation, for example PowerShell, to support troubleshooting, reporting and automating repeatable tasks.
  • Working knowledge of Linux client and server environments.

Physical Demands

Extended Hours & Flexibility:

  • Many roles require working evenings, weekends, and public holidays, particularly during race season or critical development phases.

Travel Requirements:

  • Roles supporting race operations, logistics, or communications may involve frequent international travel, including long-haul flights and time zone shifts.

Physical Activity (Varies by Role):

  • Trackside roles may involve standing for long periods, walking across paddocks, and working in noisy, crowded environments.
  • Factory roles may require manual handling of components, use of machinery, or working in temperature-controlled areas.
  • Office-based roles typically involve prolonged computer use and occasional movement between departments.

Sensory Demands:

  • Exposure to high noise levels (e.g., engines, pit lane activity), bright lighting, and fast-moving environments is common in race support roles.
  • This role is based in a shared workplace environment where exposure to common allergens (including food products, fragrances and cleaning materials) may occur. While we will always consider reasonable adjustments, we are unable to guarantee a completely allergen‑free environment.

Health & Safety Compliance:

  • All roles require adherence to strict safety protocols, especially in technical and trackside environments.
  • Completion of all mandatory compliance training (including health and safety, data protection, and role‑specific regulatory training) is a condition of employment and must be maintained throughout tenure.

This job description may not detail some less major duties, nor cover duties of a similar nature, which may from time to time be reasonably required by the relevant manager.


At TGR Haas F1 Team, we consider our employees our greatest asset. We strive to create a supportive and inclusive work environment where everyone can thrive and grow. We value diversity and encourage our employees to bring their unique perspectives and experiences to the conversation. Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion are fundamental to who we are as a company and a collective of colleagues. Our commitment to these ethics is steadfast and this promise travels with us wherever we are in the world.

We look after our team with multiple rewards packages, competitive bonuses and year-round health and wellbeing programs, providing you with the tools to motivate and perform at your best.

If you’re passionate about competition, technology and teamwork, then working at TGR Haas F1 Team could be the perfect fit for you. Motorsport is a dynamic and exciting industry that offers a wide range of opportunities for those who are willing to put in the hard work and dedication required to succeed. Working at TGR Haas F1 Team is a highly rewarding experience, as you become a crucial member of a team that is constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible and striving for excellence in everything we do.

Join our team and make your passion your profession.

Notice

Due to the nature of the organisation, all employees of TGR Haas F1 Team are required to be security cleared to National Security Vetting standards. If successful in your application, we would support you with the NSV process. As a guideline only, you would normally need to have been a UK resident for the last 5 consecutive years. Further confirmation can be found on the Civil Aviation Authority National Security Vetting (NSV) website

If you have not been a UK resident for the last 5 consecutive years, please be prepared to request an Overseas Criminal Records Check for these countries as you will be asked to provide this for referencing and security checks if you are successful.

title: Software Engineer, Reporting & Fee Management
description:
Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at .

As our new Software Engineer, Reporting & Fee Management 📈

You will help build the products our customers use to communicate investment results and charge their clients.

Reporting and fee management look simple from the outside, but every wealth manager has its own data, calculations, presentation requirements, commercial agreements, and operating processes. Joining Performativ should not require customers to abandon what makes their business work.

Our direction is to turn these differences into flexible, reusable platform capabilities. This includes a new reporting workbench and AI-assisted experiences that allow users to configure, generate, and publish reports and fee arrangements safely themselves.

  • You will build reporting and fee-management capabilities that turn complex portfolio data and customer requirements into accurate, understandable outputs.

  • You will work closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to understand real workflows, challenge assumptions, and distinguish reusable product needs from one-off requests.

  • You will help develop self-service configuration and AI-assisted workflows, with clear validation, permissions, review steps, and safeguards for untrusted input.

  • You will investigate issues across data, calculations, configuration, and presentation, then deliver permanent solutions that are observable, testable, and safe to deploy.

  • You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their decisions and output critically, and leave systems in a state that teammates can understand and extend.

You should bring solid software-engineering judgment and an interest in developing product and financial-domain understanding. Experience with investment reporting, fee calculations, portfolio data, document generation, configurable workflows, or financial software would be valuable, but deep experience with our exact technology stack is not required.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be able to recognise incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, weak product decisions, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

  • The opportunity to build products used directly by wealth managers and their clients.

  • Difficult product and engineering problems involving financial data, calculations, configuration, document generation, and AI-assisted workflows.

  • A central role in making complex reporting and fee management genuinely self-service.

  • An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

  • Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows.

title: Juniora medarbetare till IT Risk & Controls (Stockholm) – Aug 2027
description:
I teamet IT Risk & Controls identifierar och analyserar vi risker samt granskar och utvärderar hur de identifierade riskerna hanteras. Våra klienter får därigenom hjälp att förstå sina IT-relaterade risker och en bild av hur de påverkar företagets operativa och finansiella delar. Våra klienter är huvudsakligen stora nordiska och globala bolag. Uppdragens längd varierar från ett par veckor till ett par månader och i vissa fall ännu längre. Oberoende av tjänsteområde och uppdragsform arbetar vi alltid i team.

Som junior medarbetare kommer du att fokusera på uppdrag av granskningskaraktär och gap-analyser relaterade till IT-risk. Genom mixen av tjänster vi erbjuder och våra klienters föränderliga behov, kommer du över tid att bygga upp en bred erfarenhetsbas inom IT-risk. Detta gör att du kontinuerligt utvecklar förmågor och kompetenser i linje med den senaste teknikutvecklingen och marknadens behov.

Rollen innebär ett högt tempo och ständig utveckling. Du utvecklas professionellt i en riktning där du redan tidigt får möjlighet att exponeras för höga beslutsfattare med stora krav på förmåga att bygga personliga relationer och framföra komplexa budskap på ett enkelt sätt. Denna utveckling ökar gradvis i en tilltagande takt där din roll över tid i ökande grad fokuserar på relationer, ledarskap, försäljning och kommunikation.

Vi söker dig som är nyutexaminerad inom antigen systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, datorteknik, informatik, informationssäkerhet alternativt är ingenjör eller ekonom med IT-inriktning. Du är en lagspelare, men trivs även med att jobba självständigt. Du är flexibel, lösningsorienterad, analytisk och öppen för nya utmaningar.

Vidare ser vi gärna att du har:

  • Goda studieresultat

  • Engagemang vid sidan av studierna.

  • Mycket goda språkkunskaper i svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift.

Meriterande för rollen är:

  • Magister- eller Masterutbildning

  • Relevant arbetslivserfarenhet (exempelvis inom ekonomi eller IT)

  • Erfarenhet av konsultbranschen samt kunskaper inom Microsoft-program, särskilt excel.

Vi erbjuder

Som en del av Deloitte får du tillgång till världens största konsultnätverk. Tillsammans med skickliga kollegor, klienter och starka samarbeten löser vi framtidens mest komplexa utmaningar hos Sveriges största organisationer. Genom en gemensam värdegrund och ett fast driv att göra skillnad, ger samspelet mellan våra möjligheter och dina målsättningar dig en chans att påverka, bygga viktiga relationer och nätverk, samt ständig utveckling och utbildning. Vi erbjuder möjligheter till personlig utveckling genom praktisk erfarenhet, personlig coach och kontinuerlig feedback från erfarna kollegor. Låt ditt driv skapa en meningsfull skillnad.

Ansökan

Du ansöker online. Din ansökan ska bestå av:

  • CV
  • Betygskopior från högskola/universitet - De betyg som du laddar upp bör inte vara utdragna senare än 2 månader tillbaka i tiden. Bifoga kopior från både kandidatutbildning samt master/magisterutbildning, i det fall det är tillämpligt.

I första steget laddar du upp ditt CV. Därefter laddar du upp universitetsbetyg (för avklarade kurser) och svarar på frågor relaterade till rollen. Både CV och fullständiga betyg måste laddas upp för att ansökan ska vara komplett. Vi tillämpar löpande urval, så skicka gärna in ansökan så snart som möjligt. Efter inskickat CV får du en bekräftelse via mejl; får du inget, skicka ansökan igen. Om du ansöker till flera roller, ange vilken roll du är mest intresserad av.

På Deloitte värdesätter vi olika kompetenser, perspektiv och erfarenheter, eftersom det skapar bättre möjligheter att effektivt lösa komplexa utmaningar för våra kunder. Vi uppmuntrar dig att söka tjänsten om du tror att dina färdigheter kan bidra till vårt teams framgång.

Som en kvalitativ del av Deloittes rekrytering genomgår våra slutkandidater bakgrundskontroll för att öka kännedom om våra framtida medarbetare, trygga arbetsmiljön och uppfylla regelkrav. Kontrollen sker i samarbete med ToFindOut: . För tjänster med krav på universitetsbetyg sker verifiering under rekryteringen. Vid frågor, kontakta ansvarig rekryterare.

Frågor?

Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller om rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Helen Nehma, hnehma@deloitte.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

What impact will you make?

På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.

title: CZ - Retail Assistant/ka
description:
Proč pracovat právě u nás?

V Primarku nám záleží na lidech – a náš balíček benefitů je opravdu šitý na míru!

  • Soudržný, podpůrný tým Od prvního dne najdeš pomoc, podporu a jedinečného týmového ducha.
  • Rozmanitost, která nás spojuje Vítáme všechny. U nás se potkáš s kolegy z celého světa – máme tu 26 různých národností. A stejně pestrý je i věk: od nejmladšího osmnáctiletého kolegy až po toho nejzkušenějšího, kterému je 75 let.
  • U nás se pořád něco děje – a to je právě ta zábava! Naše obchody jsou plné života. Nuda tu nemá místo – každý den přináší něco nového.
  • Jistota od začátku – pracovní smlouva od prvního dne Stabilita a bezpečí jsou pro nás klíčové.
  • Podpora zdraví a wellbeingu Nepřetržitá podpora prostřednictvím programu „Let’s Talk“ – pro tebe i tvoji rodinu – včetně psychologické, právní i finanční pomoci.
  • Dovolená navíc U nás máš 5 dní dovolené navíc, aby sis užil/a volno o něco dýl.
  • Příspěvek na stravu Za každu odpracovanou směnu dostaneš 80 Kč rovnou do výplaty, žádné stravenky.
  • Trvalá sleva pro zaměstnance Využij ji ve všech prodejnách Primark v České republice.
  • Příjemné pracovní prostředí Šatny se sprchami, relaxační zóna s automaty na občerstvení a kávu, zdarma Wi-Fi i přístup k počítači.
  • Rovnováha mezi prací a osobním životem Rozvrhy plánujeme dopředu a snažíme se vyjít vstříc tvým studijním povinnostem nebo druhé práci.

Tato role je ti ušitá na míru, pokud chceš:

  • Připravovat prodejnu na další prodejní den, doplňovat zboží a starat se o to, aby byla prodejna vždy upravená, přehledná a připravená přivítat zákazníky.
  • Pomáhat s příjmem zboží, udržovat atraktivní vystavení a zajistit, aby prodejna vypadala co nejlépe.
  • Podporovat manažerský tým při objednávkách a rozhodování o sortimentu.

Protože jsi jedinečný/á

Oslavujeme rozmanitost a víme, že každý přináší do našich obchodů svůj jedinečný styl a osobnost. V Primarku neplatí přístup „jedna velikost pro všechny“.

Skvěle se k nám hodíš, pokud:

  • máš rád/a aktivní práci v rychlém tempu,
  • máš pozitivní přístup a chuť učit se nové věci,
  • se staráš o ostatní a rád/a pracuješ v týmu,
  • jsi spolehlivá/ý a všímáš si detailů,
  • je ti více než 18 let a nevadí ti práce na směny a o víkendy.

Ať už máš dlouholetou zkušenost v retailu, nebo právě začínáš – u nás jsi vítán/a. Důležitý je pro nás tvůj přístup a nasazení.
Jsme otevřeni všem – včetně osob se zdravotním postižením a lidem ve věku 50+.

PŘIHLASTE SE TEĎ

Neváhej – najdi si své místo v Primarku! :)
Protože právě ty máš tu jiskru.

Naše móda není jen o jedné univerzální velikosti pro všechny a stejně tak to platí i o naší kultuře. Primark podporuje rovné příležitosti v zaměstnání, snažíme se vytvářet inkluzivní pracovní prostředí, kde mohou být lidé sami sebou, mít přístup k příležitostem a společně růst.

Jij kan als terreinmedewerker zelfstandig werken en het terrein georganiseerd houden. Verder heb/ ben je:

title: Head of Food & Beverage
description:
About the Role

As Head of F&B, you will lead the planning and operational delivery of catering and hospitality services, ensuring every event is executed to the highest standards of quality, service and profitability. Working closely with clients, venue stakeholders and internal teams, you will drive operational excellence, maximise commercial performance, and create memorable experiences while developing a high-performing team culture.

The Venue

The Great Yorkshire Events Centre is a truly exciting place to build your career in hospitality. Set within the iconic Great Yorkshire Showground, our impressive Halls provide a dynamic backdrop for everything from major exhibitions and conferences to large-scale celebrations and corporate events. Working in partnership with Legends Global, our catering and hospitality operation delivers exceptional food, service and guest experiences across a diverse and fast-paced events calendar. With no two events the same, this is an opportunity to be part of a passionate team, delivering outstanding hospitality on a large scale while creating memorable experiences for every guest.

What we can offer

Hosting events is what we do best, and we want our People to experience that too- enjoy access to discounted tickets to unleash your superfan for all your favourites.

You will work hard at Legends Global , but you will be rewarded with lots of time to relax and rest with 25 days annual leave

We understand that you have a life outside of work and want to ensure that your loved ones will always be taken care of whilst you’re contributing to our success with our Life Assurance policy.

A healthy contribution of 5% Pension so that your golden years are spent ticking off the items on your bucket list.

Got a dental bill? Need to book a counselling session? Or even help with Physio costs? With the support of Healthshield; Legends Global will support with these unexpected costs. For you and any children.

We understand that from time to time you might need a bit of support to get you back to feeling your best, so we have teamed up with AXA Health to provide our people with an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) to support mental health in the workplace.

We are visionaries: both physically and metaphorically! When you join Legends Global you will be entitled to eye care vouchers and a contribution towards any glasses you require.

Pedal your way to a greener, healthier commute—join our Cycle to Work scheme and turn every ride into a win for you and the planet

Great people know great people! Refer a friend through our Employee Referral Scheme and get rewarded for helping us build an amazing team

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end planning and delivery of catering and hospitality services across the Great Yorkshire Event Centre and Outside Catering events, ensuring exceptional client and customer experiences.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, venue stakeholders and internal departments to ensure seamless event delivery and effective communication at every stage.

• Take ownership of operational and financial performance, delivering venue targets, KPI achievement, accurate forecasting, event reporting, billing documentation, and identifying opportunities to increase revenue and profitability.

• Continuously review operational performance, implementing improvements that enhance efficiency, service quality, guest satisfaction and commercial outcomes.

• Recruit, develop and inspire teams through effective leadership, training and open communication, creating a positive, high-performing culture.

• Champion compliance with all company policies, Standard Operating Procedures, food safety, health and safety requirements, sustainability initiatives including Guardians of Grub, and support wider business projects and venue operations as required.

We are looking for someone with

• Proven experience within event, hospitality or catering management, including leading teams and delivering high-quality events, ideally within an outside catering environment.

• Strong commercial and financial awareness, with experience managing budgets, margins, cost of sales and operational profitability.

• Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and motivate teams.

• Adaptable, proactive and solutions-focused, with the ability to work under pressure while maintaining exceptional service standards.

• Holds a Level 2 Food Hygiene qualification (or equivalent) and is willing to work towards Level 3 certification; First Aid at Work qualification desirable.

• Full UK driving licence and access to own transport, with flexibility to support events across multiple venues when required.

Recruitment Process

  • 1st Stage - Introductory call with Talent Team

  • 2nd Stage - Interview with Venue F&B Leadership Team

Any offer of employment will be subject to satisfactory pre‑employment checks. These may include verification of identity, proof of address, right to work, employment history, qualifications, and—where relevant to the role—a basic or enhanced DBS check. All checks will be carried out in line with data protection law and we will only request information that is necessary for the role.

Inclusive Workplace

At Legends Global, we are committed to leading the entertainment industry towards a greener, faster, and more innovative digital future. There’s never been a better time to join our team. We aim to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers, and suppliers. Join us and make a significant impact from day one.

We are committed to active inclusion, diversity, and equal opportunities. This commitment begins with our recruitment and selection process. We welcome discussions about flexible working arrangements.

If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of our recruitment process, please let us know in your application. We are dedicated to providing a fair and transparent assessment process and will do our utmost to accommodate your needs.

If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible to ensure it is considered. We will continue to review applications on a rolling basis and may close the advert before the closing date.

title: Client Partner
description:
Client Partner – Job Description



About S&S

Sullivan & Stanley is not a traditional consulting firm. We are intentionally building something different.


We are a company of relationship builders, consultants and entrepreneurs who believe that how work gets done matters just as much as what gets delivered. We exist to challenge ineffective change and outdated consulting models, replacing them with approaches that are human, pragmatic and built for the realities of modern organisations.


Culture at S&S is something we take seriously, not as a certification but as a daily practice. We are committed to creating an environment where people are trusted, supported and encouraged to bring their full selves to work, balancing high standards with humanity, care and accountability.


We are deeply mission driven. We want to change business for good, so that the next generation, including our founder Pat Lynes' sons, Sullivan and Stanley, who the company is named after, inherit organisations that are healthier, fairer and better equipped for the future.


As we grow, we are pioneering a Service-as-a-Software approach to consulting, blending community, capability, technology and delivery at scale. This is an opportunity to join a firm in its next phase of growth and help shape what consulting becomes next, not just participate in what it has been.

Our values

  • Be transparent and honest
  • Give more than you receive
  • Look after one another
  • Follow through


About You and the Role

Proactive, tenacious, customer focused

You are a trusted senior advisor with a strong commercial instinct and a track record of owning and growing complex client relationships. You operate at executive level, shape client agendas and are personally accountable for commercial outcomes.

The Client Partner is the senior commercial, strategic and relational owner of one or more of S&S's most important accounts. They are accountable for long-term revenue growth, strategic engagement, client value, and for defining and executing the account vision.

Client Partners act as the interface between S&S and client leadership teams, shaping demand, owning strategic outcomes, and ensuring S&S is positioned as a trusted advisor and transformation partner. They lead account planning, opportunity origination, commercial performance and value realisation.

This role sits at the centre of the S&S growth engine, driving both the strategic direction and commercial performance of assigned strategic accounts.


Accountabilities

The Client Partner is accountable for owning and growing strategic client relationships, driving significant revenue, and shaping both client outcomes and the future of Sullivan & Stanley.

1. Client engagement & delivery leadership

  • Owning senior, trusted relationships at C-suite and executive level, acting as a strategic advisor to clients.
  • Leveraging cross-sector experience to shape new opportunities and address complex or sensitive client situations.
  • Anticipating client needs beyond current engagements and identifying opportunities to add further value.
  • Taking accountability for the quality, impact and outcomes of client work under their remit.

2. Sales & business development

  • Leading significant business development opportunities across both new (hunting) and existing (farming) client relationships.
  • Providing strategic direction on proposals, shaping compelling commercial propositions across a range of offerings.
  • Negotiating commercials and contracting directly with clients.
  • Identifying, designing and selling solutions that create measurable client value and drive sustainable business growth.

3. Revenue & financial performance

  • Owning £5m+ revenue across one or more sectors or portfolios.
  • Taking full accountability for financial performance, deliverables, pipeline, and bids and win rates.
  • Demonstrating £3m+ personally attributable sales, evidencing direct commercial impact.
  • Managing margin, scope and commercial risk across engagements.

4. Internal contribution & leadership

  • Shaping long-term firm strategy, ensuring growth is underpinned by strong delivery capability, the right internal structures, and effective external and alliance relationships.
  • Providing leadership, coaching and direct intervention to consultants, delivery leads and engagement teams at all levels.
  • Acting as a role model for S&S values, behaviours and standards.

5. Internal change & continuous improvement

  • Actively contributing to S&S's ambition to be a "model organisation", operating at the leading edge of organisational design.
  • Participating in and facilitating retrospectives, strategy-to-execution sessions, team effectiveness workshops and internal strategy days.
  • Championing experimentation and improvement — "keeping S&S in beta" — to evolve how the firm operates.

6. Thought leadership & market influence

  • Acting as a visible leader and person of influence within their area of expertise.
  • Representing and expressing the S&S point of view through social media, speaking engagements and thought leadership events.
  • Contributing to the creation of content across written formats, video and audio, and live events.
  • Building personal and firm reputation in the market — potentially including long-form thought leadership (and yes, even writing a book).


Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: Proven track record (10+ years) in a senior client-facing, account management, or consulting role, with experience managing large or enterprise-level accounts.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree.
  • Consulting skills: Excellent problem-solving, analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to provide innovative, tailored solutions.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including public speaking and presentation abilities.
  • Interpersonal skills: Strong empathy, active listening, negotiation and stakeholder management skills to build trust and navigate complex client dynamics.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated leadership abilities, experience managing teams, and a focus on mentoring and developing others.
  • Business acumen: Highly commercially aware, with experience in financial management, business development and strategic planning.
  • Adaptability: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities and client needs.


Success Measures & KPIs

  • Revenue growth vs target — achieving or exceeding revenue growth goals for assigned accounts (e.g. a 40% uplift). This is the primary indicator of commercial performance and account leadership.
  • Run rate & forecast accuracy — the reliability of revenue forecasting, and quarterly and annual account predictions. This ensures predictable growth and operational planning across S&S.
  • Pipeline velocity & progression — the speed and quality of opportunity progression through the pipeline, from lead to qualified to proposal to won. This measures sales effectiveness and strategic alignment.
  • New opportunity creation (white space) — the number and quality of new, qualified opportunities created within accounts. This demonstrates proactive strategic shaping, not reactive selling.
  • Client satisfaction (CSAT/NPS) — senior stakeholder perception and relationship quality, reflecting trust, partnership and overall account health.
  • Value realisation — the percentage of engagements with defined value outcomes achieved or exceeded, showing the ability to deliver meaningful, measurable impact.
  • Commercial hygiene — the quality of SOWs, change controls, pricing and margin protection, which protects S&S's revenue and risk position.
  • Account plan adoption & governance — the completion, quality and consistency of quarterly account plan refreshes, ensuring strong strategic direction and disciplined account management.
  • Escalation frequency & resolution quality — the number of escalations and the effectiveness of remediation, ensuring stability and strengthening client trust.
  • Contribution to propositions & insight — the quality of market and client insight shared with GTM, Consulting and the Mission Hub, ensuring S&S's offering remains relevant and competitive.


Experience & Skills

Essential experience

  • 10+ years in client leadership, consulting, delivery or commercial roles.
  • Proven ability to grow large, complex accounts and shape multi-year pipelines.
  • Deep experience working with C-suite stakeholders across complex organisations.
  • Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills and financial judgement.
  • Demonstrated success in transformation, change, operating model or strategic advisory environments.

Skills & competencies

  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial instincts.
  • Exceptional communication, influence and executive presence.
  • Ability to diagnose complex client problems and articulate compelling outcomes.
  • Strong negotiation and contracting capability.
  • Ability to orchestrate multidisciplinary teams around complex accounts.


Benefits

  • Borough Market office space with event space & bar
  • Monthly gym membership contributions
  • Access to learning and development opportunities
  • Membership of The Change Society
  • Pension and life assurance
  • Hybrid working


Additional Information

S&S values difference. We are working to be our best diverse selves and are committed to providing an inclusive, safe and amicable environment for all people, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ability, age, ethnicity, socioeconomic status, and religion (or lack thereof). We are an equal opportunity employer and our recruitment process is based on capability and experience.

title: Facilities Lead – Care Campus
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Skid Row Care Campus is a comprehensive, low-barrier service center providing individuals experiencing homelessness with access to hygiene facilities, case management, health and behavioral health services, and connections to housing and other essential resources. The Campus offers a safe, welcoming, and trauma-informed environment that promotes dignity, stability, and pathways to long-term housing.

The Facilities Lead is a hands-on working lead who coordinates Facilities Specialist assignments, monitors interior and exterior campus conditions, responds to routine maintenance and environmental needs, and escalates building-system or specialized repair concerns.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Coordinate daily Facilities assignments, priorities, coverage, and campus walkthroughs.
  • Lead and participate in cleaning, groundskeeping, waste removal, routine maintenance, and campus-readiness activities.
  • Identify environmental hazards, maintenance needs, and building-system concerns and coordinate timely response or escalation.
  • Support Facilities staff through day-to-day guidance, training, quality checks, and reinforcement of PPE and safety procedures.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Two or more years of experience in facilities, environmental or custodial services, building maintenance, property operations, groundskeeping, or a related field preferred.
  • Prior lead, team-coordination, or comparable experience preferred.
  • Experience with commercial cleaning, exterior maintenance, basic building repairs, and cleaning equipment preferred.

title: Head of Risk & Resilience
description:
Location: London, UK or Tallinn, Estonia | Hybrid

Reports to: Group Chief Compliance & Risk Officer / MLRO

Function: Second line risk, independent of the FinCrime/AML line (Deputy MLRO)

Type: Permanent, full-time

About Pockit and Monese

Pockit and Monese are all-in-one money apps that make it easier for people to access and manage the financial tools they need to take control of their money.

We provide vital financial services, from accounts and cards to income advance solutions. In October 2024, Pockit acquired Monese, bringing together two complementary businesses and creating a leading fintech company focused on serving people who are underserved by traditional banks.

Together, we serve more than three million customers across the UK and Europe.

We're a diverse, international and energetic team, with colleagues based across London, Newcastle, Tallinn and remote teams across Central Europe. We value curiosity, ambition, accountability and resilience, and we want everyone to feel at home, have a voice and know that their contribution matters. We give people the trust and space to take ownership, share ideas, influence decisions, and make a real impact on our customers and our business.

Role Purpose

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Risk & Operational Resilience to own, build, and run our operational and prudential risk capabilities across Monese.

In this role, you will be the accountable owner for our operational resilience framework- specifically focusing on wind-down planning, business continuity, incident management, and third-party/outsourcing risk management in accordance with FCA expectations and DORA standards.

This is a build-and-run, individual contributor role initially. You will close current resourcing gaps across all three areas and build the underlying risk management toolkit (KRIs, control self-assessment, risk event log) needed to run them sustainably.

What you'll do

1. Risk Framework & Audit Interface

  • Own the Risk & Control Self-Assessment process and a KRI framework across all operational areas.

  • Maintain an operational risk event log with clear escalation, investigation, and remediation tracking.

  • Act as primary liaison for internal and external audit on wind-down, incident management, and TPRM matters; align control design with audit recommendations

2. Third-Party & Outsourcing Risk Management
Regulatory basis: DORA Art. 28–44; EBA/GL/2019/02; FCA SYSC 8; Operational Resilience (PS21/3), including mapping of third parties supporting important business services

  • Own the Third Party Risk Management framework, running rigorous risk assessments, ensuring due diligence is performed, maintaining the DORA Register of Information, and guaranteeing that robust exit strategies are in place for critical vendors.

  • Ensure TPRM aligns with BCP maintaining the mapping of critical third parties against important business services

3. Operational Risk Management & Wind-Down Planning
Regulatory basis: Electronic Money Regulations 2011; EBA/GL/2021/11

  • Map out critical business services and be the primary author of the firm's board- and FCA-approved Wind-Down Plan (WDP) and Business Continuity Plans (BCP), ensuring the firm can weather operational crises without harming consumers

  • Design and run the WDP and BCP testing programme - scenario testing, timeline/resource feasibility checks, and business impact analysis - evidencing the plan works operationally, not just that it exists

  • Benchmark against the FCA's 2025 multi-firm WDP review and the shift in supervisory tone (e.g. PS25/12) from document-existence to demonstrated execution capability

Governance & Reporting:

  • Feeds risk MI into the Risk Committee and Board reporting owned by the CCRO/MLRO

  • Collaborate with the Deputy MLRO on third-party or incident matters with a financial-crime dimension, without owning fincrime risk itself.

What you'll bring

  • Track record building or running a second-line operational/prudential risk function in a UK-regulated payments, e-money, or banking firm.

  • Direct experience with wind-down/recovery planning under EMR 2011/PSR 2017 or equivalent prudential regimes.

  • Hands-on incident management and resilience testing experience - able to design and run simulation exercises, not just write policy.

  • Practical DORA implementation experience (Art. 17–23 incident reporting; Art. 28–44 third-party risk), given Monese's EU entity exposure.

  • Outsourcing/TPRM experience including fourth-party due diligence

  • Experience running KRI/CSA frameworks and acting as an audit liaison

  • Comfortable operating with limited team resource initially - this is a build-out role

Why Join Us?

  • Make a real difference: Work at the intersection of technology and financial inclusion, helping people take greater control of their money.

  • Have a voice: Your ideas and perspective matter. You'll have the opportunity to influence decisions, take ownership and shape how we work.

  • Make an impact: Work on initiatives that reach millions of customers across the UK and Europe.

  • Work with great people: Join a diverse, international and ambitious team where collaboration and curiosity are encouraged.

  • Grow with us: Be part of a fast-moving fintech where you'll have plenty of opportunities to learn, develop and make your mark.

What benefits we offer

We want you to feel supported, valued and able to do your best work - both in and outside the office.

  • 25 days annual leave + public holidays, with an extra day for every year worked

  • Healthcare: Private medical with Confido, sports compensation with Stebby or discount from a gym or Bupa personal private healthcare

  • Generous pension plan

  • 10 paid sick days per year

  • Hybrid working + up to 30 days working abroad each year

  • L&D budget + 10 paid learning days per year

  • Annual eye care allowance

  • Enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave

  • VIP Pockit & Monese accounts

  • Extra paid days off for your birthday and wedding

  • Regular social events and team activities

  • Monthly recognition awards and Team of the Quarter

  • Share options, depending on role and level

  • Employee referral bonus

  • Free office parking

The use of AI tools or applications during interviews is not permitted.

We value a fair, transparent, and authentic recruitment process. Candidates are expected to participate in all stages of the interview process personally and to represent themselves accurately.

The use of AI interview proxies, real-time AI co-pilots or answer-generation tools, deepfakes, impersonation, synthetic identities, or any other technology intended to misrepresent a candidate’s identity, skills, experience, or responses during the interview process is strictly prohibited.

Any candidate found to be using such methods will be automatically disqualified from the recruitment process.

We kindly ask all candidates to respect the time and effort invested by both sides and to approach the interview process with honesty, professionalism, and integrity. If you are genuinely interested in the opportunity, we look forward to meeting you and learning about your own experience, skills, and perspective.

title: Sr Execution Business Partner Practitioner – EBP Center of Excellence
description:
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of relevant work experience is required, plus a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.

Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

General Dynamics Mission Systems has an immediate opening for a Sr Execution Business Partner (EBP) Practitioner (Sr Princ PPM Spec) to join the Execution Business Partner (EBP) Center of Excellence. This role is designed for a proven PM leader with hands-on experience in program execution, Earned Value Management (EVM), and performance optimization—with a strong understanding of audit readiness and compliance assurance. The position provides an opportunity to enhance the performance and profitability of an organization that supports some of our nation’s fundamental defense services. General Dynamics Mission Systems employees work closely with esteemed customers to develop solutions that allow them to carry out high-stakes national security missions.

As a practitioner embedded in the PPM CoE, you will mentor program managers, guide adoption of common processes and tools, and lead initiatives that strengthen program performance, customer satisfaction, and digital transformation. You will also play a key role in ensuring programs are audit-ready and compliant with internal policies and external standards.

The role is pivotal in transforming program data into actionable insights, enabling proactive decision-making, and strengthening program predictability. The practitioner will ensure alignment with Earned Value Management System (EVMS) standards, scheduling best practices, and compliance requirements—supporting audit readiness and reinforcing GDMS’s commitment to disciplined program execution.

STRATEGIC RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Represent the Program Performance Management Center of Excellence (PPM CoE) across GDMS’s lines of business, serving as a trusted advisor to program and functional leadership.

  • Drive enterprise-wide execution excellence by promoting consistent application of GDMS’s common process framework, tools, and performance standards.

  • Lead initiatives that advance digital PM transformation, enabling real-time visibility, data-driven decision-making, and tool adoption.

  • Facilitate PM POL/PRO reviews and maintain the Customer Satisfaction Database to inform strategic improvements and customer engagement.

OPERATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Guide program teams in applying Earned Value Management (EVM) principles, ensuring compliance with EIA-748 standards and actionable performance insights.

  • Support development and review of integrated cost and schedule baselines, variance analysis, and recovery planning.

  • Assist programs in achieving audit readiness, including mock audits, documentation reviews, and corrective action planning.

  • Ensure consistent use of scheduling best practices, MIL-STD-881, and NDIA’s Planning & Scheduling Excellence Guide (PASEG).

TRAINING & COACHING RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and evolve PM onboarding, PM Bootcamp, and advanced training programs focused on cost, schedule, risk, and technical execution.
  • Provide coaching and mentorship to program managers across all phases of the program lifecycle—from development through sustainment.
  • Facilitate brown bag sessions, lunch & learns, and targeted workshops to address emerging challenges and share best practices.
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning and performance accountability across the PM community.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Extensive experience in Program Management, with a proven track record of leading or advising complex defense programs through engineering, production, and sustainment phases.

  • Deep expertise in Earned Value Management (EVM), including baseline development, performance analysis, and corrective action planning in compliance with EIA-748 standards.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach program managers, enabling consistent application of PM best practices across diverse teams and portfolios.

  • Strong understanding of program lifecycle execution, including cost, schedule, risk, and technical performance integration.

  • Experience supporting or leading audit readiness efforts, including DCMA surveillance, customer reviews, and internal compliance assessments.

  • Familiarity with GDMS’s common process framework, MIL-STD-881, and NDIA’s Planning & Scheduling Excellence Guide (PASEG).

  • Skilled in facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

  • Proficiency with digital PM tools, dashboards, and analytics platforms that support performance visibility and decision-making.

  • PMP certification or equivalent required. Master’s degree preferred.

  • U.S. Citizenship required; ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance is preferred but not required.

Our Commitment to You:

  • An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
  • Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
  • Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more
  • See more at gdmissionsystems.com/careers/why-work-for-us/benefits

Are you an experienced HR Advisor looking for a role where you can make a real difference within a well-established food manufacturing site? Join Humdinger Heckington and play a key role in supporting our people and culture.

  • Experience managing multiple projects and delivering against competing priorities in a changing business environment.
  • Resilient, adaptable and confident working in ambiguity, with a proactive approach to problem solving and decision making.

  • 4% employer and 5 % employee pension plan

About Us

At Humdinger, we transform coco, nuts, seeds, fruit, and pulses into delectable snacks and chocolates for both our in-house label and renowned branded ranges. With a robust and continually growing portfolio, we've earned compliments for our commitment to quality and continuous product innovation. You might have enjoyed our products before, perhaps without even realising it! The Heckington site employs around 150 people and produces a range of nut and fruit snacking products and has a strong focus on teamwork, quality, and continuous improvement.

Situated in Heckington (Sleaford), Sherburn in Elmet and Bromborough, we are an integral part of the Zertus UK & Ireland Snacking & Chocolate Market Unit, collaborating with other esteemed food manufacturers nationwide. Join us on a flavourful journey where innovation, quality, and a passion for snacking come together. Our talented teams have created a growing portfolio of our own famous brands including NOMO, Sun Valley Nuts, Kinnerton Kids, The Fruit Factory, Yum & Yay, Humzingers, as well as collaborations with Bailey's, Guinness and Budweiser!

Application & Interview Process

First Stage Interview – Teams

The final stage includes a visit to our factory and offices, with a site tour and a chance to meet the team. We will run through some scenario-based HR questions to test your knowledge.

Humdinger is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Please let us know if you require any special arrangements or adjustments to be made for your interview by speaking with the Talent Acquisition team at application stage.

For detailed information on how we process your personal data, please review our candidate privacy policy on our careers portal.

title: DevSecOps Engineer, Video Intelligence

  • Experience in microservices architecture and distributed systems.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

Scam Alert

description:

Teens

General

Active Christian in good standing.

title: Commercieel Medewerker Binnendienst Prefab

title: FPGA Design Engineer
description:
Join our TEMPEST team and contribute to the development of advanced mission computing technology for the UK’s next-generation combat aircraft programme. In this role you will develop and integrate FPGA-based solutions for complex, safety-critical applications, working alongside engineers and technical specialists across industry, government and academia. This is an opportunity to work on a major multinational defence programme and help deliver the next generation of combat air capability.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop FPGA designs and associated firmware using VHDL and/or Verilog.

  • Contribute to design reviews and the production of supporting engineering documentation.
  • Support the exploration and application of AI/ML models within FPGA and embedded computing environments.
  • Collaborate with engineering specialists across industry, government and academia.
  • Contribute to sovereign UK defence capability through the delivery of advanced combat air technology.

Essential experience:

  • A degree, equivalent qualification or relevant practical experience in electronic engineering, computer engineering or a related discipline.
  • Practical experience developing FPGA solutions using VHDL and/or Verilog.
  • An understanding of FPGA design, simulation, verification and integration.
  • Knowledge of embedded systems and digital electronics.
  • The ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • High levels of motivation, integrity and professionalism.

Desirable experience:

  • Experience creating simulation environments or VHDL/Verilog test benches.
  • Familiarity with FPGA development, simulation and verification tools.
  • Experience working on complex, safety-critical or high-integrity systems.
  • An understanding of hardware and software integration.
  • Experience working with, implementing or deploying AI/ML models.

title: Events Assistant - South West England
description:
About WeBuyVintage

WeBuyVintage is one of the UK’s largest buyers of jewellery, antiques and collectibles. We run more roadshows than any other UK company - over 250 valuation events every month - bringing trusted experts face-to-face with customers across the country.

In lthree years, we’ve grown from a pub-table idea into an eight-figure business, and we’re on a mission to make WeBuyVintage a brand everyone recognises.

The Role:

At WeBuyVintage, we’re passionate about delivering outstanding customer experiences and building knowledgeable, confident teams that represent our company to the highest standard out in the field. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for passionate, hands-on Roadshow Assistants who enjoy going above and beyond for customers and strive for consistency & quality across their work.


Main Tasks & Responsibilities:

As a Roadshow Assistant you’ll work at our roadshows alongside our Buyers. You’ll be the person responsible for the consistent quality and smooth running of our roadshow events, which includes:

· Hospitality – you’ll be the first and last face that our customers see, building rapport with them to make sure that every minute of their time at our Roadshow is an enjoyable one. It’s the small things - making sure people are comfortable, knowing when it’s their turn to be seen, and having all of their questions answered.

· Event quality – our events cannot run and definitely don’t feel the same without you. You’ll ensure that all of our events look and feel the same, no matter where they are – banners, signs, biscuits, music… and everything else that turns an event into an experience.

· On the day venue management – work with our bookings team to (when arriving at a roadshow), meet with local venue teams, pass on health & safety messaging to our buyers, and just generally being our on-site contact for all queries.

· Product triage – alongside our Buyers, help our customer understand what items we do and don’t buy so that we can manage their expectations early on.

· Customer experience – some of our customers might have lots of valuables, others might have recently lost a family member. Your job is to be understanding, no matter the circumstances and show that individual that they can trust us.

Who We’re Looking For:

You’ll be someone who loves people (it’s as simple as that really), and because of that, want to do as much as you possibly can to make their day!

You’ll be great in this role if you have:

  • Experience being part of the customer facing team dealing with a diverse range of different customers

  • Experience identifyingcustomer problems / questions and can outline examples of how you answered these questions, even if you didn’t know the answer

  • Experience running, or helping to run customer-facing events,

  • Able to build strong relationships with internal colleagues across the business, to communicate event feedback

  • Share best practice and successful ways of working between roadshows and operational locations, as well as working with us to roll-out new processes across our roadshows and be the one making sure they are followed at your events

  • Willingness to travel 1-2 hours daily for this role (all travel will be fully expensed), as per your roadshow rota

Qualifications & Experience:

Essential:

  • Previous hospitality, retail, social work or customer service experience

  • Excellent communication skills

  • The ability to quickly build strong relationships with colleagues and customers

  • The ability to explain processes and information clearly and simply

  • Full UK Driving Licence - our locations are sometimes not accessible by public transport


What You’ll Get:

  • 4-day working week (Days will vary each week but will fall between Monday and Saturday)

  • Access to Bright Exchange - enjoy thousands of exclusive employee discounts and perks

  • Employee Assistance Programme - confidential, 24/7 support for you and your immediate family, covering work, personal, and home life matters

  • On-demand professional development - access to BrightHR’s online learning platform to build new skills and support your career progression

  • Competitive pay

  • Be part of a rapidly growing, friendly UK brand


The salary for this role is £30,000 p.a.

Please note this role is remote and requires daily travel to different locations within 2 hours of your home address

title: Change & Delivery Business Analyst
description:

At OneAdvanced, we build software that helps organisations across legal, health and care, education and the public sector work smarter. Our Professional Services team turns that software into real change for our clients, and we’re looking for a Change and Delivery Business Analyst to join them.

You’ll be the bridge between our clients and our delivery teams. You’ll get to know how a client works today, shape what good looks like tomorrow, and make sure we solve the real problem rather than the one first assumed.

description:

Organization Overview

At the YMCA of the Lowcountry, we are more than an organization — we are a cause. Together, we strengthen our community through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility. Our staff are at the heart of this mission, creating safe, welcoming environments where children grow, families thrive, and everyone feels a sense of belonging.


Role Overview

The American Red Cross CPR Instructor plays a critical role in promoting safety and preparedness by delivering high-quality CPR, First Aid, AED, and Lifeguarding certification courses. This position is responsible for teaching life-saving skills and ensuring that participants gain the knowledge and confidence needed to respond effectively in emergency situations.


The ideal candidate is passionate about safety education, demonstrates strong instructional and communication skills, and fosters a supportive, engaging learning environment aligned with the YMCA’s mission and commitment to community wellbeing.

Instruction & Course Delivery

  • Adapt teaching methods to accommodate various learning styles, skill levels, and age groups
  • Evaluate participant competency through practical skills assessment and written evaluations

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all training sessions comply with American Red Cross guidelines and YMCA safety policies
  • Maintain active supervision and ensure participant safety during all training activities
  • Promote safety awareness and emergency preparedness best practices
  • Maintain professional instruction standards and adhere to abuse prevention and professional boundary policies

Documentation & Administrative Support

Professional Development & Community Engagement

  • Maintain current American Red Cross Instructor certifications
  • Stay informed on updated safety standards, protocols, and instructional methods
  • Support YMCA staff certification needs and community safety initiatives
  • Promote training opportunities to staff, members, and the community

Minimum Qualifications

  • Current American Red Cross CPR/AED/First Aid Instructor certification required
  • Current CPR/AED/First Aid and Lifeguarding certifications preferred
  • Strong communication, presentation, and instructional skills
  • Ability to teach and evaluate participants in both classroom and hands-on environments
  • Commitment to YMCA mission, safety standards, and professional conduct

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous teaching, training, or adult education experience
  • Lifeguard certification and aquatic safety experience
  • Experience training diverse audiences
  • Background in safety training, public health, or emergency response

Benefits You’ll Receive

title: Undersköterska hemsjukvården
description:
Om oss

Mottagningen är belägen på Östermalm. Vi är en digifysisk vårdcentral med cirka 40 anställda som har ansvar för våra drygt 12 500 listade patienter, varav cirka 160 patienter inskrivna i vår hemsjukvård. Vår ambition är att erbjuda vård av hög kvalitet med bästa tänkbara tillgänglighet och service för alla åldrar. Vi arbetar i TakeCare.

Läs mer om oss:

Din roll

Vi söker en undersköterska för vår hemsjukvård. Vi erbjuder dig en positiv arbetsplats mitt i Stockholm.

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar självständigt arbete i hemsjukvården. I rollen som undersköterska hos oss får du ett stimulerande och omväxlande arbete där du tillsammans med kollegor ansvarar för att ge högkvalitativ och omtänksam vård till våra patienter.

Du samarbetar med övriga yrkeskategorier för att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för patienterna. Vårt arbetssätt präglas av ett respektfullt bemötande, lyhördhet och gott samarbete.

Om dig

Du är utbildad undersköterska och vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av arbete inom hemsjukvård. Du är van vid att arbeta självständigt, är trygg i din yrkesroll och intresserad av att ge vård av hög medicinsk kvalitet. Vi ser att du är ansvarstagande och har god organisationsförmåga.

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta heltid.

Ansökan

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Annonsen kan därför tas bort tidigare än planerat, så vänta inte – skicka in din ansökan redan idag.

I samband med anställning genomför vi bakgrundskontroll samt begär utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Tillträde: December 2026 eller enligt överenskommelse

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-11-15

Låter tjänsten intressant för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt all direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av jobbannonser.

title: Client Experience Executive
description:
Purpose of the job:

To help to deliver Foster Denovo’s Client Services Proposition by providing a high quality administration and support service to Partners and their high net worth clients, This allows our Partners to focus on the client relationship and developing relationships with new clients.

Job summary:

  • Working within the Private Wealth team, the role holder will support one of our partners.

  • The role holder will influence and encourage the Partner to work efficiently following our Private Wealth Advice Process including using the documentation provided and ensuring that their clients benefit from the efficiencies provided by our supercharged processes, systems and tools.

    requirements and Compliance processes in which Foster Denovo operate.

  • To have a good understanding of the workflow and be able to deliver and report

    updates from the providers until the plan is in force or the investment has been
    made, keeping the client and Partner(s) updated.

  • To input any electronic applications forms as required.

  • To familiarise themselves with each clients circumstances, objectives and
    timescales to ensure that we are able to deliver against or where possible exceed
    the clients expectations by providing a personalised service.

  • To provide regular updates to the Partner(s) to ensure that the clients are
    kept fully updated and value the service they receive from Foster Denovo.

  • To participate in appropriate company and departmental training, competence and
    development initiatives.

  • To undertake any other duties commensurate with your role, skills and experience.

  • In line with Foster Denovo’s service excellence programme, they will be expected to provide exceptional client service at all times. They will be required to keep up to date with all relevant organisational training and best practice to enable this standard to be met.

Key skills and personal attributes:

  • A positive, friendly service-orientated person with a “can do” attitude who is aware of the important role played by advisers and their staff in providing financial advice.

  • An articulate communicator at all levels

  • Hard working and responsive to the need to deliver a high-quality support service.

Essential:

Foster Denovo currently boast over 120 Financial Advisers supported by around 300 employees across eight Foster Denovo offices throughout the UK. We have the scale and resource to provide exceptional advice and service to our clients, advisers and employees.

Our stakeholder community is an invisible bond that gives Foster Denovo its solid foundations. It also means that our people care about our reputation and brand. And as such, we aim to delight every client we come into contact with.

When you join the Foster Denovo family, you benefit from our enviable reputation and years of industry experience. In everything we do, we’re driven by a firm set of core values, and our friendly, stakeholder culture has been praised by employees, clients and partners alike.

Foster Denovo are also proud to hold the platinum investors in people accreditation which shows a clear commitment to the people who make us an employer of choice.

Foster Denovo has an open, mutually supportive, knowledge-sharing culture. It’s a culture that has created the space to think differently for the benefit of our clients.
